verses.en: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.
verses.fr: Heureux l''homme qui ne marche pas selon le conseil des méchants, Qui ne s''arrête pas sur la voie des pécheurs, Et qui ne s''assied pas en compagnie des moqueurs,
verses.am: ምስጉን ነው በክፉዎች ምክር ያልሄደ፥ በኃጢአተኞችም መንገድ ያልቆመ፥ በዋዘኞችም ወንበር ያልተቀመጠ።

verses.en: But his delight is in the law of the Lord; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
verses.fr: Mais qui trouve son plaisir dans la loi de l''Eternel, Et qui la médite jour et nuit!
verses.am: ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ሕግ ደስ ይለዋል፥ ሕጉንም በቀንና በሌሊት ያስባል።

verses.en: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
verses.fr: Il est comme un arbre planté près d''un courant d''eau, Qui donne son fruit en sa saison, Et dont le feuillage ne se flétrit point: Tout ce qu''il fait lui réussit.
verses.am: እርሱም በውኃ ፈሳሾች ዳር እንደ ተተከለች፥ ፍሬዋን በየጊዜዋ እንደምትሰጥ፥ ቅጠልዋም እንደማይረግፍ ዛፍ ይሆናል፤ የሚሠራውም ሁሉ ይከናወንለታል።

verses.en: The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.
verses.fr: Il n''en est pas ainsi des méchants: Ils sont comme la paille que le vent dissipe.
verses.am: ክፉዎች እንዲህ አይደሉም፥ ነገር ግን ነፋስ ጠርጎ እንደሚወስደው ትቢያ ናቸው።

verses.en: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi les méchants ne résistent pas au jour du jugement, Ni les pécheurs dans l''assemblée des justes;
verses.am: ስለዚህ ክፉዎች በፍርድ፥ ኃጢአተኞችም በጻድቃን ማኅበር አይቆሙም።

verses.en: For the Lord knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel connaît la voie des justes, Et la voie des pécheurs mène à la ruine.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የጻድቃንን መንገድ ያውቃልና፥ የክፉዎች መንገድ ግን ትጠፋለች።

verses.en: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?
verses.fr: Pourquoi ce tumulte parmi les nations, Ces vaines pensées parmi les peuples?
verses.am: አሕዛብ ለምን ያጕረመርማሉ? ወገኖችስ ለምን ከንቱን ይናገራሉ?

verses.en: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord, and against his anointed, saying,
verses.fr: Pourquoi les rois de la terre se soulèvent-ils Et les princes se liguent-ils avec eux Contre l''Eternel et contre son oint? -
verses.am: የምድር ነገሥታት ተነሡ፥ አለቆችም በእግዚአብሔርና በመሢሑ ላይ እንዲህ ሲሉ ተማከሩ።

verses.en: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.
verses.fr: Brisons leurs liens, Délivrons-nous de leurs chaînes! -
verses.am: ማሰርያቸውን እንበጥስ፥ ገመዳቸውንም ከእኛ እንጣል።

verses.en: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the Lord shall have them in derision.
verses.fr: Celui qui siège dans les cieux rit, Le Seigneur se moque d''eux.
verses.am: በሰማይ የሚኖር እርሱ ይሥቃል፥ ጌታም ይሣለቅባቸዋል።

verses.en: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.
verses.fr: Puis il leur parle dans sa colère, Il les épouvante dans sa fureur:
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ በቍጣው ይናገራቸዋል፥ በመዓቱም ያውካቸዋል።

verses.en: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.
verses.fr: C''est moi qui ai oint mon roi Sur Sion, ma montagne sainte!
verses.am: እኔ ግን ንጉሤን ሾምሁ በተቀደሰው ተራራዬ በጽዮን ላይ።

verses.en: I will declare the decree: the Lord hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.
verses.fr: Je publierai le décret; L''Eternel m''a dit: Tu es mon fils! Je t''ai engendré aujourd''hui.
verses.am: ትእዛዙን እናገራለሁ፤ እግዚአብሔር አለኝ። አንተ ልጄ ነህ፥ እኔ ዛሬ ወለድሁህ።

verses.en: Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.
verses.fr: Demande-moi et je te donnerai les nations pour héritage, Les extrémités de la terre pour possession;
verses.am: ለምነኝ፥ አሕዛብን ለርስትህ የምድርንም ዳርቻ ለግዛትህ እሰጥሃለሁ።

verses.en: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.
verses.fr: Tu les briseras avec une verge de fer, Tu les briseras comme le vase d''un potier.
verses.am: በብረት በትር ትጠብቃቸዋለህ፥ እንደ ሸክላ ሠሪ ዕቃዎች ትቀጠቅጣቸዋለህ።

verses.en: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.
verses.fr: Et maintenant, rois, conduisez-vous avec sagesse! Juges de la terre, recevez instruction!
verses.am: አሁንም እናንት ነገሥታት፥ ልብ አድርጉ፤ እናንት የምድር ፈራጆችም፥ ተገሠጹ።

verses.en: Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
verses.fr: Servez l''Eternel avec crainte, Et réjouissez-vous avec tremblement.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር በፍርሃት ተገዙ፥ በረዓድም ደስ ይበላችሁ።

verses.en: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.
verses.fr: Baisez le fils, de peur qu''il ne s''irrite, Et que vous ne périssiez dans votre voie, Car sa colère est prompte à s''enflammer. Heureux tous ceux qui se confient en lui!
verses.am: ተግሣጹን ተቀበሉ ጌታ እንዳይቈጣ እናንተም በመንገድ እንዳትጠፉ፥ ቍጣው ፈጥና ትነድዳለችና። በእርሱ የታመኑ ሁሉ የተመሰገኑ ናቸው።

verses.en: Lord, how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.
verses.fr: Psaume de David. A l''occasion de sa fuite devant Absalom, son fils. O Eternel, que mes ennemis sont nombreux! Quelle multitude se lève contre moi!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የሚያስጨንቁኝ ምንኛ በዙ! በኔ ላይ የሚቆሙት ብዙ ናቸው።

verses.en: Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. Selah.
verses.fr: Combien qui disent à mon sujet: Plus de salut pour lui auprès de Dieu! -Pause.
verses.am: ብዙ ሰዎች ነፍሴን። አምላክሽ አያድንሽም አልዋት።

verses.en: But thou, O Lord, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.
verses.fr: Mais toi, ô Eternel! tu es mon bouclier, Tu es ma gloire, et tu relèves ma tête.
verses.am: አንተ ግን አቤቱ፥ መጠጊያዬ ነህ፥ ክብሬንና ራሴንም ከፍ ከፍ የምታደርገው አንተ ነህ።

verses.en: I cried unto the Lord with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.
verses.fr: De ma voix je crie à l''Eternel, Et il me répond de sa montagne sainte. -Pause.
verses.am: በቃሌ ወደ እግዚአብሔር እጮሃለሁ ከተቀደሰ ተራራውም ይሰማኛል።

verses.en: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the Lord sustained me.
verses.fr: Je me couche, et je m''endors; Je me réveille, car l''Eternel est mon soutien.
verses.am: እኔ ተኛሁ አንቀላፋሁም፤ እግዚአብሔርም ደግፎኛልና ነቃሁ።

verses.en: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.
verses.fr: Je ne crains pas les myriades de peuples Qui m''assiègent de toutes parts.
verses.am: ከሚከብቡኝ ከአእላፍ ሕዝብ አልፈራም።

verses.en: Arise, O Lord; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.
verses.fr: Lève-toi, Eternel! sauve-moi, mon Dieu! Car tu frappes à la joue tous mes ennemis, Tu brises les dents des méchants.
verses.am: ተነሥ፥ አቤቱ፤ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ አድነኝ፤ አንተ የጠላቶቼን መንጋጋ መትተሃልና፥ የክፉዎችንም ጥርስ ሰብረሃልና።

verses.en: Salvation belongeth unto the Lord: thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.
verses.fr: Le salut est auprès de l''Eternel: Que ta bénédiction soit sur ton peuple! -Pause.
verses.am: ማዳን የእግዚአብሔር ነው፥ በረከትህም በሕዝብህ ላይ ነው።

verses.en: Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Avec instruments à cordes. Psaume de David. Quand je crie, réponds-moi, Dieu de ma justice! Quand je suis dans la détresse, sauve-moi! Aie pitié de moi, écoute ma prière!
verses.am: የጽድቄ አምላክ በጠራሁት ጊዜ መለሰልኝ፥ በጭንቀቴም አሰፋህልኝ፤ ማረኝ፥ ጸሎቴንም ስማ።

verses.en: O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.
verses.fr: Fils des hommes, jusques à quand ma gloire sera-t-elle outragée? Jusques à quand aimerez-vous la vanité, Chercherez-vous le mensonge? -Pause.
verses.am: እናንት የሰው ልጆች፥ እስከ መቼ ድረስ ልባችሁን ታከብዳላችሁ?

verses.en: But know that the Lord hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the Lord will hear when I call unto him.
verses.fr: Sachez que l''Eternel s''est choisi un homme pieux; L''Eternel entend, quand je crie à lui.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በጻድቁ እንደ ተገለጠ እወቁ፤ እግዚአብሔር ወደ እርሱ በተጣራሁ ጊዜ ይሰማኛል።

verses.en: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.
verses.fr: Tremblez, et ne péchez point; Parlez en vos coeurs sur votre couche, puis taisez-vous. -Pause.
verses.am: ተቈጡ፥ ነገር ግን ኃጢአትን አታድርጉ፤ በመኝታችሁ ሳላችሁ በልባችሁ አስቡ፤ ዝም በሉ።

verses.en: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the Lord.
verses.fr: Offrez des sacrifices de justice, Et confiez-vous à l''Eternel.
verses.am: የጽድቅን መሥዋዕት ሠዉ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ታመኑ።

verses.en: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? Lord, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.
verses.fr: Plusieurs disent: Qui nous fera voir le bonheur? Fais lever sur nous la lumière de ta face, ô Eternel!
verses.am: በጎውን ማን ያሳየናል? የሚሉ ብዙ ናቸው። አቤቱ፥ የፊትህ ብርሃን በላያችን ታወቀ።

verses.en: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.
verses.fr: Tu mets dans mon coeur plus de joie qu''ils n''en ont Quand abondent leur froment et leur moût.
verses.am: በልቤ ደስታን ጨመርህ፤ ከስንዴ ፍሬና ከወይን ከዘይትም ይልቅ በዛ።

verses.en: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, Lord, only makest me dwell in safety.
verses.fr: Je me couche et je m''endors en paix, Car toi seul, ô Eternel! tu me donnes la sécurité dans ma demeure.
verses.am: በሰላም እተኛለሁ አንቀላፋለሁም፤ አቤቱ፥ አንተ ብቻህን በእምነት አሳድረኸኛልና።

verses.en: Give ear to my words, O Lord, consider my meditation.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Avec les flûtes. Psaume de David. Prête l''oreille à mes paroles, ô Eternel! Ecoute mes gémissements!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ቃሌን አድምጥ፥ ጩኸቴንም አስተውል፤

verses.en: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.
verses.fr: Sois attentif à mes cris, mon roi et mon Dieu! C''est à toi que j''adresse ma prière.
verses.am: የልመናዬን ቃል አድምጥ፥ ንጉሤና አምላኬ ሆይ፥ አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ እጸልያለሁና።

verses.en: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O Lord; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
verses.fr: Eternel! le matin tu entends ma voix; Le matin je me tourne vers toi, et je regarde.
verses.am: በማለዳ ድምፄን ትሰማለህ፥ በማለዳ በፊትህ እቆማለሁ፥ እጠብቃለሁም።

verses.en: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.
verses.fr: Car tu n''es point un Dieu qui prenne plaisir au mal; Le méchant n''a pas sa demeure auprès de toi.
verses.am: አንተ በደልን የማትወድድ አምላክ ነህና፤ ክፉ ከአንተ ጋር አያድርም።

verses.en: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
verses.fr: Les insensés ne subsistent pas devant tes yeux; Tu hais tous ceux qui commettent l''iniquité.
verses.am: በከንቱ የሚመኩ በዓይኖችህ ፊት አይኖሩም፤ ክፉ አድራጊዎችን ሁሉ ጠላህ።

verses.en: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the Lord will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.
verses.fr: Tu fais périr les menteurs; L''Eternel abhorre les hommes de sang et de fraude.
verses.am: ሐሰትን የሚናገሩትን ታጠፋቸዋለህ፤ ደም አፍሳሹንና ሸንጋዩን ሰው እግዚአብሔር ይጸየፋል።

verses.en: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.
verses.fr: Mais moi, par ta grande miséricorde, je vais à ta maison, Je me prosterne dans ton saint temple avec crainte.
verses.am: እኔ ግን በምሕረትህ ብዛት ወደ ቤትህ እገባለሁ፤ አንተን በመፍራት ወደ ቅድስናህ መቅደስ እሰግዳለሁ።

verses.en: Lead me, O Lord, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.
verses.fr: Eternel! conduis-moi dans ta justice, à cause de mes ennemis, Aplanis ta voie sous mes pas.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ስለ ጠላቶቼ በጽድቅህ ምራኝ፤ መንገዴን በፊትህ አቅና።

verses.en: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.
verses.fr: Car il n''y a point de sincérité dans leur bouche; Leur coeur est rempli de malice, Leur gosier est un sépulcre ouvert, Et ils ont sur la langue des paroles flatteuses.
verses.am: በአፋቸው እውነት የለምና፥ ልባቸውም ከንቱ ነው፤ ጕሮሮአቸው የተከፈተ መቃብር ነው፤ በምላሳቸው ይሸነግላሉ።

verses.en: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.
verses.fr: Frappe-les comme des coupables, ô Dieu! Que leurs desseins amènent leur chute! Précipite-les au milieu de leurs péchés sans nombre! Car ils se révoltent contre toi.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ፍረድባቸው፥ በምክራቸውም ይውደቁ፤ ስለ ክፋታቸውም ብዛት አሳድዳቸው፥ እነርሱ ዐምፀውብሃልና።

verses.en: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.
verses.fr: Alors tous ceux qui se confient en toi se réjouiront, Ils auront de l''allégresse à toujours, et tu les protégeras; Tu seras un sujet de joie Pour ceux qui aiment ton nom.
verses.am: በአንተ የሚታመኑት ሁሉ ግን ደስ ይላቸዋል፤ ለዘላለሙ ደስ ይላቸዋል፥ እነርሱንም ትጠብቃለህ፤ ስምህንም የሚወድዱ ሁሉ በአንተ ይመካሉ።

verses.en: For thou, Lord, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.
verses.fr: Car tu bénis le juste, ô Eternel! Tu l''entoures de ta grâce comme d''un bouclier.
verses.am: አንተ ጻድቁን ትባርከዋለህና፤ አቤቱ፥ እንደ ጋሻ በሞገስ ከለልኸን።

verses.en: O Lord, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Avec instruments à cordes. Sur la harpe à huit cordes. Psaume de David. Eternel! ne me punis pas dans ta colère, Et ne me châtie pas dans ta fureur.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በቍጣህ አትቅሠፈኝ፥ በመዓትህም አትገሥጸኝ።

verses.en: Have mercy upon me, O Lord; for I am weak: O Lord, heal me; for my bones are vexed.
verses.fr: Aie pitié de moi, Eternel! car je suis sans force; Guéris-moi, Eternel! car mes os sont tremblants.
verses.am: ድውይ ነኝና አቤቱ፥ ማረኝ፤ አጥንቶቼ ታውከዋልና ፈውሰኝ።

verses.en: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O Lord, how long?
verses.fr: Mon âme est toute troublée; Et toi, Eternel! jusques à quand?...
verses.am: ነፍሴም እጅግ ታወከች፤ አንተም አቤቱ፥ እስከ መቼ ድረስ ነው?

verses.en: Return, O Lord, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies' sake.
verses.fr: Reviens, Eternel! délivre mon âme; Sauve-moi, à cause de ta miséricorde.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ተመለስ ነፍሴንም አድናት፥ ስለ ቸርነትህም አድነኝ።

verses.en: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?
verses.fr: Car celui qui meurt n''a plus ton souvenir; Qui te louera dans le séjour des morts?
verses.am: በሞት የሚያስብህ የለምና፥ በሲኦልም የሚያመሰግንህ ማን ነው?

verses.en: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
verses.fr: Je m''épuise à force de gémir; Chaque nuit ma couche est baignée de mes larmes, Mon lit est arrosé de mes pleurs.
verses.am: በጭንቀቴ ደክሜያለሁ፤ ሌሊቱን ሁሉ አልጋዬን አጥባለሁ፥ በዕንባዬም መኝታዬን አርሳለሁ።

verses.en: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.
verses.fr: J''ai le visage usé par le chagrin; Tous ceux qui me persécutent le font vieillir.
verses.am: ዓይኔ ከቍጡ ዕንባ የተነሣ ታወከች፤ ከጠላቶቼ ሁሉ የተነሣ አረጀሁ።

verses.en: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the Lord hath heard the voice of my weeping.
verses.fr: Eloignez-vous de moi, vous tous qui faites le mal! Car l''Eternel entend la voix de mes larmes;
verses.am: ዓመፃን የምታደርጉ ሁሉ፥ ከእኔ ራቁ፥ እግዚአብሔር የልቅሶዬን ቃል ሰምቶአልና።

verses.en: The Lord hath heard my supplication; the Lord will receive my prayer.
verses.fr: L''Eternel exauce mes supplications, L''Eternel accueille ma prière.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ልመናዬን ሰማኝ፤ እግዚአብሔር ጸሎቴን ተቀበለ።

verses.en: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.
verses.fr: Tous mes ennemis sont confondus, saisis d''épouvante; Ils reculent, soudain couverts de honte.
verses.am: ጠላቶቼ ሁሉ ይፈሩ እጅግም ይጐስቍሉ፤ ወደ ኋላቸው ይመለሱ፥ በፍጥነትም ይፈሩ።

verses.en: O Lord my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:
verses.fr: Complainte de David. Chantée à l''Eternel, au sujet de Cusch, Benjamite. Eternel, mon Dieu! je cherche en toi mon refuge; Sauve-moi de tous mes persécuteurs, et délivre-moi,
verses.am: አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ በአንተ ታመንሁ፤ ከሚያሳድዱኝ ሁሉ አድነኝና አውጣኝ፥

verses.en: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.
verses.fr: Afin qu''ils ne me déchirent pas, comme un lion Qui dévore sans que personne vienne au secours.
verses.am: ነፍሴን እንደ አንበሳ ነጥቀው እንዳይሰብሩዋት፥ የሚያድንና የሚታደግ ሳይኖር።

verses.en: O Lord my God, If I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;
verses.fr: Eternel, mon Dieu! si j''ai fait cela, S''il y a de l''iniquité dans mes mains,
verses.am: አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ እንዲህስ ካደረግሁ፥ ዓመፃም በእጄ ቢኖር፥

verses.en: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)
verses.fr: Si j''ai rendu le mal à celui qui était paisible envers moi, Si j''ai dépouillé celui qui m''opprimait sans cause,
verses.am: ክፉ ላደረጉብኝም ክፉን መልሼላቸው ብሆን፥ ጠላቴንም በከንቱ ገፍቼው ብሆን፥

verses.en: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.
verses.fr: Que l''ennemi me poursuive et m''atteigne, Qu''il foule à terre ma vie, Et qu''il couche ma gloire dans la poussière! -Pause.
verses.am: ጠላት ነፍሴን ያሳድዳት ያግኛትም፥ ሕይወቴንም በምድር ላይ ይርገጣት፥ ክብሬንም በትቢያ ላይ ያዋርዳት።

verses.en: Arise, O Lord, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded.
verses.fr: Lève-toi, ô Eternel! dans ta colère, Lève-toi contre la fureur de mes adversaires, Réveille-toi pour me secourir, ordonne un jugement!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በመዓትህ ተነሥ፥ በጠላቶቼ ላይ በቍጣ ተነሣባቸው፤ አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ ባዘዝኸው ትእዛዝ ንቃ።

verses.en: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.
verses.fr: Que l''assemblée des peuples t''environne! Monte au-dessus d''elle vers les lieux élevés!
verses.am: የአሕዛብም ጉባኤ ይከብብሃል፥ በእነርሱም ላይ ወደ ከፍታ ተመለስ።

verses.en: The Lord shall judge the people: judge me, O Lord, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.
verses.fr: L''Eternel juge les peuples: Rends-moi justice, ô Eternel! Selon mon droit et selon mon innocence!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በአሕዛብ ይፈርዳል፤ አቤቱ፥ እንደ ጽድቄ ፍረድልኝ፥ እንደ የዋህነቴም ይሁንልኝ።

verses.en: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.
verses.fr: Mets un terme à la malice des méchants, Et affermis le juste, Toi qui sondes les coeurs et les reins, Dieu juste!
verses.am: የኃጥኣን ክፋት ይጥፋ፥ ጻድቁን ግን አቅና፤ እግዚአብሔር ልቡናንና ኵላሊትን ይመረምራል።

verses.en: My defence is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.
verses.fr: Mon bouclier est en Dieu, Qui sauve ceux dont le coeur est droit.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የጽድቅ ጋሻዬ ነው ልበ ቅኖችን የሚያድናቸው።

verses.en: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every day.
verses.fr: Dieu est un juste juge, Dieu s''irrite en tout temps.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የእውነት ዳኛ ነው፥ ኃይለኛም ታጋሽም ነው፥ ሁልጊዜም አይቈጣም።

verses.en: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.
verses.fr: Si le méchant ne se convertit pas, il aiguise son glaive, Il bande son arc, et il vise;
verses.am: ባትመለሱ ግን ሰይፉን ይስላል፥ ቀስቱን ገተረ አዘጋጀም፤

verses.en: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.
verses.fr: Il dirige sur lui des traits meurtriers, Il rend ses flèches brûlantes.
verses.am: የሞት መሣርያንም አዘጋጀበት፥ ፍላጻዎቹንም የሚቃጠሉ አደረገ።

verses.en: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.
verses.fr: Voici, le méchant prépare le mal, Il conçoit l''iniquité, et il enfante le néant.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በዓመፃ ተጨነቀ ጉዳትን ፀነሰ ኃጢአትንም ወለደ።

verses.en: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.
verses.fr: Il ouvre une fosse, il la creuse, Et il tombe dans la fosse qu''il a faite.
verses.am: ጕድጓድን ማሰ ቈፈረም። ባደረገውም ጕድጓድ ይወድቃል።

verses.en: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.
verses.fr: Son iniquité retombe sur sa tête, Et sa violence redescend sur son front.
verses.am: ጉዳቱ በራሱ ይመለሳል፥ ዓመፃውም በአናቱ ላይ ትወርዳለች።

verses.en: I will praise the Lord according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the Lord most high.
verses.fr: Je louerai l''Eternel à cause de sa justice, Je chanterai le nom de l''Eternel, du Très-Haut.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን እንደ ጽድቁ መጠን አመሰግናለሁ፥ ለልዑል እግዚአብሔርም ስም እዘምራለሁ።

verses.en: O Lord, our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Sur la guitthith. Psaume de David. Eternel, notre Seigneur! Que ton nom est magnifique sur toute la terre! Ta majesté s''élève au-dessus des cieux.
verses.am: አቤቱ ጌታችን፥ ስምህ በምድር ሁሉ እጅግ ተመሰገነ፥ ምስጋናህ በሰማዮች ላይ ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአልና።

verses.en: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
verses.fr: Par la bouche des enfants et de ceux qui sont à la mamelle Tu as fondé ta gloire, pour confondre tes adversaires, Pour imposer silence à l''ennemi et au vindicatif.
verses.am: ከሕፃናትና ከሚጠቡ ልጆች አፍ ምስጋናን አዘጋጀህ ስለ ጠላትህ፥ ጠላትንና ቂመኛን ለማጥፋት።

verses.en: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
verses.fr: Quand je contemple les cieux, ouvrage de tes mains, La lune et les étoiles que tu as créées:
verses.am: የጣቶችህን ሥራ ሰማዮችን ባየሁ ጊዜ፥ ጨረቃንና ከዋክብትን አንተ የሠራሃቸውን፥

verses.en: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
verses.fr: Qu''est-ce que l''homme, pour que tu te souviennes de lui? Et le fils de l''homme, pour que tu prennes garde à lui?
verses.am: ታስበው ዘንድ ሰው ምንድር ነው? ትጐበኘውም ዘንድ የሰው ልጅ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.
verses.fr: Tu l''as fait de peu inférieur à Dieu, Et tu l''as couronné de gloire et de magnificence.
verses.am: ከመላእክት እጅግ ጥቂት አሳነስኸው፤ በክብርና በምስጋና ዘውድ ከለልኸው።

verses.en: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:
verses.fr: Tu lui as donné la domination sur les oeuvres de tes mains, Tu as tout mis sous ses pieds,
verses.am: በእጆችህም ሥራ ሁሉ ላይ ሾምኸው፤ ሁሉን ከእግሮቹ በታች አስገዛህለት፥

verses.en: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;
verses.fr: Les brebis comme les boeufs, Et les animaux des champs,
verses.am: በጎችንም ላሞችንም ሁሉ ደግሞም የምድረ በዳውን እንስሶች፥

verses.en: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.
verses.fr: Les oiseaux du ciel et les poissons de la mer, Tout ce qui parcourt les sentiers des mers.
verses.am: የሰማይንም ወፎች የባሕርንም ዓሦች፥ በባሕር መንገድ የሚሄደውንም ሁሉ።

verses.en: O Lord our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!
verses.fr: Eternel, notre Seigneur! Que ton nom est magnifique sur toute la terre!
verses.am: አቤቱ ጌታችን፥ ስምህ በምድር ሁሉ እጅግ ተመሰገነ።

verses.en: I will praise thee, O Lord, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Sur Meurs pour le fils. Psaume de David. Je louerai l''Eternel de tout mon coeur, Je raconterai toutes tes merveilles.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በልቤ ሁሉ አመሰግንሃለሁ፥ ተአምራትህንም ሁሉ እነግራለሁ።

verses.en: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.
verses.fr: Je ferai de toi le sujet de ma joie et de mon allégresse, Je chanterai ton nom, Dieu Très-Haut!
verses.am: በአንተ ደስ ይለኛል፥ ሐሤትንም አደርጋለሁ፤ ልዑል ሆይ፥ ለስምህ እዘምራለሁ።

verses.en: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.
verses.fr: Mes ennemis reculent, Ils chancellent, ils périssent devant ta face.
verses.am: ጠላቶቼ ወደ ኋላ በተመለሱ ጊዜ፥ ይሰናከላሉ ከፊትህም ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.
verses.fr: Car tu soutiens mon droit et ma cause, Tu sièges sur ton trône en juste juge.
verses.am: ፍርዴንና በቀሌን አድርገህልኛልና፤ ጽድቅን እየፈረድህ በዙፋንህ ላይ ተቀመጥህ።

verses.en: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.
verses.fr: Tu châties les nations, tu détruis le méchant, Tu effaces leur nom pour toujours et à perpétuité.
verses.am: አሕዛብን ገሠጽህ፥ ዝንጉዎችንም አጠፋህ፥ ስማቸውንም ለዘላለም ደመሰስህ።

verses.en: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.
verses.fr: Plus d''ennemis! Des ruines éternelles! Des villes que tu as renversées! Leur souvenir est anéanti.
verses.am: ጠላቶች በጦር ለዘላለም ጠፉ፥ ከተሞቻቸውንም አፈረስህ፥ ዝክራቸውም በአንድነት ጠፋ።

verses.en: But the Lord shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.
verses.fr: L''Eternel règne à jamais, Il a dressé son trône pour le jugement;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን ለዘላለም ይኖራል፥ ዙፋኑንም ለመፍረድ አዘጋጀ፤

verses.en: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.
verses.fr: Il juge le monde avec justice, Il juge les peuples avec droiture.
verses.am: እርሱም ዓለምን በጽድቅ ይፈርዳታል፥ አሕዛብንም በቅንነት ይዳኛቸዋል።

verses.en: The Lord also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est un refuge pour l''opprimé, Un refuge au temps de la détresse.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለድሆች መጠጊያ ሆናቸው፥ እርሱም በመከራቸው ጊዜ ረዳታቸው ነው።

verses.en: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, Lord, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
verses.fr: Ceux qui connaissent ton nom se confient en toi. Car tu n''abandonnes pas ceux qui te cherchent, ô Eternel!
verses.am: ስምህን የሚያውቁ ሁሉ በአንተ ይታመናሉ፥ አቤቱ፥ የሚሹህን አትተዋቸውምና።

verses.en: Sing praises to the Lord, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.
verses.fr: Chantez à l''Eternel, qui réside en Sion, Publiez parmi les peuples ses hauts faits!
verses.am: በጽዮን ለሚኖር ለእግዚአብሔር ዘምሩ፥ በአሕዛብም መካከል አደራረጉን ንገሩ፤

verses.en: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.
verses.fr: Car il venge le sang et se souvient des malheureux, Il n''oublie pas leurs cris.
verses.am: ደማቸውን የሚመራመር እርሱ አስቦአልና፥ የድሆችንም ጩኸት አልረሳምና።

verses.en: Have mercy upon me, O Lord; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:
verses.fr: Aie pitié de moi, Eternel! Vois la misère où me réduisent mes ennemis, Enlève-moi des portes de la mort,
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እዘንልኝ፥ ጠላቶቼም የሚያመጡብኝን መከራ እይ፥ ከሞት ደጆች ከፍ ከፍ የምታደርገኝ፤

verses.en: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.
verses.fr: Afin que je publie toutes tes louanges, Dans les portes de la fille de Sion, Et que je me réjouisse de ton salut.
verses.am: ምስጋናውን ሁሉ እናገር ዘንድ፤ በጽዮን ልጅ በደጆችዋ በማዳንህ ደስ ይለኛል።

verses.en: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
verses.fr: Les nations tombent dans la fosse qu''elles ont faite, Leur pied se prend au filet qu''elles ont caché.
verses.am: አሕዛብ በሠሩት ጕድጓድ ወደቁ፥ በዚያችም በሸሸጓት ወጥመድ እግራቸው ተጠመደች።

verses.en: The Lord is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
verses.fr: L''Eternel se montre, il fait justice, Il enlace le méchant dans l''oeuvre de ses mains. -Jeu d''instruments. Pause.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ፍርድን በማድረግ የታወቀ ነው፤ ኃጢአተኛው በእጆቹ ሥራ ተጠመደ።

verses.en: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget God.
verses.fr: Les méchants se tournent vers le séjour des morts, Toutes les nations qui oublient Dieu.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኞች ወደ ሲኦል ይመለሳሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርን የሚረሱ አሕዛብም ሁሉ።

verses.en: For the needy shall not always be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.
verses.fr: Car le malheureux n''est point oublié à jamais, L''espérance des misérables ne périt pas à toujours.
verses.am: ድሀ ለዘላለም አይረሳምና፥ የችግረኞችም ተስፋቸው ለዘላለም አይጠፋም።

verses.en: Arise, O Lord; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.
verses.fr: Lève-toi, ô Eternel! Que l''homme ne triomphe pas! Que les nations soient jugées devant ta face!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ተነሥ፤ ሰውም አይበርታ፥ አሕዛብም በፊትህ ይፈረድባቸው።

verses.en: Put them in fear, O Lord: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.
verses.fr: Frappe-les d''épouvante, ô Eternel! Que les peuples sachent qu''ils sont des hommes! -Pause.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ፍርሃትን በላያቸው ጫንባቸው፤ አሕዛብ ሰዎች እንደ ሆኑ ይወቁ።

verses.en: Why standest thou afar off, O Lord? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?
verses.fr: Pourquoi, ô Eternel! te tiens-tu éloigné? Pourquoi te caches-tu au temps de la détresse?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ለምን ርቀህ ቆምህ? በመከራም ጊዜ ለምን ትሰወራለህ?

verses.en: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.
verses.fr: Le méchant dans son orgueil poursuit les malheureux, Ils sont victimes des trames qu''il a conçues.
verses.am: በኃጢአተኛ ትዕቢት ድሀ ይናደዳል፤ ባሰቡት ተንኰላቸው ተጠመዱ።

verses.en: For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the Lord abhorreth.
verses.fr: Car le méchant se glorifie de sa convoitise, Et le ravisseur outrage, méprise l''Eternel.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኛ በነፍሱ ፈቃድ ይወደሳልና፥ ዓመፀኛም ይባርካል።

verses.en: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.
verses.fr: Le méchant dit avec arrogance: Il ne punit pas! Il n''y a point de Dieu! -Voilà toutes ses pensées.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኛ እግዚአብሔርን አበሳጨው፥ እንደ ቍጣውም ብዛት አይመራመረውም በእርሱ ፊት እግዚአብሔር የለም።

verses.en: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.
verses.fr: Ses voies réussissent en tout temps; Tes jugements sont trop élevés pour l''atteindre, Il souffle contre tous ses adversaires.
verses.am: መንገዱ ሁሉ የረከሰ ነው፥ ፍርድህም በፊቱ የፈረሰ ነው፥ ጠላቶችንም ሁሉ ይገዛቸዋል።

verses.en: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.
verses.fr: Il dit en son coeur: Je ne chancelle pas, Je suis pour toujours à l''abri du malheur!
verses.am: በልቡ ይላል። ለልጅ ልጅ አልታወክም ክፉም አያገኘኝም።

verses.en: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.
verses.fr: Sa bouche est pleine de malédictions, de tromperies et de fraudes; Il y a sous sa langue de la malice et de l''iniquité.
verses.am: አፉ መርገምንና ሽንገላን ተንኰልን የተመላ ነው፤ ከምላሱ በታች ጉዳትና መከራ ነው።

verses.en: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.
verses.fr: Il se tient en embuscade près des villages, Il assassine l''innocent dans des lieux écartés; Ses yeux épient le malheureux.
verses.am: በመንደሮች መሸመቅያ ይቀመጣል ንጹሓንን በስውር ይገድል ዘንድ፤ ዓይኖቹም ወደ ድኃ ይመለከታሉ።

verses.en: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.
verses.fr: Il est aux aguets dans sa retraite, comme le lion dans sa tanière, Il est aux aguets pour surprendre le malheureux; Il le surprend et l''attire dans son filet.
verses.am: እንደ አንበሳ በችፍግ ዱር በስውር ይሸምቃል፤ ድሀውን ለመንጠቅ ያደባል፤ ድሀውን ይነጥቀዋል በአሽክላውም ይስበዋል።

verses.en: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.
verses.fr: Il se courbe, il se baisse, Et les misérables tombent dans ses griffes.
verses.am: ድሀ ይዋረዳል፥ ይጐብጣል፤ በኃያላኑም እጅግ ይወድቃል።

verses.en: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.
verses.fr: Il dit en son coeur: Dieu oublie! Il cache sa face, il ne regarde jamais!
verses.am: በልቡም ይላል። እግዚአብሔር ረስቶኛል፤ ፈጽሞም እንዳያይ ፊቱን ሰወረ።

verses.en: Arise, O Lord; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.
verses.fr: Lève-toi, Eternel! ô Dieu, lève ta main! N''oublie pas les malheureux!
verses.am: አቤቱ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ተነሥ እጅህም ከፍ ከፍ ትበል፤ ድሆችን አትርሳ።

verses.en: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require it.
verses.fr: Pourquoi le méchant méprise-t-il Dieu? Pourquoi dit-il en son coeur: Tu ne punis pas?
verses.am: ኃጢአተኛ ስለ ምን እግዚአብሔርን አስቈጣው? በልቡ። አይመራመረኝም ይላልና።

verses.en: Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.
verses.fr: Tu regardes cependant, car tu vois la peine et la souffrance, Pour prendre en main leur cause; C''est à toi que s''abandonne le malheureux, C''est toi qui viens en aide à l''orphelin.
verses.am: አየኸው፥ አንተ ክፋትንና ቍጣን ትመለከታለህና በእጅህ ፍዳውን ለመስጠት፤ ድሀ ራሱን ለአንተ ይተዋል፥ ለድሀ አደግም ረዳቱ አንተ ነህ።

verses.en: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.
verses.fr: Brise le bras du méchant, Punis ses iniquités, et qu''il disparaisse à tes yeux!
verses.am: የኃጢአተኛንና የክፉን ክንድ ስበር፥ የኃጢአቱንም ብድራት ክፈል ሌላ እስከማይገኝ ድረስ።

verses.en: The Lord is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est roi à toujours et à perpétuité; Les nations sont exterminées de son pays.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም ይነግሣል፤ አሕዛብ ከምድሩ ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: Lord, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:
verses.fr: Tu entends les voeux de ceux qui souffrent, ô Eternel! Tu affermis leur coeur; tu prêtes l''oreille
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የድሆችን ምኞት ሰማ፥ ጆሮውም የልባቸውን አሳብ አደመጠች፥

verses.en: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.
verses.fr: Pour rendre justice à l''orphelin et à l''opprimé, Afin que l''homme tiré de la terre cesse d''inspirer l''effroi.
verses.am: ፍርዱ ለድሀ አደግና ለችግረኛ ይደረግ ዘንድ፥ ሰዎች በምድር ላይ አፋቸውን ከፍ ከፍ ማድረግ እንዳይደግሙ።

verses.en: In the Lord put I my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. De David. C''est en l''Eternel que je cherche un refuge. Comment pouvez-vous me dire: Fuis dans vos montagnes, comme un oiseau?
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ታመንሁ፤ ነፍሴን። እንደ ወፍ ወደ ተራሮች ተቅበዝበዢ እንዴት ትሉአታላችሁ?

verses.en: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.
verses.fr: Car voici, les méchants bandent l''arc, Ils ajustent leur flèche sur la corde, Pour tirer dans l''ombre sur ceux dont le coeur est droit.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኞች እነሆ ቀስታቸውን ገትረዋልና፥ ፍላጻቸውንም በአውታር አዘጋጅተዋልና፥ ልበ ቅኖችን በስውር ይነድፉ ዘንድ።

verses.en: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?
verses.fr: Quand les fondements sont renversés, Le juste, que ferait-il? -
verses.am: አንተ የሠራኸውን እነሆ እነርሱ አፍርሰዋልና፤ ጻድቅ ግን ምን አደረገ?

verses.en: The Lord is in his holy temple, the Lord's throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est dans son saint temple, L''Eternel a son trône dans les cieux; Ses yeux regardent, Ses paupières sondent les fils de l''homme.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በተቀደሰው መቅደሱ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር፥ ዙፋኑ በሰማይ ነው፤ ዓይኖቹ ወደ ድሃ ይመለከታሉ፥ ቅንድቦቹም የሰው ልጆችን ይመረምራሉ።

verses.en: The Lord trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.
verses.fr: L''Eternel sonde le juste; Il hait le méchant et celui qui se plaît à la violence.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ጻድቅንና ኅጥእን ይመረምራል፤ ዓመፃን የወደዳት ግን ነፍሱን ጠልቶአል።

verses.en: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.
verses.fr: Il fait pleuvoir sur les méchants Des charbons, du feu et du soufre; Un vent brûlant, c''est le calice qu''ils ont en partage.
verses.am: ወጥመድ በኅጥኣን ላይ ያዘንባል እሳትና ዲን ዐውሎ ነፋስም የጽዋቸው እድል ፈንታ ነው።

verses.en: For the righteous Lord loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel est juste, il aime la justice; Les hommes droits contemplent sa face.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ጻድቅ ነውና፥ ጽድቅንም ይወድዳል፤ ቅንነት ግን ፊቱን ታየዋለች።

verses.en: Help, Lord; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Sur la harpe à huit cordes. Psaume de David. Sauve, Eternel! car les hommes pieux s''en vont, Les fidèles disparaissent parmi les fils de l''homme.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አድነኝ፤ ደግ ሰው አልቆአልና፥ ከሰው ልጆችም መተማመን ጐድሎአልና።

verses.en: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.
verses.fr: On se dit des faussetés les uns aux autres, On a sur les lèvres des choses flatteuses, On parle avec un coeur double.
verses.am: እርስ በርሳቸው ከንቱ ነገርን ይናገራሉ፤ በሽንገላ ከንፈር ሁለት ልብ ሆነው ይናገራሉ።

verses.en: The Lord shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaketh proud things:
verses.fr: Que l''Eternel extermine toutes les lèvres flatteuses, La langue qui discourt avec arrogance,
verses.am: የሽንገላን ከንፈሮች ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር ያጠፋቸዋል፥ ታላቅ ነገርን የምትናገረውን ምላስ፤

verses.en: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?
verses.fr: Ceux qui disent: Nous sommes puissants par notre langue, Nous avons nos lèvres avec nous; Qui serait notre maître? -
verses.am: ምላሳችንን እናበረታለን፤ ከንፈራችን የእኛ ነው፥ ጌታችን ማን ነው? የሚሉትን።

verses.en: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the Lord; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.
verses.fr: Parce que les malheureux sont opprimés et que les pauvres gémissent, Maintenant, dit l''Eternel, je me lève, J''apporte le salut à ceux contre qui l''on souffle.
verses.am: ስለ ድሆች መከራ፥ ስለ ችግረኞች ጩኸት እግዚአብሔር። አሁን እነሣለሁ ይላል፤ መድኃኒትን አደርጋለሁ፥ በላዩም እገልጣለሁ።

verses.en: The words of the Lord are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
verses.fr: Les paroles de l''Eternel sont des paroles pures, Un argent éprouvé sur terre au creuset, Et sept fois épuré.
verses.am: በምድር ላይ እንደ ተፈተነ ሰባት ጊዜ እንደ ተጣራ ብር። የእግዚአብሔር ቃላት የነጹ ቃላት ናቸው።

verses.en: Thou shalt keep them, O Lord, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.
verses.fr: Toi, Eternel! tu les garderas, Tu les préserveras de cette race à jamais.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ጠብቀን፥ ከዚህችም ትውልድ ለዘላለም ታደገን።

verses.en: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.
verses.fr: Les méchants se promènent de toutes parts, Quand la bassesse règne parmi les fils de l''homme.
verses.am: በሰው ልጆች ዘንድ ምናምንቴ ከፍ ከፍ ባለ ጊዜ ክፉዎች በዙሪያው ሁሉ ይመላለሳሉ።

verses.en: How long wilt thou forget me, O Lord? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Psaume de David. Jusques à quand, Eternel! m''oublieras-tu sans cesse? Jusques à quand me cacheras-tu ta face?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እስከ መቼ ፈጽመህ ትረሳኛለህ? እስከ መቼስ ፊትህን ከእኔ ትሰውራለህ?

verses.en: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?
verses.fr: Jusques à quand aurai-je des soucis dans mon âme, Et chaque jour des chagrins dans mon coeur? Jusques à quand mon ennemi s''élèvera-t-il contre moi?
verses.am: እስከ መቼ በነፍሴ እመካከራለሁ? ትካዜስ እስከ መቼ ሁልጊዜ ይሆናል? እስከ መቼ ጠላቴ በላዬ ይጓደዳል?

verses.en: Consider and hear me, O Lord my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;
verses.fr: Regarde, réponds-moi, Eternel, mon Dieu! Donne à mes yeux la clarté, Afin que je ne m''endorme pas du sommeil de la mort,
verses.am: አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ እየኝ ስማኝም፤ ጠላቴ። አሸነፍሁት እንዳይል፥

verses.en: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.
verses.fr: Afin que mon ennemi ne dise pas: Je l''ai vaincu! Et que mes adversaires ne se réjouissent pas, si je chancelle.
verses.am: የሚያስጨንቁኝም እኔ ብናወጥ ደስ እንዳይላቸው፥ ለሞትም እንዳልተኛ ዓይኖቼን አብራ።

verses.en: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.
verses.fr: Moi, j''ai confiance en ta bonté, J''ai de l''allégresse dans le coeur, à cause de ton salut;
verses.am: እኔ ግን በቸርነትህ ታመንሁ፥ ልቤም በመድኃኒትህ ደስ ይለዋል።

verses.en: I will sing unto the Lord, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
verses.fr: Je chante à l''Eternel, car il m''a fait du bien.
verses.am: የረዳኝን እግዚአብሔርን አመሰግናለሁ፥ ለልዑል እግዚአብሔር ስምም እዘምራለሁ።

verses.en: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. De David. L''insensé dit en son coeur: Il n''y a point de Dieu! Ils se sont corrompus, ils ont commis des actions abominables; Il n''en est aucun qui fasse le bien.
verses.am: ለመዘምራን አለቃ፤ የዳዊት መዝሙር።

verses.en: The Lord looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek God.
verses.fr: L''Eternel, du haut des cieux, regarde les fils de l''homme, Pour voir s''il y a quelqu''un qui soit intelligent, Qui cherche Dieu.
verses.am: የሚያስተውል እግዚአብሔርንም የሚፈልግ እንዳለ ያይ ዘንድ፤ እግዚአብሔር ከሰማይ የሰው ልጆችን ተመለከተ።

verses.en: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.fr: Tous sont égarés, tous sont pervertis; Il n''en est aucun qui fasse le bien, Pas même un seul.
verses.am: ሁሉ ዐመፁ በአንድነትም ረከሱ በጎ ነገርን የሚሠራ የለም፤ አንድም ስንኳ የለም።

verses.en: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the Lord.
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui commettent l''iniquité ont-ils perdu le sens? Ils dévorent mon peuple, ils le prennent pour nourriture; Ils n''invoquent point l''Eternel.
verses.am: ጕሮሮአቸው የተከፈተ መቃብር ነው፥ በምላሳቸው ሸነገሉ፤

verses.en: There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.
verses.fr: C''est alors qu''ils trembleront d''épouvante, Quand Dieu paraîtra au milieu de la race juste.
verses.am: ከከንፈራቸው በታች የእባብ መርዝ አለ፤ አፋቸው መርገምንና መራራን ተሞልቶአል፤

verses.en: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the Lord is his refuge.
verses.fr: Jetez l''opprobre sur l''espérance du malheureux... L''Eternel est son refuge.
verses.am: ደምን ለማፍሰስ እግራቸው ፈጣን ነው፤ ጥፋትና ጕስቍልና በመንገዳቸው አለ፥ የሰላምን መንገድ አላወቁአትምና፤ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት በዓይናቸው ፊት የለም።

verses.en: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the Lord bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
verses.fr: Oh! qui fera partir de Sion la délivrance d''Israël? Quand l''Eternel ramènera les captifs de son peuple, Jacob sera dans l''allégresse, Israël se réjouira.
verses.am: ሕዝቤን እንደ እንጀራ የሚበሉ ኃጢአት የሚሠሩ ሁሉ በውኑ አያውቁምን? እግዚአብሔርንም አይጠሩትም።

verses.en: Lord, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?
verses.fr: Psaume de David. O Eternel! qui séjournera dans ta tente? Qui demeurera sur ta montagne sainte? -
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በድንኳንህ ውስጥ ማን ያድራል? በተቀደሰውም ተራራህ ማን ይኖራል?

verses.en: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.
verses.fr: Celui qui marche dans l''intégrité, qui pratique la justice Et qui dit la vérité selon son coeur.
verses.am: በቅንነት የሚሄድ፥ ጽድቅንም የሚያደርግ፥ በልቡም እውነትን የሚናገር።

verses.en: He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.
verses.fr: Il ne calomnie point avec sa langue, Il ne fait point de mal à son semblable, Et il ne jette point l''opprobre sur son prochain.
verses.am: በአንደበቱ የማይሸነግል፥ በባልንጀራው ላይ ክፋትን የማያደርግ፥ ዘመዶቹንም የማይሰድብ።

verses.en: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the Lord. He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not.
verses.fr: Il regarde avec dédain celui qui est méprisable, Mais il honore ceux qui craignent l''Eternel; Il ne se rétracte point, s''il fait un serment à son préjudice.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኛ በፊቱ የተናቀ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም የሚፈሩትን የሚያከብር፥ ለባልንጀራው የሚምል የማይከዳም።

verses.en: He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.
verses.fr: Il n''exige point d''intérêt de son argent, Et il n''accepte point de don contre l''innocent. Celui qui se conduit ainsi ne chancelle jamais.
verses.am: ገንዘቡን በአራጣ የማያበድር፥ በንጹሑ ላይ መማለጃን የማይቀበል። እንዲህ የሚያደርግ ለዘላለም አይታወክም።

verses.en: Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.
verses.fr: Hymne de David. Garde-moi, ô Dieu! car je cherche en toi mon refuge.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በአንተ ታምኛለሁና ጠብቀኝ።

verses.en: O my soul, thou hast said unto the Lord, Thou art my Lord: my goodness extendeth not to thee;
verses.fr: Je dis à l''Eternel: Tu es mon Seigneur, Tu es mon souverain bien!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን። አንተ ጌታዬ ነህ አልሁ፤ ከአንተ በቀር በጎነት የለኝም።

verses.en: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.
verses.fr: Les saints qui sont dans le pays, Les hommes pieux sont l''objet de toute mon affection.
verses.am: ፈቃድህ ሁሉ በምድር ባሉት ቅዱሳንና ክቡራን ላይ ነው።

verses.en: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.
verses.fr: On multiplie les idoles, on court après les dieux étrangers: Je ne répands pas leurs libations de sang, Je ne mets pas leurs noms sur mes lèvres.
verses.am: ወደ ሌላ ለሚፋጠኑት መከራቸው ይበዛል፤ የቍርባናቸውን ደም እኔ አላፈስሰውም፥ ስማቸውንም በከንፈሬ አልጠራም።

verses.en: The Lord is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est mon partage et mon calice; C''est toi qui m''assures mon lot;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የርስቴ እድል ፈንታና ጽዋዬ ነው፥ ዕጣዬንም የምታጠና አንተ ነህ።

verses.en: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
verses.fr: Un héritage délicieux m''est échu, Une belle possession m''est accordée.
verses.am: ገመድ ባማረ ስፍራ ወደቀችልኝ፥ ርስቴም ተዋበችልኝ።

verses.en: I will bless the Lord, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.
verses.fr: Je bénis l''Eternel, mon conseiller; La nuit même mon coeur m''exhorte.
verses.am: የመከረኝን እግዚአብሔርን እባርካለሁ፤ ደግሞም በሌሊት ኵላሊቶቼ ይገሥጹኛል።

verses.en: I have set the Lord always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
verses.fr: J''ai constamment l''Eternel sous mes yeux; Quand il est à ma droite, je ne chancelle pas.
verses.am: ሁልጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን በፊቴ አየዋለሁ፤ በቀኜ ነውና አልታወክም።

verses.en: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.
verses.fr: Aussi mon coeur est dans la joie, mon esprit dans l''allégresse, Et mon corps repose en sécurité.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ልቤን ደስ አለው ምላሴም ሐሴት አደረገች፤ ሥጋዬም ደግሞ በተስፋ ታድራለች፤

verses.en: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
verses.fr: Car tu ne livreras pas mon âme au séjour des morts, Tu ne permettras pas que ton bien-aimé voie la corruption.
verses.am: ነፍሴን በሲኦል አትተዋትምና፥ ቅዱስህንም መበስበስን ያይ ዘንድ አትተወውም።

verses.en: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
verses.fr: Tu me feras connaître le sentier de la vie; Il y a d''abondantes joies devant ta face, Des délices éternelles à ta droite.
verses.am: የሕይወትን መንገድ አሳየኸኝ፤ ከፊትህ ጋር ደስታን አጠገብኸኝ፥ በቀኝህም የዘላለም ፍሥሐ አለ።

verses.en: Hear the right, O Lord, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.
verses.fr: Prière de David. Eternel! écoute la droiture, sois attentif à mes cris, Prête l''oreille à ma prière faite avec des lèvres sans tromperie!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጽድቄን ስማ ጩኸቴንም አድምጥ፤ በተንኰለኛም ከንፈር ያልሆነውን ጸሎቴን አድምጥ።

verses.en: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.
verses.fr: Que ma justice paraisse devant ta face, Que tes yeux contemplent mon intégrité!
verses.am: ፍርዴ ከፊትህ ይውጣ፥ ዓይኖችህም በቅንነት ይዩ።

verses.en: Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited me in the night; thou hast tried me, and shalt find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.
verses.fr: Si tu sondes mon coeur, si tu le visites la nuit, Si tu m''éprouves, tu ne trouveras rien: Ma pensée n''est pas autre que ce qui sort de ma bouche.
verses.am: ልቤን ፈተንኸው በሌሊትም ጐበኘኸኝ፤ ፈተንኸኝ፥ ምንም አላገኘህብኝም።

verses.en: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.
verses.fr: A la vue des actions des hommes, fidèle à la parole de tes lèvres, Je me tiens en garde contre la voie des violents;
verses.am: የሰውን ሥራ አፌ እንዳይናገር ፈቃዴ ነው፤ ስለ ከንፈሮችህ ቃል ጭንቅ የሆኑ መንገዶችን ጠበቅሁ።

verses.en: Hold up my goings in thy paths, that my footsteps slip not.
verses.fr: Mes pas sont fermes dans tes sentiers, Mes pieds ne chancellent point.
verses.am: እግሮች እንዳይናወጡ አረማመዴን በመንገድህ አጽና።

verses.en: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.
verses.fr: Je t''invoque, car tu m''exauces, ô Dieu! Incline vers moi ton oreille, écoute ma parole!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ሰምተኸኛልና ወደ አንተ ጠራሁ፤ ጆሮህን ወደ እኔ አዘንብል፥ ቃሌንም ስማ።

verses.en: Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust in thee from those that rise up against them.
verses.fr: Signale ta bonté, toi qui sauves ceux qui cherchent un refuge, Et qui par ta droite les délivres de leurs adversaires!
verses.am: የሚያምኑህን ከሚቃወሙ በቀኝህ የምታድናቸው፥ ቸርነትህን ድንቅ አድርገህ ግለጠው።

verses.en: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,
verses.fr: Garde-moi comme la prunelle de l''oeil; Protège-moi, à l''ombre de tes ailes,
verses.am: እንደ ዓይን ብሌን ጠብቀኝ፥ በክንፎችህ ጥላ ሰውረኝ፥

verses.en: From the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies, who compass me about.
verses.fr: Contre les méchants qui me persécutent, Contre mes ennemis acharnés qui m''enveloppent.
verses.am: ከሚያስጨንቁኝ ከኃጢአተኞች፥ ነፍሴንም ከሚከብቡአት ከጠላቶቼ።

verses.en: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.
verses.fr: Ils ferment leurs entrailles, Ils ont à la bouche des paroles hautaines.
verses.am: አንጀታቸውን በስብ ቋጠሩ፥ በአፋቸውም ትንቢትን ተናገሩ።

verses.en: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;
verses.fr: Ils sont sur nos pas, déjà ils nous entourent, Ils nous épient pour nous terrasser.
verses.am: አሁንም እርምጃችንን ከበቡ፤ ዓይናቸውን ወደ ምድር ዝቅ ዝቅ አደረጉ።

verses.en: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
verses.fr: On dirait un lion avide de déchirer, Un lionceau aux aguets dans son repaire.
verses.am: እርሱ ንጥቂያን እንደሚናፍቅ አንበሳ ተሸጕጦም እንደሚኖር እንደ አንበሳ ደቦል ነው።

verses.en: Arise, O Lord, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword:
verses.fr: Lève-toi, Eternel, marche à sa rencontre, renverse-le! Délivre-moi du méchant par ton glaive!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ተነሥ፤ ቀድመህ ወደ ታች ጣለው፤ ነፍሴን ከኃጢአተኛ በሰይፍህ አድናት።

verses.en: From men which are thy hand, O Lord, from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance to their babes.
verses.fr: Délivre-moi des hommes par ta main, Eternel, des hommes de ce monde! Leur part est dans la vie, Et tu remplis leur ventre de tes biens; Leurs enfants sont rassasiés, Et ils laissent leur superflu à leurs petits-enfants.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ከሰዎች፥ እድል ፈንታቸው በሕይወታቸው ከሆነች ከዚህ ዓለም ሰዎች በእጅህ አድነኝ፤ ከሰወርኸው መዝገብህ ሆዳቸውን አጠገብህ፤ ልጆቻቸው ብዙ ናቸው የተረፋቸውንም ለሕፃናቶቻቸው ያተርፋሉ።

verses.en: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.
verses.fr: Pour moi, dans mon innocence, je verrai ta face; Dès le réveil, je me rassasierai de ton image.
verses.am: እኔ ግን በጽድቅ ፊትህን አያለሁ፤ ክብርህን ሳይ እጠግባለሁ።

verses.en: I will love thee, O Lord, my strength.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Du serviteur de l''Eternel, de David, qui adressa à l''Eternel les paroles de ce cantique, lorsque l''Eternel l''eut délivré de la main de tous ses ennemis et de la main de Saül. Il dit: Je t''aime, ô Eternel, ma force!
verses.am: አቤቱ ጕልበቴ ሆይ፥ እወድድሃለሁ።

verses.en: The Lord is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
verses.fr: Eternel, mon rocher, ma forteresse, mon libérateur! Mon Dieu, mon rocher, où je trouve un abri! Mon bouclier, la force qui me sauve, ma haute retraite!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ዓለቴ፥ አምባዬ፥ መድኃኒቴ፥ አምላኬ፥ በእርሱም የምተማመንበት ረዳቴ፥ መታመኛዬና የደኅንነቴ ቀንድ መጠጊያዬም ነው።

verses.en: I will call upon the Lord, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
verses.fr: Je m''écrie: Loué soit l''Eternel! Et je suis délivré de mes ennemis.
verses.am: ምስጋና የሚገባውን እግዚአብሔርን እጠራለሁ፥ ከጠላቶቼም እድናለሁ።

verses.en: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.
verses.fr: Les liens de la mort m''avaient environné, Et les torrents de la destruction m''avaient épouvanté;
verses.am: የሞት ጣር ያዘኝ፥ የዓመፅ ፈሳሽም አስፈራኝ፤

verses.en: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.
verses.fr: Les liens du sépulcre m''avaient entouré, Les filets de la mort m''avaient surpris.
verses.am: የሲኦል ጣር ከበበኝ፤ የሞት ወጥመድም ደረሰብኝ።

verses.en: In my distress I called upon the Lord, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.
verses.fr: Dans ma détresse, j''ai invoqué l''Eternel, J''ai crié à mon Dieu; De son palais, il a entendu ma voix, Et mon cri est parvenu devant lui à ses oreilles.
verses.am: በጨነቀኝ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን ጠራሁት፥ ወደ አምላኬም ጮኽሁ፤ ከመቅደሱም ቃሌን ሰማኝ፥ ጩኸቴም በፊቱ ወደ ጆሮው ገባ።

verses.en: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.
verses.fr: La terre fut ébranlée et trembla, Les fondements des montagnes frémirent, Et ils furent ébranlés, parce qu''il était irrité.
verses.am: ምድርም ተንቀጠቀጠች ተናወጠችም፥ የተራሮችም መሠረቶች ተነቃነቁ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ተቈጥቶአልና ተንቀጠቀጡ።

verses.en: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
verses.fr: Il s''élevait de la fumée dans ses narines, Et un feu dévorant sortait de sa bouche: Il en jaillissait des charbons embrasés.
verses.am: ከቍጣው ጢስ ወጣ፥ ከፊቱም የሚበላ እሳት ነደደ፤ ፍምም ከእርሱ በራ።

verses.en: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.
verses.fr: Il abaissa les cieux, et il descendit: Il y avait une épaisse nuée sous ses pieds.
verses.am: ሰማዮችን ዝቅ ዝቅ አደረገ ወረደም፥ ጨለማ ከእግሩ በታች ነበረ።

verses.en: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.
verses.fr: Il était monté sur un chérubin, et il volait, Il planait sur les ailes du vent.
verses.am: በኪሩቤልም ላይ ተቀምጦ በረረ፥ በነፋስም ክንፍ በረረ።

verses.en: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.
verses.fr: Il faisait des ténèbres sa retraite, sa tente autour de lui, Il était enveloppé des eaux obscures et de sombres nuages.
verses.am: መሰወሪያውን ጨለማ አደረገ፤ በዙሪያውም ድንኳኑ፤ በደመናት ውስጥ የጨለማ ውኃ ነበረ።

verses.en: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.
verses.fr: De la splendeur qui le précédait s''échappaient les nuées, Lançant de la grêle et des charbons de feu.
verses.am: በፊቱ ካለው ብርሃን የተነሣ ደመናትና በረዶ የእሳት ፍምም አለፉ።

verses.en: The Lord also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.
verses.fr: L''Eternel tonna dans les cieux, Le Très-Haut fit retentir sa voix, Avec la grêle et les charbons de feu.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከሰማያት አንጐደጐደ፥ ልዑልም ቃሉን ሰጠ።

verses.en: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.
verses.fr: Il lança ses flèches et dispersa mes ennemis, Il multiplia les coups de la foudre et les mit en déroute.
verses.am: ፍላጻውን ላከ በተናቸውም፤ መብረቆችን አበዛ አወካቸውም።

verses.en: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O Lord, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.
verses.fr: Le lit des eaux apparut, Les fondements du monde furent découverts, Par ta menace, ô Eternel! Par le bruit du souffle de tes narines.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ከዘለፋህ ከመዓትህም መንፈስ እስትንፋስ የተነሣ፥ የውኆች ምንጮች ታዩ፥ የዓለም መሠረቶችም ተገለጡ።

verses.en: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.
verses.fr: Il étendit sa main d''en haut, il me saisit, Il me retira des grandes eaux;
verses.am: ከላይ ሰደደ ወሰደኝም፥ ከብዙ ውኆችም አወጣኝ።

verses.en: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.
verses.fr: Il me délivra de mon adversaire puissant, De mes ennemis qui étaient plus forts que moi.
verses.am: ከብርቱዎች ጠላቶቼ ከሚጠሉኝም አዳነኝ፥ በርትተውብኝ ነበርና።

verses.en: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the Lord was my stay.
verses.fr: Ils m''avaient surpris au jour de ma détresse; Mais l''Eternel fut mon appui.
verses.am: በመከራዬ ቀን ደረሱብኝ፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ደገፋዬ ሆነ።

verses.en: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verses.fr: Il m''a mis au large, Il m''a sauvé, parce qu''il m''aime.
verses.am: ወደ ሰፊ ስፍራም አወጣኝ፤ ወድዶኛልና አዳነኝ።

verses.en: The Lord rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
verses.fr: L''Eternel m''a traité selon ma droiture, Il m''a rendu selon la pureté de mes mains;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንደ ጽድቄ ይከፍለኛል፤ እንደ እጄ ንጽሕና ይመልስልኛል።

verses.en: For I have kept the ways of the Lord, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.fr: Car j''ai observé les voies de l''Eternel, Et je n''ai point été coupable envers mon Dieu.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን መንገድ ጠብቄአለሁና፥ በአምላኬም አላመፅሁም።

verses.en: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.
verses.fr: Toutes ses ordonnances ont été devant moi, Et je ne me suis point écarté de ses lois.
verses.am: ፍርዱ ሁሉ በፊቴ ነበረና፥ ሥርዓቱንም ከፊቴ አላራቅሁም።

verses.en: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.
verses.fr: J''ai été sans reproche envers lui, Et je me suis tenu en garde contre mon iniquité.
verses.am: በእርሱ ዘንድ ቅን ነበርሁ፥ ከኃጢአቴም ተጠበቅሁ።

verses.en: Therefore hath the Lord recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
verses.fr: Aussi l''Eternel m''a rendu selon ma droiture, Selon la pureté de mes mains devant ses yeux.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ጽድቄ እንደ እጄም ንጽሕና በዓይኖቹ ፊት መለሰልኝ።

verses.en: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;
verses.fr: Avec celui qui est bon tu te montres bon, Avec l''homme droit tu agis selon la droiture,
verses.am: ከቸር ሰው ጋር ቸር ሆነህ ትገኛለህ፤ ከቅን ሰው ጋር ቅን ሆነህ ትገኛለህ፤

verses.en: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.
verses.fr: Avec celui qui est pur tu te montres pur, Et avec le pervers tu agis selon sa perversité.
verses.am: ከንጹሕ ጋር ንጹሕ ሆነህ ትገኛለህ፤ ከጠማማም ጋር ጠማማ ሆነህ ትገኛለህ።

verses.en: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.
verses.fr: Tu sauves le peuple qui s''humilie, Et tu abaisses les regards hautains.
verses.am: አንተ የተጠቃውን ሕዝብ ታድናለህና፥ የትዕቢተኞችን ዓይን ግን ታዋርዳለህ።

verses.en: For thou wilt light my candle: the Lord my God will enlighten my darkness.
verses.fr: Oui, tu fais briller ma lumière; L''Eternel, mon Dieu, éclaire mes ténèbres.
verses.am: አንተ መብራቴን ታበራለህና፤ እግዚአብሔር አምላኬ ጨለማዬን ያበራል።

verses.en: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.
verses.fr: Avec toi je me précipite sur une troupe en armes, Avec mon Dieu je franchis une muraille.
verses.am: በአንተ ከጥፋት እድናለሁና በአምላኬም ቅጥሩን እዘልላለሁ።

verses.en: As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the Lord is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.
verses.fr: Les voies de Dieu sont parfaites, La parole de l''Eternel est éprouvée; Il est un bouclier pour tous ceux qui se confient en lui.
verses.am: የአምላኬ መንገድ ፍጹም ነው፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል የነጠረ ነው፥ በእርሱ ለሚታመኑት ሁሉ ጋሻ ነው።

verses.en: For who is God save the Lord? or who is a rock save our God?
verses.fr: Car qui est Dieu, si ce n''est l''Eternel; Et qui est un rocher, si ce n''est notre Dieu?
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር በቀር አምላክ ማን ነው? ከአምላካችን በቀር አምላክ ማን ነው?

verses.en: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.
verses.fr: C''est Dieu qui me ceint de force, Et qui me conduit dans la voie droite.
verses.am: ኃይልን የሚያስታጥቀኝ መንገዴንም የሚያቃና፥

verses.en: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet, and setteth me upon my high places.
verses.fr: Il rend mes pieds semblables à ceux des biches, Et il me place sur mes lieux élevés.
verses.am: እግሮቼን እንደ ብሖር እግሮች የሚያረታ በኮረብቶችም የሚያቆመኝ እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
verses.fr: Il exerce mes mains au combat, Et mes bras tendent l''arc d''airain.
verses.am: እጆቼን ሰልፍ ያስተምራል፥ በክንዴም የናስ ቀስት እገትራለሁ።

verses.en: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.
verses.fr: Tu me donnes le bouclier de ton salut, Ta droite me soutient, Et je deviens grand par ta bonté.
verses.am: ለደኅንነቴም መታመኛን ሰጠኸኝ፥ ቀኝህም ትረዳኛለች፥ ትምህርትህም ለዘላለም ታጠናኛለች፥ ተግሣጽህም ታስተምረኛለች።

verses.en: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.
verses.fr: Tu élargis le chemin sous mes pas, Et mes pieds ne chancellent point.
verses.am: አረማመዴን በበታቼ አሰፋህ፥ እግሮቼም አልተንሸራተቱም።

verses.en: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.
verses.fr: Je poursuis mes ennemis, je les atteins, Et je ne reviens pas avant de les avoir anéantis.
verses.am: ጠላቶቼን አሳድዳቸዋለሁ እይዛቸዋለሁም፥ እስካጠፋቸውም ድረስ አልመለስም።

verses.en: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.
verses.fr: Je les brise, et ils ne peuvent se relever; Ils tombent sous mes pieds.
verses.am: አስጨንቃቸዋለሁ መቆምም አይችሉም፥ ከእግሬም በታች ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.
verses.fr: Tu me ceins de force pour le combat, Tu fais plier sous moi mes adversaires.
verses.am: ለሰልፍም ኃይልን ታስታጥቀኛለህ፤ በበላዬ የቆሙትን ሁሉ በበታቼ ታስገዛቸዋለህ።

verses.en: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.
verses.fr: Tu fais tourner le dos à mes ennemis devant moi, Et j''extermine ceux qui me haïssent.
verses.am: የጠላቶቼን ጀርባ ሰጠኸኝ፥ የሚጠሉኝንም አጠፋሃቸው።

verses.en: They cried, but there was none to save them: even unto the Lord, but he answered them not.
verses.fr: Ils crient, et personne pour les sauver! Ils crient à l''Eternel, et il ne leur répond pas!
verses.am: ጮኹ የሚረዳቸውም አልነበረም፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ጮኹ አልሰማቸውም።

verses.en: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.
verses.fr: Je les broie comme la poussière qu''emporte le vent, Je les foule comme la boue des rues.
verses.am: እንደ ትቢያ በነፋስ ፊት እፈጫቸዋለሁ፥ እንደ አደባባይም ጭቃ እረግጣቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; and thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.
verses.fr: Tu me délivres des dissensions du peuple; Tu me mets à la tête des nations; Un peuple que je ne connaissais pas m''est asservi.
verses.am: ከሕዝብ ክርክር ታድነኛለህ፥ የአሕዛብም ራስ አድርገህ ትሾመኛለህ፥ የማላውቀው ሕዝብም ይገዛልኛል።

verses.en: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.
verses.fr: Ils m''obéissent au premier ordre, Les fils de l''étranger me flattent;
verses.am: በጆሮ ሰምተው ተገዙልኝ፤ የባዕድ ልጆች ደለሉኝ።

verses.en: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.
verses.fr: Les fils de l''étranger sont en défaillance, Ils tremblent hors de leurs forteresses.
verses.am: የባዕድ ልጆች አረጁ፥ በመንገዳቸውም ተሰናከሉ።

verses.en: The Lord liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.
verses.fr: Vive l''Eternel, et béni soit mon rocher! Que le Dieu de mon salut soit exalté,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሕያው ነው፥ አምላኬም ቡሩክ ነው፥ የመድኃኒቴም አምላክ ከፍ ከፍ ይበል።

verses.en: It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.
verses.fr: Le Dieu qui est mon vengeur, Qui m''assujettit les peuples,
verses.am: በቀሌን የሚመልስልኝ አምላክ አሕዛብን በበታቼ ያስገዛልኛል።

verses.en: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
verses.fr: Qui me délivre de mes ennemis! Tu m''élèves au-dessus de mes adversaires, Tu me sauves de l''homme violent.
verses.am: ከጠላቶቼ የሚታደገኝ እርሱ ነው፤ በእኔም ላይ ከቆሙ ከፍ ከፍ ታደርገኛለህ፥ ከግፈኛ ሰው ታድነኛለህ።

verses.en: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O Lord, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je te louerai parmi les nations, ô Eternel! Et je chanterai à la gloire de ton nom.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ስለዚህ በአሕዛብ ዘንድ አመሰግንሃለሁ፥ ለስምህም እዘምራለሁ።

verses.en: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.
verses.fr: Il accorde de grandes délivrances à son roi, Et il fait miséricorde à son oint, A David, et à sa postérité, pour toujours.
verses.am: የንጉሡን መድኃኒት ታላቅ ያደርጋል፥ ቸርነቱንም ለቀባው ለዳዊትና ለዘሩ ለዘላለም ይሰጣል።

verses.en: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Psaume de David. Les cieux racontent la gloire de Dieu, Et l''étendue manifeste l''oeuvre de ses mains.
verses.am: ሰማያት የእግዚአብሔርን ክብር ይናገራሉ፥ የሰማይም ጠፈር የእጁን ሥራ ያወራል።

verses.en: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.
verses.fr: Le jour en instruit un autre jour, La nuit en donne connaissance à une autre nuit.
verses.am: ቀን ለቀን ነገርን ታወጣለች፥ ሌሊትም ለሌሊት እውቀትን ትናገራለች።

verses.en: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.
verses.fr: Ce n''est pas un langage, ce ne sont pas des paroles Dont le son ne soit point entendu:
verses.am: ነገር የለም መናገርም የለም፥ ድምፃቸውም አይሰማም።

verses.en: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,
verses.fr: Leur retentissement parcourt toute la terre, Leurs accents vont aux extrémités du monde, Où il a dressé une tente pour le soleil.
verses.am: ድምፃቸው ወደ ምድር ሁሉ፥ ቃላቸውም እስከ ዓለም ዳርቻ ወጣ።

verses.en: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.
verses.fr: Et le soleil, semblable à un époux qui sort de sa chambre, S''élance dans la carrière avec la joie d''un héros;
verses.am: በእነርሱም ውስጥ የፀሐይን ድንኳን አደረገ፥ እርሱም እንደ ሙሽራ ከእልፍኙ ይወጣል፤ እንደ አርበኛ በመንገዱ ለመሮጥ ደስ ይለዋል።

verses.en: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
verses.fr: Il se lève à une extrémité des cieux, Et achève sa course à l''autre extrémité: Rien ne se dérobe à sa chaleur.
verses.am: አወጣጡ ከሰማያት ዳርቻ ነው፥ ዙረቱም እስከ ዳርቻቸው ነው፤ ከትኩሳቱም የሚሰወር የለም።

verses.en: The law of the Lord is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the simple.
verses.fr: La loi de l''Eternel est parfaite, elle restaure l''âme; Le témoignage de l''Eternel est véritable, il rend sage l''ignorant.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ሕግ ፍጹም ነው፤ ነፍስን ይመልሳል፤ የእግዚአብሔር ምስክር የታመነ ነው፤ ሕፃናትን ጠቢባን ያደርጋል።

verses.en: The statutes of the Lord are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the Lord is pure, enlightening the eyes.
verses.fr: Les ordonnances de l''Eternel sont droites, elles réjouissent le coeur; Les commandements de l''Eternel sont purs, ils éclairent les yeux.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ሥርዓት ቅን ነው፥ ልብንም ደስ ያሰኛል፤ የእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ብሩህ ነው፥ ዓይንንም ያበራል።

verses.en: The fear of the Lord is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the Lord are true and righteous altogether.
verses.fr: La crainte de l''Eternel est pure, elle subsiste à toujours; Les jugements de l''Eternel sont vrais, ils sont tous justes.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ፍርሃት ንጹሕ ነው፤ ለዘላለም ይኖራል፤ የእግዚአብሔር ፍርድ እውነትና ቅንነት በአንድነት ነው።

verses.en: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
verses.fr: Ils sont plus précieux que l''or, que beaucoup d''or fin; Ils sont plus doux que le miel, que celui qui coule des rayons.
verses.am: ከወርቅና ከክቡር ዕንቍ ይልቅ ይወደዳል፤ ከማርና ከማር ወለላም ይጣፍጣል።

verses.en: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.
verses.fr: Ton serviteur aussi en reçoit instruction; Pour qui les observe la récompense est grande.
verses.am: ባሪያህ ደግሞ ይጠብቀዋል፤ በመጠበቁም እጅግ ይጠቀማል።

verses.en: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.
verses.fr: Qui connaît ses égarements? Pardonne-moi ceux que j''ignore.
verses.am: ስሕተትን ማን ያስተውላታል? ከተሰወረ ኃጢአት አንጻኝ።

verses.en: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
verses.fr: Préserve aussi ton serviteur des orgueilleux; Qu''ils ne dominent point sur moi! Alors je serai intègre, innocent de grands péchés.
verses.am: የድፍረት ኃጢአት እንዳይገዛኝ ባሪያህን ጠብቅ፤ የዚያን ጊዜ ፍጹም እሆናለሁ፥ ከታላቁም ኃጢአት እነጻለሁ።

verses.en: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O Lord, my strength, and my redeemer.
verses.fr: Reçois favorablement les paroles de ma bouche Et les sentiments de mon coeur, O Eternel, mon rocher et mon libérateur!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ረድኤቴ መድኃኒቴም፥ የአፌ ቃልና የልቤ አሳብ በፊትህ ያማረ ይሁን።

verses.en: The Lord hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Psaume de David. Que l''Eternel t''exauce au jour de la détresse, Que le nom du Dieu de Jacob te protège!
verses.am: በመከራ ቀን እግዚአብሔር ይስማህ፤ የያዕቆብ አምላክ ስም ያቁምህ።

verses.en: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;
verses.fr: Que du sanctuaire il t''envoie du secours, Que de Sion il te soutienne!
verses.am: ከመቅደሱ ረድኤትን ይላክልህ፥ ከጽዮንም ያጥናህ።

verses.en: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.
verses.fr: Qu''il se souvienne de toutes tes offrandes, Et qu''il agrée tes holocaustes! -Pause.
verses.am: ቍርባንህን ሁሉ ያስብልህ፤ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትህን ያለምልምልህ።

verses.en: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.
verses.fr: Qu''il te donne ce que ton coeur désire, Et qu''il accomplisse tous tes desseins!
verses.am: እንደ ልብህ ይስጥህ ፈቃድህንም ሁሉ ይፈጽምልህ።

verses.en: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the Lord fulfil all thy petitions.
verses.fr: Nous nous réjouirons de ton salut, Nous lèverons l''étendard au nom de notre Dieu; L''Eternel exaucera tous tes voeux.
verses.am: በማዳንህ ደስ ይለናል፤ በአምላካችን ስም ከፍ ከፍ እንላለን፤ ልመናህን ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር ይፈጽምልህ።

verses.en: Now know I that the Lord saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.
verses.fr: Je sais déjà que l''Eternel sauve son oint; Il l''exaucera des cieux, de sa sainte demeure, Par le secours puissant de sa droite.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የቀባውን እንዳዳነው ዛሬ አወቅሁ፤ ከሰማይ መቅደሱ ይመልስለታል፤ በቀኙ ብርታት ማዳን።

verses.en: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the Lord our God.
verses.fr: Ceux-ci s''appuient sur leurs chars, ceux-là sur leurs chevaux; Nous, nous invoquons le nom de l''Eternel, notre Dieu.
verses.am: እነዚያ በሰረገላ እነዚያም በፈረስ ይታመናሉ፤ እኛ ግን በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር ስም ከፍ ከፍ እንላለን።

verses.en: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.
verses.fr: Eux, ils plient, et ils tombent; Nous, nous tenons ferme, et restons debout.
verses.am: እነርሱ ተሰነካክለው ወደቁ፤ እኛ ግን ተነሣን፥ ጸንተንም ቆምን።

verses.en: Save, Lord: let the king hear us when we call.
verses.fr: Eternel, sauve le roi! Qu''il nous exauce, quand nous l''invoquons!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ንጉሥን አድነው፥ በጠራንህም ቀን ስማን።

verses.en: The king shall joy in thy strength, O Lord; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Psaume de David. Eternel! le roi se réjouit de ta protection puissante. Oh! comme ton secours le remplit d''allégresse!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በኃይልህ ንጉሥ ደስ ይለዋል፤ በማዳንህ እጅግ ሐሤትን ያደርጋል።

verses.en: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.
verses.fr: Tu lui as donné ce que désirait son coeur, Et tu n''as pas refusé ce que demandaient ses lèvres. -Pause.
verses.am: የልቡን ፈቃድ ሰጠኽው፥ የከንፈሩንም ልመና አልከለከልኸውም።

verses.en: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.
verses.fr: Car tu l''as prévenu par les bénédictions de ta grâce, Tu as mis sur sa tête une couronne d''or pur.
verses.am: በበጎ በረከት ደርሰህለታልና፤ ከክቡር ዕንቍ የሆነ ዘውድን በራሱ ላይ አኖርህ።

verses.en: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.
verses.fr: Il te demandait la vie, tu la lui as donnée, Une vie longue pour toujours et à perpétuité.
verses.am: ሕይወትን ለመነህ ሰጠኸውም፥ ለረጅም ዘመን ለዘላለሙ።

verses.en: His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.
verses.fr: Sa gloire est grande à cause de ton secours; Tu places sur lui l''éclat et la magnificence.
verses.am: በማዳንህ ክብሩ ታላቅ ነው፤ ክብርንና ምስጋናን ጨመርህለት።

verses.en: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.
verses.fr: Tu le rends à jamais un objet de bénédictions, Tu le combles de joie devant ta face.
verses.am: የዘላለም በረከትን ሰጥተኸዋልና። በፊትህም ደስታ ደስ ታሰኘዋለህ።

verses.en: For the king trusteth in the Lord, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.
verses.fr: Le roi se confie en l''Eternel; Et, par la bonté du Très-Haut, il ne chancelle pas.
verses.am: ንጉሥ በእግዚአብሔር ተማምኖአልና፥ በልዑልም ምሕረት አይናወጥም።

verses.en: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.
verses.fr: Ta main trouvera tous tes ennemis, Ta droite trouvera ceux qui te haïssent.
verses.am: እጅህ ጠላቶችህን ሁሉ ታግኛቸው፥ ቀኝህም የሚጠሉህን ሁሉ ታግኛቸው።

verses.en: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the Lord shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.
verses.fr: Tu les rendras tels qu''une fournaise ardente, Le jour où tu te montreras; L''Eternel les anéantira dans sa colère, Et le feu les dévorera.
verses.am: በተቈጣህም ጊዜ እንደ እሳት እቶን አድርጋቸው፤ እግዚአብሔር በቍጣው ያጠፋቸዋል፥ እሳትም ትበላቸዋለች።

verses.en: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
verses.fr: Tu feras disparaître leur postérité de la terre, Et leur race du milieu des fils de l''homme.
verses.am: ፍሬአቸውን ከምድር ዘራቸውንም ከሰው ልጆች ታጠፋለህ።

verses.en: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.
verses.fr: Ils ont projeté du mal contre toi, Ils ont conçu de mauvais desseins, mais ils seront impuissants.
verses.am: ክፋትን በአንተ ላይ ዘርግተዋልና፥ የማይቻላቸውንም ምክር አሰቡ።

verses.en: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.
verses.fr: Car tu leur feras tourner le dos, Et avec ton arc tu tireras sur eux.
verses.am: ወደ ኋላቸው ትመልሳቸዋለህ፤ ፍላጻን በፊታቸው ላይ ታዘጋጃለህ።

verses.en: Be thou exalted, Lord, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.
verses.fr: Lève-toi, Eternel, avec ta force! Nous voulons chanter, célébrer ta puissance.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በኃይልህ ከፍ ከፍ በል፤ ጽናትህንም እናመሰግናለን እንዘምርማለን።

verses.en: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Sur Biche de l''aurore. Psaume de David. Mon Dieu! mon Dieu! pourquoi m''as-tu abandonné, Et t''éloignes-tu sans me secourir, sans écouter mes plaintes?
verses.am: አምላኬ፥ አምላኬ፥ ለምን ተውኸኝ? እኔን ከማዳንና ከጩኸቴ ቃል ሩቅ ነህ።

verses.en: O my God, I cry in the day time, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.
verses.fr: Mon Dieu! je crie le jour, et tu ne réponds pas; La nuit, et je n''ai point de repos.
verses.am: አምላኬ፥ በቀን ወደ አንተ እጠራለሁ፥ አልመለስህልኝም፤ በሌሊትም እንኳ ዕረፍት የለኝም።

verses.en: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.
verses.fr: Pourtant tu es le Saint, Tu sièges au milieu des louanges d''Israël.
verses.am: በእስራኤል የተመሰገንህ አንተ ግን በቅድስና ትኖራለህ።

verses.en: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.
verses.fr: En toi se confiaient nos pères; Ils se confiaient, et tu les délivrais.
verses.am: አባቶቻችን አንተን ተማመኑ፥ ተማመኑ አንተም አዳንሃቸው።

verses.en: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.
verses.fr: Ils criaient à toi, et ils étaient sauvés; Ils se confiaient en toi, et ils n''étaient point confus.
verses.am: ወደ አንተ ጮኹ አመለጡም፥ አንተንም ተማመኑ አላፈሩም።

verses.en: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.
verses.fr: Et moi, je suis un ver et non un homme, L''opprobre des hommes et le méprisé du peuple.
verses.am: እኔ ግን ትል ነኝ ሰውም አይደለሁም፤ የሰው ማላገጫ በሕዝብም ዘንድ የተናቅሁ ነኝ።

verses.en: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui me voient se moquent de moi, Ils ouvrent la bouche, secouent la tête:
verses.am: የሚያዩኝ ሁሉ ይላገዱብኛል፤ ራሳቸውን እየነቀነቁ በከንፈሮቻቸው እንዲህ ይላሉ።

verses.en: He trusted on the Lord that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.
verses.fr: Recommande-toi à l''Eternel! L''Eternel le sauvera, Il le délivrera, puisqu''il l''aime! -
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ተማመነ፥ እርሱንም ያድነው፤ ቢወድደውስ ያድነው።

verses.en: But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother's breasts.
verses.fr: Oui, tu m''as fait sortir du sein maternel, Tu m''as mis en sûreté sur les mamelles de ma mère;
verses.am: አንተ ግን ከሆድ አውጥተኸኛልና፥ በእናቴ ጡት ሳለሁም በአንተ ታመንሁ።

verses.en: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother's belly.
verses.fr: Dès le sein maternel j''ai été sous ta garde, Dès le ventre de ma mère tu as été mon Dieu.
verses.am: ከማኅፀን ጀምሮ በአንተ ላይ ተጣልሁ፤ ከእናቴ ሆድ ጀምረህ አንተ አምላኬ ነህ።

verses.en: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.
verses.fr: Ne t''éloigne pas de moi quand la détresse est proche, Quand personne ne vient à mon secours!
verses.am: ጭንቀት ቀርባለችና የሚረዳኝም የለምና ከእኔ አትራቅ።

verses.en: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.
verses.fr: De nombreux taureaux sont autour de moi, Des taureaux de Basan m''environnent.
verses.am: ብዙ በሬዎች ከበቡኝ፥ የሰቡትም ፍሪዳዎች ያዙኝ፤

verses.en: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.
verses.fr: Ils ouvrent contre moi leur gueule, Semblables au lion qui déchire et rugit.
verses.am: እንደ ነጣቂና እንደሚጮኽ አንበሳ በላዬ አፋቸውን ከፈቱ።

verses.en: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.
verses.fr: Je suis comme de l''eau qui s''écoule, Et tous mes os se séparent; Mon coeur est comme de la cire, Il se fond dans mes entrailles.
verses.am: እንደ ውኃ ፈሰስሁ፤ አጥንቶቼም ሁሉ ተለያዩ፤ ልቤ እንደ ሰም ሆነ፥ በአንጀቴም መካከል ቀለጠ።

verses.en: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.
verses.fr: Ma force se dessèche comme l''argile, Et ma langue s''attache à mon palais; Tu me réduis à la poussière de la mort.
verses.am: ኃይሌ እንደ ገል ደረቀ፥ በጕሮሮዬም ምላሴ ተጣጋ፥ ወደ ሞትም አሸዋ አወረድኸኝ።

verses.en: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.
verses.fr: Car des chiens m''environnent, Une bande de scélérats rôdent autour de moi, Ils ont percé mes mains et mes pieds.
verses.am: ብዙ ውሾች ከብበውኛልና፤ የክፋተኞች ጉባኤም ያዘኝ፤ እጆቼንና እግሮቼን ቸነከሩኝ።

verses.en: I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.
verses.fr: Je pourrais compter tous mes os. Eux, ils observent, ils me regardent;
verses.am: አጥንቶቼ ሁሉ ተቈጠሩ፤ እነርሱም አዩኝ ተመለከቱኝም።

verses.en: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.
verses.fr: Ils se partagent mes vêtements, Ils tirent au sort ma tunique.
verses.am: ልብሶቼን ለራሳቸው ተከፋፈሉ፥ በቀሚሴም ላይ ዕጣ ተጣጣሉ።

verses.en: But be not thou far from me, O Lord: O my strength, haste thee to help me.
verses.fr: Et toi, Eternel, ne t''éloigne pas! Toi qui es ma force, viens en hâte à mon secours!
verses.am: አንተ ግን፥ አቤቱ፥ ከእኔ አትራቅ፤ አንተ ጕልበቴ፥ እኔን ለመርዳት ፍጠን።

verses.en: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.
verses.fr: Protège mon âme contre le glaive, Ma vie contre le pouvoir des chiens!
