verses.am: ነፍሴን ከሰይፍ አድናት፥ ብቻነቴንም ከውሾች እጅ።

verses.en: Save me from the lion's mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.
verses.fr: Sauve-moi de la gueule du lion, Délivre-moi des cornes du buffle!
verses.am: ከአንበሳ አፍ አድነኝ፥ ብቻነቴንም አንድ ቀንድ ካላቸው።

verses.en: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.
verses.fr: Je publierai ton nom parmi mes frères, Je te célébrerai au milieu de l''assemblée.
verses.am: ስምህን ለወንድሞቼ እነግራቸዋለሁ፥ በጉባኤም መካከል አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.en: Ye that fear the Lord, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.
verses.fr: Vous qui craignez l''Eternel, louez-le! Vous tous, postérité de Jacob, glorifiez-le! Tremblez devant lui, vous tous, postérité d''Israël!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን የምትፈሩ፥ አመስግኑት፤ የያዕቆብ ዘር ሁላችሁ፥ አክብሩት፥ የእስራኤልም ዘር ሁላችሁ፥ ፍሩት።

verses.en: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.
verses.fr: Car il n''a ni mépris ni dédain pour les peines du misérable, Et il ne lui cache point sa face; Mais il l''écoute quand il crie à lui.
verses.am: የችግረኛን ችግር አልናቀምና፥ ቸልም አላለምና፤ ፊቱንም ከእኔ አልሰወረምና፥ ነገር ግን ወደ እርሱ በጮኽሁ ጊዜ ሰማኝ።

verses.en: My praise shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.
verses.fr: Tu seras dans la grande assemblée l''objet de mes louanges; J''accomplirai mes voeux en présence de ceux qui te craignent.
verses.am: በታላቅ ጉባኤ ምስጋናዬ ከአንተ ዘንድ ነው። እርሱን በሚፈሩት ፊት ስእለቴን እሰጣለሁ።

verses.en: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the Lord that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.
verses.fr: Les malheureux mangeront et se rassasieront, Ceux qui cherchent l''Eternel le célébreront. Que votre coeur vive à toujours!
verses.am: ችግረኞች ይበላሉ፥ ይጠግቡማል፤ እግዚአብሔርንም የሚሹት ያመሰግኑታል፤ ልባቸውም ለዘላለም ሕያው ይሆናል።

verses.en: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the Lord: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.
verses.fr: Toutes les extrémités de la terre penseront à l''Eternel et se tourneront vers lui; Toutes les familles des nations se prosterneront devant ta face.
verses.am: የምድር ዳርቻዎች ሁሉ ያስቡ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ይመለሱ፤ የአሕዛብ ነገዶች ሁሉ በፊቱ ይሰግዳሉ።

verses.en: For the kingdom is the Lord's: and he is the governor among the nations.
verses.fr: Car à l''Eternel appartient le règne: Il domine sur les nations.
verses.am: መንግሥት ለእግዚአብሔር ነውና፥ እርሱም አሕዛብን ይገዛል።

verses.en: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.
verses.fr: Tous les puissants de la terre mangeront et se prosterneront aussi; Devant lui s''inclineront tous ceux qui descendent dans la poussière, Ceux qui ne peuvent conserver leur vie.
verses.am: የምድር ደንዳኖች ሁሉ ይበላሉ ይሰግዳሉም፤ ወደ መሬት የሚወርዱት ሁሉ በፊቱ ይንበረከካሉ፤ ነፍሴም ስለ እርሱ በሕይወት ትኖራለች።

verses.en: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.
verses.fr: La postérité le servira; On parlera du Seigneur à la génération future.
verses.am: ዘሬ ይገዛለታል፤ የምትመጣው ትውልድ ለእግዚአብሔር ትነግረዋለች፤

verses.en: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.
verses.fr: Quand elle viendra, elle annoncera sa justice, Elle annoncera son oeuvre au peuple nouveau-né.
verses.am: ጽድቁንም ለሚወለደው ሕዝብ፥ እግዚአብሔር ያደረገውን ጽድቁን፥ ይነግራሉ።

verses.en: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
verses.fr: Cantique de David. L''Eternel est mon berger: je ne manquerai de rien.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እረኛዬ ነው፥ የሚያሳጣኝም የለም።

verses.en: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
verses.fr: Il me fait reposer dans de verts pâturages, Il me dirige près des eaux paisibles.
verses.am: በለመለመ መስክ ያሳድረኛል፤ በዕረፍት ውኃ ዘንድ ይመራኛል።

verses.en: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
verses.fr: Il restaure mon âme, Il me conduit dans les sentiers de la justice, A cause de son nom.
verses.am: ነፍሴን መለሳት፥ ስለ ስሙም በጽድቅ መንገድ መራኝ።

verses.en: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
verses.fr: Quand je marche dans la vallée de l''ombre de la mort, Je ne crains aucun mal, car tu es avec moi: Ta houlette et ton bâton me rassurent.
verses.am: በሞት ጥላ መካከል እንኳ ብሄድ አንተ ከእኔ ጋር ነህና ክፉን አልፈራም፤ በትርህና ምርኵዝህ እነርሱ ያጸናኑኛል።

verses.en: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
verses.fr: Tu dresses devant moi une table, En face de mes adversaires; Tu oins d''huile ma tête, Et ma coupe déborde.
verses.am: በፊቴ ገበታን አዘጋጀህልኝ በጠላቶቼ ፊት ለፊት ራሴን በዘይት ቀባህ፥ ጽዋዬም የተረፈ ነው።

verses.en: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the Lord for ever.
verses.fr: Oui, le bonheur et la grâce m''accompagneront Tous les jours de ma vie, Et j''habiterai dans la maison de l''Eternel Jusqu''à la fin de mes jours.
verses.am: ቸርነትህና ምሕረትህ በሕይወቴ ዘመን ሁሉ ይከተሉኛል፥ በእግዚአሔርም ቤት ለዘላለም እኖራለሁ።

verses.en: The earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.fr: Psaume de David. A l''Eternel la terre et ce qu''elle renferme, Le monde et ceux qui l''habitent!
verses.am: በመጀመሪያ ሰንበት የዳዊት መዝሙር።  1 ምድርና ሞላዋ ለእግዚአብሔር ናት፥ ዓለምም በእርስዋም የሚኖሩ ሁሉ።

verses.en: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.
verses.fr: Car il l''a fondée sur les mers, Et affermie sur les fleuves.
verses.am: እርሱ በባሕሮች መሥርቶአታልና፥ በፈሳሾችም አጽንቶአታልና።

verses.en: Who shall ascend into the hill of the Lord? or who shall stand in his holy place?
verses.fr: Qui pourra monter à la montagne de l''Eternel? Qui s''élèvera jusqu''à son lieu saint? -
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተራራ ማን ይወጣል? በቅድስናውስ ስፍራ ማን ይቆማል?

verses.en: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.
verses.fr: Celui qui a les mains innocentes et le coeur pur; Celui qui ne livre pas son âme au mensonge, Et qui ne jure pas pour tromper.
verses.am: እጆቹ የነጹ፥ ልቡም ንጹሕ የሆነ፥ ነፍሱን ለከንቱ ያላነሣ፥ ለባልንጀራውም በሽንገላ ያልማለ።

verses.en: He shall receive the blessing from the Lord, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
verses.fr: Il obtiendra la bénédiction de l''Eternel, La miséricorde du Dieu de son salut.
verses.am: እርሱ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ በረከትን ከመድኃኒቱ አምላክም ምሕረትን ይቀበላል።

verses.en: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.
verses.fr: Voilà le partage de la génération qui l''invoque, De ceux qui cherchent ta face, de Jacob! -Pause.
verses.am: ይህች ትውልድ እርሱን የምትፈልግ ናት፥ የያዕቆብን አምላክ ፊት የምትፈልግ።

verses.en: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
verses.fr: Portes, élevez vos linteaux; Elevez-vous, portes éternelles! Que le roi de gloire fasse son entrée! -
verses.am: እናንት መኳንንቶች፥ በሮችን ክፈቱ፥ የዘላለም ደጆችም ይከፈቱ፥ የክብርም ንጉሥ ይግባ።

verses.en: Who is this King of glory? The Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle.
verses.fr: Qui est ce roi de gloire? -L''Eternel fort et puissant, L''Eternel puissant dans les combats.
verses.am: ይህ የክብር ንጉሥ ማን ነው? እግዚአብሔር ነው፥ ብርቱና ኃያል፥ እግዚአብሔር ነው፥ በሰልፍ ኃያል።

verses.en: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
verses.fr: Portes, élevez vos linteaux; Elevez-les, portes éternelles! Que le roi de gloire fasse son entrée! -
verses.am: እናንተ መኳንንቶች፥ በሮችን ክፈቱ፥ የዘላለም ደጆችም ይከፈቱ፥ የክብርም ንጉሥ ይግባ።

verses.en: Who is this King of glory? The Lord of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.
verses.fr: Qui donc est ce roi de gloire? -L''Eternel des armées: Voilà le roi de gloire! -Pause.
verses.am: ይህ የክብር ንጉሥ ማን ነው? የጭፍሮች አምላክ እግዚአብሔር፥ እርሱ የክብር ንጉሥ ነው።

verses.en: Unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
verses.fr: De David. Eternel! j''élève à toi mon âme.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ ነፍሴን አነሣለሁ።

verses.en: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.
verses.fr: Mon Dieu! en toi je me confie: que je ne sois pas couvert de honte! Que mes ennemis ne se réjouissent pas à mon sujet!
verses.am: አምላኬ፥ አንተን ታመንሁ፤ አልፈር፥ ጠላቶቼ በእኔ አይሣቁብኝ።

verses.en: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui espèrent en toi ne seront point confondus; Ceux-là seront confondus qui sont infidèles sans cause.
verses.am: አንተን ተስፋ የሚያደርጉ አያፍሩም፤ በከንቱ የሚገበዙ ያፍራሉ።

verses.en: Shew me thy ways, O Lord; teach me thy paths.
verses.fr: Eternel! fais-moi connaître tes voies, Enseigne-moi tes sentiers.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ መንገድህን አመልክተኝ፥ ፍለጋህንም አስተምረኝ።

verses.en: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.
verses.fr: Conduis-moi dans ta vérité, et instruis-moi; Car tu es le Dieu de mon salut, Tu es toujours mon espérance.
verses.am: አንተ የመድኃኒቴ አምላክ ነህና በእውነትህ ምራኝ፥ አስተምረኝም፤ ቀኑን ሁሉ አንተን ተስፋ አድርጌአለሁ።

verses.en: Remember, O Lord, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.
verses.fr: Eternel! souviens-toi de ta miséricorde et de ta bonté; Car elles sont éternelles.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህንና ቸርነትህን አስብ፥ ከጥንት ጀምሮ ናቸውና።

verses.en: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O Lord.
verses.fr: Ne te souviens pas des fautes de ma jeunesse ni de mes transgressions; Souviens-toi de moi selon ta miséricorde, A cause de ta bonté, ô Eternel!
verses.am: የልጅነቴን ኃጢአትና መተላለፍ አታስብብኝ፤ አቤቱ፥ ስለ ቸርነትህ ብዛት እንደ ምሕረትህ አስበኝ።

verses.en: Good and upright is the Lord: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est bon et droit: C''est pourquoi il montre aux pécheurs la voie.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ቸር ቅንም ነው፤ ስለዚህ ኃጢአተኞችን በመንገድ ይመራቸዋል።

verses.en: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.
verses.fr: Il conduit les humbles dans la justice, Il enseigne aux humbles sa voie.
verses.am: ገሮችን በፍርድ ይመራል፥ ለገሮችም መንገድን ያስተምራቸዋል።

verses.en: All the paths of the Lord are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
verses.fr: Tous les sentiers de l''Eternel sont miséricorde et fidélité, Pour ceux qui gardent son alliance et ses commandements.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር መንገድ ሁሉ ቸርነትና እውነት ነው። ቃል ኪዳኑንና ምስክሩን ለሚጠብቁ።

verses.en: For thy name's sake, O Lord, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.
verses.fr: C''est à cause de ton nom, ô Eternel! Que tu pardonneras mon iniquité, car elle est grande.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ኃጢአቴ እጅግ ነውና ስለ ስምህ ይቅር በለኝ።

verses.en: What man is he that feareth the Lord? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.
verses.fr: Quel est l''homme qui craint l''Eternel? L''Eternel lui montre la voie qu''il doit choisir.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ ሰው ማን ነው? በሚመርጠው መንገድ ያስተምረዋል።

verses.en: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.
verses.fr: Son âme reposera dans le bonheur, Et sa postérité possédera le pays.
verses.am: ነፍሱ በመልካም ታድራለች፥ ዘሩም ምድርን ይወርሳል።

verses.en: The secret of the Lord is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.
verses.fr: L''amitié de l''Eternel est pour ceux qui le craignent, Et son alliance leur donne instruction.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለሚፈሩት ኃይላቸው ነው፥ ቃል ኪዳኑንም ያስታውቃቸዋል።

verses.en: Mine eyes are ever toward the Lord; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.
verses.fr: Je tourne constamment les yeux vers l''Eternel, Car il fera sortir mes pieds du filet.
verses.am: እርሱ እግሮቼን ከወጥመድ ያወጣቸዋልና ዓይኖቼ ሁልጊዜ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ናቸው።

verses.en: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.
verses.fr: Regarde-moi et aie pitié de moi, Car je suis abandonné et malheureux.
verses.am: እኔ ብቻዬንና ችግረኛ ነኝና ፊትህን ወደ እኔ አድርግ ማረኝም።

verses.en: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.
verses.fr: Les angoisses de mon coeur augmentent; Tire-moi de ma détresse.
verses.am: የልቤ ችግር ብዙ ነው፤ ከጭንቀቴ አውጣኝ።

verses.en: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.
verses.fr: Vois ma misère et ma peine, Et pardonne tous mes péchés.
verses.am: ድካሜንና መከራዬን እይ፥ ኃጢአቴንም ሁሉ ይቅር በለኝ።

verses.en: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.
verses.fr: Vois combien mes ennemis sont nombreux, Et de quelle haine violente ils me poursuivent.
verses.am: ጠላቶቼ እንደ በዙ እይ፥ የግፍም ጥል ጠልተውኛል።

verses.en: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.
verses.fr: Garde mon âme et sauve-moi! Que je ne sois pas confus, Quand je cherche auprès de toi mon refuge!
verses.am: ነፍሴን ጠብቅና አድነኝ፤ አንተን ታምኛለሁና አልፈር።

verses.en: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.
verses.fr: Que l''innocence et la droiture me protègent, Quand je mets en toi mon espérance!
verses.am: አንተን ተስፋ አድርጌአለሁና የውሃትና ቅንነት ይጠብቁኝ።

verses.en: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.
verses.fr: O Dieu! délivre Israël De toutes ses détresses!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እስራኤልን ከመከራው ሁሉ አድነው።

verses.en: Judge me, O Lord; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the Lord; therefore I shall not slide.
verses.fr: De David. Rends-moi justice, Eternel! car je marche dans l''intégrité, Je me confie en l''Eternel, je ne chancelle pas.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እኔ በየውሃቴ ሄጃለሁና ፍረድልኝ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም አምኛለሁና አልናወጥም።

verses.en: Examine me, O Lord, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.
verses.fr: Sonde-moi, Eternel! éprouve-moi, Fais passer au creuset mes reins et mon coeur;
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ፍተነኝ መርምረኝም፤ ኵላሊቴንና ልቤን ፍተን።

verses.en: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.
verses.fr: Car ta grâce est devant mes yeux, Et je marche dans ta vérité.
verses.am: ምሕረትህ በዓይኔ ፊት ነውና፥ በእውነትህም ተመላለስሁ።

verses.en: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.
verses.fr: Je ne m''assieds pas avec les hommes faux, Je ne vais pas avec les gens dissimulés;
verses.am: በከንቱ ሸንጎ አልተቀመጥሁም፥ ከዓመፀኞችም ጋር አልገባሁም።

verses.en: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.
verses.fr: Je hais l''assemblée de ceux qui font le mal, Je ne m''assieds pas avec les méchants.
verses.am: የክፉዎችን ማኅበር ጠላሁ፥ ከዝንጉዎችም ጋር አልቀመጥም።

verses.en: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O Lord:
verses.fr: Je lave mes mains dans l''innocence, Et je vais autour de ton autel, ô Eternel!
verses.am: እጆቼን በንጽሕና አጥባለሁ፤ አቤቱ፥ መሠዊያህን እዞራለሁ፥

verses.en: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.
verses.fr: Pour éclater en actions de grâces, Et raconter toutes tes merveilles.
verses.am: የምስጋናን ድምፅ እሰማ ዘንድ፥ ተአምራትህንም ሁሉ እነግር ዘንድ።

verses.en: Lord, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.
verses.fr: Eternel! j''aime le séjour de ta maison, Le lieu où ta gloire habite.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የቤትህን ስፍራ የክብርህንም ማደሪያ ቦታ ወደድሁ።

verses.en: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:
verses.fr: N''enlève pas mon âme avec les pécheurs, Ma vie avec les hommes de sang,
verses.am: ከኃጢአተኞች ጋር ነፍሴን፥ ከደም ሰዎችም ጋር ሕይወቴን አታጥፋ።

verses.en: In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.
verses.fr: Dont les mains sont criminelles Et la droite pleine de présents!
verses.am: በእጃቸው ተንኰል አለባቸው፥ ቀኛቸውም መማለጃ ተሞልታለች።

verses.en: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.
verses.fr: Moi, je marche dans l''intégrité; Délivre-moi et aie pitié de moi!
verses.am: እኔ ግን በየውሃቴ ሄጃለሁ፤ አድነኝ ማረኝም።

verses.en: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the Lord.
verses.fr: Mon pied est ferme dans la droiture: Je bénirai l''Eternel dans les assemblées.
verses.am: እግሮቼ በቅንነት ቆመዋልና፤ አቤቱ፥ በማኅበር አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.en: The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the Lord is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
verses.fr: De David. L''Eternel est ma lumière et mon salut: De qui aurais-je crainte? L''Eternel est le soutien de ma vie: De qui aurais-je peur?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ብርሃኔና መድኃኒቴ ነው፤ የሚያስፈራኝ ማን ነው? እግዚአብሔር የሕይወቴ መታመኛዋ ነው፤ የሚያስደነግጠኝ ማን ነው?

verses.en: When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.
verses.fr: Quand des méchants s''avancent contre moi, Pour dévorer ma chair, Ce sont mes persécuteurs et mes ennemis Qui chancellent et tombent.
verses.am: ክፉዎች፥ አስጨናቂዎቼ ጠላቶቼም፥ ሥጋዬን ይበሉ ዘንድ በቀረቡ ጊዜ፥ እነርሱ ተሰናከሉና ወደቁ።

verses.en: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.
verses.fr: Si une armée se campait contre moi, Mon coeur n''aurait aucune crainte; Si une guerre s''élevait contre moi, Je serais malgré cela plein de confiance.
verses.am: ሠራዊትም ቢሰፍርብኝ ልቤ አይፈራም፤ ሰልፍም ቢነሣብኝ በዚህ እተማመናለሁ።

verses.en: One thing have I desired of the Lord, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the Lord, and to enquire in his temple.
verses.fr: Je demande à l''Eternel une chose, que je désire ardemment: Je voudrais habiter toute ma vie dans la maison de l''Eternel, Pour contempler la magnificence de l''Eternel Et pour admirer son temple.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን አንዲት ነገር ለመንሁት እርስዋንም እሻለሁ፤ በሕይወቴ ዘመን ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት እኖር ዘንድ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ደስ የሚያሰኘውንም አይ ዘንድ፥ መቅደሱንም እመለከት ዘንድ።

verses.en: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.
verses.fr: Car il me protégera dans son tabernacle au jour du malheur, Il me cachera sous l''abri de sa tente; Il m''élèvera sur un rocher.
verses.am: በመከራዬ ቀን በድንኳኑ ሰውሮኛልና፥ በድንኳኑም መሸሸጊያ ሸሽጎኛልና፥ በዓለት ላይ ከፍ ከፍ አድርጎኛልና።

verses.en: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Et déjà ma tête s''élève sur mes ennemis qui m''entourent; J''offrirai des sacrifices dans sa tente, au son de la trompette; Je chanterai, je célébrerai l''Eternel.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ አሁን በዙሪያ ባሉ በጠላቶቼ ላይ ራሴን ከፍ ከፍ አደረገ፤ በድንኳኑም የእልልታ መሥዋዕትን ሠዋሁ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር እቀኛለሁ እዘምርለትማለሁ።

verses.en: Hear, O Lord, when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.
verses.fr: Eternel! écoute ma voix, je t''invoque: Aie pitié de moi et exauce-moi!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ የጮኽሁትን ቃሌን ስማኝ። ማረኝና አድምጠኝ።

verses.en: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, Lord, will I seek.
verses.fr: Mon coeur dit de ta part: Cherchez ma face! Je cherche ta face, ô Eternel!
verses.am: አንተ ፊቴን እሹት ባልህ ጊዜ። አቤቱ፥ ፊትህን እሻለሁ ልቤ አንተን አለ።

verses.en: Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.
verses.fr: Ne me cache point ta face, Ne repousse pas avec colère ton serviteur! Tu es mon secours, ne me laisse pas, ne m''abandonne pas, Dieu de mon salut!
verses.am: ፊትህን ከእኔ አትሰውር፥ ተቈጥተህ ከባሪያህ ፈቀቅ አትበል፤ ረዳት ሁነኝ፥ አትጣለኝም፥ የመድኃኒቴም አምላክ ሆይ፥ አትተውኝ።

verses.en: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the Lord will take me up.
verses.fr: Car mon père et ma mère m''abandonnent, Mais l''Eternel me recueillera.
verses.am: አባቴና እናቴ ትተውኛልና፥ እግዚአብሔር ግን ተቀበለኝ።

verses.en: Teach me thy way, O Lord, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.
verses.fr: Eternel! enseigne-moi ta voie, Conduis-moi dans le sentier de la droiture, A cause de mes ennemis.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ መንገድህን አስተምረኝ፥ ስለ ጠላቶቼም በቀና መንገድ ምራኝ።

verses.en: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.
verses.fr: Ne me livre pas au bon plaisir de mes adversaires, Car il s''élève contre moi de faux témoins Et des gens qui ne respirent que la violence.
verses.am: የሐሰት ምስክሮችና ዓመፀኞች ተነሥተውብኛልና ለጠላቶቼ ፈቃድ አትስጠኝ።

verses.en: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.
verses.fr: Oh! si je n''étais pas sûr de voir la bonté de l''Eternel Sur la terre des vivants!...
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ቸርነት በሕያዋን ምድር አይ ዘንድ አምናለሁ።

verses.en: Wait on the Lord: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the Lord.
verses.fr: Espère en l''Eternel! Fortifie-toi et que ton coeur s''affermisse! Espère en l''Eternel!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ተስፋ አድርግ፤ በርታ፥ ልብህም ይጽና፤ እግዚአብሔርን ተስፋ አድርግ።

verses.en: Unto thee will I cry, O Lord my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
verses.fr: De David. Eternel! c''est à toi que je crie. Mon rocher! ne reste pas sourd à ma voix, De peur que, si tu t''éloignes sans me répondre, Je ne sois semblable à ceux qui descendent dans la fosse.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ እጠራለሁ፤ ዝም ብትለኝ ወደ ጓድጓድ እንደሚወርዱት እንዳልመስል፥ አንተ አምላኬ፥ ዝም አትበለኝ።

verses.en: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.
verses.fr: Ecoute la voix de mes supplications, quand je crie à toi, Quand j''élève mes mains vers ton sanctuaire.
verses.am: ወደ መቅደስህ ማደሪያ እጄን ባነሣሁ ጊዜ፥ ወደ አንተ የጮኽሁትን የልመናዬን ቃል ስማ።

verses.en: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.
verses.fr: Ne m''emporte pas avec les méchants et les hommes iniques, Qui parlent de paix à leur prochain et qui ont la malice dans le coeur.
verses.am: ከኃጥኣንና ከክፉ አድራጊዎች ጋር ነፍሴን አትውሰዳት፤ ክፋትም በልባቸው እያለ ከባልንጀራቸው ጋር ሰላም ከሚናገሩት ጋር አትጣለኝ።

verses.en: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.
verses.fr: Rends-leur selon leurs oeuvres et selon la malice de leurs actions, Rends-leur selon l''ouvrage de leurs mains; Donne-leur le salaire qu''ils méritent.
verses.am: እንደ ሥራቸው እንደ አካሄዳቸውም ክፉት ስጣቸው፤ እንደ እጃቸውም ሥራ ስጣቸው፤ ፍዳቸውን ወደ ራሳቸው መልስ።

verses.en: Because they regard not the works of the Lord, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.
verses.fr: Car ils ne sont pas attentifs aux oeuvres de l''Eternel, A l''ouvrage de ses mains. Qu''il les renverse et ne les relève point!
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሥራ ወደ እጆቹም አደራረግ አላሰቡምና ያፈርሳቸዋል እንጂ አይሠራቸውም።

verses.en: Blessed be the Lord, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.
verses.fr: Béni soit l''Eternel! Car il exauce la voix de mes supplications.
verses.am: የልመናዬን ቃል ሰምቶኛልና እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን።

verses.en: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est ma force et mon bouclier; En lui mon coeur se confie, et je suis secouru; J''ai de l''allégresse dans le coeur, Et je le loue par mes chants.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ኃይሌና ጋሻዬ ነው፤ ልቤ በእርሱ ታመነ እኔም ተረዳሁ፤ ሥጋዬም ደስ ይለዋል፥ ፈቅጄም አመሰግነዋለሁ።

verses.en: The Lord is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est la force de son peuple, Il est le rocher des délivrances de son oint.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቡ ኃይላቸው ነው፥ ለቀባውም የመድኃኒቱ መታመኛ ነው።

verses.en: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.
verses.fr: Sauve ton peuple et bénis ton héritage! Sois leur berger et leur soutien pour toujours!
verses.am: ሕዝብህን አድን፥ ርስትህንም ባርክ፤ ጠብቃቸው፥ ለዘላለሙም ከፍ ከፍ አድርጋቸው።

verses.en: Give unto the Lord, O ye mighty, give unto the Lord glory and strength.
verses.fr: Psaume de David. Fils de Dieu, rendez à l''Eternel, Rendez à l''Eternel gloire et honneur!
verses.am: የአምላክ ልጆች ሆይ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር አምጡ። ክብርንና ምስጋናን ለእግዚአብሔር አምጡ።

verses.en: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name; worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.
verses.fr: Rendez à l''Eternel gloire pour son nom! Prosternez-vous devant l''Eternel avec des ornements sacrés!
verses.am: የስሙን ክብር ለእግዚአብሔር አምጡ፥ በቅድስናው ስፍራ ለእግዚአብሔር ስገዱ።

verses.en: The voice of the Lord is upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the Lord is upon many waters.
verses.fr: La voix de l''Eternel retentit sur les eaux, Le Dieu de gloire fait gronder le tonnerre; L''Eternel est sur les grandes eaux.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ በውኆች ላይ፥ የክብር አምላክ አንጐደጐደ፥ እግዚአብሔር በብዙ ውኆች ላይ።

verses.en: The voice of the Lord is powerful; the voice of the Lord is full of majesty.
verses.fr: La voix de l''Eternel est puissante, La voix de l''Eternel est majestueuse.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ በኃይል ነው፤ የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ በታላቅ ክብር ነው።

verses.en: The voice of the Lord breaketh the cedars; yea, the Lord breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.fr: La voix de l''Eternel brise les cèdres; L''Eternel brise les cèdres du Liban,
verses.am: የእግዚአብር ድምፅ ዝግባን ይሰብራል፤ እግዚአብሔር የሊባኖስን ዝግባ ይቀጠቅጣል።

verses.en: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.
verses.fr: Il les fait bondir comme des veaux, Et le Liban et le Sirion comme de jeunes buffles.
verses.am: እንደ ጥጃ ሊባኖስን፥ አንድ ቀን እንዳለው አውሬ ልጅ ስርዮንን ያዘልላቸዋል።

verses.en: The voice of the Lord divideth the flames of fire.
verses.fr: La voix de l''Eternel fait jaillir des flammes de feu.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ የእሳቱን ነበልባል ይቈርጣል።

verses.en: The voice of the Lord shaketh the wilderness; the Lord shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.fr: La voix de l''Eternel fait trembler le désert; L''Eternel fait trembler le désert de Kadès.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ ምድረ በዳውን ያናውጣል፥ እግዚአብሔር የቃዴስን ምድረ በዳ ያናውጣል።

verses.en: The voice of the Lord maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.
verses.fr: La voix de l''Eternel fait enfanter les biches, Elle dépouille les forêts. Dans son palais tout s''écrie: Gloire!
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ ዋላዎችን ያጠነክራቸዋል፥ ጫካዎቹንም ይገልጣል፤ ሁሉም በመቅደሱ። ምስጋና ይላል።

verses.en: The Lord sitteth upon the flood; yea, the Lord sitteth King for ever.
verses.fr: L''Eternel était sur son trône lors du déluge; L''Eternel sur son trône règne éternellement.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የጥፋት ውኃን ሰብስቦአል፤ እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም ንጉሥ ሆኖ ይቀመጣል።

verses.en: The Lord will give strength unto his people; the Lord will bless his people with peace.
verses.fr: L''Eternel donne la force à son peuple; L''Eternel bénit son peuple et le rend heureux.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቡ ኃይልን ይሰጣል፤ እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን በሰላም ይባርካል።

verses.en: I will extol thee, O Lord; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.
verses.fr: Psaume. Cantique pour la dédicace de la maison. De David. Je t''exalte, ô Eternel, car tu m''as relevé, Tu n''as pas voulu que mes ennemis se réjouissent à mon sujet.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ተቀብለኸኛልና፥ ጠላቶቼንም ደስ አላሰኘህብኝምና ከፍ ከፍ አደርግሃለሁ።

verses.en: O Lord my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
verses.fr: Eternel, mon Dieu! J''ai crié à toi, et tu m''as guéri.
verses.am: አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ ወደ አንተ ጮኽሁ ምሕረትም አደረግህልኝ።

verses.en: O Lord, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
verses.fr: Eternel! tu as fait remonter mon âme du séjour des morts, Tu m''as fait revivre loin de ceux qui descendent dans la fosse.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ነፍሴን ከሲኦል አወጣሃት፥ ወደ ጕድጓድም እንዳልወርድ አዳንኸኝ።

verses.en: Sing unto the Lord, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
verses.fr: Chantez à l''Eternel, vous qui l''aimez, Célébrez par vos louanges sa sainteté!
verses.am: ቅዱሳን ሆይ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ዘምሩ፥ ለቅድስናውም መታሰቢያ አመስግኑ።

verses.en: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
verses.fr: Car sa colère dure un instant, Mais sa grâce toute la vie; Le soir arrivent les pleurs, Et le matin l''allégresse.
verses.am: ቍጣው ለጥቂት ጊዜ ነው፥ ሞገሱ ግን ለሕይወት ዘመን፤ ልቅሶ ማታ ይመጣል፥ ጥዋት ግን ደስታ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.
verses.fr: Je disais dans ma sécurité: Je ne chancellerai jamais!
verses.am: እኔም በደስታዬ። ለዘላለም አልታወክም አልሁ።

verses.en: Lord, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.
verses.fr: Eternel! par ta grâce tu avais affermi ma montagne... Tu cachas ta face, et je fus troublé.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በፈቃድህ ለሕይወቴ ኃይልን ሰጠሃት፤ ፊትህን መለስህ፥ እኔም ደነገጥሁ።

verses.en: I cried to thee, O Lord; and unto the Lord I made supplication.
verses.fr: Eternel! j''ai crié à toi, J''ai imploré l''Eternel:
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ ጠራሁ፥ ወደ አምላኬም ለመንሁ።

verses.en: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?
verses.fr: Que gagnes-tu à verser mon sang, A me faire descendre dans la fosse? La poussière a-t-elle pour toi des louanges? Raconte-t-elle ta fidélité?
verses.am: ወደ ጥፋት ብወርድ በደሜ ምን ጥቅም አለ? አፈር ያመሰግንሃልን? እውነትህንም ይናገራልን?

verses.en: Hear, O Lord, and have mercy upon me: Lord, be thou my helper.
verses.fr: Ecoute, Eternel, aie pitié de moi! Eternel, secours-moi! -
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሰማ ማረኝም፤ እግዚአብሔር ረዳቴ ሆነኝ።

verses.en: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
verses.fr: Et tu as changé mes lamentations en allégresse, Tu as délié mon sac, et tu m''as ceint de joie,
verses.am: ክብሬ ትዘምርልህ ዘንድ ዝምም እንዳትል ልቅሶዬን ለደስታ ለወጥህልኝ፥ ማቄን ቀድደህ ደስታንም አስታጠቅኸኝ።

verses.en: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O Lord my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.
verses.fr: Afin que mon coeur te chante et ne soit pas muet. Eternel, mon Dieu! je te louerai toujours.
verses.am: አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ ለዘላለም አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.en: In thee, O Lord, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Psaume de David. Eternel! je cherche en toi mon refuge: Que jamais je ne sois confondu! Délivre-moi dans ta justice!
verses.am: አቤቱ አንተን ታመንሁ፤ ለዘላለም አልፈር፤ በጽድቅህም አድነኝ።

verses.en: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.
verses.fr: Incline vers moi ton oreille, hâte-toi de me secourir! Sois pour moi un rocher protecteur, une forteresse, Où je trouve mon salut!
verses.am: ጆሮህን ወደ እኔ አዘንብል፥ ፈጥነህም አድነኝ፤ ታድነኝ ዘንድ መታመኛ አምላክና የመጠጊያ ቤት ሁነኝ።

verses.en: For thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name's sake lead me, and guide me.
verses.fr: Car tu es mon rocher, ma forteresse; Et à cause de ton nom tu me conduiras, tu me dirigeras.
verses.am: አምባዬና መጠጊያዬ አንተ ነህና ስለ ስምህ መንገዴን አቅና ምራኝም።

verses.en: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.
verses.fr: Tu me feras sortir du filet qu''ils m''ont tendu; Car tu es mon protecteur.
verses.am: አንተ መታመኛዬ ነህና ከደበቁብኝ ወጥመድ አውጣኝ።

verses.en: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O Lord God of truth.
verses.fr: Je remets mon esprit entre tes mains; Tu me délivreras, Eternel, Dieu de vérité!
verses.am: በእጅህ ነፍሴን እሰጣለሁ፤ የእውነት አምላክ አቤቱ፥ ተቤዥተኸኛል።

verses.en: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the Lord.
verses.fr: Je hais ceux qui s''attachent à de vaines idoles, Et je me confie en l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከንቱ ምናምንቴነትን የጠበቁትን ጠላህ፤ እኔ ግን በእግዚአብሔር ታመንሁ።

verses.en: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;
verses.fr: Je serai par ta grâce dans l''allégresse et dans la joie; Car tu vois ma misère, tu sais les angoisses de mon âme,
verses.am: መከራዬን አይተሃልና፥ ነፍሴንም ከጭንቀት አድነሃታልና በምሕረትህ ደስ ይለኛል ሐሤትም አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.
verses.fr: Et tu ne me livreras pas aux mains de l''ennemi, Tu mettras mes pieds au large.
verses.am: በጠላቴ እጅ አልዘጋኸኝም፥ በሰፊም ስፍራ እግሮቼን አቆምህ።

verses.en: Have mercy upon me, O Lord, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.
verses.fr: Aie pitié de moi, Eternel! car je suis dans la détresse; J''ai le visage, l''âme et le corps usés par le chagrin.
verses.am: ተቸግሬአለሁና አቤቱ ምራኝ፤ ዓይኔም ከኃዘን የተነሣ ተፈጀች፥ ነፍሴም ሆዴም።

verses.en: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.
verses.fr: Ma vie se consume dans la douleur, Et mes années dans les soupirs; Ma force est épuisée à cause de mon iniquité, Et mes os dépérissent.
verses.am: ሕይወቴ በኅዘን አልቃለችና፥ ዓመታቴም በልቅሶ ጩኸት፤ ኃይሌ በችግር ደከመ፥ አጥንቶቼም ተነዋወጡ።

verses.en: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.
verses.fr: Tous mes adversaires m''ont rendu un objet d''opprobre, De grand opprobre pour mes voisins, et de terreur pour mes amis; Ceux qui me voient dehors s''enfuient loin de moi.
verses.am: በጠላቶቼ ዘንድ ተነወርኹ፥ ይልቁንም በጎረቤቶቼ ዘንድ፥ ለሚያውቁኝም ፍርሃት ሆንሁ፤ በሜዳ ያዩኝም ከእኔ ሸሹ።

verses.en: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.
verses.fr: Je suis oublié des coeurs comme un mort, Je suis comme un vase brisé.
verses.am: እንደ ሞተ ሰው ከልብ ተረሳሁ፥ እንደ ተበላሸ ዕቃም ሆንሁ።

verses.en: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.
verses.fr: J''apprends les mauvais propos de plusieurs, L''épouvante qui règne à l''entour, Quand ils se concertent ensemble contre moi: Ils complotent de m''ôter la vie.
verses.am: የብዙ ሰዎችን ስድብ ሰምቻለሁና፤ በዙሪያው ፍርሃት ነበረ፤ በላዬ በአንድነት በተሰበሰቡ ጊዜ ነፍሴን ለመንጠቅ ተማከሩ።

verses.en: But I trusted in thee, O Lord: I said, Thou art my God.
verses.fr: Mais en toi je me confie, ô Eternel! Je dis: Tu es mon Dieu!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እኔ ግን በአንተ ታመንሁ፤ አንተ አምላኬ ነህ አልሁ።

verses.en: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.
verses.fr: Mes destinées sont dans ta main; Délivre-moi de mes ennemis et de mes persécuteurs!
verses.am: ርስቴ በእጅህ ነው፤ ከጠላቶቼ እጅና ከሚያሳድዱኝ አድነኝ።

verses.en: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies' sake.
verses.fr: Fais luire ta face sur ton serviteur, Sauve-moi par ta grâce!
verses.am: ፊትህን በባሪያህ ላይ አብራ፥ ስለ ምሕረትህም አድነኝ።

verses.en: Let me not be ashamed, O Lord; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.
verses.fr: Eternel, que je ne sois pas confondu quand je t''invoque. Que les méchants soient confondus, Qu''ils descendent en silence au séjour des morts!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተን ጠርቻለሁና አልፈር፤ ክፉዎች ይፈሩ በሲኦልም ዝም ይበሉ።

verses.en: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.
verses.fr: Qu''elles deviennent muettes, les lèvres menteuses, Qui parlent avec audace contre le juste, Avec arrogance et dédain!
verses.am: በድፍረትና በትዕቢት በመናቅም በጻድቅ ላይ የሚናገሩ የሽንገላ ከንፈሮች ድዳ ይሁኑ።

verses.en: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!
verses.fr: Oh! combien est grande ta bonté, Que tu tiens en réserve pour ceux qui te craignent, Que tu témoignes à ceux qui cherchent en toi leur refuge, A la vue des fils de l''homme!
verses.am: በአንተ ለሚያምኑ በሰው ልጆች ፊት ያዘጋጀሃት ለሚፈሩህም የሰወርሃት፥ ቸርነትህ እንደ ምን በዛች!

verses.en: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
verses.fr: Tu les protèges sous l''abri de ta face contre ceux qui les persécutent, Tu les protèges dans ta tente contre les langues qui les attaquent.
verses.am: በፊትህ መጋረጃ ከሰው ክርክር ትጋርዳቸዋለህ፥ በድንኳንህም ከአንደበት ክርክር ትሸፍናቸዋለህ።

verses.en: Blessed be the Lord: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.
verses.fr: Béni soit l''Eternel! Car il a signalé sa grâce envers moi, Comme si j''avais été dans une ville forte.
verses.am: በተከበበ ከተማ የሚያስደንቅ ምሕረቱን በእኔ የገለጠ እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን።

verses.en: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.
verses.fr: Je disais dans ma précipitation: Je suis chassé loin de ton regard! Mais tu as entendu la voix de mes supplications, Quand j''ai crié vers toi.
verses.am: እኔስ ከዓይንህ ፊት ተጣልሁ፥ በድንጋጤ አልሁ፤ አንተ ግን ወደ አንተ በጮኽሁ ጊዜ የልመናዬን ቃል ሰማኸኝ።

verses.en: O love the Lord, all ye his saints: for the Lord preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.
verses.fr: Aimez l''Eternel, vous qui avez de la piété! L''Eternel garde les fidèles, Et il punit sévèrement les orgueilleux.
verses.am: ሁላችሁ ቅዱሳኑ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ውደዱት፤ እግዚአብሔር እውነተኞችን ይፈልጋል፥ ትዕቢተኞችንም ፈጽሞ ይበቀላቸዋል።

verses.en: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the Lord.
verses.fr: Fortifiez-vous et que votre coeur s''affermisse, Vous tous qui espérez en l''Eternel!
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር የምታምኑ ሁላችሁ፥ በርቱ ልባችሁም ይጥና።

verses.en: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
verses.fr: De David. Cantique. Heureux celui à qui la transgression est remise, A qui le péché est pardonné!
verses.am: መተላለፉ የቀረችለት ኃጢአቱም የተከደነችለት ምስጉን ነው።

verses.en: Blessed is the man unto whom the Lord imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.
verses.fr: Heureux l''homme à qui l''Eternel n''impute pas d''iniquité, Et dans l''esprit duquel il n''y a point de fraude!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በደልን የማይቈጥርበት በመንፈሱም ሽንገላ የሌለበት ሰው ምስጉን ነው።

verses.en: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.
verses.fr: Tant que je me suis tu, mes os se consumaient, Je gémissais toute la journée;
verses.am: ሁልጊዜ ከመጮኼ የተነሣ ዝም ባልሁ ጊዜ አጥንቶቼ ተበላሹ፤

verses.en: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
verses.fr: Car nuit et jour ta main s''appesantissait sur moi, Ma vigueur n''était plus que sécheresse, comme celle de l''été. -Pause.
verses.am: በቀንና በሌሊት እጅህ ከብዳብኛለችና፥ እርጥበቴም ለበጋ ትኵሳት ተለወጠ።

verses.en: I acknowledge my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the Lord; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
verses.fr: Je t''ai fait connaître mon péché, je n''ai pas caché mon iniquité; J''ai dit: J''avouerai mes transgressions à l''Eternel! Et tu as effacé la peine de mon péché. -Pause.
verses.am: ኃጢአቴን ለአንተ አስታወቅሁ፥ በደሌንም አልሸፈንሁም፤ ለእግዚአብሔር መተላለፌን እነግራለሁ አልሁ፤ አንተም የልቤን ኃጢአት ተውህልኝ።

verses.en: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.
verses.fr: Qu''ainsi tout homme pieux te prie au temps convenable! Si de grandes eaux débordent, elles ne l''atteindront nullement.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ቅዱስ ሁሉ በምቹ ጊዜ ወደ አንተ ይለምናል፤ ብዙ የጥፋት ውኃም ወደ እርሱ አይቀርብም።

verses.en: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
verses.fr: Tu es un asile pour moi, tu me garantis de la détresse, Tu m''entoures de chants de délivrance. -Pause.
verses.am: አንተ ለእኔ መሸሸጊያዬ ነህ፥ ከጣርም ትጠብቀኛለህ፤ ከከበቡኝ ታድነኝ ዘንድ ደስታዬ ነህ።

verses.en: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.
verses.fr: Je t''instruirai et te montrerai la voie que tu dois suivre; Je te conseillerai, j''aurai le regard sur toi.
verses.am: አስተምርሃለሁ በምትሄድበትም መንገድ እመራሃለሁ፤ ዓይኖቼን በአንተ ላይ አጠናለሁ።

verses.en: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.
verses.fr: Ne soyez pas comme un cheval ou un mulet sans intelligence; On les bride avec un frein et un mors, dont on les pare, Afin qu''ils ne s''approchent point de toi.
verses.am: ወደ አንተ እንዳይቀርቡ በልባብና በልጓም ጉንጫቸውን እንደሚለጕሙአቸው፥ ልብ እንደሌላቸው እንደ ፈረስና እንደ በቅሎ አትሁኑ።

verses.en: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the Lord, mercy shall compass him about.
verses.fr: Beaucoup de douleurs sont la part du méchant, Mais celui qui se confie en l''Eternel est environné de sa grâce.
verses.am: በኃጢአተኛ ብዙ መቅሠፍት አለበት፤ በእግዚአብሔር የሚታመነውን ግን ምሕረት ይከብበዋል።

verses.en: Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.
verses.fr: Justes, réjouissez-vous en l''Eternel et soyez dans l''allégresse! Poussez des cris de joie, vous tous qui êtes droits de coeur!
verses.am: ጻድቃን ሆይ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይበላችሁ ሐሤትም አድርጉ፤  ልባችሁም የቀና ሁላችሁ፥ እልል በሉ።

verses.en: Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.
verses.fr: Justes, réjouissez-vous en l''Eternel! La louange sied aux hommes droits.
verses.am: ጻድቃን ሆይ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይበላችሁ፤ ለቅኖች ምስጋና ይገባል።

verses.en: Praise the Lord with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.
verses.fr: Célébrez l''Eternel avec la harpe, Célébrez-le sur le luth à dix cordes.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን በመሰንቆ አመስግኑት፥ አሥር አውታርም ባለው በበገና ዘምሩለት።

verses.en: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.
verses.fr: Chantez-lui un cantique nouveau! Faites retentir vos instruments et vos voix!
verses.am: አዲስ ቅኔም ተቀኙለት፥ በእልልታም መልካም ዝማሬ ዘምሩ፤

verses.en: For the word of the Lord is right; and all his works are done in truth.
verses.fr: Car la parole de l''Eternel est droite, Et toutes ses oeuvres s''accomplissent avec fidélité;
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ቅን ነውና ሥራውም ሁሉ በእምነት ነውና።

verses.en: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the Lord.
verses.fr: Il aime la justice et la droiture; La bonté de l''Eternel remplit la terre.
verses.am: ጽድቅንና ፍርድን ይወድዳል፤ የእግዚአብሔር ቸርነት ምድርን ሞላች።

verses.en: By the word of the Lord were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
verses.fr: Les cieux ont été faits par la parole de l''Eternel, Et toute leur armée par le souffle de sa bouche.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሰማዮች ጸኑ፥ ሠራዊታቸውም ሁሉ በአፉ እስትንፋስ፤

verses.en: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.
verses.fr: Il amoncelle en un tas les eaux de la mer, Il met dans des réservoirs les abîmes.
verses.am: የባሕርን ውኃ እንደ ረዋት የሚሰበስበው፥ ቀላዮችንም በመዝገቦች የሚያኖራቸው።

verses.en: Let all the earth fear the Lord: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
verses.fr: Que toute la terre craigne l''Eternel! Que tous les habitants du monde tremblent devant lui!
verses.am: ምድር ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን ትፍራው፥ በዓለም የሚኖሩ ሁሉም ከእርሱ የተነሣ ይደንግጡ።

verses.en: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.
verses.fr: Car il dit, et la chose arrive; Il ordonne, et elle existe.
verses.am: እርሱ ተናግሮአልና፥ ሆኑም፤ እርሱ አዘዘ፥ ጸኑም።

verses.en: The Lord bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.
verses.fr: L''Eternel renverse les desseins des nations, Il anéantit les projets des peuples;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የአሕዛብን ምክር ያጠፋል፥ የአሕዛብንም አሳብ ይመልሳል።

verses.en: The counsel of the Lord standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
verses.fr: Les desseins de l''Eternel subsistent à toujours, Et les projets de son coeur, de génération en génération.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ምክር ግን ለዘላለም ይኖራል። የልቡም አሳብ ለልጅ ልጅ ነው።

verses.en: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.
verses.fr: Heureuse la nation dont l''Eternel est le Dieu! Heureux le peuple qu''il choisit pour son héritage!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላኩ የሚሆንለት ሕዝብ ምስጉን ነው፥ እርሱ ለርስቱ የመረጠው ሕዝብ።

verses.en: The Lord looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.
verses.fr: L''Eternel regarde du haut des cieux, Il voit tous les fils de l''homme;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከሰማይ ተመለከተ፥ የሰውንም ልጆች ሁሉ አየ።

verses.en: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.fr: Du lieu de sa demeure il observe Tous les habitants de la terre,
verses.am: ከማደሪያው ቦታ ሆኖ በምድር ወደሚኖሩ ሁሉ ተመለከተ፥

verses.en: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.
verses.fr: Lui qui forme leur coeur à tous, Qui est attentif à toutes leurs actions.
verses.am: እርሱ ብቻውን ልባቸውን የሠራ ሥራቸውንም ሁሉ የሚያስተውል።

verses.en: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.
verses.fr: Ce n''est pas une grande armée qui sauve le roi, Ce n''est pas une grande force qui délivre le héros;
verses.am: ንጉሥ በሠራዊቱ ብዛት አይድንም ኃያልም በኃይሉ ብዛት አያመልጥም።

verses.en: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.
verses.fr: Le cheval est impuissant pour assurer le salut, Et toute sa vigueur ne donne pas la délivrance.
verses.am: ፈረስም ከንቱ ነው፥ አያድንም፤ በኃይሉም ብዛት አያመልጥም።

verses.en: Behold, the eye of the Lord is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;
verses.fr: Voici, l''oeil de l''Eternel est sur ceux qui le craignent, Sur ceux qui espèrent en sa bonté,
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ዓይኖች ወደሚፈሩት ናቸው፥ በምሕረቱም ወደሚታመኑ፥

verses.en: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.
verses.fr: Afin d''arracher leur âme à la mort Et de les faire vivre au milieu de la famine.
verses.am: ነፍሳቸውን ከሞት ያድን ዘንድ፥ በራብም ጊዜ ይመግባቸው ዘንድ።

verses.en: Our soul waiteth for the Lord: he is our help and our shield.
verses.fr: Notre âme espère en l''Eternel; Il est notre secours et notre bouclier.
verses.am: ነፍሳችን እግዚአብሔርን ተስፋ ታደርገዋለች፥ ረዳታችንና መጠጊያችን እርሱ ነውና።

verses.en: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
verses.fr: Car notre coeur met en lui sa joie, Car nous avons confiance en son saint nom.
verses.am: ልባችን በእርሱ ደስ ይለዋልና፥ በቅዱስ ስሙም ታምነናልና።

verses.en: Let thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.
verses.fr: Eternel! que ta grâce soit sur nous, Comme nous espérons en toi!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህ በላያችን ትሁን፥ በአንተ እንደ ታመንን።

verses.en: I will bless the Lord at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
verses.fr: De David. Lorsqu''il contrefit l''insensé en présence d''Abimélec, et qu''il s''en alla chassé par lui. Je bénirai l''Eternel en tout temps; Sa louange sera toujours dans ma bouche.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ሁልጊዜ እባርከዋለሁ፥ ምስጋናውንም ዘወትር በአፌ ነው።

verses.en: My soul shall make her boast in the Lord: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.
verses.fr: Que mon âme se glorifie en l''Eternel! Que les malheureux écoutent et se réjouissent!
verses.am: ነፍሴ በእግዚአብሔር ትከብራለች፥ ገሮችም ሰምተው ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: O magnify the Lord with me, and let us exalt his name together.
verses.fr: Exaltez avec moi l''Eternel! Célébrons tous son nom!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ከእኔ ጋር ታላቅ አድርጉት፥ በአንድነትም ስሙን ከፍ ከፍ እናድርግ።

verses.en: I sought the Lord, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
verses.fr: J''ai cherché l''Eternel, et il m''a répondu; Il m''a délivré de toutes mes frayeurs.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ፈለግሁት መለሰልኝም፥ ከመከራዬም ሁሉ አዳነኝ።

verses.en: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.
verses.fr: Quand on tourne vers lui les regards, on est rayonnant de joie, Et le visage ne se couvre pas de honte.
verses.am: ወደ እርሱ ቅረቡ ያበራላችሁማል፥ ፊታችሁም አያፍርም።

verses.en: This poor man cried, and the Lord heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
verses.fr: Quand un malheureux crie, l''Eternel entend, Et il le sauve de toutes ses détresses.
verses.am: ይህ ችግረኛ ጮኸ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ሰማው፥ ከመከራውም ሁሉ አዳነው።

verses.en: The angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.
verses.fr: L''ange de l''Eternel campe autour de ceux qui le craignent, Et il les arrache au danger.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ በሚፈሩት ሰዎች ዙሪያ ይሰፍራል፥ ያድናቸውማል።

verses.en: O taste and see that the Lord is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
verses.fr: Sentez et voyez combien l''Eternel est bon! Heureux l''homme qui cherche en lui son refuge!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ቸር እንደ ሆነ ቅመሱ እዩም፤ በእርሱ የሚታመን ሰው ምስጉን ነው።

verses.en: O fear the Lord, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.
verses.fr: Craignez l''Eternel, vous ses saints! Car rien ne manque à ceux qui le craignent.
verses.am: የሚፈሩት አንዳችን አያጡምና ቅዱሳኑ ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ፍሩት።

verses.en: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the Lord shall not want any good thing.
verses.fr: Les lionceaux éprouvent la disette et la faim, Mais ceux qui cherchent l''Eternel ne sont privés d''aucun bien.
verses.am: ባለጠጎች ደኸዩ፥ ተራቡም፥ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈልጉትን ግን ከመልካም ነገር ሁሉ አይጐድሉም።

verses.en: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the Lord.
verses.fr: Venez, mes fils, écoutez-moi! Je vous enseignerai la crainte de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ልጆቼ ኑ፥ ስሙኝ፤ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት አስተምራችኋለሁ።

verses.en: What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?
verses.fr: Quel est l''homme qui aime la vie, Qui désire la prolonger pour jouir du bonheur?
verses.am: ሕይወትን የሚፈቅድ ሰው ማን ነው? በጎንም ዘመን ለማየት የሚወድድ?

verses.en: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.
verses.fr: Préserve ta langue du mal, Et tes lèvres des paroles trompeuses;
verses.am: አንደበትህን ከክፉ ከልክል፥ ከንፈሮችህም ሽንገላን እንዳይናገሩ።

verses.en: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
verses.fr: Eloigne-toi du mal, et fais le bien; Recherche et poursuis la paix.
verses.am: ከክፉ ሽሽ መልካምንም አድርግ፤ ሰላምን እሻ ተከተላትም።

verses.en: The eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.
verses.fr: Les yeux de l''Eternel sont sur les justes, Et ses oreilles sont attentives à leurs cris.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ዓይኖች ወደ ጻድቃን ጆሮቹም ወደ ጩኸታቸው ናቸውና።

verses.en: The face of the Lord is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
verses.fr: L''Eternel tourne sa face contre les méchants, Pour retrancher de la terre leur souvenir.
verses.am: መታሰቢያቸውን ከምድር ያጠፋ ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉን በሚያደርጉ ላይ ነው።

verses.en: The righteous cry, and the Lord heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.
verses.fr: Quand les justes crient, l''Eternel entend, Et il les délivre de toutes leurs détresses;
verses.am: ጻድቃን ጮኹ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ሰማቸው ከመከራቸውም ሁሉ አዳናቸው።

verses.en: The Lord is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est près de ceux qui ont le coeur brisé, Et il sauve ceux qui ont l''esprit dans l''abattement.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ልባቸው ለተሰበረ ቅርብ ነው፥ መንፈሳቸው የተሰበረውንም ያድናቸዋል።

verses.en: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the Lord delivereth him out of them all.
verses.fr: Le malheur atteint souvent le juste, Mais l''Eternel l''en délivre toujours.
verses.am: የጻድቃን መከራቸው ብዙ ነው፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከሁሉ ያድናቸዋል።

verses.en: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.
verses.fr: Il garde tous ses os, Aucun d''eux n''est brisé.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አጥንቶቻቸውን ሁሉ ይጠብቃል፥ ከእነርሱም አንድ አይሰበርም።

verses.en: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.
verses.fr: Le malheur tue le méchant, Et les ennemis du juste sont châtiés.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኞችን ክፋት ይገድላቸዋል ጻድቃንንም የሚጠሉ ይጸጸታሉ።

verses.en: The Lord redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.
verses.fr: L''Eternel délivre l''âme de ses serviteurs, Et tous ceux qui l''ont pour refuge échappent au châtiment.
verses.am: የባሪያዎቹን ነፍስ እግዚአብሔር ይቤዣል፥ በእርሱም የሚያምኑ ሁሉ አይጸጸቱም።

verses.en: Plead my cause, O Lord, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.
verses.fr: De David. Eternel! défends-moi contre mes adversaires, Combats ceux qui me combattent!
verses.am: የዳዊት መዝሙር።

verses.en: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.
verses.fr: Saisis le petit et le grand bouclier, Et lève-toi pour me secourir!
verses.am: ጥሩርና ጋሻ ያዝ፥ እኔንም ለመርዳት ተነሥ።

verses.en: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.
verses.fr: Brandis la lance et le javelot contre mes persécuteurs! Dis à mon âme: Je suis ton salut!
verses.am: ሰይፍህን ምዘዝ የሚያሳድዱኝንም መንገዳቸውን ዝጋ፤ ነፍሴን። መድኃኒትሽ እኔ ነኝ በላት።

verses.en: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.
verses.fr: Qu''ils soient honteux et confus, ceux qui en veulent à ma vie! Qu''ils reculent et rougissent, ceux qui méditent ma perte!
verses.am: ነፍሴን የሚሹ ሁሉ ይፈሩ ይጐስቈሉም፤ ክፉትን በእኔ ላይ የሚያስቡ ይፈሩ ወደ ኋላቸውም ይበሉ።

verses.en: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the Lord chase them.
verses.fr: Qu''ils soient comme la balle emportée par le vent, Et que l''ange de l''Eternel les chasse!
verses.am: በነፋስ ፊት እንዳለ ትቢያ ይሁኑ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም መልአክ ያስጨንቃቸው።

verses.en: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the Lord persecute them.
verses.fr: Que leur route soit ténébreuse et glissante, Et que l''ange de l''Eternel les poursuive!
verses.am: መንገዳቸው ዳጥና ጨለማ ይሁን፥ የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ያሳድዳቸው።

verses.en: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.
verses.fr: Car sans cause ils m''ont tendu leur filet sur une fosse, Sans cause ils l''ont creusée pour m''ôter la vie.
verses.am: በከንቱ ያጠፉኝ ዘንድ ወጥመዳቸውን ሸሽገውብኛልና፥ ነፍሴን በከንቱ አበሳጭተዋልና።

verses.en: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.
verses.fr: Que la ruine les atteigne à l''improviste, Qu''ils soient pris dans le filet qu''ils ont tendu, Qu''ils y tombent et périssent!
verses.am: ያላወቁት ወጥመድ ይምጣባቸው፥ የሸሸጉትም ወጥመድ ይያዛቸው፤ በዚህ ወጥመድ ውስጥ ይውደቁ።

verses.en: And my soul shall be joyful in the Lord: it shall rejoice in his salvation.
verses.fr: Et mon âme aura de la joie en l''Eternel, De l''allégresse en son salut.
verses.am: ነፍሴ ግን በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይላታል፥ በማዳኑም ሐሴት ታደርጋለች።

verses.en: All my bones shall say, Lord, who is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?
verses.fr: Tous mes os diront: Eternel! qui peut, comme toi, Délivrer le malheureux d''un plus fort que lui, Le malheureux et le pauvre de celui qui le dépouille?
verses.am: አጥንቶቼ ሁሉ እንዲህ ይሉሃል። አቤቱ፥ እንደ አንተ ማን ነው? ችግረኛን ከሚቀማው እጅ፥ ችግረኛንና ድሀውንም ከሚነጥቀው እጅ ታድነዋለህ።

verses.en: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.
verses.fr: De faux témoins se lèvent: Ils m''interrogent sur ce que j''ignore.
verses.am: የክፋት ምስክሮች ተነሡብኝ፥ የማላውቀውንም በእኔ ላይ ተናገሩ።

verses.en: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.
verses.fr: Ils me rendent le mal pour le bien: Mon âme est dans l''abandon.
verses.am: ስለ በጎ ክፋትን መለሱልኝ፥ ነፍሴንም ልጆችን አሳጡአት።

verses.en: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.
verses.fr: Et moi, quand ils étaient malades, je revêtais un sac, J''humiliais mon âme par le jeûne, Je priais, la tête penchée sur mon sein.
verses.am: እኔስ እነርሱ በታመሙ ጊዜ ማቅ ለበስሁ፥ ነፍሴንም በጾም አደከምኋት፤ ጸሎቴም ወደ ብብቴ ተመለሰ።

verses.en: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.
verses.fr: Comme pour un ami, pour un frère, je me traînais lentement; Comme pour le deuil d''une mère, je me courbais avec tristesse.
verses.am: ለወዳጄና ለወንድሜ እንደማደርግ አደረግሁ፤ ለእናቱም እንደሚያለቅስ ራሴን ዝቅ ዝቅ አደረግሁ።

verses.en: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:
verses.fr: Puis, quand je chancelle, ils se réjouissent et s''assemblent, Ils s''assemblent à mon insu pour m''outrager, Ils me déchirent sans relâche;
verses.am: በእኔ ላይ ተሰበሰቡ ደስም አላቸው፤ ግፈኞች በእኔ ላይ ተሰበሰቡ እኔም አላውቅሁም፤ ቀደዱኝ አልተውኝምም።

verses.en: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.
verses.fr: Avec les impies, les parasites moqueurs, Ils grincent des dents contre moi.
verses.am: ፈተኑኝ በሣቅም ዘበቱብኝ፥ ጥርሳቸውንም በእኔ ላይ አንቀጫቅጩ።

verses.en: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.
verses.fr: Seigneur! Jusques à quand le verras-tu? Protège mon âme contre leurs embûches, Ma vie contre les lionceaux!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እስከ መቼ ድረስ ታይልኛለህ? ነፍሴን ከክፉ ሥራቸው ብችነቴንም ከአንበሶች አድናት።

verses.en: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.
verses.fr: Je te louerai dans la grande assemblée, Je te célébrerai au milieu d''un peuple nombreux.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በታላቁ ጉባኤ ውስጥ እገዛልሃለሁ፥ በብዙ ሕዝብ መካከልም አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.en: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.
verses.fr: Que ceux qui sont à tort mes ennemis ne se réjouissent pas à mon sujet, Que ceux qui me haïssent sans cause ne m''insultent pas du regard!
verses.am: በግፍ የሚጠሉኝ በላዬ ደስ አይበላቸው፥ በከንቱ የሚጣሉኝም በዓይናቸው አይጣቀሱብኝ።

verses.en: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.
verses.fr: Car ils tiennent un langage qui n''est point celui de la paix, Ils méditent la tromperie contre les gens tranquilles du pays.
verses.am: ለእኔስ ሰላምን ይናገሩኛልና፥ በቍጣም ሽንገላን ይመክራሉ።

verses.en: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.
verses.fr: Ils ouvrent contre moi leur bouche, Ils disent: Ah! ah! nos yeux regardent! -
verses.am: አፋቸውንም በእኔ ላይ አላቀቁ፤ እሰይ እሰይ፥ ዓይናችን አየው ይላሉ።

verses.en: This thou hast seen, O Lord: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.
verses.fr: Eternel, tu le vois! ne reste pas en silence! Seigneur, ne t''éloigne pas de moi!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ አየኸው፤ ዝም አትበል፤ አቤቱ፥ ከእኔ አትራቅ።

verses.en: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.
verses.fr: Réveille-toi, réveille-toi pour me faire justice! Mon Dieu et mon Seigneur, défends ma cause!
verses.am: አምላኬ ጌታዬም፥ ወደ ፍርዴ ተነሥ፥ አቤቱ፥ ፍርዴን አድምጥ።

verses.en: Judge me, O Lord my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.
verses.fr: Juge-moi selon ta justice, Eternel, mon Dieu! Et qu''ils ne se réjouissent pas à mon sujet!
verses.am: አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ እንደ ጽድቅህ ፍረድልኝ፥ በላዬም ደስ አይበላቸው።

verses.en: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.
verses.fr: Qu''ils ne disent pas dans leur coeur: Ah! voilà ce que nous voulions! Qu''ils ne disent pas: Nous l''avons englouti!
verses.am: በልባቸው። እሰይ እሰይ፥ ነፍሳችንን ደስ አላት አይበሉ፤ ደግሞም። ዋጥነው አይበሉ።

verses.en: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.
verses.fr: Que tous ensemble ils soient honteux et confus, Ceux qui se réjouissent de mon malheur! Qu''ils revêtent l''ignominie et l''opprobre, Ceux qui s''élèvent contre moi!
verses.am: በመከራዬ ደስ የሚላቸው ይፈሩ፥ በአንድነትም ይጐስቍሉ፤ በእኔ ላይ የሚታበዩ እፍረትንና ጕስቍልናን ይልበሱ።

verses.en: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the Lord be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.
verses.fr: Qu''ils aient de l''allégresse et de la joie, Ceux qui prennent plaisir à mon innocence, Et que sans cesse ils disent: Exalté soit l''Eternel, Qui veut la paix de son serviteur!
verses.am: ጽድቄን የሚወድዱአት ደስ ይበላቸው ሐሴትንም ያድርጉ፤ የባሪያውን ሰላም የሚወድድ እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ይሁን ዘወትር ይበሉ።

verses.en: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.
verses.fr: Et ma langue célébrera ta justice, Elle dira tous les jours ta louange.
verses.am: ምላሴ ጽድቅህን ሁልጊዜም ምስጋናህን ይናገራል።

verses.en: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, that there is no fear of God before his eyes.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Du serviteur de l''Eternel, de David. La parole impie du méchant est au fond de son coeur; La crainte de Dieu n''est pas devant ses yeux.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኛ በራሱ የሚያስት ነገርን ይናገራል፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ፍርሃት በዓይኖቹ ፊት የለም።

verses.en: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.
verses.fr: Car il se flatte à ses propres yeux, Pour consommer son iniquité, pour assouvir sa haine.
verses.am: በአንደበቱ ሸንግሎአልና፤ ኃጢአቱ ባገኘችው ጊዜ ይጠላታል።

verses.en: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, and to do good.
verses.fr: Les paroles de sa bouche sont fausses et trompeuses; Il renonce à agir avec sagesse, à faire le bien.
verses.am: የአፉ ቃል ግፍና ሽንገላ ነው፤ ማስተዋልን በጎ ማድረግንም ተወ።

verses.en: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.
verses.fr: Il médite l''injustice sur sa couche, Il se tient sur une voie qui n''est pas bonne, Il ne repousse pas le mal.
verses.am: በመኝታው ጠማማነትን አሰበ፤ መልካም ባልሆነች መንገድ ቆሞአል፤ ክፋትን አይንቃትም።

verses.en: Thy mercy, O Lord, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.
verses.fr: Eternel! ta bonté atteint jusqu''aux cieux, Ta fidélité jusqu''aux nues.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህ በሰማይ ነው፥ እውነትህም ወደ ደመናት ትደርሳለች።

verses.en: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O Lord, thou preservest man and beast.
verses.fr: Ta justice est comme les montagnes de Dieu, Tes jugements sont comme le grand abîme. Eternel! tu soutiens les hommes et les bêtes.
verses.am: ጽድቅህም እንደ እግዚአብሔር ተራሮች፥ ፍርድህም እጅግ ጥልቅ ናት፤ አቤቱ፥ ሰውንና እንስሳን ታድናለህ።

verses.en: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.
verses.fr: Combien est précieuse ta bonté, ô Dieu! A l''ombre de tes ailes les fils de l''homme cherchent un refuge.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህን እንዴት አበዛህ! የሰው ልጆች በክንፎችህ ጥላ ይታመናሉ።

verses.en: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.
verses.fr: Ils se rassasient de l''abondance de ta maison, Et tu les abreuves au torrent de tes délices.
verses.am: ከቤትህ ጠል ይጠጣሉ፥ ከተድላም ፈሳሽ ታጠጣቸዋለህ።

verses.en: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.
verses.fr: Car auprès de toi est la source de la vie; Par ta lumière nous voyons la lumière.
verses.am: የሕይወት ምንጭ ከአንተ ዘንድ ነውና፤ በብርሃንህ ብርሃንን እናያለን።

verses.en: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.fr: Etends ta bonté sur ceux qui te connaissent, Et ta justice sur ceux dont le coeur est droit!
verses.am: ምሕረትህን በሚያውቁህ ላይ፥ ጽድቅህንም ልባቸው በቀና ላይ ዘርጋ።

verses.en: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.
verses.fr: Que le pied de l''orgueil ne m''atteigne pas, Et que la main des méchants ne me fasse pas fuir!
verses.am: የትዕቢት እግር አይምጣብኝ፥ የኃጢአተኞችም እጅ አያውከኝ።

verses.en: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.
verses.fr: Déjà tombent ceux qui commettent l''iniquité; Ils sont renversés, et ils ne peuvent se relever.
verses.am: ዓመፃን የሚያደርጉ ሁሉ ከዚያ ወደቁ፤ ወድቀዋል፥ መቆምም አይችሉም።

verses.en: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.
verses.fr: De David. Ne t''irrite pas contre les méchants, N''envie pas ceux qui font le mal.
verses.am: በክፉዎች ላይ አትቅና፥ ዓመፃንም በሚያደርጉ ላይ አትቅና፤

verses.en: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.
verses.fr: Car ils sont fauchés aussi vite que l''herbe, Et ils se flétrissent comme le gazon vert.
verses.am: እንደ ሣር ፈጥነው ይደርቃሉና፥ እንደ ለመለመ ቅጠልም ይረግፋሉና።

verses.en: Trust in the Lord, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
verses.fr: Confie-toi en l''Eternel, et pratique le bien; Aie le pays pour demeure et la fidélité pour pâture.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ታመን፥ መልካምንም አድርግ፥ በምድርም ተቀመጥ፥ ታምነህም ተሰማራ።

verses.en: Delight thyself also in the Lord: and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
verses.fr: Fais de l''Eternel tes délices, Et il te donnera ce que ton coeur désire.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይበልህ፥ የልብህንም መሻት ይሰጥሃል።

verses.en: Commit thy way unto the Lord; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
verses.fr: Recommande ton sort à l''Eternel, Mets en lui ta confiance, et il agira.
verses.am: መንገድህን ለእግዚአብሔር አደራ ስጥ፥ በእርሱም ታመን፥ እርሱም ያደርግልሃል።

verses.en: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.
verses.fr: Il fera paraître ta justice comme la lumière, Et ton droit comme le soleil à son midi.
verses.am: ጽድቅህን እንደ ብርሃን። ፍርድህንም እንደ ቀትር ያመጣል።

verses.en: Rest in the Lord, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
verses.fr: Garde le silence devant l''Eternel, et espère en lui; Ne t''irrite pas contre celui qui réussit dans ses voies, Contre l''homme qui vient à bout de ses mauvais desseins.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር ተገዛ ተስፋም አድርገው። መንገድም በቀናችለትና ጥመትን በሚያደርግ ሰው አትቅና።

verses.en: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
verses.fr: Laisse la colère, abandonne la fureur; Ne t''irrite pas, ce serait mal faire.
verses.am: ከቁጣ ራቅ መዓትንም ተው፤ እንዳትበድል አትቅና።

verses.en: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the Lord, they shall inherit the earth.
verses.fr: Car les méchants seront retranchés, Et ceux qui espèrent en l''Eternel posséderont le pays.
verses.am: ክፉ አድራጊዎች ይጠፋሉና፤ እግዚአብሔርን ተስፋ የሚያደርጉ ግን እነርሱ ምድርን ይወርሳሉ።

verses.en: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.
verses.fr: Encore un peu de temps, et le méchant n''est plus; Tu regardes le lieu où il était, et il a disparu.
verses.am: ገና ጥቂት፥ ኃጢአተኛም አይኖርም፤ ትፈልገዋለህ ቦታውንም አታገኝም።

verses.en: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
verses.fr: Les misérables possèdent le pays, Et ils jouissent abondamment de la paix.
verses.am: ገሮች ግን ምድርን ይወርሳሉ፥ በብዙም ሰላም ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.
verses.fr: Le méchant forme des projets contre le juste, Et il grince des dents contre lui.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኛ ጻድቁን ይመለካከተዋል፥ ጥርሱንም በእርሱ ላይ ያንገጫግጫል።

verses.en: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur se rit du méchant, Car il voit que son jour arrive.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ይሥቅበታል፥ ቀኑ እንደሚደርስ አይቶአልና።

verses.en: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.
verses.fr: Les méchants tirent le glaive, Ils bandent leur arc, Pour faire tomber le malheureux et l''indigent, Pour égorger ceux dont la voie est droite.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኞች ሰይፋቸውን መዘዙ፥ ቀስታቸውንም ገተሩ ድሀውንና ችግረኛውን ይጥሉ ዘንድ ልበ ቅኖችንም ይወጉ ዘንድ፤

verses.en: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
verses.fr: Leur glaive entre dans leur propre coeur, Et leurs arcs se brisent.
verses.am: ሰይፋቸው ወደ ልባቸው ይግባ፥ ቀስታቸውም ይሰበር።

verses.en: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.
verses.fr: Mieux vaut le peu du juste Que l''abondance de beaucoup de méchants;
verses.am: ለጻድቅ ያለው ጥቂት ከብዙ ከኃጢአተኞች ሀብት ይበልጣል።

verses.en: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the Lord upholdeth the righteous.
verses.fr: Car les bras des méchants seront brisés, Mais l''Eternel soutient les justes.
verses.am: የኃጥአን ክንድ ትሰበራለችና፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ጻድቃንን ይደግፋቸዋል።

verses.en: The Lord knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.
verses.fr: L''Eternel connaît les jours des hommes intègres, Et leur héritage dure à jamais.
verses.am: የንጹሓንን መንገድ እግዚአብሔር ያውቃል፥ ርስታቸውም ለዘላለም ነው፤

verses.en: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
verses.fr: Ils ne sont pas confondus au temps du malheur, Et ils sont rassasiés aux jours de la famine.
verses.am: በክፉ ዘመንም አያፍሩም በራብ ዘመንም ይጠግባሉ።

verses.en: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the Lord shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.
verses.fr: Mais les méchants périssent, Et les ennemis de l''Eternel, comme les plus beaux pâturages; Ils s''évanouissent, ils s''évanouissent en fumée.
verses.am: ኅጥአን ግን ይጠፋሉ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ጠላቶች በከበሩና ከፍ ከፍ ባሉ ጊዜ እንደ ጢስ ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.
verses.fr: Le méchant emprunte, et il ne rend pas; Le juste est compatissant, et il donne.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኛ ይበደራል አይከፍልምም፤ ጻድቅ ግን ይራራል ይሰጣልም።

verses.en: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.
verses.fr: Car ceux que bénit l''Eternel possèdent le pays, Et ceux qu''il maudit sont retranchés.
verses.am: እርሱን የሚባርኩት ምድርን ይወርሳሉና፤ የሚረግሙት ግን ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord: and he delighteth in his way.
verses.fr: L''Eternel affermit les pas de l''homme, Et il prend plaisir à sa voie;
verses.am: የሰው አካሄድ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ይጸናል፥ መንገዱንም ይወድዳል።

verses.en: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the Lord upholdeth him with his hand.
verses.fr: S''il tombe, il n''est pas terrassé, Car l''Eternel lui prend la main.
verses.am: ቢወድቅም ለድንጋፄ አይጣልም፥ እግዚአብሔር እጁን ይዞ ይደግፈዋልና።

verses.en: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
verses.fr: J''ai été jeune, j''ai vieilli; Et je n''ai point vu le juste abandonné, Ni sa postérité mendiant son pain.
verses.am: ጐለመስሁ አረጀሁም፤ ጻድቅ ሲጣል፥ ዘሩም እህል ሲለምን አላየሁም።

verses.en: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.
verses.fr: Toujours il est compatissant, et il prête; Et sa postérité est bénie.
verses.am: ሁልጊዜ ይራራል ያበድርማል፥ ዘሩም በበረከት ይኖራል።

verses.en: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.
verses.fr: Détourne-toi du mal, fais le bien, Et possède à jamais ta demeure.
verses.am: ከክፉ ሽሽ፥ መልካምንም አድርግ፤ ለዘላለምም ትኖራለህ።

verses.en: For the Lord loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel aime la justice, Et il n''abandonne pas ses fidèles; Ils sont toujours sous sa garde, Mais la postérité des méchants est retranchée.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ፍርዱን ይወድዳልና፥ ቅዱሳኑንም አይጥላቸውምና፤ ለዘላለምም ይጠብቃቸዋል ለንጹሓንም ይበቀልላቸዋል፤ የኅጥኣን ዘር ግን ይጠፋል።

verses.en: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.
verses.fr: Les justes posséderont le pays, Et ils y demeureront à jamais.
verses.am: ጻድቃን ምድርን ይወርሳሉ፥ በእርስዋም ለዘላለም ይኖራሉ።

verses.en: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.
verses.fr: La bouche du juste annonce la sagesse, Et sa langue proclame la justice.
verses.am: የጻድቅ አፍ ጥበብን ያስተምራል፥ አንደበቱም ፍርድን ይናገራል።

verses.en: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.
verses.fr: La loi de son Dieu est dans son coeur; Ses pas ne chancellent point.
verses.am: የአምላኩ ሕግ በልቡ ውስጥ ነው፥ በእርምጃውም አይሰናከልም።

verses.en: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.
verses.fr: Le méchant épie le juste, Et il cherche à le faire mourir.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኛ ጻድቁን ይመለከተዋል፥ ሊገድለውም ይወድዳል።

verses.en: The Lord will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
verses.fr: L''Eternel ne le laisse pas entre ses mains, Et il ne le condamne pas quand il est en jugement.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን በእጁ አይተወውም፥ በተፋረደውም ጊዜ አያሸንፈውም።

verses.en: Wait on the Lord, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.
verses.fr: Espère en l''Eternel, garde sa voie, Et il t''élèvera pour que tu possèdes le pays; Tu verras les méchants retranchés.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ደጅ ጥና፥ መንገዱንም ጠብቅ፥ ምድርንም ትወርስ ዘንድ ከፍ ከፍ ያደርግሃል፤ ኃጢአተኞችም ሲጠፉ ታያለህ።

verses.en: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.
verses.fr: J''ai vu le méchant dans toute sa puissance; Il s''étendait comme un arbre verdoyant.
verses.am: ኃጥአን ከፍ ከፍ ብሎ እንደ ሊባኖስ ዝግባም ለምልሞ አየሁት።

verses.en: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
verses.fr: Il a passé, et voici, il n''est plus; Je le cherche, et il ne se trouve plus.
verses.am: ብመለስ ግን አጣሁት፤ ፈለግሁት ቦታውንም አላገኘሁም።

verses.en: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.
verses.fr: Observe celui qui est intègre, et regarde celui qui est droit; Car il y a une postérité pour l''homme de paix.
verses.am: ቅንነትን ጠብቅ፥ ጽድቅንም እይ፤ ለሰላም ሰው ቅሬታ አለውና።

verses.en: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.fr: Mais les rebelles sont tous anéantis, La postérité des méchants est retranchée.
verses.am: በደለኞች በአንድነት ይጠፋሉ። የኃጢአተኞች ቅሬታ ይጠፋል።

verses.en: But the salvation of the righteous is of the Lord: he is their strength in the time of trouble.
verses.fr: Le salut des justes vient de l''Eternel; Il est leur protecteur au temps de la détresse.
verses.am: የጻድቃን መድኃኒታቸው ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው፤ በመከራቸውም ጊዜ መጠጊያቸው እርሱ ነው።

verses.en: And the Lord shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.
verses.fr: L''Eternel les secourt et les délivre; Il les délivre des méchants et les sauve, Parce qu''ils cherchent en lui leur refuge.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ይረዳቸዋል፥ ያድናቸዋልም፥ ከኃጢአተኞችም እጅ ያወጣቸዋል፥ ያድናቸዋል፥ በእርሱ ታምነዋልና።

verses.en: O Lord, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
verses.fr: Psaume de David. Pour souvenir. Eternel! ne me punis pas dans ta colère, Et ne me châtie pas dans ta fureur.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በቍጣህ አትቅሠፈኝ፥ በመዓትህም አትገሥጸኝ።

verses.en: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.
verses.fr: Car tes flèches m''ont atteint, Et ta main s''est appesantie sur moi.
verses.am: ፍላጾችህ ወግተውኛልና፥ እጅህንም አክብደህብኛልና።

verses.en: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.
verses.fr: Il n''y a rien de sain dans ma chair à cause de ta colère, Il n''y a plus de vigueur dans mes os à cause de mon péché.
verses.am: ከቍጣህ የተነሣ ለሥጋዬ ጤና የለውም፤ ከኃጢአቴም የተነሣ ለአጥንቶቼ ሰላም የላቸውም።

verses.en: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
verses.fr: Car mes iniquités s''élèvent au-dessus de ma tête; Comme un lourd fardeau, elles sont trop pesantes pour moi.
verses.am: ኃጢአቴ በራሴ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአልና፥ እንደ ከባድ ሸክምም በላዬ ከብዶአልና።

verses.en: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.
verses.fr: Mes plaies sont infectes et purulentes, Par l''effet de ma folie.
verses.am: ከስንፍናዬ የተነሣ ቍስሌ ሸተተ በሰበሰም፤

verses.en: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.
verses.fr: Je suis courbé, abattu au dernier point; Tout le jour je marche dans la tristesse.
verses.am: እጅግ ጐሰቈልሁ ተዋረድሁም፥ ሁልጊዜም በትካዜ እመላለሳለሁ።

verses.en: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.
verses.fr: Car un mal brûlant dévore mes entrailles, Et il n''y a rien de sain dans ma chair.
verses.am: ነፍሴ ስድብን ተሞልታለችና፥ ለሥጋዬም ጤና የላትምና።

verses.en: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
verses.fr: Je suis sans force, entièrement brisé; Le trouble de mon coeur m''arrache des gémissements.
verses.am: ታመምሁ፤ እጅግም ተቸገርሁ፥ ከልቤ ውዝዋዜም የተነሣ ጮኽሁ።

verses.en: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.
verses.fr: Seigneur! tous mes désirs sont devant toi, Et mes soupirs ne te sont point cachés.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ፈቃዴ ሁሉ በፊትህ ነው፥ ጭንቀቴም ከአንተ አይሰወርም።

verses.en: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.
verses.fr: Mon coeur est agité, ma force m''abandonne, Et la lumière de mes yeux n''est plus même avec moi.
verses.am: ልቤ ደነገጠብኝ፥ ኃይሌም ተወችኝ፥ የዓይኖቼም ብርሃን ፈዘዘ።

verses.en: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.
verses.fr: Mes amis et mes connaissances s''éloignent de ma plaie, Et mes proches se tiennent à l''écart.
verses.am: ወዳጆቼም ባልንጀሮቼም ከቍስሌ ገለል ብለው ቆሙ፥ ዘመዶቼም ርቀው ቆሙ።

verses.en: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.
verses.fr: Ceux qui en veulent à ma vie tendent leurs pièges; Ceux qui cherchent mon malheur disent des méchancetés, Et méditent tout le jour des tromperies.
verses.am: ነፍሴንም የሚሹአት በረቱብኝ፥ መከራዬንም የሚፈልጉ ከንቱን ተናገሩ፥ ሁልጊዜም በሽንገላ ይመክራሉ።

verses.en: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.
verses.fr: Et moi, je suis comme un sourd, je n''entends pas; Je suis comme un muet, qui n''ouvre pas la bouche.
verses.am: እኔ ግን እንደማይሰማ ደንቆሮ አፉንም እንደማይከፍት ዲዳ ሆንሁ።

verses.en: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.
verses.fr: Je suis comme un homme qui n''entend pas, Et dans la bouche duquel il n''y a point de réplique.
verses.am: እንደማይሰማ ሰው በአፉም ተግሣጽ እንደሌለው ሰው ሆንሁ።

verses.en: For in thee, O Lord, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.
verses.fr: Eternel! c''est en toi que j''espère; Tu répondras, Seigneur, mon Dieu!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በአንተ ታምኛለሁና፤ አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ አንተ ትሰማኛለህ።

verses.en: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.
verses.fr: Car je dis: Ne permets pas qu''ils se réjouissent à mon sujet, Qu''ils s''élèvent contre moi, si mon pied chancelle!
verses.am: ጠላቶቼ በእኔ ላይ ደስ እንዳይላቸው ብያለሁና፥ እግሮቼም ቢሰናከሉ ራሳቸውን በእኔ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋሉ።

verses.en: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.
verses.fr: Car je suis près de tomber, Et ma douleur est toujours devant moi.
verses.am: እኔስ ወደ ማንከስ ቀርቤአለሁና፥ ቍስሌም ሁልጊዜም በፊቴ ነውና።

verses.en: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
verses.fr: Car je reconnais mon iniquité, Je suis dans la crainte à cause de mon péché.
verses.am: በደሌን እናገራለሁና፥ ስለ ኃጢአቴም እተክዛለሁ።

verses.en: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
verses.fr: Et mes ennemis sont pleins de vie, pleins de force; Ceux qui me haïssent sans cause sont nombreux.
verses.am: ጠላቶቼ ሕያዋን ናቸው ይበረቱብኝማል፥ በጠማማነትም የሚጠሉኝ በዙ።

verses.en: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.
verses.fr: Ils me rendent le mal pour le bien; Ils sont mes adversaires, parce que je recherche le bien.
verses.am: ጽድቅን ስለ ተከተልሁ፥ በበጎ ፋንታ ክፉን የሚመልሱልኝ ይጠሉኛል።

verses.en: Forsake me not, O Lord: O my God, be not far from me.
verses.fr: Ne m''abandonne pas, Eternel! Mon Dieu, ne t''éloigne pas de moi!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ አትጣለኝ፤ አምላኬ፥ ከኔ አትራቅ።

verses.en: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.
verses.fr: Viens en hâte à mon secours, Seigneur, mon salut!
verses.am: አቤቱ መድኃኒቴ፥ እኔን ለመርዳት ፍጠን።

verses.en: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. A Jeduthun, Psaume de David. Je disais: Je veillerai sur mes voies, De peur de pécher par ma langue; Je mettrai un frein à ma bouche, Tant que le méchant sera devant moi.
verses.am: በአንደበቴ እንዳልስት መንገዴን እጠብቃለሁ፤ ኃጢአተኛ በፊቴ በተቃወመኝ ጊዜ በአፌ ላይ ጠባቂ አኖራለሁ አልሁ።

verses.en: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.
verses.fr: Je suis resté muet, dans le silence; Je me suis tu, quoique malheureux; Et ma douleur n''était pas moins vive.
verses.am: ከዝምታ የተነሣ እንደ ዲዳ ሆንሁ፥ ለበጎ እንኳ ዝም አልሁ፥ ቍስሌም ታደሰብኝ።

verses.en: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,
verses.fr: Mon coeur brûlait au dedans de moi, Un feu intérieur me consumait, Et la parole est venue sur ma langue.
verses.am: ልቤም በውስጤ ሞቀብኝ፤ ከማሰቤም የተነሣ እሳት ነደደ፥ በአንደበቴም ተናገርሁ።

verses.en: Lord, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is: that I may know how frail I am.
