verses.fr: Malgré mon innocence, ils courent, ils se préparent: Réveille-toi, viens à ma rencontre, et regarde!
verses.am: ያለ በደል ሮጥሁ ተዘጋጀሁም፤ ተነሥ፥ ተቀበለኝ፥ እይም።

verses.en: Thou therefore, O Lord God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.
verses.fr: Toi, Eternel, Dieu des armées, Dieu d''Israël, Lève-toi, pour châtier toutes les nations! N''aie pitié d''aucun de ces méchants infidèles! -Pause.
verses.am: አንተም አቤቱ፥ የኃያላን አምላክ፥ የእስራኤል አምላክ፥ አሕዛብን ሁሉ ትጐበኛቸው ዘንድ ተነሥ፤ ዓመፅ የሚያደርጉትን ሁሉ አትማራቸው።

verses.en: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
verses.fr: Ils reviennent chaque soir, ils hurlent comme des chiens, Ils font le tour de la ville.
verses.am: ማታ ይመለሱ እንደ ውሾችም ይራቡ፥ በከተማም ይዙሩ።

verses.en: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they, doth hear?
verses.fr: Voici, de leur bouche ils font jaillir le mal, Des glaives sont sur leurs lèvres; Car, qui est-ce qui entend?
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በአፋቸው አሰምተው ይናገራሉ፤ ሰይፍም በከንፈሮቻቸው አለ፤ ማን ይሰማል? ይላሉ።

verses.en: But thou, O Lord, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.
verses.fr: Et toi, Eternel, tu te ris d''eux, Tu te moques de toutes les nations.
verses.am: አንተ ግን አቤቱ፥ ትሥቅባቸዋለህ፥ አሕዛብንም ሁሉ ትንቃቸዋለህ።

verses.en: Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God is my defence.
verses.fr: Quelle que soit leur force, c''est en toi que j''espère, Car Dieu est ma haute retraite.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር መጠጊያዬ ነውና ኃይሌን ወደ አንተ አስጠጋለሁ።

verses.en: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.
verses.fr: Mon Dieu vient au-devant de moi dans sa bonté, Dieu me fait contempler avec joie ceux qui me persécutent.
verses.am: የአምላኬ ቸርነቱ ይገናኘኛል አምላኬ በጠላቶቼ ላይ ያሳየኛል።

verses.en: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.
verses.fr: Ne les tue pas, de peur que mon peuple ne l''oublie; Fais-les errer par ta puissance, et précipite-les, Seigneur, notre bouclier!
verses.am: ሕግህን እንዳይረሱ አትግደላቸው፤ አቤቱ ጋሻዬ፥ በኃይልህ በትናቸው አውርዳቸውም።

verses.en: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.
verses.fr: Leur bouche pèche à chaque parole de leurs lèvres: Qu''ils soient pris dans leur propre orgueil! Ils ne profèrent que malédictions et mensonges.
verses.am: ስለ አፋቸው ኃጢአት ስለ ከንፈራቸውም ቃል፥ መርገምንና ሐሰትን ስለሚናገሩ፥ በትዕቢታቸው ይጠመዱ።

verses.en: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.
verses.fr: Détruis-les, dans ta fureur, détruis-les, et qu''ils ne soient plus! Qu''ils sachent que Dieu règne sur Jacob, Jusqu''aux extrémités de la terre! -Pause.
verses.am: በቍጣ አጥፋቸው፥ እንዳይኖሩም አጥፋቸው፤ የያዕቆብም አምላክ እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ ድረስ እንዲገዛ ይወቁ።

verses.en: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
verses.fr: Ils reviennent chaque soir, ils hurlent comme des chiens, Ils font le tour de la ville.
verses.am: ማታ ይመለሱ እንደ ውሾችም ይራቡ፥ በከተማም ይዙሩ።

verses.en: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.
verses.fr: Ils errent çà et là, cherchant leur nourriture, Et ils passent la nuit sans être rassasiés.
verses.am: እነርሱም መብል ለመፈለግ ይበተኑ፤ ያልጠገቡ እንደ ሆነም ያንጐረጕራሉ።

verses.en: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.
verses.fr: Et moi, je chanterai ta force; Dès le matin, je célébrerai ta bonté. Car tu es pour moi une haute retraite, Un refuge au jour de ma détresse.
verses.am: እኔ ግን ለኃይልህ እቀኛለሁ፤ በምሕረትህም ማልዶ ደስ ይለኛል፤ በመከራዬ ቀን መጠጊያዬና አምባዬ ሆነኸኛልና።

verses.en: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.
verses.fr: O ma force! c''est toi que je célébrerai, Car Dieu, mon Dieu tout bon, est ma haute retraite.
verses.am: ረዳቴ ሆይ፥ ለአንተ ለአምላኬ እዘምራለሁ፤ አንተ፥ አምላኬ፥ መጠጊያዬ ምሕረቴም ነህና።

verses.en: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Sur le lis lyrique. Hymne de David, pour enseigner. Lorsqu''il fit la guerre aux Syriens de Mésopotamie et aux Syriens de Tsoba, et que Joab revint et battit dans la vallée du sel douze mille Edomites. O Dieu! tu nous as repoussés, dispersés, Tu t''es irrité: relève-nous!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጣልኸን አፈረስኸንም፤ ተቈጣኸን ይቅርም አልኸን።

verses.en: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.
verses.fr: Tu as ébranlé la terre, tu l''as déchirée: Répare ses brèches, car elle chancelle!
verses.am: ምድርን አናወጥሃት አወክሃትም፤ ተናውጣለችና ቍስልዋን ፈውስ።

verses.en: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.
verses.fr: Tu as fait voir à ton peuple des choses dures, Tu nous as abreuvés d''un vin d''étourdissement.
verses.am: ለሕዝብህ ጭንቅን አሳየሃቸው፥ አስደንጋጩንም ወይን አጠጣኸን።

verses.en: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
verses.fr: Tu as donné à ceux qui te craignent une bannière, Pour qu''elle s''élève à cause de la vérité. -Pause.
verses.am: ከቀስት ፊት ያመልጡ ዘንድ፥ ለሚፈሩህ ምልክትን ሰጠሃቸው።

verses.en: That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.
verses.fr: Afin que tes bien-aimés soient délivrés, Sauve par ta droite, et exauce-nous!
verses.am: ወዳጆችህ እንዲድኑ በቀኝህ አድን፥ አድምጠኝም።

verses.en: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.fr: Dieu a dit dans sa sainteté: Je triompherai, Je partagerai Sichem, je mesurerai la vallée de Succoth;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በቅድስናው ተናገረ፤ ደስ ይለኛል፥ ሴኬምንም እካፈላለሁ፥ የሱኮትንም ሸለቆ እሰፍራለሁ።

verses.en: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
verses.fr: A moi Galaad, à moi Manassé; Ephraïm est le rempart de ma tête, Et Juda, mon sceptre;
verses.am: ገለዓድ የእኔ ነው፥ ምናሴም የእኔ ነው፤ ኤፍሬም የራሴ መጠጊያ ነው። ይሁዳ ንጉሤ ነው፤

verses.en: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.
verses.fr: Moab est le bassin où je me lave; Je jette mon soulier sur Edom; Pays des Philistins, pousse à mon sujet des cris de joie! -
verses.am: ሞዓብ መታጠቢያዬ ነው፥ በኤዶምያስ ላይ ጫማዬን እዘረጋለሁ፤ ፍልስጥኤም ይገዙልኛል።

verses.en: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
verses.fr: Qui me mènera dans la ville forte? Qui me conduira à Edom?
verses.am: ወደ ጽኑ ከተማ ማን ይወስደኛል? ማንስ እስከ ኤዶምያስ ይመራኛል?

verses.en: Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?
verses.fr: N''est-ce pas toi, ô Dieu, qui nous as repoussés, Et qui ne sortais plus, ô Dieu, avec nos armées?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የጣልኸን አንተ አይደለህምን? አምላክ ሆይ፥ ከሠራዊታችን ጋር አትወጣም።

verses.en: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
verses.fr: Donne-nous du secours contre la détresse! Le secours de l''homme n''est que vanité.
verses.am: በመከራችን ረድኤትን ስጠን የሰውም ማዳን ከንቱ ነው።

verses.en: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
verses.fr: Avec Dieu, nous ferons des exploits; Il écrasera nos ennemis.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ኃይልን እናደርጋለን እርሱ የሚያስጨንቁንን ያዋርዳቸዋልና።

verses.en: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Sur instruments à cordes. De David. O Dieu! écoute mes cris, Sois attentif à ma prière!
verses.am: አምላክ ሆይ፥ ልመናዬን ስማ፥ ጸሎቴንም አድምጥ።

verses.en: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
verses.fr: Du bout de la terre je crie à toi, le coeur abattu; Conduis-moi sur le rocher que je ne puis atteindre!
verses.am: ልቤ ተስፋ በቈረጠ ጊዜ ከምድር ዳርቻ ወደ አንተ እጮኻለሁ፤ በድንጋይ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ አደረግኸኝ።

verses.en: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.
verses.fr: Car tu es pour moi un refuge, Une tour forte, en face de l''ennemi.
verses.am: ጽኑ ግንብ በጠላት ፊት ተስፋዬም ሆነኸኛልና መራኸኝ።

verses.en: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.
verses.fr: Je voudrais séjourner éternellement dans ta tente, Me réfugier à l''abri de tes ailes. -Pause.
verses.am: በድንኳንህ ለዘላለም እኖራለሁ፤ በክንፎችህም ጥላ እጋረዳለሁ፤

verses.en: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.
verses.fr: Car toi, ô Dieu! tu exauces mes voeux, Tu me donnes l''héritage de ceux qui craignent ton nom.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ስእለቴን ሰምተሃልና፤ ስምህንም ለሚፈሩ ርስትህን ሰጠሃቸው።

verses.en: Thou wilt prolong the king's life: and his years as many generations.
verses.fr: Ajoute des jours aux jours du roi; Que ses années se prolongent à jamais!
verses.am: ለንጉሥ ከቀን በላይ ቀን ትጨምራለህ፥ ዓመታቱም ከትውልድ ወደ ትውልድ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.
verses.fr: Qu''il reste sur le trône éternellement devant Dieu! Fais que ta bonté et ta fidélité veillent sur lui!
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለዘላለም ይኖራል፤ ይጠብቁት ዘንድ ምሕረትንና እውነትን አዘጋጅለት።

verses.en: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.
verses.fr: Alors je chanterai sans cesse ton nom, En accomplissant chaque jour mes voeux.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ለስምህ ለዘላለም እዘምራለሁ ስእለቴን ሁልጊዜ እፈጽም ዘንድ።

verses.en: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. D''après Jeduthun. Psaume de David. Oui, c''est en Dieu que mon âme se confie; De lui vient mon salut.
verses.am: ነፍሴ ለእግዚአብሔር የምትገዛ አይደለችምን? መድኃኒቴ ከእርሱ ዘንድ ናትና።

verses.en: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.
verses.fr: Oui, c''est lui qui est mon rocher et mon salut; Ma haute retraite: je ne chancellerai guère.
verses.am: እርሱ አምላኬ መድኃኒቴም ነውና፤ እርሱ መጠጊያዬ ነው፥ እጅግም አልታወክም።

verses.en: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.
verses.fr: Jusqu''à quand vous jetterez-vous sur un homme, Chercherez-vous tous à l''abattre, Comme une muraille qui penche, Comme une clôture qu''on renverse?
verses.am: እስከ መቼ በሰው ላይ ትቆማላችሁ? እናንተ ሁላችሁ እንዳዘነበለ ግድግዳ እንደ ፈረሰም ቅጥር ትገድላላችሁ።

verses.en: They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
verses.fr: Ils conspirent pour le précipiter de son poste élevé; Ils prennent plaisir au mensonge; Ils bénissent de leur bouche, Et ils maudissent dans leur coeur. -Pause.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ክብሬን ይሽሩ ዘንድ መከሩ፥ ሐሰትንም ይወድዳሉ፤ በአፋቸው ይባርካሉ፥ በልባቸውም ይረግማሉ።

verses.en: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.
verses.fr: Oui, mon âme, confie-toi en Dieu! Car de lui vient mon espérance.
verses.am: ነገር ግን፥ ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ አንቺ ለእግዚአብሔር ተገዢ፥ ተስፋዬ ከእርሱ ዘንድ ናትና።

verses.en: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.
verses.fr: Oui, c''est lui qui est mon rocher et mon salut; Ma haute retraite: je ne chancellerai pas.
verses.am: እርሱ አምላኬ መድኃኒቴም ነውና፤ እርሱ መጠጊያዬ ነው፤ አልታወክም።

verses.en: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
verses.fr: Sur Dieu reposent mon salut et ma gloire; Le rocher de ma force, mon refuge, est en Dieu.
verses.am: መድኃኒቴና ክብሬ በእግዚአብሔር ነው፤ የረድኤቴ አምላክ ተስፋዬም እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.
verses.fr: En tout temps, peuples, confiez-vous en lui, Répandez vos coeurs en sa présence! Dieu est notre refuge, -Pause.
verses.am: የሕዝብ ማኅበር ሁላችሁ፥ በእርሱ ታመኑ፥ ልባችሁንም በፊቱ አፍስሱ፤ እግዚአብሔር ረዳታችን ነው።

verses.en: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.
verses.fr: Oui, vanité, les fils de l''homme! Mensonge, les fils de l''homme! Dans une balance ils monteraient Tous ensemble, plus légers qu''un souffle.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የሰው ልጆች ከንቱ ናቸው፥ የሰው ልጆችም ሐሰተኞች ናቸው፤ በሚዛንም ይበድላሉ፥ እነርሱስ በፍጹም ከንቱ ናቸው።

verses.en: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.
verses.fr: Ne vous confiez pas dans la violence, Et ne mettez pas un vain espoir dans la rapine; Quand les richesses s''accroissent, N''y attachez pas votre coeur.
verses.am: ዓመፃን ተስፋ አታድርጉ፥ ቅሚያንም አትተማመኑት፤ ባለጠግነት ቢበዛ ልባችሁ አይኵራ።

verses.en: God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongeth unto God.
verses.fr: Dieu a parlé une fois; Deux fois j''ai entendu ceci: C''est que la force est à Dieu.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አንድ ጊዜ ተናገረ፥ እኔም ይህን ብቻ ሰማሁ፤ ኃይል የእግዚአብሔር ነው፥

verses.en: Also unto thee, O Lord, belongeth mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.
verses.fr: A toi aussi, Seigneur! la bonté; Car tu rends à chacun selon ses oeuvres.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትም ያንተ ነው፤ አንተ ለእያንዳንዱ እንደ ሥራው ፍዳውን ትሰጣለህና።

verses.en: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
verses.fr: Psaume de David. Lorsqu''il était dans le désert de Juda. O Dieu! tu es mon Dieu, je te cherche; Mon âme a soif de toi, mon corps soupire après toi, Dans une terre aride, desséchée, sans eau.
verses.am: አምላኬ፥ አምላኬ፥ ወደ አንተ እገሠግሣለሁ፤ ነፍሴ አንተን ተጠማች፥ ሥጋዬ አንተን እንዴት ናፈቀች እንጨትና ውኃ በሌለበት በምድረ በዳ።

verses.en: To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.
verses.fr: Ainsi je te contemple dans le sanctuaire, Pour voir ta puissance et ta gloire.
verses.am: ኃይልህንና ክብርህን አይ ዘንድ እንዲሁ በመቅደስ ውስጥ ተመለከትሁህ።

verses.en: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.
verses.fr: Car ta bonté vaut mieux que la vie: Mes lèvres célèbrent tes louanges.
verses.am: ምሕረትህ ከሕይወት ይሻላልና ከንፈሮቼ ያመሰግኑሃል።

verses.en: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.
verses.fr: Je te bénirai donc toute ma vie, J''élèverai mes mains en ton nom.
verses.am: እንዲህ በሕይወቴ ዘመን አመሰግንሃለሁ፥ በአንተም ስም እጆቼን አነሣለሁ።

verses.en: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:
verses.fr: Mon âme sera rassasiée comme de mets gras et succulents, Et, avec des cris de joie sur les lèvres, ma bouche te célébrera.
verses.am: ነፍሴ በቅቤና በስብ እንደሚጠግቡ ትጠግባለች፥ ከንፈሮቼም ስምህን በደስታ ያመሰግናሉ።

verses.en: When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.
verses.fr: Lorsque je pense à toi sur ma couche, Je médite sur toi pendant les veilles de la nuit.
verses.am: በመኝታዬም አስብሃለሁ፥ በማለዳም እናገርልሃለሁ፤

verses.en: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
verses.fr: Car tu es mon secours, Et je suis dans l''allégresse à l''ombre de tes ailes.
verses.am: ረዳቴ ሆነኸኛልና፥ በክንፎችህም ጥላ ደስ ይለኛልና።

verses.en: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.
verses.fr: Mon âme est attachée à toi; Ta droite me soutient.
verses.am: ነፍሴ በኋላህ ተከታተለች፥ እኔንም ቀኝህ ተቀበለችኝ።

verses.en: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
verses.fr: Mais ceux qui cherchent à m''ôter la vie Iront dans les profondeurs de la terre;
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን ነፍሴን ለከንቱ ፈለጓት፤ ወደ ምድር ጥልቅ ይገባሉ።

verses.en: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.
verses.fr: Ils seront livrés au glaive, Ils seront la proie des chacals.
verses.am: ለሰይፍ እጅ አልፈው ይሰጣሉ፥ የቀበሮም እድል ፈንታ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
verses.fr: Et le roi se réjouira en Dieu; Quiconque jure par lui s''en glorifiera, Car la bouche des menteurs sera fermée.
verses.am: ንጉሥ ግን በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይለዋል፤ በእርሱ የሚምል ሁሉ ይከብራል፥ ሐሰትን የሚናገር አፍ ይዘጋልና።

verses.en: Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Psaume de David. O Dieu, écoute ma voix, quand je gémis! Protège ma vie contre l''ennemi que je crains!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ በለመንሁ ጊዜ ጸሎቴን ስማኝ፥ ከጠላትም ፍርሃት ነፍሴን አድን።

verses.en: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:
verses.fr: Garantis-moi des complots des méchants, De la troupe bruyante des hommes iniques!
verses.am: ከክፉዎች ሸንጎ ከዓመፀኞችም ብዛት ሰውረኝ።

verses.en: Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:
verses.fr: Ils aiguisent leur langue comme un glaive, Ils lancent comme des traits leurs paroles amères,
verses.am: እንደ ሰይፍ ምላሳቸውን አሰሉ፤ መራራ ነገርን ለማድረግ፥

verses.en: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.
verses.fr: Pour tirer en cachette sur l''innocent; Ils tirent sur lui à l''improviste, et n''ont aucune crainte.
verses.am: ንጹሕንም በስውር ለመንደፍ ቀስትን ገተሩ፤ ድንገት ይነድፉታል አይፈሩምም።

verses.en: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?
verses.fr: Ils se fortifient dans leur méchanceté: Ils se concertent pour tendre des pièges, Ils disent: Qui les verra?
verses.am: ለእነርሱ ለራሳቸው ክፉ ነገርን አጸኑ፤ ወጥመድን ይሰውሩ ዘንድ ተማከሩ፤ ማንስ ያየናል? ይላሉ።

verses.en: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.
verses.fr: Ils méditent des crimes: Nous voici prêts, le plan est conçu! La pensée intime, le coeur de chacun est un abîme.
verses.am: ዓመፃን ፈልጓት፥ ሲፈትኑም አለቁ፤ የሰው የውስጥ አሳቡና ልቡ የጠለቀ ነው፥

verses.en: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.
verses.fr: Dieu lance contre eux ses traits: Soudain les voilà frappés.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከፍ ከፍ ይላል። የድንገትም ፍላጻ፤ ያቈስላቸዋል፤

verses.en: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.
verses.fr: Leur langue a causé leur chute; Tous ceux qui les voient secouent la tête.
verses.am: አንደበታቸው ያሰናክላቸዋል፥ የሚያዩአቸውም ሁሉ ይደነግጣሉ።

verses.en: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.
verses.fr: Tous les hommes sont saisis de crainte, Ils publient ce que Dieu fait, Et prennent garde à son oeuvre.
verses.am: ሰዎች ሁሉ ፈሩ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ሥራ ተናገሩ፥ ሥራውንም አስተዋሉ።

verses.en: The righteous shall be glad in the Lord, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.
verses.fr: Le juste se réjouit en l''Eternel et cherche en lui son refuge, Tous ceux qui ont le coeur droit se glorifient.
verses.am: ጻድቅ በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይለዋል፥ በእርሱም ይታመናል፤ ልባቸውም የቀና ሁሉ እልል ይላሉ።

verses.en: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Psaume de David. Cantique. Avec confiance, ô Dieu! on te louera dans Sion, Et l''on accomplira les voeux qu''on t''a faits.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በጽዮን ለአንተ ምስጋና ይገባል፥ ለአንተም ጸሎት ይቀርባል።

verses.en: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.
verses.fr: O toi, qui écoutes la prière! Tous les hommes viendront à toi.
verses.am: ሥጋ ሁሉ ጸሎትን ወደምትሰማ ወደ አንተ ይመጣል።

verses.en: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.
verses.fr: Les iniquités m''accablent: Tu pardonneras nos transgressions.
verses.am: የዓመፃ ነገር በረታብን፤ ኃጢአታችንንስ አንተ ይቅር ትላለህ።

verses.en: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.
verses.fr: Heureux celui que tu choisis et que tu admets en ta présence, Pour qu''il habite dans tes parvis! Nous nous rassasierons du bonheur de ta maison, De la sainteté de ton temple.
verses.am: አንተ የመረጥኸው በአደባባዮችህም ለማደር የተቀበልኸው ምስጉን ነው፤ ከቤትህ በረከት እንጠግባለን።

verses.en: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:
verses.fr: Dans ta bonté, tu nous exauces par des prodiges, Dieu de notre salut, Espoir de toutes les extrémités lointaines de la terre et de la mer!
verses.am: ቤተ መቅደስህ ቅዱስ ነው በጽድቅም ድንቅ ነው። በምድር ዳርቻ ሁሉና በሩቅ ባሕር ውስጥ ላሉ ተስፋቸው የሆንህ፥ አምላካችንና መድኃኒታችን ሆይ፥ ስማን።

verses.en: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:
verses.fr: Il affermit les montagnes par sa force, Il est ceint de puissance;
verses.am: በጉልበትህ ተራሮችን አጸናሃቸው፥ በኃይልም ታጥቀሃል።

verses.en: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.
verses.fr: Il apaise le mugissement des mers, le mugissement de leurs flots, Et le tumulte des peuples.
verses.am: የባሕሩን ጥልቀት የሞገድንም ጩኸት ታናውጣለህ።

verses.en: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
verses.fr: Ceux qui habitent aux extrémités du monde s''effraient de tes prodiges; Tu remplis d''allégresse l''orient et l''occident.
verses.am: ከተአምራትህ የተነሣ አሕዛብ ይደነግጣሉ፥ በምድር ዳርቻም የሚኖሩ ይፈራሉ፤ የጥዋትንና የማታን መውጫ ደስ ታሰኛቸዋለህ።

verses.en: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.
verses.fr: Tu visites la terre et tu lui donnes l''abondance, Tu la combles de richesses; Le ruisseau de Dieu est plein d''eau; Tu prépares le blé, quand tu la fertilises ainsi.
verses.am: ምድርን ጐበኘሃት አጠጣሃትም፥ ብልጥግናዋንም እጅግ አበዛህ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ወንዝ ውኃን የተመላ ነው፤ ምግባቸውን አዘጋጀህ እንዲሁ ታሰናዳለህና።

verses.en: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.
verses.fr: En arrosant ses sillons, en aplanissant ses mottes, Tu la détrempes par des pluies, tu bénis son germe.
verses.am: ትልምዋን ታረካለህ፥ ቦይዋንም ታስተካክላለህ፤ በነጠብጣብ ታለሰልሳታለህ፥ ቡቃያዋንም ትባርካለህ።

verses.en: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.
verses.fr: Tu couronnes l''année de tes biens, Et tes pas versent l''abondance;
verses.am: በቸርነትህ ዓመትን ታቀዳጃለህ፥ ምድረ በዳውም ስብን ይጠግባል።

verses.en: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.
verses.fr: Les plaines du désert sont abreuvées, Et les collines sont ceintes d''allégresse;
verses.am: የምድረ በዳ ተራሮች ይረካሉ፥ ኮረብቶችም በደስታ ይታጠቃሉ።

verses.en: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.
verses.fr: Les pâturages se couvrent de brebis, Et les vallées se revêtent de froment. Les cris de joie et les chants retentissent.
verses.am: ማሰማርያዎች መንጎችን ለበሱ፥ ሸለቆችም በእህል ተሸፈኑ፤ በደስታ ይጮኻሉ ይዘምራሉም።

verses.en: Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Cantique. Psaume. Poussez vers Dieu des cris de joie, Vous tous, habitants de la terre!
verses.am: በምድር ያላችሁ ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር እልል በሉ፥

verses.en: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.
verses.fr: Chantez la gloire de son nom, Célébrez sa gloire par vos louanges!
verses.am: ለስሙም ዘምሩ፥ ለምስጋናውም ክብርን ስጡ።

verses.en: Say unto God, How terrible art thou in thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.
verses.fr: Dites à Dieu: Que tes oeuvres sont redoutables! A cause de la grandeur de ta force, tes ennemis te flattent.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን እንዲህ በሉት። ሥራህ ግሩም ነው፤ ኃይልህ ብዙ ሲሆን ጠላቶች ዋሹብህ።

verses.en: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.
verses.fr: Toute la terre se prosterne devant toi et chante en ton honneur; Elle chante ton nom. -Pause.
verses.am: በምድር ያሉ ሁሉ ለአንተ ይሰግዳሉ፥ ለአንተም ይዘምራሉ፥ ለስምህም ይዘምራሉ።

verses.en: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.
verses.fr: Venez et contemplez les oeuvres de Dieu! Il est redoutable quand il agit sur les fils de l''homme.
verses.am: ኑ የእግዚአብሔርንም ሥራ እዩ፤ ከሰው ልጆች ይልቅ በምክር ግሩም ነው።

verses.en: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.
verses.fr: Il changea la mer en une terre sèche, On traversa le fleuve à pied: Alors nous nous réjouîmes en lui.
verses.am: ባሕርን የብስ አደረጋት፥ ወንዙንም በእግር ተሻገሩ፤ በዚያ በእርሱ ደስ ይለናል።

verses.en: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.
verses.fr: Il domine éternellement par sa puissance, Ses yeux observent les nations: Que les rebelles ne s''élèvent pas! -Pause.
verses.am: በኃይሉ ለዘላለም ይገዛል፤ ዓይኖቹ ወደ አሕዛብ ይመለከታሉ፤ ዓመፀኞች ራሳቸውን ከፍ ከፍ አያድርጉ።

verses.en: O bless our God, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:
verses.fr: Peuples, bénissez notre Dieu, Faites retentir sa louange!
verses.am: አሕዛብ ሆይ፥ አምላካችንን ባርኩ፥ የምስጋናውንም ድምፅ አሰሙ።

verses.en: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.
verses.fr: Il a conservé la vie à notre âme, Et il n''a pas permis que notre pied chancelât.
verses.am: ነፍሴን በሕይወት ያኖራታል፥ እግሮቼንም ለመናወጥ አልሰጠም።

verses.en: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.
verses.fr: Car tu nous as éprouvés, ô Dieu! Tu nous as fait passer au creuset comme l''argent.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ፈትነኸናልና፥ ብርንም እንደሚያነጥሩት አንጥረኸናልና።

verses.en: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.
verses.fr: Tu nous as amenés dans le filet, Tu as mis sur nos reins un pesant fardeau,
verses.am: ወደ ወጥመድ አገባኸን፥ በጀርባችንም መከራን አኖርህ።

verses.en: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.
verses.fr: Tu as fait monter des hommes sur nos têtes; Nous avons passé par le feu et par l''eau. Mais tu nous en as tirés pour nous donner l''abondance.
verses.am: በራሳችን ላይ ሰውን አስረገጥኸን፤ በእሳትና በውኃ መካከል አለፍን፥ ወደ ዕረፍትም አወጣኸን።

verses.en: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,
verses.fr: J''irai dans ta maison avec des holocaustes, J''accomplirai mes voeux envers toi:
verses.am: ከዕጣንና ከወጠጤዎች ጋር ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ፍሪዳን አቀርባለሁ፤ ላሞችንና ፍየሎችን እሠዋልሃለሁ።

verses.en: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.
verses.fr: Pour eux mes lèvres se sont ouvertes, Et ma bouche les a prononcés dans ma détresse.
verses.am: ከዕጣንና ከወጠጤዎች ጋር ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ፍሪዳን አቀርባለሁ፤ ላሞችንና ፍየሎችን እሠዋልሃለሁ።

verses.en: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.
verses.fr: Je t''offrirai des brebis grasses en holocauste, Avec la graisse des béliers; Je sacrifierai des brebis avec des boucs. -Pause.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን የምትፈሩት ሁሉ፥ ኑ፥ ስሙኝ፤ ለነፍሴ ያደረገላትን ልንገራችሁ።

verses.en: Come and hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.
verses.fr: Venez, écoutez, vous tous qui craignez Dieu, et je raconterai Ce qu''il a fait à mon âme.
verses.am: በአፌ ወደ እርሱ ጮኽሁ፥ በአንደበቴም አመሰገንሁት።

verses.en: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.
verses.fr: J''ai crié à lui de ma bouche, Et la louange a été sur ma langue.
verses.am: በልቤስ በደልን አይቼ ብሆን ጌታ አይሰማኝም ነበር።

verses.en: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me:
verses.fr: Si j''avais conçu l''iniquité dans mon coeur, Le Seigneur ne m''aurait pas exaucé.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር ሰማኝ፤ የልመናዬን ድምፅ አደመጠ።

verses.en: But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.
verses.fr: Mais Dieu m''a exaucé, Il a été attentif à la voix de ma prière.
verses.am: ጸሎቴን ያልከለከለኝ ምሕረቱንም ከእኔ ያላራቀ እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን።

verses.en: Blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.
verses.fr: Béni soit Dieu, Qui n''a pas rejeté ma prière, Et qui ne m''a pas retiré sa bonté!
verses.am: ጸሎቴን ያልከለከለኝ ምሕረቱንም ከእኔ ያላራቀ እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን።

verses.en: God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Avec instruments à cordes. Psaume. Cantique. Que Dieu ait pitié de nous et qu''il nous bénisse, Qu''il fasse luire sur nous sa face, -Pause.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ይማረን ይባርከንም፥ ፊቱንም በላያችን ያብራ፤

verses.en: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.
verses.fr: Afin que l''on connaisse sur la terre ta voie, Et parmi toutes les nations ton salut!
verses.am: በአሕዛብ ሁሉ መካከል ማዳንህን፥ መንገድህንም በምድር እናውቅ ዘንድ።

verses.en: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
verses.fr: Les peuples te louent, ô Dieu! Tous les peuples te louent.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አሕዛብ ያመስግኑህ፥ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ያመስግኑህ።

verses.en: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.
verses.fr: Les nations se réjouissent et sont dans l''allégresse; Car tu juges les peuples avec droiture, Et tu conduis les nations sur la terre. -Pause.
verses.am: ለአሕዛብ በቅን ትፈርድላቸዋለህና፥ አሕዛብንም በምድር ላይ ትመራለህና አሕዛብ ደስ ይበላቸው ሐሤትም ያድርጉ።

verses.en: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
verses.fr: Les peuples te louent, ô Dieu! Tous les peuples te louent.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አሕዛብ ያመስግኑህ፥ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ያመስግኑህ።

verses.en: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and God, even our own God, shall bless us.
verses.fr: La terre donne ses produits; Dieu, notre Dieu, nous bénit.
verses.am: ምድር ፍሬዋን ሰጠች፤ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችንም ይባርከናል።

verses.en: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
verses.fr: Dieu, nous bénit, Et toutes les extrémités de la terre le craignent.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ይባርከናል፥ የምድርም ዳርቻ ሁሉ ይፈሩታል።

verses.en: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. De David. Psaume. Cantique. Dieu se lève, ses ennemis se dispersent, Et ses adversaires fuient devant sa face.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ይነሣ፥ ጠላቶቹም ይበተኑ፥ የሚጠሉትም ከፊቱ ይሽሹ።

verses.en: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
verses.fr: Comme la fumée se dissipe, tu les dissipes; Comme la cire se fond au feu, Les méchants disparaissent devant Dieu.
verses.am: ጢስ እንደሚበንን እንዲሁ ይብነኑ፤ ሰም በእሳት ፊት እንደሚቀልጥ፥ እንዲሁ ኅጥኣን ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይጥፉ።

verses.en: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.
verses.fr: Mais les justes se réjouissent, ils triomphent devant Dieu, Ils ont des transports d''allégresse.
verses.am: ጻድቃንም ደስ ይበላቸው፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ሐሤት ያድርጉ፥ በደስታም ደስ ይበላቸው።

verses.en: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name Jah, and rejoice before him.
verses.fr: Chantez à Dieu, célébrez son nom! Frayez le chemin à celui qui s''avance à travers les plaines! L''Eternel est son nom: réjouissez-vous devant lui!
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር ተቀኙ ለስሙም ዘምሩ፤ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ለወጣም መንገድ አድርጉ፤ ስሙ እግዚአብሔር ነው፥ በፊቱም ደስ ይበላችሁ፤ በፊቱም ይደነግጣሉ።

verses.en: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
verses.fr: Le père des orphelins, le défenseur des veuves, C''est Dieu dans sa demeure sainte.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በቅዱስ ቦታው ለድሀ አደጎች አባት፥ ለባልቴቶችም ዳኛ ነው።

verses.en: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.
verses.fr: Dieu donne une famille à ceux qui étaient abandonnés, Il délivre les captifs et les rend heureux; Les rebelles seuls habitent des lieux arides.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ብቸኞችን በቤት ያሳድራቸዋል፥ እስረኞችንም በኃይሉ ያወጣቸዋል፤ ዓመፀኞች ግን በምድረ በዳ ይኖራሉ።

verses.en: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:
verses.fr: O Dieu! quand tu sortis à la tête de ton peuple, Quand tu marchais dans le désert, -Pause.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በሕዝብም ፊት በወጣህ ጊዜ፥ በምድረ በዳም ባለፍህ ጊዜ፥ ምድር ተናወጠች፥

verses.en: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
verses.fr: La terre trembla, les cieux se fondirent devant Dieu, Le Sinaï s''ébranla devant Dieu, le Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: ከሲና አምላክ ፊት፥ ከእስራኤል አምላክ ፊት ሰማያትም አንጠበጠቡ።

verses.en: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.
verses.fr: Tu fis tomber une pluie bienfaisante, ô Dieu! Tu fortifias ton héritage épuisé.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የሞገስን ዝናብ ለርስትህ አዘነብህ፥ በደከመም ጊዜ አንተ አጸናኸው።

verses.en: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.
verses.fr: Ton peuple établit sa demeure dans le pays Que par ta bonté, ô Dieu! tu avais préparé pour les malheureux.
verses.am: እንስሶችህ በውስጡ አደሩ፤ አቤቱ፥ በቸርነትህ ለድሆች አዘጋጀህ።

verses.en: The Lord gave the word: great was the company of those that published it.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur dit une parole, Et les messagères de bonnes nouvelles sont une grande armée: -
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ቃሉን ሰጠ፤ የሚያወሩት ብዙ ሠራዊት ናቸው።

verses.en: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.
verses.fr: Les rois des armées fuient, fuient, Et celle qui reste à la maison partage le butin.
verses.am: የሠራዊት ነገሥታት ፈጥነው ይሸሻሉ፤ በቤትም የምትኖር ምርኮን ተካፈለች።

verses.en: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.
verses.fr: Tandis que vous reposez au milieu des étables, Les ailes de la colombe sont couvertes d''argent, Et son plumage est d''un jaune d''or. -
verses.am: በርስቶች መካከል ብታድሩ፥ ከብር እንደ ተሠሩ እንደ ርግብ ክንፎች፥ በቅጠልያ ወርቅም እንደ ተለበጡ ላባዎችዋ ትሆናላችሁ።

verses.en: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon.
verses.fr: Lorsque le Tout-Puissant dispersa les rois dans le pays, La terre devint blanche comme la neige du Tsalmon.
verses.am: ሰማያዊ ንጉሥ በላይዋ ባዘዘ ጊዜ፥ በሰልሞን ላይ በረዶ ዘነበ።

verses.en: The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.
verses.fr: Montagnes de Dieu, montagnes de Basan, Montagnes aux cimes nombreuses, montagnes de Basan,
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ተራራ የለመለመ ተራራ ነው፤ የጸና ተራራና የለመለመ ተራራ ነው።

verses.en: Why leap ye, ye high hills? this is the hill which God desireth to dwell in; yea, the Lord will dwell in it for ever.
verses.fr: Pourquoi, montagnes aux cimes nombreuses, avez-vous de l''envie Contre la montagne que Dieu a voulue pour résidence? L''Eternel n''en fera pas moins sa demeure à perpétuité.
verses.am: የጸኑ ተራራዎች ለምን ይነሣሉ? እግዚአብሔር ይህን ተራራ ያድርበት ዘንድ ወደደው፤ በእውነት እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም ያድርበታል።

verses.en: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: the Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.
verses.fr: Les chars de l''Eternel se comptent par vingt mille, Par milliers et par milliers; Le Seigneur est au milieu d''eux, le Sinaï est dans le sanctuaire.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ሰረገላዎች የብዙ ብዙ ሺህ ናቸው፤ ጌታ በመቅደሱ በሲና በመካከላቸው ነው።

verses.en: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, for the rebellious also, that the Lord God might dwell among them.
verses.fr: Tu es monté dans les hauteurs, tu as emmené des captifs, Tu as pris en don des hommes; Les rebelles habiteront aussi près de l''Eternel Dieu.
verses.am: ወደ ላይ ዓረግህ፥ ምርኮን ማረክህ፥ ስጦታንም ለሰዎች ሰጠህ፥ ደግሞም ለዓመፀኞች በዚያ ያድሩ ዘንድ።

verses.en: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.
verses.fr: Béni soit le Seigneur chaque jour! Quand on nous accable, Dieu nous délivre. -Pause.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ቡሩክ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር በየዕለቱ ቡሩክ ነው፤ የመድኃኒታችን አምላክ ይረዳናል።

verses.en: He that is our God is the God of salvation; and unto God the Lord belong the issues from death.
verses.fr: Dieu est pour nous le Dieu des délivrances, Et l''Eternel, le Seigneur, peut nous garantir de la mort.
verses.am: አምላካችንስ የደኅንነት አምላክ ነው፤ ከሞት መውጣትም ከእግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.
verses.fr: Oui, Dieu brisera la tête de ses ennemis, Le sommet de la tête de ceux qui vivent dans le péché.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር የጠላቶቹን ራስ፥ በኃጢአት የሚሄድንም የጠጕሩን አናት ይቀጠቅጣል።

verses.en: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:
verses.fr: Le Seigneur dit: Je les ramènerai de Basan, Je les ramènerai du fond de la mer,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ አለ። ከባሳን አመጣቸዋለሁ፥ ከባሕርም ጥልቅ እመልሳቸዋለሁ፥

verses.en: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies, and the tongue of thy dogs in the same.
verses.fr: Afin que tu plonges ton pied dans le sang, Et que la langue de tes chiens ait sa part des ennemis.
verses.am: እግሮችህ በደም ይረገጡ ዘንድ፥ የውሾችህ ምላስ በጠላቶች ላይ ይሆን ዘንድ።

verses.en: They have seen thy goings, O God; even the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.
verses.fr: Ils voient ta marche, ô Dieu! La marche de mon Dieu, de mon roi, dans le sanctuaire.
verses.am: የአምላኬ የንጉሥ መንገድ በመቅደሱ፥ አቤቱ፥ መንገድህ ተገለጠ።

verses.en: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.
verses.fr: En tête vont les chanteurs, puis ceux qui jouent des instruments, Au milieu de jeunes filles battant du tambourin.
verses.am: አለቆች ቀደሙ፥ መዘምራንም ተከተሉ፤ ከበሮን በሚመቱ በቈነጃጅት መካከል።

verses.en: Bless ye God in the congregations, even the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.
verses.fr: Bénissez Dieu dans les assemblées, Bénissez le Seigneur, descendants d''Israël!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን በጉባኤ፥ ጌታችንንም በእስራኤል ምንጭ አመስግኑት።

verses.en: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
verses.fr: Là sont Benjamin, le plus jeune, qui domine sur eux, Les chefs de Juda et leur troupe, Les chefs de Zabulon, les chefs de Nephthali.
verses.am: ወጣቱ ብንያም በጕልበቱ በዚያ አለ፥ ገዦቻቸው የይሁዳ አለቆች የዛብሎን አለቆችና የንፍታሌምም አለቆች።

verses.en: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.
verses.fr: Ton Dieu ordonne que tu sois puissant; Affermis, ô Dieu, ce que tu as fait pour nous!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ኃይልህን እዘዝ፤ አቤቱ፥ ይህንም ለእኛ የሠራኸውን አጽናው።

verses.en: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.
verses.fr: De ton temple tu règnes sur Jérusalem; Les rois t''apporteront des présents.
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌም ስላለው መቅደስህ ነገሥታት እጅ መንሻን ለአንተ ያመጣሉ።

verses.en: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people that delight in war.
verses.fr: Epouvante l''animal des roseaux, La troupe des taureaux avec les veaux des peuples, Qui se prosternent avec des pièces d''argent! Disperse les peuples qui prennent plaisir à combattre!
verses.am: በሸምበቆ ውስጥ ያሉትን አራዊት፥ በአሕዛብ ውስጥ ያሉትን የበሬዎችንና የወይፈኖችን ጉባኤ ገሥጽ፥ እንደ ብር የተፈተኑት አሕዛብ እንዳይዘጉ፤ ሰልፍን የሚወድዱትን አሕዛብን በትናቸው።

verses.en: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.
verses.fr: Des grands viennent de l''Egypte; L''Ethiopie accourt, les mains tendues vers Dieu.
verses.am: መኳንንት ከግብጽ ይመጣሉ፤ ኢትዮጵያ እጆችዋን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ትዘረጋለች።

verses.en: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:
verses.fr: Royaumes de la terre, chantez à Dieu, Célébrez le Seigneur! -Pause.
verses.am: የምድር ነገሥታት፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ተቀኙ፥ ለጌታም ዘምሩ።

verses.en: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.
verses.fr: Chantez à celui qui s''avance dans les cieux, les cieux éternels! Voici, il fait entendre sa voix, sa voix puissante.
verses.am: በምሥራቅ በኩል ወደ ሰማየ ሰማያት ለወጣ ለእግዚአብሔር ዘምሩ፤ የኃይል ቃል የሆነ ቃሉን፥ እነሆ፥ ይሰጣል።

verses.en: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency is over Israel, and his strength is in the clouds.
verses.fr: Rendez gloire à Dieu! Sa majesté est sur Israël, et sa force dans les cieux.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር ክብርን ስጡ፤ ግርማው በእስራኤል ላይ፥ ኃይሉም በደመናት ላይ ነው።

verses.en: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel is he that giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.
verses.fr: De ton sanctuaire, ô Dieu! tu es redoutable. Le Dieu d''Israël donne à son peuple la force et la puissance. Béni soit Dieu!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በቅዱሳኑ ላይ ድንቅ ነው፤ የእስራኤል አምላክ እርሱ ኃይልን ብርታትንም ለሕዝቡ ይሰጣል፤ እግዚአብሔርም ይመስገን።

verses.en: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Sur les lis. De David. Sauve-moi, ô Dieu! Car les eaux menacent ma vie.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ውኃ እስከ ነፍሴ ደርሶብኛልና አድነኝ።

verses.en: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
verses.fr: J''enfonce dans la boue, sans pouvoir me tenir; Je suis tombé dans un gouffre, et les eaux m''inondent.
verses.am: በጥልቅ ረግረግ ጠለቅሁ መቋሚያም የለኝም። ወደ ጥልቅ ባሕር ገባሁ ማዕበልም አሰጠመኝ።

verses.en: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.
verses.fr: Je m''épuise à crier, mon gosier se dessèche, Mes yeux se consument, tandis que je regarde vers mon Dieu.
verses.am: በጩኸት ደከምሁ ጕሮሮዬም ሰለለ፤ አምላኬን ስጠብቅ ዓይኖቼ ፈዘዙ።

verses.en: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.
verses.fr: Ils sont plus nombreux que les cheveux de ma tête, Ceux qui me haïssent sans cause; Ils sont puissants, ceux qui veulent me perdre, Qui sont à tort mes ennemis. Ce que je n''ai pas dérobé, il faut que je le restitue.
verses.am: በከንቱ የሚጠሉኝ ከራሴ ጠጕር በዙ፤ በዓመፅ ያሚያሳድዱኝ ጠላቶቼ በረቱ፤ በዚያን ጊዜ ያልቀማሁትን መለስሁ።

verses.en: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.
verses.fr: O Dieu! tu connais ma folie, Et mes fautes ne te sont point cachées.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ስንፍናዬን ታውቃለህ፥ ኃጢአቴም ከአንተ አልተሰወረም።

verses.en: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord God of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.
verses.fr: Que ceux qui espèrent en toi ne soient pas confus à cause de moi, Seigneur, Eternel des armées! Que ceux qui te cherchent ne soient pas dans la honte à cause de moi, Dieu d''Israël!
verses.am: አቤቱ የሠራዊት አምላክ፥ ተስፋ የሚያደርጉህ በእኔ አይፈሩ፤ የእስራኤል አምላክ ሆይ፥ የሚሹህ በእኔ አይነወሩ።

verses.en: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.
verses.fr: Car c''est pour toi que je porte l''opprobre, Que la honte couvre mon visage;
verses.am: ስለ አንተ ስድብን ታግሻለሁና፥ እፍረትም ፊቴን ሸፍናለችና።

verses.en: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother's children.
verses.fr: Je suis devenu un étranger pour mes frères, Un inconnu pour les fils de ma mère.
verses.am: ለወንድሞቼ እንደ ሌላ፥ ለእናቴ ልጆችም እንደ እንግዳ ሆንሁባቸው፥

verses.en: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.
verses.fr: Car le zèle de ta maison me dévore, Et les outrages de ceux qui t''insultent tombent sur moi.
verses.am: የቤትህ ቅንዓት በልታኛለችና፥ የሚሰድቡህም ስድብ በላዬ ወድቆአልና።

verses.en: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.
verses.fr: Je verse des larmes et je jeûne, Et c''est ce qui m''attire l''opprobre;
verses.am: ነፍሴን በጾም አስመረርሁአት፥ ለስድብም ሆነብኝ።

verses.en: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.
verses.fr: Je prends un sac pour vêtement, Et je suis l''objet de leurs sarcasmes.
verses.am: ማቅ ለበስሁ ምሳሌም ሆንሁላቸው።

verses.en: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.
verses.fr: Ceux qui sont assis à la porte parlent de moi, Et les buveurs de liqueurs fortes me mettent en chansons.
verses.am: በደጅ የሚቀመጡ በእኔ ይጫወታሉ፤ ወይን የሚጠጡ እኔን ይዘፍናሉ።

verses.en: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O Lord, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.
verses.fr: Mais je t''adresse ma prière, ô Eternel! Que ce soit le temps favorable, ô Dieu, par ta grande bonté! Réponds-moi, en m''assurant ton secours!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በመልካሙ ጊዜ ጸሎቴ ወደ አንተ ነው፤ አቤቱ፥ በምሕረትህ ብዛት በማዳንህም እውነት አድምጠኝ።

verses.en: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
verses.fr: Retire-moi de la boue, et que je n''enfonce plus! Que je sois délivré de mes ennemis et du gouffre!
verses.am: እንዳይውጠኝ ከረግረግ አውጣኝ፤ ከሚጠሉኝና ከጥልቅ ውኃ አስጥለኝ።

verses.en: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
verses.fr: Que les flots ne m''inondent plus, Que l''abîme ne m''engloutisse pas, Et que la fosse ne se ferme pas sur moi!
verses.am: የውኃው ማዕበል አያስጥመኝ፥ ጥልቁም አይዋጠኝ፥ ጕድጓድም አፉን በእኔ ላይ አይዝጋ።

verses.en: Hear me, O Lord; for thy lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.
verses.fr: Exauce-moi, Eternel! car ta bonté est immense. Dans tes grandes compassions, tourne vers moi les regards,
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህ መልካም ናትና ስማኝ። እንደ ርኅራኄህም ብዛት ወደ እኔ ተመልከት፤

verses.en: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.
verses.fr: Et ne cache pas ta face à ton serviteur! Puisque je suis dans la détresse, hâte-toi de m''exaucer!
verses.am: ከባሪያህም ፊትህን አትሰውር፤ ተጨንቄአለሁና ፈጥነህ አድምጠኝ።

verses.en: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.
verses.fr: Approche-toi de mon âme, délivre-la! Sauve-moi, à cause de mes ennemis!
verses.am: ነፍሴን ተመልክተህ ተቤዣት፤ ስለ ጠላቶቼም አድነኝ።

verses.en: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.
verses.fr: Tu connais mon opprobre, ma honte, mon ignominie; Tous mes adversaires sont devant toi.
verses.am: አንተ ስድቤን እፍረቴንም ነውሬንም ታውቃለህ፤ የሚያስጨንቁኝ ሁሉ በፊትህ ናቸው።

verses.en: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.
verses.fr: L''opprobre me brise le coeur, et je suis malade; J''attends de la pitié, mais en vain, Des consolateurs, et je n''en trouve aucun.
verses.am: ነፍሴ ስድብንና ኃሣርን ታገሠች፤ አስተዛዛኝም ተመኘሁ አላገኘሁም። የሚያጽናናኝም አጣሁ።

verses.en: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
verses.fr: Ils mettent du fiel dans ma nourriture, Et, pour apaiser ma soif, ils m''abreuvent de vinaigre.
verses.am: ለመብሌ ሐሞት ሰጡኝ፥ ለጥማቴም ሆምጣጤ አጠጡኝ።

verses.en: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.
verses.fr: Que leur table soit pour eux un piège, Et un filet au sein de leur sécurité!
verses.am: ማዕዳቸው በፊታቸው ለወጥመድ ለፍዳ ለዕንቅፋት ትሁንባቸው፤

verses.en: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.
verses.fr: Que leurs yeux s''obscurcissent et ne voient plus, Et fais continuellement chanceler leurs reins!
verses.am: ዓይኖቻቸው እንዳያዩ ይጨልሙ፥ ጀርባቸውም ዘወትር ይጕበጥ።

verses.en: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.
verses.fr: Répands sur eux ta colère, Et que ton ardente fureur les atteigne!
verses.am: መዓትህን በላያቸው አፍስስ፥ የቍጣህ መቅሠፍትም ያግኛቸው።

verses.en: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.
verses.fr: Que leur demeure soit dévastée, Qu''il n''y ait plus d''habitants dans leurs tentes!
verses.am: ማደሪያቸው በረሃ ትሁን፥ በድንኳኖቻቸውም የሚቀመጥ አይገኝ፤

verses.en: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.
verses.fr: Car ils persécutent celui que tu frappes, Ils racontent les souffrances de ceux que tu blesses.
verses.am: አንተ የቀሠፍኸውን እነርሱ አሳድደዋልና፥ በቍስሌም ላይ ጥዝጣዜ ጨመሩብኝ።

verses.en: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.
verses.fr: Ajoute des iniquités à leurs iniquités, Et qu''ils n''aient point part à ta miséricorde!
verses.am: በኃጢአታቸው ላይ ኃጢአትን ጨምርባቸው፥ በጽድቅህም አይግቡ።

verses.en: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.
verses.fr: Qu''ils soient effacés du livre de vie, Et qu''ils ne soient point inscrits avec les justes!
verses.am: ከሕያዋን መጽሐፍ ይደምሰሱ፥ ከጻድቃንም ጋር አይጻፉ።

verses.en: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.
verses.fr: Moi, je suis malheureux et souffrant: O Dieu, que ton secours me relève!
verses.am: እኔ ችግረኛና ቍስለኛ ነኝ፤ አቤቱ፥ የፊትህ መድኃኒት ይቀበለኝ።

verses.en: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
verses.fr: Je célébrerai le nom de Dieu par des cantiques, Je l''exalterai par des louanges.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ስም በዝማሬ አመሰግናለሁ፥ በምስጋናም ከፍ ከፍ አደርገዋለሁ።

verses.en: This also shall please the Lord better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.
verses.fr: Cela est agréable à l''Eternel, plus qu''un taureau Avec des cornes et des sabots.
verses.am: ቀንድና ጥፍር ካበቀለ ከእምቦሳ ይልቅ እግዚአብሔርን ደስ ያሰኘዋል።

verses.en: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.
verses.fr: Les malheureux le voient et se réjouissent; Vous qui cherchez Dieu, que votre coeur vive!
verses.am: ችግረኞች ያያሉ ደስ ይላቸዋል፤ እግዚአብሔርን ፈልጉ ሕያዋንም ሁኑ።

verses.en: For the Lord heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel écoute les pauvres, Et il ne méprise point ses captifs.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ችግረኞችን ሰምቶአልና፥ እስረኞቹንም አልናቀምና።

verses.en: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.
verses.fr: Que les cieux et la terre le célèbrent, Les mers et tout ce qui s''y meut!
verses.am: ሰማይና ምድር ባሕርም በእርስዋም የሚንቀሳቀስ ሁሉ ያመሰግኑታል።

verses.en: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.
verses.fr: Car Dieu sauvera Sion, et bâtira les villes de Juda; On s''y établira, et l''on en prendra possession;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ጽዮንን ያድናታልና፥ የይሁዳንም ከተሞች ይሠራልና፤ በዚያም ይቀመጣሉ ይወርሱአትማል።

verses.en: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.
verses.fr: La postérité de ses serviteurs en fera son héritage, Et ceux qui aiment son nom y auront leur demeure.
verses.am: የባሪያዎቹ ዘር ይኖሩባታል። ስሙንም የሚወድዱ በዚያ ይቀመጣሉ።

verses.en: Make haste, o God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O Lord.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. De David. Pour souvenir. O Dieu, hâte-toi de me délivrer! Eternel, hâte-toi de me secourir!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እኔን ለማዳን ተመልከት፤ አቤቱ፥ እኔን ለመርዳት ፍጠን።

verses.en: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.
verses.fr: Qu''ils soient honteux et confus, ceux qui en veulent à ma vie! Qu''ils reculent et rougissent, ceux qui désirent ma perte!
verses.am: ነፍሴን የሚሹአት ይፈሩ ይጐስቍሉም፥ ክፉንም የሚመክሩብኝ ወደ ኋላቸው ይመለሱ ይፈሩም።

verses.en: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.
verses.fr: Qu''ils retournent en arrière par l''effet de leur honte, Ceux qui disent: Ah! ah!
verses.am: እንኳ እንኳ የሚሉኝ አፍረው ወዲያው ወደ ኋላቸው ይመለሱ።

verses.en: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
verses.fr: Que tous ceux qui te cherchent Soient dans l''allégresse et se réjouissent en toi! Que ceux qui aiment ton salut Disent sans cesse: Exalté soit Dieu!
verses.am: የሚሹህ ሁሉ በአንተ ሐሤት ያድርጉ ደስ ይበላቸው፤ ማዳንህን የሚወድዱ ሁልጊዜ። እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ነው ይበሉ።

verses.en: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O Lord, make no tarrying.
verses.fr: Moi, je suis pauvre et indigent: O Dieu, hâte-toi en ma faveur! Tu es mon aide et mon libérateur: Eternel, ne tarde pas!
verses.am: እኔ ችግረኛና ምስኪን ነኝ፤ አቤቱ፥ እርዳኝ፤ ረዳቴ ታዳጊዬም አንተ ነህ፤ አቤቱ፥ አትዘግይ።

verses.en: In thee, O Lord, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.
verses.fr: Eternel! je cherche en toi mon refuge: Que jamais je ne sois confondu!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተን ታመንሁ፤ ለዘላለም አልፈር።

verses.en: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.
verses.fr: Dans ta justice, sauve-moi et délivre-moi! Incline vers moi ton oreille, et secours-moi!
verses.am: በጽድቅህ አስጥለኝ ታደገኝም፤ ጆሮህን ወደ እኔ አዘንብል አድነኝም።

verses.en: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.
verses.fr: Sois pour moi un rocher qui me serve d''asile, Où je puisse toujours me retirer! Tu as résolu de me sauver, Car tu es mon rocher et ma forteresse.
verses.am: በጠንካራ ቦታ ታድነኝ ዘንድ አምላክና መሸሸጊያ ሁነኝ፤ ኃይሌ መጠጊያዬ አንተ ነህና።

verses.en: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
verses.fr: Mon Dieu, délivre-moi de la main du méchant, De la main de l''homme inique et violent!
verses.am: አምላኬ፥ ከኃጢአተኛ እጅ፥ ከዓመፀኛና ከግፈኛም እጅ አድነኝ።

verses.en: For thou art my hope, O Lord God: thou art my trust from my youth.
verses.fr: Car tu es mon espérance, Seigneur Eternel! En toi je me confie dès ma jeunesse.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ተስፋዬ ነህና፥ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ ከታናሽነቴ ጀምረህ መታመኛዬ ነህና።

verses.en: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.
verses.fr: Dès le ventre de ma mère je m''appuie sur toi; C''est toi qui m''as fait sortir du sein maternel; tu es sans cesse l''objet de mes louanges.
verses.am: ከማኅፀን ጀምሮ በአንተ ተደገፍሁ፥ ከእናቴም ሆድ ጀምሮ አንተ መሸሸጊያዬ ነህ፤ ሁልጊዜም ዝማሬዬ ለአንተ ነው።

verses.en: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.
verses.fr: Je suis pour plusieurs comme un prodige, Et toi, tu es mon puissant refuge.
verses.am: ለብዙዎች መደነቂያ ሆንሁ፤ አንተ ግን ብርቱ መጠጊያዬ ነህ።

verses.en: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.
verses.fr: Que ma bouche soit remplie de tes louanges, Que chaque jour elle te glorifie!
verses.am: አፌን ምስጋና ምላ ሁልጊዜ ክብርህንና ግርማህን እዘምር ዘንድ።

verses.en: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.
verses.fr: Ne me rejette pas au temps de la vieillesse; Quand mes forces s''en vont, ne m''abandonne pas!
verses.am: በእርጅናዬ ዘመን አትጣለኝ፥ ጕልበቴም ባለቀ ጊዜ አትተወኝ።

verses.en: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,
verses.fr: Car mes ennemis parlent de moi, Et ceux qui guettent ma vie se consultent entre eux,
verses.am: ጠላቶቹ በላዬ ተናግረዋልና፤ ነፍሴንም የሚሹአት በአንድነት ተማክረዋልና፥ እንዲህም አሉ።

verses.en: Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.
verses.fr: Disant: Dieu l''abandonne; Poursuivez, saisissez-le; il n''y a personne pour le délivrer.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ትቶታል፤ የሚያድነው የለምና ተከትላችሁ ያዙት።

verses.en: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.
verses.fr: O Dieu, ne t''éloigne pas de moi! Mon Dieu, viens en hâte à mon secours!
verses.am: አምላክ ሆይ፥ ከእኔ አትራቅ፤ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ እኔን ለመርዳት ፍጠን።

verses.en: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.
verses.fr: Qu''ils soient confus, anéantis, ceux qui en veulent à ma vie! Qu''ils soient couverts de honte et d''opprobre, ceux qui cherchent ma perte!
verses.am: ነፍሴን የሚቃወሙአት ይፈሩ ይጥፉም፥ ጕዳቴንም የሚፈልጉ እፍረትንና ኃሣርን ይልበሱ።

verses.en: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.
verses.fr: Et moi, j''espérerai toujours, Je te louerai de plus en plus.
verses.am: እኔ ግን ሁልጊዜ ተስፋ አደርጋለሁ፥ በምስጋናህም ሁሉ ላይ እጨምራለሁ።

verses.en: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.
verses.fr: Ma bouche publiera ta justice, ton salut, chaque jour, Car j''ignore quelles en sont les bornes.
verses.am: ሥራን አላውቅምና አፌ ጽድቅህን ሁልጊዜም ማዳንህን ይናገራል።

verses.en: I will go in the strength of the Lord God: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.
verses.fr: Je dirai tes oeuvres puissantes, Seigneur Eternel! Je rappellerai ta justice, la tienne seule.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ኃይል እገባለሁ፤ አቤቱ፥ ጽድቅህን ብቻ አስባለሁ።

verses.en: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.
verses.fr: O Dieu! tu m''as instruit dès ma jeunesse, Et jusqu''à présent j''annonce tes merveilles.
verses.am: አምላኬ፥ ከታናሽነቴ ጀምረህ አስተማርኸኝ፤ እስከ ዛሬም ተአምራትህን እነግራለሁ።

verses.en: Now also when I am old and greyheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, and thy power to every one that is to come.
verses.fr: Ne m''abandonne pas, ô Dieu! même dans la blanche vieillesse, Afin que j''annonce ta force à la génération présente, Ta puissance à la génération future!
verses.am: እስካረጅም እስክሸመግልም ድረስ፥ ለሚመጣ ትውልድም ሁሉ ክንድህን ኃይልህንም ጽድቅህንም እስክነግር ድረስ፥ አቤቱ፥ አትተወኝ።

verses.en: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high, who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee!
verses.fr: Ta justice, ô Dieu! atteint jusqu''au ciel; Tu as accompli de grandes choses: ô Dieu! qui est semblable à toi?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እስከ አርያም ታላላቅ ነገሮችን አደረግህ፤ አምላክ ሆይ፥ እንደ አንተ ያለ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Thou, which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
verses.fr: Tu nous as fait éprouver bien des détresses et des malheurs; Mais tu nous redonneras la vie, Tu nous feras remonter des abîmes de la terre.
verses.am: ብዙ ጭንቀትንና መከራን አሳይተኸኛልና፥ ተመለስህ ሕያውም አደረግኸኝ፤ ከምድር ጥልቅም እንደ ገና አወጣኸኝ።

verses.en: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.
verses.fr: Relève ma grandeur, Console-moi de nouveau!
verses.am: ጽድቅህንም አብዛው፥ ተመልሰህም ደስ አሰኘኝ፥ ከጥልቅም እንደ ገና አወጣኸኝ።

verses.en: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.
verses.fr: Et je te louerai au son du luth, je chanterai ta fidélité, mon Dieu, Je te célébrerai avec la harpe, Saint d''Israël!
verses.am: እኔም በበገና ስለ እውነትህ አመሰግንሃለሁ፤ የእስራኤል ቅዱስ አምላክ ሆይ፥ በመሰንቆ እዘምርልሃለሁ።

verses.en: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.
verses.fr: En te célébrant, j''aurai la joie sur les lèvres, La joie dans mon âme que tu as délivrée;
verses.am: ዝማሬን ባቀርብሁልህ ጊዜ ከንፈሮቼ ደስ ይላቸዋል፥ አንተ ያዳንሃትም ነፍሴ።

verses.en: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.
verses.fr: Ma langue chaque jour publiera ta justice, Car ceux qui cherchent ma perte sont honteux et confus.
verses.am: ጕዳቴን የሚሹ ባፈሩና በተነወሩ ጊዜ አንደበቴ ደግሞ ሁልጊዜ ጽድቅህን ይናገራል።

verses.en: Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king's son.
verses.fr: De Salomon. O Dieu, donne tes jugements au roi, Et ta justice au fils du roi!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ፍርድህን ለንጉሥ ስጥ፥ ጽድቅህንም ለንጉሥ ልጅ፥

verses.en: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.
verses.fr: Il jugera ton peuple avec justice, Et tes malheureux avec équité.
verses.am: ሕዝብህን በጽድቅ፥ ችግረኞችህንም በፍርድ ይዳኝ ዘንድ።

verses.en: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.
verses.fr: Les montagnes porteront la paix pour le peuple, Et les collines aussi, par l''effet de ta justice.
verses.am: ተራሮችና ኰረብቶች ለሕዝብህ ሰላምን ይቀበሉ።

verses.en: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.
verses.fr: Il fera droit aux malheureux du peuple, Il sauvera les enfants du pauvre, Et il écrasera l''oppresseur.
verses.am: ለችግረኞች ሕዝብ በጽድቅ ትፈርዳለህ የድሆችንም ልጆች ታድናለህ፤ ክፉውንም ታዋርደዋለህ።

verses.en: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.
verses.fr: On te craindra, tant que subsistera le soleil, Tant que paraîtra la lune, de génération en génération.
verses.am: ፀሐይ በሚኖርበት ዘመን ሁሉ፥ በጨረቃም ፊት ለፊት ለልጅ ልጅ ይኖራል።

verses.en: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.
verses.fr: Il sera comme une pluie qui tombe sur un terrain fauché, Comme des ondées qui arrosent la campagne.
verses.am: እንደ ዝናብ በታጨደ መስክ ላይ፥ በምድርም ላይ እንደሚንጠባጠብ ጠብታ ይወርዳል።

verses.en: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.
verses.fr: En ses jours le juste fleurira, Et la paix sera grande jusqu''à ce qu''il n''y ait plus de lune.
verses.am: በዘመኑም ጽድቅ ያብባል፥ ጨረቃም እስኪያልፍ ድረስ ሰላም ብዙ ነው።

verses.en: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.
verses.fr: Il dominera d''une mer à l''autre, Et du fleuve aux extrémités de la terre.
verses.am: ከባሕር እስከ ባሕር ድረስ፥ ከወንዝም እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ ድረስ ይገዛል።

verses.en: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.
verses.fr: Devant lui, les habitants du désert fléchiront le genou, Et ses ennemis lécheront la poussière.
verses.am: በፊቱም ኢትዮጵያ ይሰግዳሉ፥ ጠላቶቹም አፈር ይልሳሉ።

verses.en: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
verses.fr: Les rois de Tarsis et des îles paieront des tributs, Les rois de Séba et de Saba offriront des présents.
verses.am: የተርሴስና የደሴቶች ነገሥታት ስጦታን ያመጣሉ፤ የዓረብና የሳባ ነገሥታት እጅ መንሻን ያቀርባሉ።

verses.en: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.
verses.fr: Tous les rois se prosterneront devant lui, Toutes les nations le serviront.
verses.am: ነገሥታት ሁሉ ይሰግዱለታል። አሕዛብም ሁሉ ይገዙለታል።

verses.en: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.
verses.fr: Car il délivrera le pauvre qui crie, Et le malheureux qui n''a point d''aide.
verses.am: ችግረኛውን ከቀማኛው እጅ፥ ረዳት የሌለውንም ምስኪን ያድነዋልና።

verses.en: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.
verses.fr: Il aura pitié du misérable et de l''indigent, Et il sauvera la vie des pauvres;
verses.am: ለችግረኛና ለምስኪን ይራራል፥ የችግረኞችንም ነፍስ ያድናል።

verses.en: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.
verses.fr: Il les affranchira de l''oppression et de la violence, Et leur sang aura du prix à ses yeux.
verses.am: ከግፍና ከጭንቀት ነፍሳቸውን ያድናል፤ ስማቸው በፊቱ ክቡር ነው።

verses.en: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.
verses.fr: Ils vivront, et lui donneront de l''or de Séba; Ils prieront pour lui sans cesse, ils le béniront chaque jour.
verses.am: እርሱ ይኖራል ከዓረብም ወርቅ ይሰጡታል፤ ሁልጊዜም ወደ እርሱ ይጸልያሉ፥ ዘወትርም ይባርኩታል።

verses.en: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.
verses.fr: Les blés abonderont dans le pays, au sommet des montagnes, Et leurs épis s''agiteront comme les arbres du Liban; Les hommes fleuriront dans les villes comme l''herbe de la terre.
verses.am: በምድር ውስጥ በተራሮች ላይ መጠጊያ ይሆናል፤ ፍሬውም ከሊባኖስ ይልቅ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል፤ እንደ ምድር ሣር በከተማ ይበቅላል።

verses.en: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.
verses.fr: Son nom subsistera toujours, Aussi longtemps que le soleil son nom se perpétuera; Par lui on se bénira mutuellement, Et toutes les nations le diront heureux.
verses.am: ስሙ ለዘላለም ቡሩክ ይሆናል፥ ከፀሐይም አስቀድሞ ስሙ ይኖራል፤ የምድር አሕዛብ ሁሉ በእርሱ ይባረካሉም አሕዛብ ሁሉ ያመሰግኑታል።

verses.en: Blessed be the Lord God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.
verses.fr: Béni soit l''Eternel Dieu, le Dieu d''Israël, qui seul fait des prodiges!
verses.am: ብቻውን ተአምራትን የሚያደርግ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ይባረክ።

verses.en: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.
verses.fr: Béni soit à jamais son nom glorieux! Que toute la terre soit remplie de sa gloire! Amen! Amen!
verses.am: የምስጋናው ስም ለዓለምና ለዘላለም ይባረክ፤ ምስጋናውም ምድርን ሁሉ ይምላ። ይሁን፤ ይሁን።

verses.en: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
verses.fr: Fin des prières de David, fils d''Isaï.
verses.am: የእሴይ ልጅ የዳዊት መዝሙር ተፈጸመ።

verses.en: Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.
verses.fr: Psaume d''Asaph. Oui, Dieu est bon pour Israël, Pour ceux qui ont le coeur pur.
verses.am: ልባቸው ለቀና ለእስራኤል እግዚአብሔር እንዴት ቸር ነው።

verses.en: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.
verses.fr: Toutefois, mon pied allait fléchir, Mes pas étaient sur le point de glisser;
verses.am: እኔ ግን እግሮቼ ሊሰናከሉ፥ አረማመዴም ሊወድቅ ትንሽ ቀረ።

verses.en: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
verses.fr: Car je portais envie aux insensés, En voyant le bonheur des méchants.
verses.am: የኃጢአተኞችን ሰላም አይቼ በዓመፀኞች ቀንቼ ነበርና።

verses.en: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.
verses.fr: Rien ne les tourmente jusqu''à leur mort, Et leur corps est chargé d''embonpoint;
verses.am: ለሞታቸው መጣጣር የለውምና፤ ኃይላቸውም ጠንካራ ነውና።

verses.en: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.
verses.fr: Ils n''ont aucune part aux souffrances humaines, Ils ne sont point frappés comme le reste des hommes.
verses.am: እንደ ሰው በድካም አልሆኑም፥ ከሰው ጋርም አልተገረፉም።

verses.en: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.
verses.fr: Aussi l''orgueil leur sert de collier, La violence est le vêtement qui les enveloppe;
verses.am: ስለዚህ ትዕቢት ያዛቸው፤ ኃጢአትንና በደልን ተጐናጸፉአት።

verses.en: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.
verses.fr: L''iniquité sort de leurs entrailles, Les pensées de leur coeur se font jour.
verses.am: ዓይናቸው ስብ ስለ ሆነ ወጣ፤ ልባቸውም ከምኞታቸው ይልቅ አገኘ።

verses.en: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.
verses.fr: Ils raillent, et parlent méchamment d''opprimer; Ils profèrent des discours hautains,
verses.am: አስበው ክፉ ነገርን ተናገሩ። ከፍ ከፍ ብለውም በዓመፃ ተናገሩ።

verses.en: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.
verses.fr: Ils élèvent leur bouche jusqu''aux cieux, Et leur langue se promène sur la terre.
verses.am: አፋቸውን በሰማይ አኖሩ፥ አንደበታቸውም በምድር ውስጥ ተመላለሰ።

verses.en: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.
verses.fr: Voilà pourquoi son peuple se tourne de leur côté, Il avale l''eau abondamment,
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሕዝቤ ወደዚህ ይመለሳሉ፤ ፍጹም ጊዜም በላያቸው ይገኛል፤

verses.en: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?
verses.fr: Et il dit: Comment Dieu saurait-il, Comment le Très-Haut connaîtrait-il?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዴት ያውቃል? በልዑልስ ዘንድ በውኑ እውቀት አለ? ይላሉ።

verses.en: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.
verses.fr: Ainsi sont les méchants: Toujours heureux, ils accroissent leurs richesses.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እነዚህ ኃጢአተኞች ይደሰታሉ፥ ሁልጊዜም ባለጠግነታቸውን ያበዛሉ።

verses.en: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.
verses.fr: C''est donc en vain que j''ai purifié mon coeur, Et que j''ai lavé mes mains dans l''innocence:
verses.am: እንዲህም አልሁ። በውኑ ልቤን በከንቱ አጸደቅሁ፥ እጆቼንም በንጽሕና በከንቱ አጠብሁ።

verses.en: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.
verses.fr: Chaque jour je suis frappé, Tous les matins mon châtiment est là.
verses.am: ሁልጊዜም የተገረፍሁ ሆንሁ፥ መሰደቤም በማለዳ ነው።

verses.en: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.
verses.fr: Si je disais: Je veux parler comme eux, Voici, je trahirais la race de tes enfants.
verses.am: እንደዚህ ብዬ ብናገር ኖሮ፥ እነሆ፥ የልጆችህን ትውልድ በበደልሁ ነበር።

verses.en: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;
verses.fr: Quand j''ai réfléchi là-dessus pour m''éclairer, La difficulté fut grande à mes yeux,
verses.am: አውቅም ዘንድ አሰብሁ፥ ይህ ግን በፊቴ ችግር ነበረ።

verses.en: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.
verses.fr: Jusqu''à ce que j''eusse pénétré dans les sanctuaires de Dieu, Et que j''eusse pris garde au sort final des méchants.
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔር መቅደስ እስክገባ ድረስ፥ ፍጻሜአቸውንም እስካስተውል ድረስ።

verses.en: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.
verses.fr: Oui, tu les places sur des voies glissantes, Tu les fais tomber et les mets en ruines.
verses.am: በድጥ ስፍራ አስቀመጥኻቸው፥ ወደ ጥፋትም ጣልኻቸው።

verses.en: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.
verses.fr: Eh quoi! en un instant les voilà détruits! Ils sont enlevés, anéantis par une fin soudaine!
verses.am: እንዴት ለጥፋት ሆኑ! በድንገት አለቁ ስለ ኃጢአታቸውም ጠፉ።

verses.en: As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.
verses.fr: Comme un songe au réveil, Seigneur, à ton réveil, tu repousses leur image.
verses.am: ከሕልም እንደሚነቃ፥ አቤቱ፥ ስትነቃ ምልክታቸውን ታስነውራለህ።

verses.en: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.
verses.fr: Lorsque mon coeur s''aigrissait, Et que je me sentais percé dans les entrailles,
verses.am: ልቤ ነድዶአልና፥ ኵላሊቴም ቀልጦአልና፤

verses.en: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.
verses.fr: J''étais stupide et sans intelligence, J''étais à ton égard comme les bêtes.
verses.am: እኔ የተናቅሁ ነኝ አላውቅሁምም፥ በአንተ ዘንድም እንደ እንስሳ ሆንሁ።

verses.en: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.
verses.fr: Cependant je suis toujours avec toi, Tu m''as saisi la main droite;
verses.am: እኔ ግን ዘወትር ከአንተ ጋር ነኝ፥ ቀኝ እጄንም ያዝኸኝ።

verses.en: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
verses.fr: Tu me conduiras par ton conseil, Puis tu me recevras dans la gloire.
verses.am: በአንተ ምክር መራኸኝ፤ ከክብር ጋር ተቀበልኸኝ።

verses.en: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.
verses.fr: Quel autre ai-je au ciel que toi! Et sur la terre je ne prends plaisir qu''en toi.
verses.am: በሰማይ ያለኝ ምንድር ነው? በምድርስ ውስጥ ከአንተ ዘንድ ምን እሻለሁ?

verses.en: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
verses.fr: Ma chair et mon coeur peuvent se consumer: Dieu sera toujours le rocher de mon coeur et mon partage.
verses.am: የልቤ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ልቤና ሥጋዬ አለቀ፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ለዘላለም እድል ፈንታዬ ነው።

verses.en: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.
verses.fr: Car voici, ceux qui s''éloignent de toi périssent; Tu anéantis tous ceux qui te sont infidèles.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ከአንተ የሚርቁ ይጠፋሉና ከአንተ ርቀው የሚያመነዝሩትንም ሁሉ አጠፋኻቸው።

verses.en: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord God, that I may declare all thy works.
verses.fr: Pour moi, m''approcher de Dieu, c''est mon bien: Je place mon refuge dans le Seigneur, l''Eternel, Afin de raconter toutes tes oeuvres.
verses.am: ለእኔ ግን ወደ እግዚአብሔር መቅረብ ይሻለኛል፤ መታመኛዬም እግዚአብሔር ነው በጽዮን ልጅ በሮች ምስጋናህን ሁሉ እናገር ዘንድ።

verses.en: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?
verses.fr: Cantique d''Asaph. Pourquoi, ô Dieu! rejettes-tu pour toujours? Pourquoi t''irrites-tu contre le troupeau de ton pâturage?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ስለ ምን ለዘወትር ጣልኸኝ? በማሰማርያህ በጎች ላይስ ቍጣህን ስለ ምን ተቈጣህ?

verses.en: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.
verses.fr: Souviens-toi de ton peuple que tu as acquis autrefois, Que tu as racheté comme la tribu de ton héritage! Souviens-toi de la montagne de Sion, où tu faisais ta résidence;
verses.am: አስቀድመህ የፈጠርሃትን ማኅበርህን፥ የተቤዤሃትንም የርስትህን በትር፥ በእርስዋ ያደርህባትን የጽዮንን ተራራ አስብ።

verses.en: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.
verses.fr: Porte tes pas vers ces lieux constamment dévastés! L''ennemi a tout ravagé dans le sanctuaire.
verses.am: ጠላት በቅዱሳንህ ላይ እንደ ከፋ መጠን፥ ሁልጊዜም በትዕቢታቸው ላይ እጅህን አንሣ።

verses.en: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.
verses.fr: Tes adversaires ont rugi au milieu de ton temple; Ils ont établi pour signes leurs signes.
verses.am: ጠላቶችህ በበዓል መካከል ተመኩ፤ የማያውቁትንም ምልክት ምልክታቸው አደረጉ።

verses.en: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.
verses.fr: On les a vus, pareils à celui qui lève La cognée dans une épaisse forêt;
verses.am: እንደ ላይኛው መግቢያ ውስጥ በዱር እንዳሉም እንጨቶች፥ በመጥረቢያ በሮችዋን ሰበሩ።

verses.en: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.
verses.fr: Et bientôt ils ont brisé toutes les sculptures, A coups de haches et de marteaux.
verses.am: እንዲሁ በመጥረቢያና በመዶሻ ሰበሩአት።

verses.en: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.
verses.fr: Ils ont mis le feu à ton sanctuaire; Ils ont abattu, profané la demeure de ton nom.
verses.am: መቅደስህን በእሳት አቃጠሉ፤ የስምህንም ማደሪያ በምድር ውስጥ አረከሱ።

verses.en: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.
verses.fr: Ils disaient en leur coeur: Traitons-les tous avec violence! Ils ont brûlé dans le pays tous les lieux saints.
verses.am: አንድ ሆነው በልባቸው በየሕዝባቸው። ኑ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን በዓሎች ከምድር እንሻር አሉ።

verses.en: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.
verses.fr: Nous ne voyons plus nos signes; Il n''y a plus de prophète, Et personne parmi nous qui sache jusqu''à quand...
verses.am: ምልክታችንን አናይም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህም ነቢይ የለም፤ እስከ መቼ እንዲኖር የሚያውቅ በኛ ዘንድ የለም።

verses.en: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?
verses.fr: Jusqu''à quand, ô Dieu! l''oppresseur outragera-t-il, L''ennemi méprisera-t-il sans cesse ton nom?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጠላት እስከ መቼ ይሳደባል? ስምህን ጠላት ሁልጊዜ ያቃልላልን?

verses.en: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck it out of thy bosom.
verses.fr: Pourquoi retires-tu ta main et ta droite? Sors-la de ton sein! détruis!
verses.am: ቀኝህንም በብብትህ መካከል፥ እጅህንም ፈጽመህ ለምን ትመልሳለህ?

verses.en: For God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.
verses.fr: Dieu est mon roi dès les temps anciens, Lui qui opère des délivrances au milieu de la terre.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን ከዓለም አስቀድሞ ንጉሥ ነው፥ በምድርም መካከል መድኃኒትን አደረገ።

verses.en: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.
verses.fr: Tu as fendu la mer par ta puissance, Tu as brisé les têtes des monstres sur les eaux;
verses.am: አንተ ባሕርን በኃይልህ አጸናሃት፤ አንተ የእባቦችን ራስ በውኃ ውስጥ ሰበርህ።

verses.en: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.
verses.fr: Tu as écrasé la tête du crocodile, Tu l''as donné pour nourriture au peuple du désert.
verses.am: አንተም የዘንዶውን ራሶች ቀጠቀጥህ፤ ለኢትዮጵያ ሰዎችም ምግባቸውን ሰጠሃቸው።

verses.en: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.
verses.fr: Tu as fait jaillir des sources et des torrents. Tu as mis à sec des fleuves qui ne tarissent point.
verses.am: አንተ ምንጮቹንና ፈሳሾቹን ሰነጠቅህ፤ አንተ ሁልጊዜ የሚፈስሱትን ወንዞች አደረቅህ።

verses.en: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.
verses.fr: A toi est le jour, à toi est la nuit; Tu as créé la lumière et le soleil.
verses.am: ቀኑ የአንተ ነው ሌሊቱም የአንተ ነው፤ አንተ ፀሓዩንና ጨረቃውን አዘጋጀህ።

verses.en: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.
verses.fr: Tu as fixé toutes les limites de la terre, Tu as établi l''été et l''hiver.
verses.am: አንተ የምድርን ዳርቻ ሁሉ ሠራህ፤ በጋንም ክረምትንም አንተ አደረግህ።

verses.en: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O Lord, and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.
verses.fr: Souviens-toi que l''ennemi outrage l''Eternel, Et qu''un peuple insensé méprise ton nom!
verses.am: ይህን ፍጥረትህን አስብ። ጠላት እግዚአብሔርን ተላገደ፥ ሰነፍ ሕዝብም ስሙን አስቈጣ።

verses.en: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.
verses.fr: Ne livre pas aux bêtes l''âme de ta tourterelle, N''oublie pas à toujours la vie de tes malheureux!
verses.am: የምትገዛልህን ነፍስ ለአራዊት አትስጣት፤ የችግረኞችህን ነፍስ ለዘወትር አትርሳ።

verses.en: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.
verses.fr: Aie égard à l''alliance! Car les lieux sombres du pays sont pleins de repaires de brigands.
verses.am: ወደ ኪዳንህ ተመልከት፥ የምድር የጨለማ ስፍራዎች በኅጥኣን ቤቶች ተሞልተዋልና።

verses.en: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.
verses.fr: Que l''opprimé ne retourne pas confus! Que le malheureux et le pauvre célèbrent ton nom!
verses.am: ችግረኛ አፍሮ አይመለስ፤ ችግረኛና ምስኪን ስምህን ያመሰግናሉ።

verses.en: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.
verses.fr: Lève-toi, ô Dieu! défends ta cause! Souviens-toi des outrages que te fait chaque jour l''insensé!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ተነሥ በቀልህንም ተበቀል፤ ሰነፎች ሁልጊዜም የተላገዱህን አስብ።

verses.en: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.
verses.fr: N''oublie pas les clameurs de tes adversaires, Le tumulte sans cesse croissant de ceux qui s''élèvent contre toi!
verses.am: የባሪያዎችህን ቃል አትርሳ፤ የጠላቶችህ ኵራት ሁልጊዜ ወደ አንተ ይወጣል።

verses.en: Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, unto thee do we give thanks: for that thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Ne détruis pas. Psaume d''Asaph. Cantique. Nous te louons, ô Dieu! nous te louons; Ton nom est dans nos bouches; Nous publions tes merveilles.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እናመሰግንሃለን እናመሰግንሃለን ስምህንም እንጠራለን፤ ተኣምራትህን ሁሉ እናገራለሁ።

verses.en: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.
verses.fr: Au temps que j''aurai fixé, Je jugerai avec droiture.
verses.am: ጊዜውን ስቀበል እኔ በቅን እፈርዳለሁ።

verses.en: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.
verses.fr: La terre tremble avec tous ceux qui l''habitent: Moi, j''affermis ses colonnes. -Pause.
verses.am: ምድርና በእርስዋ ውስጥ የሚኖሩት ሁሉ ቀለጡ፥ እኔም ምሰሶችዋን አጠናሁ።

verses.en: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:
verses.fr: Je dis à ceux qui se glorifient: Ne vous glorifiez pas! Et aux méchants: N''élevez pas la tête!
verses.am: ዓመፀኞችን። አትበድሉ አልኋቸው፥ ኃጢአተኞችንም። ቀንዳችሁን አታንሡ፤

verses.en: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.
verses.fr: N''élevez pas si haut votre tête, Ne parlez pas avec tant d''arrogance!
verses.am: ቀንዳችሁን እስከ ላይ አታንሡ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ላይ ዓመፅን አትናገሩ።

verses.en: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.
verses.fr: Car ce n''est ni de l''orient, ni de l''occident, Ni du désert, que vient l''élévation.
verses.am: ክብር ከምሥራቅ ወይም ከምዕራብ ወይም ከምድረ በዳ የለምና፤

verses.en: But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.
verses.fr: Mais Dieu est celui qui juge: Il abaisse l''un, et il élève l''autre.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ፈራጅ ነውና ይህን ያዋርዳል ይህንም ያከብራል።

verses.en: For in the hand of the Lord there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.
verses.fr: Il y a dans la main de l''Eternel une coupe, Où fermente un vin plein de mélange, Et il en verse: Tous les méchants de la terre sucent, boivent jusqu''à la lie.
verses.am: ጽዋ በእግዚአብሔር እጅ ነውና፤ ያልተቀላቀለ የወይን ጠጅ ሞላበት፤ ከዚህ ወደዚያ አገላበጠው፥ ነገር ግን አተላው አልፈሰሰም፤ የምድር ኃጢአተኞች ሁሉ ይጠጡታል።

verses.en: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
verses.fr: Je publierai ces choses à jamais; Je chanterai en l''honneur du Dieu de Jacob. -
verses.am: እኔ ግን ለዘላለም ደስ ይለኛል፥ ለያዕቆብም አምላክ ዝማሬን አቀርባለሁ።

verses.en: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
verses.fr: Et j''abattrai toutes les forces des méchants; Les forces du juste seront élevées.
verses.am: የኅጥኣንን ቀንዶች ሁሉ እሰብራለሁ፤ የጻድቃን ቀንዶች ግን ከፍ ከፍ ይላሉ።

verses.en: In Judah is God known: his name is great in Israel.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Avec instruments à cordes. Psaume d''Asaph. Cantique. Dieu est connu en Juda, Son nom est grand en Israël.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በይሁዳ ታወቀ፥ ስሙም በእስራኤል ታላቅ ነው።

verses.en: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.
