verses.fr: Sa tente est à Salem, Et sa demeure à Sion.
verses.am: ስፍራው በሳሌም፥ ማደሪያውም በጽዮን ነው።

verses.en: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.
verses.fr: C''est là qu''il a brisé les flèches, Le bouclier, l''épée et les armes de guerre. -Pause.
verses.am: በዚያም የቀስትን ኃይል፥ ጋሻን ሰይፍን ሰልፍንም ሰበረ፤ በዚያም ቀንዶችን ሰበረ።

verses.en: Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.
verses.fr: Tu es plus majestueux, plus puissant Que les montagnes des ravisseurs.
verses.am: አንተ በዘላለም ተራሮች ሆነህ በድንቅ ታበራለህ።

verses.en: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.
verses.fr: Ils ont été dépouillés, ces héros pleins de courage, Ils se sont endormis de leur dernier sommeil; Ils n''ont pas su se défendre, tous ces vaillants hommes.
verses.am: ልበ ሰነፎች ሁሉ ደነገጡ፥ እንቅልፋቸውንም አንቀላፉ፤ ባለጠጎች ሁሉ በእነርሱ እጅ ምንም አላገኙም።

verses.en: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
verses.fr: A ta menace, Dieu de Jacob! Ils se sont endormis, cavaliers et chevaux.
verses.am: የያዕቆብ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ከተግሣጽህ የተነሣ ፈረሰኞች ሁሉ አንቀላፉ።

verses.en: Thou, even thou, art to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?
verses.fr: Tu es redoutable, ô toi! Qui peut te résister, quand ta colère éclate?
verses.am: አንተ ግን፥ አንተ ግሩም ነህ፤ ቍጣህን ማን ይቃወማል?

verses.en: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,
verses.fr: Du haut des cieux tu as proclamé la sentence; La terre effrayée s''est tenue tranquille,
verses.am: ፍርድን ከሰማይ አሰማህ፤ ምድር ፈራች ዝምም አለች፥

verses.en: When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.
verses.fr: Lorsque Dieu s''est levé pour faire justice, Pour sauver tous les malheureux de la terre. -Pause.
verses.am: ልበ የዋሃን ያድን ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ለፍርድ በተነሣ ጊዜ።

verses.en: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.
verses.fr: L''homme te célèbre même dans sa fureur, Quand tu te revêts de tout ton courroux.
verses.am: ሰው በፈቃዱ ያመሰግንሃልና፥ ከሕሊናቸው ትርፍም በዓልህን ያደርጋሉ።

verses.en: Vow, and pay unto the Lord your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.
verses.fr: Faites des voeux à l''Eternel, votre Dieu, et accomplissez-les! Que tous ceux qui l''environnent apportent des dons au Dieu terrible!
verses.am: ለአምላካችን ለእግዚአብሔር ስእለትን ክፈሉ፤ በዙሪያው ያሉ ሁሉ እጅ መንሻን ለሚያስፈራው ያገባሉ።

verses.en: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.
verses.fr: Il abat l''orgueil des princes, Il est redoutable aux rois de la terre.
verses.am: የመኳንንትን ነፍስ ያወጣል፤ በምድርም ነገሥታት ዘንድ ያስፈራል።

verses.en: I cried unto God with my voice, even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. D''après Jeduthun. Psaume d''Asaph. Ma voix s''élève à Dieu, et je crie; Ma voix s''élève à Dieu, et il m''écoutera.
verses.am: በቃሌ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኽሁ፥ ቃሌም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ነው፥ እርሱም አደመጠኝ።

verses.en: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.
verses.fr: Au jour de ma détresse, je cherche le Seigneur; La nuit, mes mains sont étendues sans se lasser; Mon âme refuse toute consolation.
verses.am: በመከራዬ ቀን እግዚአብሔርን ፈለግሁት፤ እጆቼ በሌሊት በፊቱ ናቸው፥ አላረፍሁምም፥ ነፍሴም መጽናናትን አልቻለችም።

verses.en: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.
verses.fr: Je me souviens de Dieu, et je gémis; Je médite, et mon esprit est abattu. -Pause.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን አሰብሁት ደስ አለኝም፤ ተናገርሁ፥ ነፍሴም ፈዘዘች።

verses.en: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
verses.fr: Tu tiens mes paupières en éveil; Et, dans mon trouble, je ne puis parler.
verses.am: ዓይኖቼ እንዲተጉ ያዝሃቸው፤ ደነገጥሁ አልተናገርሁም።

verses.en: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
verses.fr: Je pense aux jours anciens, Aux années d''autrefois.
verses.am: የዱሮውን ዘመን አሰብሁ፤ የዘላለሙን ዓመታት አሰብሁ፤ አጠናጠንሁም

verses.en: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.
verses.fr: Je pense à mes cantiques pendant la nuit, Je fais des réflexions au dedans de mon coeur, Et mon esprit médite.
verses.am: በሌሊት ከልቤ ጋር ተጫወትሁ፥ ነፍሴንም አነቃቃኋት።

verses.en: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?
verses.fr: Le Seigneur rejettera-t-il pour toujours? Ne sera-t-il plus favorable?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም ይጥላልን? እንግዲህስ ቸርነቱን አይጨምርምን?

verses.en: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?
verses.fr: Sa bonté est-elle à jamais épuisée? Sa parole est-elle anéantie pour l''éternité?
verses.am: ለዘላለምስ ምሕረቱ ለልጅ ልጅ ተቈረጠችን? የተናገረውስ ቃል አልቆአልን?

verses.en: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.
verses.fr: Dieu a-t-il oublié d''avoir compassion? A-t-il, dans sa colère, retiré sa miséricorde? -Pause.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርስ ሞገሱን ረሳን? በቍጣውስ ምሕረቱን ዘጋውን?

verses.en: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.
verses.fr: Je dis: Ce qui fait ma souffrance, C''est que la droite du Très-Haut n''est plus la même...
verses.am: ይህ ድካሜ ነው አልሁ፥ የልዑል ቀኝ እንደ ተለወጠ።

verses.en: I will remember the works of the Lord: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.
verses.fr: Je rappellerai les oeuvres de l''Eternel, Car je me souviens de tes merveilles d''autrefois;
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ አስታወስሁ፤ የቀደመውን ተአምራትህን አስታወሳለሁና፤

verses.en: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.
verses.fr: Je parlerai de toutes tes oeuvres, Je raconterai tes hauts faits.
verses.am: በምግባርህም ሁሉ እናገራለሁ፥ በሥራህም እጫወታለሁ።

verses.en: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a God as our God?
verses.fr: O Dieu! tes voies sont saintes; Quel dieu est grand comme Dieu?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ መንገድህ በመቅደስ ውስጥ ነው፤ እንደ አምላካችን ያለ ታላቅ አምላክ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Thou art the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.
verses.fr: Tu es le Dieu qui fait des prodiges; Tu as manifesté parmi les peuples ta puissance.
verses.am: ተኣምራትን የምታደርግ አምላክ አንተ ነህ። ለሕዝብህ ኃይልን አስታወቅሃቸው።

verses.en: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
verses.fr: Par ton bras tu as délivré ton peuple, Les fils de Jacob et de Joseph. -Pause.
verses.am: የያዕቆብንና የዮሴፍን ልጆች፥ ሕዝብህን በክንድህ አዳንሃቸው።

verses.en: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.
verses.fr: Les eaux t''ont vu, ô Dieu! Les eaux t''ont vu, elles ont tremblé; Les abîmes se sont émus.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ውኆች አዩህ፥ ውኆችም አይተውህ ፈሩ፤ ጥልቆች ተነዋወጡ፥ ውኆችም ጮኹ።

verses.en: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.
verses.fr: Les nuages versèrent de l''eau par torrents, Le tonnerre retentit dans les nues, Et tes flèches volèrent de toutes parts.
verses.am: ደመኖች ድምፅን ሰጡ፥ ፍላጾችህም ወጡ።

verses.en: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.
verses.fr: Ton tonnerre éclata dans le tourbillon, Les éclairs illuminèrent le monde; La terre s''émut et trembla.
verses.am: የነጐድጓድህ ድምፅ በዐውሎ ነበረ፤ መብረቆች ለዓለም አበሩ፤ ምድር ተናወጠች ተንቀጠቀጠችም።

verses.en: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.
verses.fr: Tu te frayas un chemin par la mer, Un sentier par les grandes eaux, Et tes traces ne furent plus reconnues.
verses.am: መንገድህ በባህር ውስጥ ነው፥ ፍለጋህም በብዙ ውኆች ነው፥ አረማመድህም አልታወቀም።

verses.en: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.fr: Tu as conduit ton peuple comme un troupeau, Par la main de Moïse et d''Aaron.
verses.am: በሙሴና በአሮን እጅ ሕዝብህን እንደ በጎች መራሃቸው።

verses.en: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
verses.fr: Cantique d''Asaph. Mon peuple, écoute mes instructions! Prêtez l''oreille aux paroles de ma bouche!
verses.am: ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ ሕጌን አድምጡ፤ ጆሮአችሁንም ወደ አፌ ቃል አዘንብሉ።

verses.en: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:
verses.fr: J''ouvre la bouche par des sentences, Je publie la sagesse des temps anciens.
verses.am: አፌን በምሳሌ እከፍታለሁ፤ ከቀድሞ ጀምሮ፥ ያለውንም ተምሳሊት እናገራለሁ።

verses.en: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
verses.fr: Ce que nous avons entendu, ce que nous savons, Ce que nos pères nous ont raconté,
verses.am: የሰማነውንና ያውቅነውን፥ አባቶቻችንም የነገሩንን፥ ለሚመጣ ትውልድ ከልጆቻቸው አልሰወሩም።

verses.en: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the Lord, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.
verses.fr: Nous ne le cacherons point à leurs enfants; Nous dirons à la génération future les louanges de l''Eternel, Et sa puissance, et les prodiges qu''il a opérés.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ምስጋናና ኃይሉን ያደረገውንም ተኣምራት ተናገሩ።

verses.en: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:
verses.fr: Il a établi un témoignage en Jacob, Il a mis une loi en Israël, Et il a ordonné à nos pères de l''enseigner à leurs enfants,
verses.am: ለልጆቻቸው ያስታውቅ ዘንድ ለአባቶቻችን ያዘዘውን ምስክር በያዕቆብ አቆመ፥ በእስራኤልም ሕግን ሠራ፤

verses.en: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:
verses.fr: Pour qu''elle fût connue de la génération future, Des enfants qui naîtraient, Et que, devenus grands, ils en parlassent à leurs enfants,
verses.am: የሚመጣ፥ ትውልድ የሚወለዱም ልጆች ያውቁ ዘንድ፥ ተነሥተው ለልጆቻቸው ይነግራሉ፤

verses.en: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:
verses.fr: Afin qu''ils missent en Dieu leur confiance, Qu''ils n''oubliassent pas les oeuvres de Dieu, Et qu''ils observassent ses commandements,
verses.am: ተስፋቸውን በእግዚአብሔር እንዲያደርጉ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ሥራ እንዳይረሱ፥ ትእዛዙንም እንዲጠብቁ፤

verses.en: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.
verses.fr: Afin qu''ils ne fussent pas, comme leurs pères, Une race indocile et rebelle, Une race dont le coeur n''était pas ferme, Et dont l''esprit n''était pas fidèle à Dieu.
verses.am: እንደ አባቶቻቸው እንዳይሆኑ ጠማማና የምታስመርር ትውልድ፥ ልብዋን ያላቀናች ትውልድ፥ ነፍስዋ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ያልታመነች።

verses.en: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
verses.fr: Les fils d''Ephraïm, armés et tirant de l''arc, Tournèrent le dos le jour du combat.
verses.am: የኤፍሬም ልጆች ለሰልፍ ታጥቀው ቀስትንም ገትረው በሰልፍ ቀን ወደ ኋላ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;
verses.fr: Ils ne gardèrent point l''alliance de Dieu, Et ils refusèrent de marcher selon sa loi.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ኪዳን አልጠበቁም፥ በሕጉም ለመመላለስ እንቢ አሉ፤

verses.en: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.
verses.fr: Ils mirent en oubli ses oeuvres, Ses merveilles qu''il leur avait fait voir.
verses.am: መልካም ሥራውንና ያሳያቸውን ተኣምራቱን ረሱ፥

verses.en: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
verses.fr: Devant leurs pères il avait fait des prodiges, Au pays d''Egypte, dans les campagnes de Tsoan.
verses.am: በግብጽ አገርና በጣኔዎስ በረሃ በአባቶቻቸው ፊት የሠራውን ተኣምራት።

verses.en: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.
verses.fr: Il fendit la mer et leur ouvrit un passage, Il fit dresser les eaux comme une muraille.
verses.am: ባሕርን ከፍሎ አሳለፋቸው፤ ውኆችን እንደ ክምር አቆመ።

verses.en: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.
verses.fr: Il les conduisit le jour par la nuée, Et toute la nuit par un feu éclatant.
verses.am: ቀን በደመና መራቸው፥ ሌሊቱንም ሁሉ በእሳት ብርሃን።

verses.en: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.
verses.fr: Il fendit des rochers dans le désert, Et il donna à boire comme des flots abondants;
verses.am: ዓለቱን በምድረ በዳ ሰነጠቀ፤ ከጥልቅ እንደሚገኝ ያህል በብዙ አጠጣቸው።

verses.en: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
verses.fr: Du rocher il fit jaillir des sources, Et couler des eaux comme des fleuves.
verses.am: ውኃን ከጭንጫ አወጣ፥ ውኃንም እንደ ወንዞች አፈሰሰ።

verses.en: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.
verses.fr: Mais ils continuèrent à pécher contre lui, A se révolter contre le Très-Haut dans le désert.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ይበድሉት ዘንድ እንደ ገና ደገሙ፥ ልዑልንም በምድረ በዳ አስቈጡት።

verses.en: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.
verses.fr: Ils tentèrent Dieu dans leur coeur, En demandant de la nourriture selon leur désir.
verses.am: ለነፍሳቸው መብልን ይፈልጉ ዘንድ፥ እግዚአብሔርን በልባቸው ፈተኑት።

verses.en: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?
verses.fr: Ils parlèrent contre Dieu, Ils dirent: Dieu pourrait-il Dresser une table dans le désert?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን እንዲህ ብለው አሙት። እግዚአብሔር በምድረ በዳ ማዕድን ያሰናዳ ዘንድ ይችላልን?

verses.en: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?
verses.fr: Voici, il a frappé le rocher, et des eaux ont coulé, Et des torrents se sont répandus; Pourra-t-il aussi donner du pain, Ou fournir de la viande à son peuple?
verses.am: ዓለቱን መታ፤ ውኆችም ወጡ፥ ወንዞችም ጐረፉ፤ እንጀራን መስጠትስ ይችላልን? ለሕዝቡስ ማዕድን ያዘጋጃልን?

verses.en: Therefore the Lord heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;
verses.fr: L''Eternel entendit, et il fut irrité; Un feu s''alluma contre Jacob, Et la colère s''éleva contre Israël,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ይህን ሰምቶ ተቈጣ፤ በያዕቆብም ላይ እሳት ነደደ፥ መዓትም በእስራኤል ላይ መጣ፤

verses.en: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:
verses.fr: Parce qu''ils ne crurent pas en Dieu, Parce qu''ils n''eurent pas confiance dans son secours.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር አላመኑምና፥ በመድኃኒቱም አልተማመኑምና።

verses.en: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,
verses.fr: Il commanda aux nuages d''en haut, Et il ouvrit les portes des cieux;
verses.am: ደመናውንም ከላይ አዘዘ፥ የሰማይንም ደጆች ከፈተ፤

verses.en: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.
verses.fr: Il fit pleuvoir sur eux la manne pour nourriture, Il leur donna le blé du ciel.
verses.am: ይበሉም ዘንድ መናን አዘነበላቸው፥ የሰማይንም እንጀራ ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: Man did eat angels' food: he sent them meat to the full.
verses.fr: Ils mangèrent tous le pain des grands, Il leur envoya de la nourriture à satiété.
verses.am: የመላክትንም እንጀራ ሰው በላ ስንቅንም እስኪተርፋቸው ላከላቸው።

verses.en: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.
verses.fr: Il fit souffler dans les cieux le vent d''orient, Et il amena par sa puissance le vent du midi;
verses.am: ከሰማይ የምሥራቅን ነፋስ አስነሣ፥ በኃይሉም የደቡብን ነፋስ አመጣ፤

verses.en: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:
verses.fr: Il fit pleuvoir sur eux la viande comme de la poussière, Et comme le sable des mers les oiseaux ailés;
verses.am: ሥጋን እንደ አፈር፥ የሚበርሩትንም ወፎች እንደ ባሕር አሸዋ አዘነበላቸው፤

verses.en: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.
verses.fr: Il les fit tomber au milieu de leur camp, Tout autour de leurs demeures.
verses.am: በሰፈራቸው መካከል፥ በድንኳናቸውም ዙሪያ ወደቀ።

verses.en: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;
verses.fr: Ils mangèrent et se rassasièrent abondamment: Dieu leur donna ce qu''ils avaient désiré.
verses.am: በሉ እጅግም ጠገቡ፤ ምኞታቸውንም ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,
verses.fr: Ils n''avaient pas satisfait leur désir, Ils avaient encore leur nourriture dans la bouche,
verses.am: ከወደዱትም አላሳጣቸውም፤ መብላቸውም ገና በአፋቸው ሳለ፥

verses.en: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.
verses.fr: Lorsque la colère de Dieu s''éleva contre eux; Il frappa de mort les plus vigoureux, Il abattit les jeunes hommes d''Israël.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በላያቸው መጣ፥ ከእነርሱም ከፍ ያሉትን ገደለ፥ የእስራኤልንም ምርጦች አሰናከለ።

verses.en: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.
verses.fr: Malgré tout cela, ils continuèrent à pécher, Et ne crurent point à ses prodiges.
verses.am: ከዚህም ሁሉ ጋር እንደ ገና በደሉ፥ ተኣምራቱንም አላመኑም፤

verses.en: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.
verses.fr: Il consuma leurs jours par la vanité, Et leurs années par une fin soudaine.
verses.am: ቀኖቻቸውም በከንቱ አለቁ፥ ዓመቶቻቸውም በችኰላ።

verses.en: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.
verses.fr: Quand il les frappait de mort, ils le cherchaient, Ils revenaient et se tournaient vers Dieu;
verses.am: በገደላቸውም ጊዜ ወዲያው ፈለጉት፤ ተመለሱ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ገሠገሡ፤

verses.en: And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.
verses.fr: Ils se souvenaient que Dieu était leur rocher, Que le Dieu Très-Haut était leur libérateur.
verses.am: ረዳታቸውም እግዚአብሔር፥ መድኃኒታቸውም ልዑል አምላክ እንደ ሆነ አሰቡ።

verses.en: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.
verses.fr: Mais ils le trompaient de la bouche, Et ils lui mentaient de la langue;
verses.am: እርሱ ግን መሓሪ ነው፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም ይቅር አላቸው፥ አላጠፋቸውምም፤ ቍጣውንም መመለስ አበዛ፥ መዓቱንም ሁሉ አላቃጠለም።

verses.en: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.
verses.fr: Leur coeur n''était pas ferme envers lui, Et ils n''étaient pas fidèles à son alliance.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን መሓሪ ነው፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም ይቅር አላቸው፥ አላጠፋቸውምም፤ ቍጣውንም መመለስ አበዛ፥ መዓቱንም ሁሉ አላቃጠለም።

verses.en: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.
verses.fr: Toutefois, dans sa miséricorde, il pardonne l''iniquité et ne détruit pas; Il retient souvent sa colère et ne se livre pas à toute sa fureur.
verses.am: ወጥቶ የማይመለስ መንፈስ፥ ሥጋም እንደ ሆኑ አሰበ።

verses.en: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.
verses.fr: Il se souvint qu''ils n''étaient que chair, Un souffle qui s''en va et ne revient pas.
verses.am: በምድረ በዳ ምን ያህል አስቈጡት፥ በበረሃም አሳዘኑት።

verses.en: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!
verses.fr: Que de fois ils se révoltèrent contre lui dans le désert! Que de fois ils l''irritèrent dans la solitude!
verses.am: ተመለሱ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ፈተኑት፥ የእስራኤልንም ቅዱስ አሳዘኑት።

verses.en: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.
verses.fr: Ils ne cessèrent de tenter Dieu, Et de provoquer le Saint d''Israël.
verses.am: እነርሱም እጁን አላሰቡም፥ ከጠላቶቻቸው እጅ ያዳነበትን ቀን፥

verses.en: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.
verses.fr: Ils ne se souvinrent pas de sa puissance, Du jour où il les délivra de l''ennemi,
verses.am: በግብጽ ያደረገውን ተኣምራቱን፥ በጣኔዎስም በረሃ ያደረገውን ድንቁን።

verses.en: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan.
verses.fr: Des miracles qu''il accomplit en Egypte, Et de ses prodiges dans les campagnes de Tsoan.
verses.am: ወንዞቻቸውንም ወደ ደም ለወጠ፥ ምንጮቻቸውን ደግሞ እንዳይጠጡ።

verses.en: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.
verses.fr: Il changea leurs fleuves en sang, Et ils ne purent en boire les eaux.
verses.am: ዝንቦችንም በላያቸው ሰደደባቸው፥ በሉአቸውም፤ በጓጉንቸርም አጠፋቸው።

verses.en: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
verses.fr: Il envoya contre eux des mouches venimeuses qui les dévorèrent, Et des grenouilles qui les détruisirent.
verses.am: ፍሬያቸውን ለኩብኩባ፥ ሥራቸውንም ለአንበጣ ሰጠ።

verses.en: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.
verses.fr: Il livra leurs récoltes aux sauterelles, Le produit de leur travail aux sauterelles.
verses.am: ወይናቸውን በበረዶ፥ በለሳቸውንም በአመዳይ አጠፋ።

verses.en: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.
verses.fr: Il fit périr leurs vignes par la grêle, Et leurs sycomores par la gelée.
verses.am: እንስሶቻቸውን ለበረዶ፥ ሀብታቸውንም ለእሳት ሰጠ።

verses.en: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
verses.fr: Il abandonna leur bétail à la grêle, Et leurs troupeaux au feu du ciel.
verses.am: የመዓቱን መቅሠፍት በላያቸው ሰደደ፤ መቅሠፍትን መዓትንም መከራንም በክፉዎች መላእክት ሰደደ።

verses.en: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.
verses.fr: Il lança contre eux son ardente colère, La fureur, la rage et la détresse, Une troupe de messagers de malheur.
verses.am: ለቍጣው መንገድን ጠረገ፤ ነፍሳቸውንም ከሞት አላዳናትም፥ እንስሶቻቸውንም በሞት ውስጥ ዘጋ፤

verses.en: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;
verses.fr: Il donna libre cours à sa colère, Il ne sauva pas leur âme de la mort, Il livra leur vie à la mortalité;
verses.am: በኵሮቻቸውን ሁሉ በግብጽ፥ የድካማቸውንም መጀመሪያ በካም ድንኳኖች ገደለ።

verses.en: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:
verses.fr: Il frappa tous les premiers-nés en Egypte, Les prémices de la force sous les tentes de Cham.
verses.am: ሕዝቡን ግን እንደ በጎች አሰማራቸው፥ እንደ መንጋም በምድረ በዳ መራቸው።

verses.en: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
verses.fr: Il fit partir son peuple comme des brebis, Il les conduisit comme un troupeau dans le désert.
verses.am: በተስፋም መራቸው አልፈሩምም፥ ጠላቶቻቸውንም ባሕር ደፈናቸው።

verses.en: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
verses.fr: Il les dirigea sûrement, pour qu''ils fussent sans crainte, Et la mer couvrit leurs ennemis.
verses.am: ወደ መቅደሱም ተራራ አገባቸው፥ ቀኙ ወደ ፈጠረችው ወደዚህች ተራራ፤

verses.en: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.
verses.fr: Il les amena vers sa frontière sainte, Vers cette montagne que sa droite a acquise.
verses.am: ከፊታቸውም አሕዛብን አባረረ፥ ርስቱንም በገመድ አካፈላቸው፥ የእስራኤልንም ወገኖች በቤታቸው አኖረ።

verses.en: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
verses.fr: Il chassa devant eux les nations, Leur distribua le pays en héritage, Et fit habiter dans leurs tentes les tribus d''Israël.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ልዑል እግዚአብሔርን ፈተኑት አስቈጡትም፥ ምስክሩንም አልጠበቁም፤

verses.en: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:
verses.fr: Mais ils tentèrent le Dieu Très-Haut et se révoltèrent contre lui, Et ils n''observèrent point ses ordonnances.
verses.am: ተመለሱም እንደ አባቶቻቸውም ከዱ፤ እንደ ጠማማ ቀስትም ተገለበጡ፤

verses.en: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
verses.fr: Ils s''éloignèrent et furent infidèles, comme leurs pères, Ils tournèrent, comme un arc trompeur.
verses.am: በኰረብታ መስገጃዎቻቸውም አስቈጡት፥ በተቀረጹ ምስሎቻቸውም አስቀኑት።

verses.en: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.
verses.fr: Ils l''irritèrent par leurs hauts lieux, Et ils excitèrent sa jalousie par leurs idoles.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ይህን ሰምቶ ተቈጣ፥ እስራኤልንም እጅግ ናቀ፤

verses.en: When God heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:
verses.fr: Dieu entendit, et il fut irrité; Il repoussa fortement Israël.
verses.am: የሴሎምን ማደሪያ ተዋት በሰዎች መካከል ያደረገባትን ድንኳኑን፤

verses.en: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;
verses.fr: Il abandonna la demeure de Silo, La tente où il habitait parmi les hommes;
verses.am: ኃይላቸውን ለምርኮ፥ ሽልማቱንም በጠላት እጅ ሰጠ።

verses.en: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy's hand.
verses.fr: Il livra sa gloire à la captivité, Et sa majesté entre les mains de l''ennemi.
verses.am: ሕዝቡንም በጦር ውስጥ ዘጋቸው፥ ርስቱንም ቸል አላቸው።

verses.en: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.
verses.fr: Il mit son peuple à la merci du glaive, Et il s''indigna contre son héritage.
verses.am: ጕልማሶቻቸውን እሳት በላቸው፥ ቈነጃጅቶቻቸውም አላዘኑም፤

verses.en: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.
verses.fr: Le feu dévora ses jeunes hommes, Et ses vierges ne furent pas célébrées;
verses.am: ካህናቶቻቸውም በሰይፍ ወደቁ፥ ባልቴቶቻቸውም አላለቀሱላቸውም።

verses.en: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.
verses.fr: Ses sacrificateurs tombèrent par l''épée, Et ses veuves ne pleurèrent pas.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከእንቅልፍ እንደሚነቃ ተነሣ፥ የወይን ስካር እንደ ተወው እንደ ኃያልም ሰው፤

verses.en: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur s''éveilla comme celui qui a dormi, Comme un héros qu''a subjugué le vin.
verses.am: ጠላቶቹንም በኋላቸው መታ፤ የዘላለምን ኀሣር ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.
verses.fr: Il frappa ses adversaires en fuite, Il les couvrit d''un opprobre éternel.
verses.am: የዮሴፍንም ድንኳን ተዋት፥ የኤፍሬምንም ወገን አልመረጠውም፤

verses.en: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:
verses.fr: Cependant il rejeta la tente de Joseph, Et il ne choisit point la tribu d''Ephraïm;
verses.am: የይሁዳን ወገን ግን መረጠ፥ የወደደውን የጽዮንን ተራራ።

verses.en: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.
verses.fr: Il préféra la tribu de Juda, La montagne de Sion qu''il aimait.
verses.am: መቅደሱን እንደ አርያም ሠራ፥ ለዘላለምም በምድር ውስጥ መሠረታት።

verses.en: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he hath established for ever.
verses.fr: Et il bâtit son sanctuaire comme les lieux élevés, Comme la terre qu''il a fondée pour toujours.
verses.am: ዳዊትንም ባሪያውን መረጠው፥ ከበጎቹም መንጋ ውስጥ ወሰደው፤

verses.en: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:
verses.fr: Il choisit David, son serviteur, Et il le tira des bergeries;
verses.am: ዳዊትንም ባሪያውን መረጠው፥ ከበጎቹም መንጋ ውስጥ ወሰደው፤

verses.en: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.
verses.fr: Il le prit derrière les brebis qui allaitent, Pour lui faire paître Jacob, son peuple, Et Israël, son héritage.

verses.en: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.
verses.fr: Et David les dirigea avec un coeur intègre, Et les conduisit avec des mains intelligentes.

verses.en: O god, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.
verses.fr: Psaume d''Asaph. O Dieu! les nations ont envahi ton héritage, Elles ont profané ton saint temple, Elles ont fait de Jérusalem un monceau de pierres.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አሕዛብ ወደ ርስትህ ገቡ፤ የቅድስናህንም መቅደስ አረከሱ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምንም እንደ መደብ አደረጉአት።

verses.en: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.
verses.fr: Elles ont livré les cadavres de tes serviteurs En pâture aux oiseaux du ciel, La chair de tes fidèles aux bêtes de la terre;
verses.am: የባሪያዎችህንም በድኖች ለሰማይ ወፎች መብል አደረጉ፥ የጻድቃንህንም ሥራ ለምድር አራዊት፤

verses.en: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.
verses.fr: Elles ont versé leur sang comme de l''eau Tout autour de Jérusalem, Et il n''y a eu personne pour les enterrer.
verses.am: ደማቸውንም በኢየሩሳሌም ዙሪያ እንደ ውኃ አፈሰሱ፥ የሚቀብራቸውም አጡ።

verses.en: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.
verses.fr: Nous sommes devenus un objet d''opprobre pour nos voisins, De moquerie et de risée pour ceux qui nous entourent.
verses.am: ለጎረቤቶቻችንም ስድብ ሆንን፥ በዙሪያችንም ላሉ ሣቅና ዘበት።

verses.en: How long, Lord? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?
verses.fr: Jusques à quand, Eternel! t''irriteras-tu sans cesse, Et ta colère s''embrasera-t-elle comme le feu?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እስከ መቼ ለዘላለም ትቈጣለህ? ቅንዓትህም እንደ እሳት ይነድዳል?

verses.en: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.
verses.fr: Répands ta fureur sur les nations qui ne te connaissent pas, Et sur les royaumes qui n''invoquent pas ton nom!
verses.am: ስምህን በማይጠሩ መንግሥታት ላይ በማያውቁህም አሕዛብ ላይ መዓትህን አፍስስ፤

verses.en: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.
verses.fr: Car on a dévoré Jacob, Et ravagé sa demeure.
verses.am: ያዕቆብን በልተውታልና፥ ስፍራውንም ባድማ አድርገዋልና።

verses.en: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.
verses.fr: Ne te souviens plus de nos iniquités passées! Que tes compassions viennent en hâte au-devant de nous! Car nous sommes bien malheureux.
verses.am: የቀደመውን በደላችንን አታስብብን፥ ምሕረትህ በቶሎ ታግኘን፥ እጅግ ተቸግረናልና።

verses.en: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name's sake.
verses.fr: Secours-nous, Dieu de notre salut, pour la gloire de ton nom! Délivre-nous, et pardonne nos péchés, à cause de ton nom!
verses.am: አምላካችንና መድኃኒታችን ሆይ፥ እርዳን፤ ስለ ስምህ ክብር፥ አቤቱ፥ ታደገን፥ ስለ ስምህም ኃጢአታችንን አስተሰርይልን።

verses.en: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.
verses.fr: Pourquoi les nations diraient-elles: Où est leur Dieu? Qu''on sache, en notre présence, parmi les nations, Que tu venges le sang de tes serviteurs, le sang répandu!
verses.am: አሕዛብ፥ አምላካቸው ወዴት ነው? እንዳይሉ፥ የፈሰሰውን የባሪያዎችህን ደም በቀል በዓይኖቻችን ፊት አሕዛብ ያወቁ፤

verses.en: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;
verses.fr: Que les gémissements des captifs parviennent jusqu''à toi! Par ton bras puissant sauve ceux qui vont périr!
verses.am: የእስረኞች ጩኸት ወደ ፊትህ ይግባ፤ እንደ ክንድህም ታላቅነት ሊገደሉ የተፈረደባቸውን አድን።

verses.en: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.
verses.fr: Rends à nos voisins sept fois dans leur sein Les outrages qu''ils t''ont faits, Seigneur!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የተዘባበቱብህን መዘባበታቸውን ለጎረቤቶቻችን ሰባት እጥፍ በብብታቸው ክፈላቸው።

verses.en: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.
verses.fr: Et nous, ton peuple, le troupeau de ton pâturage, Nous te célébrerons éternellement; De génération en génération nous publierons tes louanges.
verses.am: እኛ ሕዝብህ ግን፥ የማሰማርያህም በጎች፥ ለዘላለም እናመሰግንሃለን፤ ለልጅ ልጅም ምስጋናህን እንናገራለን።

verses.en: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Sur les lis lyriques. D''Asaph. Psaume. Prête l''oreille, berger d''Israël, Toi qui conduis Joseph comme un troupeau! Parais dans ta splendeur, Toi qui es assis sur les chérubins!
verses.am: ዮሴፍን እንደ መንጋ የምትመራ፥ የእስራኤል ጠባቂ ሆይ፥ አድምጥ፤ በኪሩቤል ላይ የምትቀመጥ፥ ተገለጥ።

verses.en: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come and save us.
verses.fr: Devant Ephraïm, Benjamin et Manassé, réveille ta force, Et viens à notre secours!
verses.am: በኤፍሬምና በብንያም በምናሴም፤ ኃይልህን አንሣ እኛንም ለማዳን ና።

verses.en: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.fr: O Dieu, relève-nous! Fais briller ta face, et nous serons sauvés!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ መልሰን፥ ፊትህንም አብራ፥ እኛም እንድናለን።

verses.en: O Lord God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?
verses.fr: Eternel, Dieu des armées! Jusques à quand t''irriteras-tu contre la prière de ton peuple?
verses.am: የሠራዊት አምላክ አቤቱ፥ በባሪያህ ጸሎት ላይ እስከ መቼ ትቈጣለህ?

verses.en: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.
verses.fr: Tu les nourris d''un pain de larmes. Tu les abreuves de larmes à pleine mesure.
verses.am: የእንባ እንጀራን ትመግበናለህ፥ እንባም በስፍር ታጠጣናለህ።

verses.en: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.
verses.fr: Tu fais de nous un objet de discorde pour nos voisins, Et nos ennemis se raillent de nous.
verses.am: ለጎረቤቶቻችን ክርክር አደረግኸን፥ ጠላቶቻችንም በላያችን ተሣለቁብን።

verses.en: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.fr: Dieu des armées, relève-nous! Fais briller ta face, et nous serons sauvés!
verses.am: የሠራዊት አምላክ አቤቱ፥ መልሰን፥ ፊትህንም አብራ፥ እኛም እንድናለን።

verses.en: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.
verses.fr: Tu avais arraché de l''Egypte une vigne; Tu as chassé des nations, et tu l''as plantée.
verses.am: ከግብጽ የወይን ግንድ አመጣህ፤ አሕዛብን አባረርህ እርስዋንም ተከልህ።

verses.en: Thou preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.
verses.fr: Tu as fait place devant elle: Elle a jeté des racines et rempli la terre;
verses.am: በፊትዋም ስፍራን አዘጋጀህ፥ ሥሮችዋንም ተከልህ ምድርንም ሞላች።

verses.en: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.
verses.fr: Les montagnes étaient couvertes de son ombre, Et ses rameaux étaient comme des cèdres de Dieu;
verses.am: ጥላዋ ተራሮችን ከደነ፥ ጫፎችዋም እንደ እግዚአብሔር ዝግባ ሆኑ።

verses.en: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.
verses.fr: Elle étendait ses branches jusqu''à la mer, Et ses rejetons jusqu''au fleuve.
verses.am: ቅርንጫፎችዋንም እስከ ባሕር፥ ቡቃያዋንም እስከ ወንዙ ዘረጋች።

verses.en: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?
verses.fr: Pourquoi as-tu rompu ses clôtures, En sorte que tous les passants la dépouillent?
verses.am: አጥርዋን ለምን አፈረስህ? መንገድ አላፊም ሁሉ ይቀጥፋታል።

verses.en: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.
verses.fr: Le sanglier de la forêt la ronge, Et les bêtes des champs en font leur pâture.
verses.am: የዱር እርያ አረከሳት፥ የአገር አውሬም ተሰማራባት።

verses.en: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;
verses.fr: Dieu des armées, reviens donc! Regarde du haut des cieux, et vois! considère cette vigne!
verses.am: የሠራዊት አምላክ ሆይ፥ እንግዲህ ተመለስ፤ ከሰማይ ተመልከት፥ እይም፥ ይህችንም የወይን ግንድ ጐብኝ።

verses.en: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.
verses.fr: Protège ce que ta droite a planté, Et le fils que tu t''es choisi!...
verses.am: በሰው ልጅ ለአንተ ያጸናኸውን ቀኝህ የተከላትን አንሣ።

verses.en: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
verses.fr: Elle est brûlée par le feu, elle est coupée! Ils périssent devant ta face menaçante.
verses.am: በእሳት ተቃጥላለች ተነቅላማለች፤ ከፊትህ ተግሣጽም የተነሣ ይጠፋሉ።

verses.en: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.
verses.fr: Que ta main soit sur l''homme de ta droite, Sur le fils de l''homme que tu t''es choisi!
verses.am: ለአንተ ባጸናኸው በሰው ልጅ ላይ፥ በቀኝህ ሰው ላይ እጅህ ትሁን።

verses.en: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.
verses.fr: Et nous ne nous éloignerons plus de toi. Fais-nous revivre, et nous invoquerons ton nom.
verses.am: ከአንተም አንራቅ፤ አድነን ስምህንም እንጠራለን።

verses.en: Turn us again, O Lord God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.fr: Eternel, Dieu des armées, relève-nous! Fais briller ta face, et nous serons sauvés!
verses.am: የሠራዊት አምላክ አቤቱ፥ መልሰን፥ ፊትህንም አብራ፥ እኛም እንድናለን።

verses.en: Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Sur la guitthith. D''Asaph. Chantez avec allégresse à Dieu, notre force! Poussez des cris de joie vers le Dieu de Jacob!
verses.am: በረድኤታችን በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይበላችሁ፥ ለያዕቆብም አምላክ እልል በሉ።

verses.en: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.
verses.fr: Entonnez des cantiques, faites résonner le tambourin, La harpe mélodieuse et le luth!
verses.am: ዝማሬውን አንሡ ከበሮንም ስጡ፥ ደስ የሚያሰኘውን በገና ከመሰንቆ ጋር፤

verses.en: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.
verses.fr: Sonnez de la trompette à la nouvelle lune, A la pleine lune, au jour de notre fête!
verses.am: በመባቻ ቀን በከፍተኛው በዓላችን ቀን መለከትን ንፉ፤

verses.en: For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.
verses.fr: Car c''est une loi pour Israël, Une ordonnance du Dieu de Jacob.
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ሥርዓቱ ነውና፥ የያዕቆብም አምላክ ፍርድ።

verses.en: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: where I heard a language that I understood not.
verses.fr: Il en fit un statut pour Joseph, Quand il marcha contre le pays d''Egypte... J''entends une voix qui m''est inconnue:
verses.am: ከግብጽ በወጣ ጊዜ ለዮሴፍ ምስክር አቆመው። ያላወቅሁትን ቋንቋ ሰማሁ።

verses.en: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.
verses.fr: J''ai déchargé son épaule du fardeau, Et ses mains ont lâché la corbeille.
verses.am: ጫንቃውን ከሸክም፥ እጆቹንም በቅርጫት ከመገዛት አራቅሁ።

verses.en: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
verses.fr: Tu as crié dans la détresse, et je t''ai délivré; Je t''ai répondu dans la retraite du tonnerre; Je t''ai éprouvé près des eaux de Meriba. Pause.
verses.am: በመከራህ ጊዜ ጠራኸኝ አዳንሁህም፥ በተሰወረ ዐውሎም መለስሁልህ፥ በክርክር ውኃ ዘንድም ፈተንሁህ።

verses.en: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;
verses.fr: Ecoute, mon peuple! et je t''avertirai; Israël, puisses-tu m''écouter!
verses.am: ሕዝቤ ሆይ፥ስማኝ እነግርሃለሁም፤ እስራኤል ሆይ፥ እመሰክርልሃለሁ።

verses.en: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.
verses.fr: Qu''il n''y ait au milieu de toi point de dieu étranger! Ne te prosterne pas devant des dieux étrangers!
verses.am: አንተስ ብትሰማኝ ሌላ አምላክ አይሆንልህም፥ ለሌላ አምላክም አትሰግድም።

verses.en: I am the Lord thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
verses.fr: Je suis l''Eternel, ton Dieu, qui t''ai fait monter du pays d''Egypte; Ouvre ta bouche, et je la remplirai.
verses.am: ከግብጽ ምድር ያወጣሁህ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ ነኝና፤ አፍህን አስፋ እሞላዋለሁም።

verses.en: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.
verses.fr: Mais mon peuple n''a point écouté ma voix, Israël ne m''a point obéi.
verses.am: ሕዝቤ ግን ቃሌን አልሰሙኝም፥ እስራኤልም አላዳመጠኝም።

verses.en: So I gave them up unto their own hearts' lust: and they walked in their own counsels.
verses.fr: Alors je les ai livrés aux penchants de leur coeur, Et ils ont suivi leurs propres conseils.
verses.am: እንደ ልባቸው ሥራ ተውኋቸው፥ በልባቸውም አሳብ ሄዱ።

verses.en: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Israel had walked in my ways!
verses.fr: Oh! si mon peuple m''écoutait, Si Israël marchait dans mes voies!
verses.am: ሕዝቤስ ሰምቶኝ ቢሆን፥ እስራኤልም በመንገዴ ሄደው ቢሆን፤

verses.en: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.
verses.fr: En un instant je confondrais leurs ennemis, Je tournerais ma main contre leurs adversaires;
verses.am: ጠላቶቻቸውን ፈጥኜ ባዋረድኋቸው ነበር፥ በሚያስጨንቋቸውም ላይ እጄን በጣልሁ ነበር፤

verses.en: The haters of the Lord should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.
verses.fr: Ceux qui haïssent l''Eternel le flatteraient, Et le bonheur d''Israël durerait toujours;
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ጠላቶችም በተገዙለት ነበር፥ ዘመናቸውም ለዘላለም በሆነ ነበር፤

verses.en: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.
verses.fr: Je le nourrirais du meilleur froment, Et je le rassasierais du miel du rocher.
verses.am: ከስንዴም ስብ ባበላቸው ነበር፥ ከዓለቱም ማር ባጠገባቸው ነበር።

verses.en: God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.
verses.fr: Psaume d''Asaph. Dieu se tient dans l''assemblée de Dieu; Il juge au milieu des dieux.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በአማልክት ማኅበር ቆመ፥ በአማልክትም መካከል ይፈርዳል።

verses.en: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.
verses.fr: Jusques à quand jugerez-vous avec iniquité, Et aurez-vous égard à la personne des méchants? Pause.
verses.am: እስከ መቼ ሐሰትን ትፈርዳላችሁ? እስከ መቼ ለኃጢአተኞች ፊት ታደላላችሁ?

verses.en: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.
verses.fr: Rendez justice au faible et à l''orphelin, Faites droit au malheureux et au pauvre,
verses.am: ለድሆችና ለድሀ አደጎች ፍረዱ፤ ለችግረኛውና ለምስኪኑ ጽድቅ አድርጉ፤

verses.en: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.fr: Sauvez le misérable et l''indigent, Délivrez-les de la main des méchants.
verses.am: ብቸኛውንና ችግረኛውን አድኑ፤ ከኃጢአተኞችም እጅ አስጥሉአቸው።

verses.en: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.
verses.fr: Ils n''ont ni savoir ni intelligence, Ils marchent dans les ténèbres; Tous les fondements de la terre sont ébranlés.
verses.am: አያውቁም፥ አያስተውሉም፤ በጨለማ ውስጥ ይመላለሳሉ፤ የምድር መሠረቶች ሁሉ ተናወጡ።

verses.en: I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.
verses.fr: J''avais dit: Vous êtes des dieux, Vous êtes tous des fils du Très-Haut.
verses.am: እኔ ግን። አማልክት ናችሁ፥ ሁላችሁም የልዑል ልጆች ናችሁ፤

verses.en: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.
verses.fr: Cependant vous mourrez comme des hommes, Vous tomberez comme un prince quelconque.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እንደ ሰው ትሞታላችሁ፥ ከአለቆችም እንደ አንዱ ትወድቃላችሁ አልሁ።

verses.en: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.
verses.fr: Lève-toi, ô Dieu, juge la terre! Car toutes les nations t''appartiennent.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ተነሥ፥ በምድር ላይ ፍርድ፥ አንተ አሕዛብን ሁሉ ትወርሳለህና።

verses.en: Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.
verses.fr: Cantique. Psaume d''Asaph. O Dieu, ne reste pas dans le silence! Ne te tais pas, et ne te repose pas, ô Dieu!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እንደ አንተ ማን ነው? አቤቱ፥ ዝም አትበል፥ ቸልም አትበል።

verses.en: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
verses.fr: Car voici, tes ennemis s''agitent, Ceux qui te haïssent lèvent la tête.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ጠላቶችህ ጮኽዋልና፥ የሚጠሉህም ራሳቸውን አንሥተዋልና።

verses.en: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.
verses.fr: Ils forment contre ton peuple des projets pleins de ruse, Et ils délibèrent contre ceux que tu protèges.
verses.am: ሕዝብህን በምክር ሸነገሉአቸው፥ በቅዱሳንህም ላይ ተማከሩ።

verses.en: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.
verses.fr: Venez, disent-ils, exterminons-les du milieu des nations, Et qu''on ne se souvienne plus du nom d''Israël!
verses.am: ኑ ከሕዝብ እናጥፋቸው፥ ደግሞም የእስራኤል ስም አይታሰብ አሉ።

verses.en: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:
verses.fr: Ils se concertent tous d''un même coeur, Ils font une alliance contre toi;
verses.am: አንድ ሆነው በአንተ ላይ ተማከሩ፤ በአንተ ላይ ቃል ኪዳን አደረጉ፤

verses.en: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;
verses.fr: Les tentes d''Edom et les Ismaélites, Moab et les Hagaréniens,
verses.am: የኤዶማውያን ድንኳኖች እስማኤላውያንም፥ ሞዓብም አጋራውያንም፥

verses.en: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;
verses.fr: Guebal, Ammon, Amalek, Les Philistins avec les habitants de Tyr;
verses.am: ጌባል አሞንም አማሌቅም፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያንም ከጢሮስ ሰዎች ጋር፤

verses.en: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.
verses.fr: L''Assyrie aussi se joint à eux, Elle prête son bras aux enfants de Lot. Pause.
verses.am: አሦርም ከእነርሱ ጋር ተባበረ፥ ለሎጥ ልጆችም ረዳት ሆኑአቸው።

verses.en: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:
verses.fr: Traite-les comme Madian, Comme Sisera, comme Jabin au torrent de Kison!
verses.am: እንደ ምድያምና እንደ ሲሣራ፥ በቂሶንም ወንዝ እንደ ኢያቢስ አድርግባቸው።

verses.en: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.
verses.fr: Ils ont été détruits à En-Dor, Ils sont devenus du fumier pour la terre.
verses.am: በዓይንዶር ጠፉ፥ እንደ ምድርም ጕድፍ ሆኑ።

verses.en: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:
verses.fr: Traite leurs chefs comme Oreb et Zeeb, Et tous leurs princes comme Zébach et Tsalmunna!
verses.am: አለቆቻቸውን እንደ ሔሬብና እንደ ዜብ፥ ታላላቆቻቸውንም እንደ ዛብሄልና እንደ ስልማና አድርጋቸው።

verses.en: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.
verses.fr: Car ils disent: Emparons-nous Des demeures de Dieu!
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን መሠዊያ እንወርሳለን የሚሉትን።

verses.en: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.
verses.fr: Mon Dieu! rends-les semblables au tourbillon, Au chaume qu''emporte le vent,
verses.am: አምላኬ ሆይ፥ እንደ ትቢያ በነፋስ ፊትም እንደ ገለባ አድርጋቸው።

verses.en: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;
verses.fr: Au feu qui brûle la forêt, A la flamme qui embrase les montagnes!
verses.am: እሳት ዱርን እንደሚያቃጥል፥ ነበልባልም ተራሮች እንደሚያነድድ፥

verses.en: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.
verses.fr: Poursuis-les ainsi de ta tempête, Et fais-les trembler par ton ouragan!
verses.am: እንዲሁ በቍጣህ አሳድዳቸው፥ በመቅሠፍትህም አስደንግጣቸው።

verses.en: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O Lord.
verses.fr: Couvre leur face d''ignominie, Afin qu''ils cherchent ton nom, ô Eternel!
verses.am: ፊታቸውን እፍረት ሙላው፥ አቤቱ፥ ስምህንም ይፈልጋሉ።

verses.en: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:
verses.fr: Qu''ils soient confus et épouvantés pour toujours, Qu''ils soient honteux et qu''ils périssent!
verses.am: ይፈሩ ለዘላለሙም ይታወኩ፤ ይጐስቍሉ ይጥፉም።

verses.en: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is Jehovah, art the most high over all the earth.
verses.fr: Qu''ils sachent que toi seul, dont le nom est l''Eternel, Tu es le Très-Haut sur toute la terre!
verses.am: ስምህም እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆነ፥ በምድር ሁሉ ላይም አንተ ብቻ ልዑል እንደ ሆንህ ይወቁ።

verses.en: How amiable are thy tabernacles, O Lord of hosts!
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Sur la guitthith. Des fils de Koré. Psaume. Que tes demeures sont aimables, Eternel des armées!
verses.am: የሠራዊት አምላክ ሆይ፥ ማደሪያዎችህ እንደምን የተወደዱ ናቸው!

verses.en: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the Lord: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.
verses.fr: Mon âme soupire et languit après les parvis de l''Eternel, Mon coeur et ma chair poussent des cris vers le Dieu vivant.
verses.am: ነፍሴ የእግዚአብሔርን አደባባዮች ትወድዳለች ትናፍቅማለች፤ ልቤም ሥጋዬም በሕያው አምላክ ደስ ተሰኘ።

verses.en: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even thine altars, O Lord of hosts, my King, and my God.
verses.fr: Le passereau même trouve une maison, Et l''hirondelle un nid où elle dépose ses petits... Tes autels, Eternel des armées! Mon roi et mon Dieu!
verses.am: ወፍ ለእርስዋ ቤትን አገኘች፥ ዋኖስም ጫጩቶችዋን የምታኖርበት ቤት አገኘች፤ የሠራዊት አምላክ ንጉሤም አምላኬም ሆይ፥ እርሱ መሠዊያህ ነው።

verses.en: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.
verses.fr: Heureux ceux qui habitent ta maison! Ils peuvent te célébrer encore. Pause.
verses.am: በቤትህ የሚኖሩ ሁሉ የተመሰገኑ ናቸው፤ ለዓለምና ለዘላለምም ያመሰግኑሃል።

verses.en: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them.
verses.fr: Heureux ceux qui placent en toi leur appui! Ils trouvent dans leur coeur des chemins tout tracés.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እርዳታው ከአንተ ዘንድ የሆነለት፥ በልቡም የላይኛውን መንገድ የሚያስብ ሰው ምስጉን ነው።

verses.en: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils traversent la vallée de Baca, Ils la transforment en un lieu plein de sources, Et la pluie la couvre aussi de bénédictions.
verses.am: በልቅሶ ሸለቆ ውስጥ በወሰነው ስፍራ የሕግ መምህር በረከትን ይሰጣልና።

verses.en: They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Zion appeareth before God.
verses.fr: Leur force augmente pendant la marche, Et ils se présentent devant Dieu à Sion.
verses.am: ከኃይል ወደ ኃይል ይሄዳሉ፤ የአማልክት አምላክ በጽዮን ይታያል።

verses.en: O Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.
verses.fr: Eternel, Dieu des armées, écoute ma prière! Prête l''oreille, Dieu de Jacob! Pause.
verses.am: የሠራዊት አምላክ አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴን ስማ፤ የያዕቆብ አምላክ ሆይ፥ አድምጥ።

verses.en: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.
verses.fr: Toi qui es notre bouclier, vois, ô Dieu! Et regarde la face de ton oint!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ መታመናችንን እይልን፥ ወደ ቀባኸውም ፊት ተመልከት።

verses.en: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
verses.fr: Mieux vaut un jour dans tes parvis que mille ailleurs; Je préfère me tenir sur le seuil de la maison de mon Dieu, Plutôt que d''habiter sous les tentes de la méchanceté.
verses.am: ከአእላፍ ይልቅ በአደባባዮችህ አንዲት ቀን ትሻላለች፤ በኃጥኣን ድንኳኖች ከመቀመጥ ይልቅ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት እጣል ዘንድ መረጥሁ።

verses.en: For the Lord God is a sun and shield: the Lord will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel Dieu est un soleil et un bouclier, L''Eternel donne la grâce et la gloire, Il ne refuse aucun bien à ceux qui marchent dans l''intégrité.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ምሕረትንና እውነትን ስለ ወደደ፥ ሞገስንና ክብርን ይሰጣል፤ እግዚአብሔር በቅንነት የሚሄዱትን ከመልካም ነገር አያሳጣቸውም።

verses.en: O Lord of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.
verses.fr: Eternel des armées! Heureux l''homme qui se confie en toi!
verses.am: የሠራዊት አምላክ ሆይ፥ በአንተ የታመነ ሰው ምስጉን ነው።

verses.en: Lord, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Des fils de Koré. Psaume. Tu as été favorable à ton pays, ô Eternel! Tu as ramené les captifs de Jacob;
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ለምድርህ ሞገስን አደረግህ፥ የያዕቆብንም ምርኮ መለስህ።

verses.en: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.
verses.fr: Tu as pardonné l''iniquité de ton peuple, Tu as couvert tous ses péchés; Pause.
verses.am: የሕዝብህን ኃጢአት አስቀረህ፥ አበሳቸውንም ሁሉ ከደንህ።

verses.en: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.
verses.fr: Tu as retiré toute ta fureur, Tu es revenu de l''ardeur de ta colère.
verses.am: መዓትህንም ሁሉ አስወገድህ፤ ከቍጣህ መቅሠፍት ተመለስህ።

verses.en: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.
verses.fr: Rétablis-nous, Dieu de notre salut! Cesse ton indignation contre nous!
verses.am: የመድኃኒታችን አምላክ ሆይ፥ መልሰን፥ ቍጣህንም ከእኛ መልስ።

verses.en: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?
verses.fr: T''irriteras-tu contre nous à jamais? Prolongeras-tu ta colère éternellement?
verses.am: በውኑ ለዘላለም ትቈጣናለህን? ቍጣህንስ ለልጅ ልጅ ታስረዝማለህን?

verses.en: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
verses.fr: Ne nous rendras-tu pas à la vie, Afin que ton peuple se réjouisse en toi?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ትመለሳለህ ታድነንማለህ፤ ሕዝቡም በአንተ ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: Shew us thy mercy, O Lord, and grant us thy salvation.
verses.fr: Eternel! fais-nous voir ta bonté, Et accorde-nous ton salut!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህን አሳየን፥ አቤቱ፥ መድኃኒትህንም ስጠን።

verses.en: I will hear what God the Lord will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
verses.fr: J''écouterai ce que dit Dieu, l''Eternel; Car il parle de paix à son peuple et à ses fidèles, Pourvu qu''ils ne retombent pas dans la folie.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላክ የሚናገረውን እሰማለሁ፤ ሰላምን ለሕዝቡና ለቅዱሳኑ ልባቸውንም ወደ እርሱ ለሚመልሱ ይናገራልና።

verses.en: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.
verses.fr: Oui, son salut est près de ceux qui le craignent, Afin que la gloire habite dans notre pays.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ክብር በምድራችን ያድር ዘንድ ማዳኑ ለሚፈሩት ቅርብ ነው፤

verses.en: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
verses.fr: La bonté et la fidélité se rencontrent, La justice et la paix s''embrassent;
verses.am: ምሕረትና እውነት ተገናኙ፤ ጽድቅና ሰላም ተስማሙ።

verses.en: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.
verses.fr: La fidélité germe de la terre, Et la justice regarde du haut des cieux.
verses.am: እውነት ከምድር በቀለች፥ ጽድቅም ከሰማይ ተመለከተች።

verses.en: Yea, the Lord shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.
verses.fr: L''Eternel aussi accordera le bonheur, Et notre terre donnera ses fruits.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በጎ ነገርን ይሰጣል፥ ምድራችንም ፍሬዋን ትሰጣለች።

verses.en: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.
verses.fr: La justice marchera devant lui, Et imprimera ses pas sur le chemin.
verses.am: ጽድቅ በፊቱ ይሄዳል፥ ፍለጋውንም በመንገድ ውስጥ ያኖራል።

verses.en: Bow down thine ear, O Lord, hear me: for I am poor and needy.
verses.fr: Prière de David. Eternel, prête l''oreille, exauce-moi! Car je suis malheureux et indigent.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጆሮህን ወደ እኔ አዘንብል አድምጠኝም፥ ችግረኛና ምስኪን ነኝና።

verses.en: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.
verses.fr: Garde mon âme, car je suis pieux! Mon Dieu, sauve ton serviteur qui se confie en toi!
verses.am: ቅዱስ ነኝና ነፍሴን ጠብቅ፤ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ አንተን የታመነውን ባሪያህን አድነው።

verses.en: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.
verses.fr: Aie pitié de moi, Seigneur! Car je crie à toi tout le jour.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ቀኑን ሁሉ ወደ አንተ እጮኻለሁና ማረኝ።

verses.en: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
verses.fr: Réjouis l''âme de ton serviteur, Car à toi, Seigneur, j''élève mon âme.
verses.am: የባሪያህን ነፍስ ደስ አሰኛት፥ አቤቱ፥ ነፍሴን ወደ አንተ አነሣለሁና።

verses.en: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.
verses.fr: Car tu es bon, Seigneur, tu pardonnes, Tu es plein d''amour pour tous ceux qui t''invoquent.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ መሓሪና ይቅር ባይ ነህና፥ ምሕረትህም ለሚጠሩህ ሁሉ ብዙ ነውና።

verses.en: Give ear, O Lord, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.
verses.fr: Eternel, prête l''oreille à ma prière, Sois attentif à la voix de mes supplications!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴን አድምጥ፥ የልመናዬንም ድምፅ ስማ።

verses.en: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.
verses.fr: Je t''invoque au jour de ma détresse, Car tu m''exauces.
verses.am: ትመልስልኛለህና በመከራዬ ቀን ወደ አንተ እጠራለሁ።

verses.en: Among the gods there is none like unto thee, O Lord; neither are there any works like unto thy works.
verses.fr: Nul n''est comme toi parmi les dieux, Seigneur, Et rien ne ressemble à tes oeuvres.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ከአማልክት የሚመስልህ የለም፥ እንደ ሥራህም ያለ የለም።

verses.en: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.
verses.fr: Toutes les nations que tu as faites viendront Se prosterner devant ta face, Seigneur, Et rendre gloire à ton nom.
verses.am: ያደረግሃቸው አሕዛብ ሁሉ ይመጣሉ፥ አቤቱ፥ በፊትህም ይሰግዳሉ፥ ስምህንም ያከብራሉ፤

verses.en: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art God alone.
verses.fr: Car tu es grand, et tu opères des prodiges; Toi seul, tu es Dieu.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ድንቅ የምታደርግ አንተ ታላቅ ነህና፥ አንተም ብቻህን ታላቅ አምላክ ነህና።

verses.en: Teach me thy way, O Lord; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.
verses.fr: Enseigne-moi tes voies, ô Eternel! Je marcherai dans ta fidélité. Dispose mon coeur à la crainte de ton nom.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ መንገድህን ምራኝ፥ በእውነትህም እሄዳለሁ፤ ስምህን ለመፍራት ልቤ ደስ ይለዋል።

verses.en: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.
verses.fr: Je te louerai de tout mon coeur, Seigneur, mon Dieu! Et je glorifierai ton nom à perpétuité.
verses.am: አቤቱ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ በልቤ ሁሉ አመሰግንሃለሁ፥ ለዘላለምም ስምህን አከብራለሁ፤

verses.en: For great is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.
verses.fr: Car ta bonté est grande envers moi, Et tu délivres mon âme du séjour profond des morts.
verses.am: ምሕረትህ በእኔ ላይ ታላቅ ናትና፥ ነፍሴንም ከታችኛይቱ ሲኦል አድነሃታልና።

verses.en: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.
verses.fr: O Dieu! des orgueilleux se sont levés contre moi, Une troupe d''hommes violents en veulent à ma vie; Ils ne portent pas leurs pensées sur toi.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ዓመፀኞች በእኔ ላይ ተነሥተዋል፥ የክፉዎችንም ማኅበር ነፍሴን ፈለጉአት፤ በፊታቸውም አላደረጉህም።

verses.en: But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, long suffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
verses.fr: Mais toi, Seigneur, tu es un Dieu miséricordieux et compatissant, Lent à la colère, riche en bonté et en fidélité;
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ግን መሓሪና ርኅሩኅ አምላክ ነህ፤ መዓትህ የራቀ ምሕረትህም እውነትህም የበዛ፤

verses.en: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.
verses.fr: Tourne vers moi les regards et aie pitié de moi, Donne la force à ton serviteur, Et sauve le fils de ta servante!
verses.am: ወደ እኔ ተመልከት ማረኝም፤ ለባሪያህ ኃይልህን ስጥ፥ የሴት ባሪያህንም ልጅ አድን።

verses.en: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because thou, Lord, hast holpen me, and comforted me.
verses.fr: Opère un signe en ma faveur! Que mes ennemis le voient et soient confus! Car tu me secours et tu me consoles, ô Eternel!
verses.am: ምልክትንም ለመልካም ከእኔ ጋር አድርግ፤ የሚጠሉኝ ይዩ ይፈሩም፥ አቤቱ፥ አንተ ረድተኸኛልና፥ አጽንተኸኛልምና።

verses.en: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
verses.fr: Des fils de Koré. Psaume. Cantique. Elle est fondée sur les montagnes saintes.
verses.am: መሠረቶቹ በተቀደሱ ተራሮች ናቸው፤

verses.en: The Lord loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
verses.fr: L''Eternel aime les portes de Sion Plus que toutes les demeures de Jacob.
verses.am: ከያዕቆብ ድንኳኖች ይልቅ፥ እግዚአብሔር የጽዮንን ደጆች ይወድዳቸዋል።

verses.en: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.
verses.fr: Des choses glorieuses ont été dites sur toi, Ville de Dieu! Pause.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ከተማ ሆይ፥ በአንቺ የተከበረ ነገር ይባላል።

verses.en: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.
verses.fr: Je proclame l''Egypte et Babylone parmi ceux qui me connaissent; Voici, le pays des Philistins, Tyr, avec l''Ethiopie: C''est dans Sion qu''ils sont nés.
verses.am: የሚያውቁኝን ረዓብንና ባቢሎንን አስባቸዋለሁ፤ እነሆ፥ ፍልስጥኤማውያን ጢሮስም የኢትዮጵያም ሕዝብ፥ እነዚህ በዚያ ተወለዱ።

verses.en: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.
verses.fr: Et de Sion il est dit: Tous y sont nés, Et c''est le Très-Haut qui l''affermit.
verses.am: ሰው እናታችን ጽዮን ይላል፥ በውስጥዋም ሰው ተወለደ፤ እርሱ ራሱም ልዑል መሠረታት።

verses.en: The Lord shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.
verses.fr: L''Eternel compte en inscrivant les peuples: C''est là qu''ils sont nés. Pause.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቡ፥ በውስጥዋም ለተወለዱት አለቆችዋ በመጽሐፍ ይነግራቸዋል።

verses.en: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.
verses.fr: Et ceux qui chantent et ceux qui dansent s''écrient: Toutes mes sources sont en toi.
verses.am: በአንቺ የሚኖሩ ሁሉ ደስ እንደሚላቸው ይነግራቸዋል።

verses.en: O lord God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:
verses.fr: Cantique. Psaume des fils de Koré. Au chef des chantres. Pour chanter sur la flûte. Cantique d''Héman, l''Ezrachite. Eternel, Dieu de mon salut! Je crie jour et nuit devant toi.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የመድኃኒቴ አምላክ፥ በቀንና በሌሊት በፊትህ ጮኽሁ፤

verses.en: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;
verses.fr: Que ma prière parvienne en ta présence! Prête l''oreille à mes supplications!
verses.am: ጸሎቴ ወደ ፊትህ ትግባ፥ ጆሮህንም ወደ ጩኸቴ አዘንብል፤

verses.en: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.
verses.fr: Car mon âme est rassasiée de maux, Et ma vie s''approche du séjour des morts.
verses.am: ነፍሴ መከራን ጠግባለችና፥ ሕይወቴም ወደ ሲኦል ቀርባለችና።

verses.en: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:
verses.fr: Je suis mis au rang de ceux qui descendent dans la fosse, Je suis comme un homme qui n''a plus de force.
verses.am: ወደ ጓድጓድ ከሚወርዱ ጋር ተቈጠርሁ፥ ረዳትም እንደሌለው ሰው ሆንሁ።

verses.en: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.
verses.fr: Je suis étendu parmi les morts, Semblable à ceux qui sont tués et couchés dans le sépulcre, A ceux dont tu n''as plus le souvenir, Et qui sont séparés de ta main.
verses.am: ለዘላለም እንደማታስባቸው፥ እንደ ተገደሉና በመቃብር ውስጥ እንደ ተጣሉ፥ በሙታን ውስጥ እንዳሉ የተጣልሁ ሆንሁ፤ እነርሱም ከእጅህ ተለዩ።

verses.en: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.
verses.fr: Tu m''as jeté dans une fosse profonde, Dans les ténèbres, dans les abîmes.
verses.am: በጨለማና በሞት ጥላ ውስጥ፥ በታችኛው ጕድጓድ አስቀመጥኸኝ።

verses.en: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.
verses.fr: Ta fureur s''appesantit sur moi, Et tu m''accables de tous tes flots. Pause.
verses.am: በእኔ ላይ ቍጣህ ጸና፥ መቅሠፍትህን ሁሉ በእኔ ላይ አመጣህ።

verses.en: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
verses.fr: Tu as éloigné de moi mes amis, Tu m''as rendu pour eux un objet d''horreur; Je suis enfermé et je ne puis sortir.
verses.am: የሚያውቁኝን ከእኔ አራቅህ፤ በእነርሱ ዘንድ ርኵስ አደረግኸኝ፤ ያዙኝ፥ መውጫም የለኝም።

verses.en: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: Lord, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.
verses.fr: Mes yeux se consument dans la souffrance; Je t''invoque tous les jours, ô Eternel! J''étends vers toi les mains.
verses.am: ዓይኖቼም በመከራ ፈዘዙ፤ አቤቱ፥ ሁልጊዜ ወደ አንተ ጮኽሁ፥ እጆቼንም ወደ አንተ ዘረጋሁ፥

verses.en: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.
verses.fr: Est-ce pour les morts que tu fais des miracles? Les morts se lèvent-ils pour te louer? Pause.
verses.am: በውኑ ለሙታን ተኣምራት ታደርጋለህን? የሞቱትስ ተነሥተው ያመሰግኑሃልን?

verses.en: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or thy faithfulness in destruction?
verses.fr: Parle-t-on de ta bonté dans le sépulcre, De ta fidélité dans l''abîme?
verses.am: በመቃብርስ ውስጥ ቸርነትህን፥ እውነትህንስ በጥፋት ስፍራ ይናገራሉን?

verses.en: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
verses.fr: Tes prodiges sont-ils connus dans les ténèbres, Et ta justice dans la terre de l''oubli?
verses.am: ተአምራትህ በጨለማ፥ ጽድቅህንም በመርሳት ምድር ትታወቃለችን?

verses.en: But unto thee have I cried, O Lord; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.
verses.fr: O Eternel! j''implore ton secours, Et le matin ma prière s''élève à toi.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እኔ ግን ወደ አንተ ጮኽሁ፤ በጥዋት ጸሎቴ ወደ ፊትህ ትደርሳለች።

verses.en: Lord, why castest thou off my soul? why hidest thou thy face from me?
verses.fr: Pourquoi, Eternel, repousses-tu mon âme? Pourquoi me caches-tu ta face?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ነፍሴን ለምን ትጥላለህ? ፊትህንስ ከእኔ ለምን ትሰውራለህ?

verses.en: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.
verses.fr: Je suis malheureux et moribond dès ma jeunesse, Je suis chargé de tes terreurs, je suis troublé.
verses.am: እኔ ከታናሽነቴ ችግረኛ ለሞትም የቀረብሁ ነኝ፤ ከፍ ከፍ ካልሁ በኋላ ግን ተዋረድሁ ተናቅሁም።

verses.en: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.
verses.fr: Tes fureurs passent sur moi, Tes terreurs m''anéantissent;
verses.am: መቅሠፍትህ በላዬ አለፈ፥ ግርማህም አስደነገጠኝ።

verses.en: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.
verses.fr: Elles m''environnent tout le jour comme des eaux, Elles m''enveloppent toutes à la fois.
verses.am: ሁልጊዜ እንደ ውኃ ከበቡኝ፥ በአንድነትም ያዙኝ።

verses.en: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.
verses.fr: Tu as éloigné de moi amis et compagnons; Mes intimes ont disparu.
verses.am: ወዳጄንና ባልንጀራዬን ዘመዶቼንም ከመከራ የተነሣ ከእኔ አራቅህ።

verses.en: I will sing of the mercies of the Lord for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
verses.fr: Cantique d''Ethan, l''Ezrachite. Je chanterai toujours les bontés de l''Eternel; Ma bouche fera connaître à jamais ta fidélité.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህን ለዘላለም እዘምራለሁ፥ እውነትህንም በአፌ ለልጅ ልጅ እናገራለሁ።

verses.en: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.
verses.fr: Car je dis: La bonté a des fondements éternels; Tu établis ta fidélité dans les cieux.
verses.am: እንዲህ ብለሃልና። ምሕረት ለዘላለም ይመሠረታል፥ እውነትህም በሰማይ ይጸናል።

verses.en: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,
verses.fr: J''ai fait alliance avec mon élu; Voici ce que j''ai juré à David, mon serviteur:
verses.am: ከመረጥሁት ጋር ቃል ኪዳኔን አደረግሁ፥ ለባሪያዬም ለዳዊት ማልሁ።

verses.en: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.
verses.fr: J''affermirai ta postérité pour toujours, Et j''établirai ton trône à perpétuité. Pause.
verses.am: ዘርህን ለዘላለም አዘጋጃለሁ፥ ዙፋንህንም ለልጅ ልጅ እመሠርታለሁ።

verses.en: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O Lord: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.
verses.fr: Les cieux célèbrent tes merveilles, ô Eternel! Et ta fidélité dans l''assemblée des saints.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ሰማያት ተኣምራትህን እውነትህንም ደግሞ በቅዱሳን ማኅበር ያመሰግናሉ።

verses.en: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the Lord? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the Lord?
verses.fr: Car qui, dans le ciel, peut se comparer à l''Eternel? Qui est semblable à toi parmi les fils de Dieu?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን በሰማይ የሚተካከለው ማን ነው? ከአማልክትስ ልጆች እግዚአብሔርን ማን ይመስለዋል?

verses.en: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.
verses.fr: Dieu est terrible dans la grande assemblée des saints, Il est redoutable pour tous ceux qui l''entourent.
verses.am: በቅዱሳን ምክር እግዚአብሔር ክቡር ነው፤ በዙሪያው ባሉት ሁሉ ላይ ታላቅና ግሩም ነው።

verses.en: O Lord God of hosts, who is a strong Lord like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?
verses.fr: Eternel, Dieu des armées! qui est comme toi puissant, ô Eternel? Ta fidélité t''environne.
verses.am: አቤቱ የሠራዊት አምላክ፥ እንደ አንተ ያለ ማን ነው? አቤቱ፥ አንተ ብርቱ ነህ፥ እውነትህም ይከብብሃል።

verses.en: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.
verses.fr: Tu domptes l''orgueil de la mer; Quand ses flots se soulèvent, tu les apaises.
verses.am: የባሕርን ኃይል አንተ ትገዛለህ፥ የሞገዱንም መናወጥ አንተ ዝም ታሰኘዋለህ።

verses.en: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.
verses.fr: Tu écrasas l''Egypte comme un cadavre, Tu dispersas tes ennemis par la puissance de ton bras.
verses.am: አንተ ረዓብን እንደ ተገደለ አዋረድኸው፥ በኃይልህም ክንድ ጠላቶችህን በተንሃቸው።

verses.en: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.
verses.fr: C''est à toi qu''appartiennent les cieux et la terre, C''est toi qui as fondé le monde et ce qu''il renferme.
verses.am: ሰማያት የአንተ ናቸው፥ ምድርም የአንተ ናት፤ ዓለምንና ሞላውም አንተ መሠረትህ።

verses.en: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.
verses.fr: Tu as créé le nord et le midi; Le Thabor et l''Hermon se réjouissent à ton nom.
verses.am: ሰሜንና ደቡብን አንተ ፈጠርህ፤ ታቦርና አርሞንዔም በስምህ ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.
verses.fr: Ton bras est puissant, Ta main forte, ta droite élevée.
verses.am: ክንድህ ከኃይልህ ጋር ነው፤ እጅህ በረታች ቀኝህም ከፍ ከፍ አለች።

verses.en: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.
verses.fr: La justice et l''équité sont la base de ton trône. La bonté et la fidélité sont devant ta face.
verses.am: የዙፋንህ መሠረት ጽድቅና ፍርድ ነው፤ ምሕረትና እውነት በፊትህ ይሄዳሉ።

verses.en: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O Lord, in the light of thy countenance.
verses.fr: Heureux le peuple qui connaît le son de la trompette; Il marche à la clarté de ta face, ô Eternel!
verses.am: እልልታ የሚያውቅ ሕዝብ ምስጉን ነው፤ አቤቱ፥ በፊትህ ብርሃን ይሄዳሉ።

verses.en: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.
verses.fr: Il se réjouit sans cesse de ton nom, Et il se glorifie de ta justice.
verses.am: በስምህ ቀኑን ሁሉ ደስ ይላቸዋል፥ በጽድቅህም ከፍ ከፍ ይላሉ፤

verses.en: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.
verses.fr: Car tu es la gloire de sa puissance; C''est ta faveur qui relève notre force.
verses.am: የኃይላቸው ትምክሕት አንተ ነህና፥ በሞገስህም ቀንዳችን ከፍ ከፍ ይላልና።

verses.en: For the Lord is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel est notre bouclier, Le Saint d''Israël est notre roi.
verses.am: ረድኤታችን ከእግዚአብሔር ከንጉሣችንም ከእስራኤል ቅዱስ ነውና።

verses.en: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.
verses.fr: Alors tu parlas dans une vision à ton bien-aimé, Et tu dis: J''ai prêté mon secours à un héros, J''ai élevé du milieu du peuple un jeune homme;
verses.am: በዚያ ጊዜ ለልጆችህ በራእይ ተናገርህ እንዲህም አልህ። ረድኤቴን በኃይል ላይ አኖርሁ፤ ከሕዝቤ የተመረጠውን ከፍ ከፍ አደረግሁ።

verses.en: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:
verses.fr: J''ai trouvé David, mon serviteur, Je l''ai oint de mon huile sainte.
verses.am: ባሪያዬን ዳዊትን አገኘሁት፥ ቅዱስ ዘይትም ቀባሁት።

verses.en: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.
verses.fr: Ma main le soutiendra, Et mon bras le fortifiera.
verses.am: እጄም ትረዳዋለች፥ ክንዴም ታጸናዋለች።

verses.en: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
verses.fr: L''ennemi ne le surprendra pas, Et le méchant ne l''opprimera point;
verses.am: ጠላት በእርሱ ላይ አይጠቀምም፥ የዓመፃ ልጅም መከራ አይጨምርበትም።

verses.en: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.
verses.fr: J''écraserai devant lui ses adversaires, Et je frapperai ceux qui le haïssent.
verses.am: ጠላቶቹን ከፊቱ አጠፋለሁ፥ የሚጠሉትንም አዋርዳቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.
verses.fr: Ma fidélité et ma bonté seront avec lui, Et sa force s''élèvera par mon nom.
verses.am: እውነቴና ምሕረቴም ከእርሱ ጋር ነው፥ በስሜም ቀንዱ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል።

verses.en: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.
verses.fr: Je mettrai sa main sur la mer, Et sa droite sur les fleuves.
verses.am: እጁን በባሕር ላይ ቀኙንም በወንዞች ላይ አኖራለሁ።

verses.en: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.
verses.fr: Lui, il m''invoquera: Tu es mon père, Mon Dieu et le rocher de mon salut!
verses.am: እርሱ። አባቴ አንተ ነህ፥ አምላኬ የመድኃኒቴም መጠጊያ ይላል።

verses.en: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.
verses.fr: Et moi, je ferai de lui le premier-né, Le plus élevé des rois de la terre.
verses.am: እኔም ደግሞ በኵሬ አደርገዋለሁ፥ ከምድር ነገሥታትም ከፍ ይላል።

verses.en: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.
verses.fr: Je lui conserverai toujours ma bonté, Et mon alliance lui sera fidèle;
verses.am: ለዘላለምም ምሕረቴን ለእርሱ እጠብቃለሁ፥ ኪዳኔም በእርሱ ዘንድ የታመነ ነው።

verses.en: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
verses.fr: Je rendrai sa postérité éternelle, Et son trône comme les jours des cieux.
verses.am: ዘሩንም ለዓለምና ለዘላለም፥ ዙፋኑንም እንደ ሰማይ ዘመን አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;
verses.fr: Si ses fils abandonnent ma loi Et ne marchent pas selon ses ordonnances,
verses.am: ልጆቹ ግን ሕጌን ቢተዉ፥ በፍርዴም ባይሄዱ፤

verses.en: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;
verses.fr: S''ils violent mes préceptes Et n''observent pas mes commandements,
verses.am: ሥርዓቴንም ቢያረክሱ፥ ትእዛዜንም ባይጠብቁ፤

verses.en: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
verses.fr: Je punirai de la verge leurs transgressions, Et par des coups leurs iniquités;
verses.am: ኃጢአታቸውን በበትር፥ በደላቸውንም በመቅሠፍት እጐበኛታለሁ።

verses.en: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
verses.fr: Mais je ne lui retirerai point ma bonté Et je ne trahirai pas ma fidélité,
verses.am: ምሕረቴን ግን ከእርሱ አላርቅም፥ በእውነቴም አልበድልም፤

verses.en: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.
verses.fr: Je ne violerai point mon alliance Et je ne changerai pas ce qui est sorti de mes lèvres.
verses.am: ኪዳኔንም አላረክስም፥ ከከንፈሬም የወጣውን አልለውጥም።

verses.en: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.
verses.fr: J''ai juré une fois par ma sainteté: Mentirai-je à David?
verses.am: ዳዊትን እንዳልዋሸው አንድ ጊዜ በቅዱስነቴ ማልሁ።

verses.en: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.
verses.fr: Sa postérité subsistera toujours; Son trône sera devant moi comme le soleil,
verses.am: ዘሩ ለዘላለም፥ ዙፋኑም በፊቴ እንደ ፀሐይ ይኖራል።

verses.en: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.
verses.fr: Comme la lune il aura une éternelle durée. Le témoin qui est dans le ciel est fidèle. Pause.
verses.am: ለዘላለም እንደ ጨረቃ ይጸናል፤ ምስክርነቱ በሰማይ የታመን ነው።

verses.en: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.
verses.fr: Et pourtant, tu as rejeté, tu as repoussé! Tu t''es irrité contre ton oint!
verses.am: አንተ ግን ናቅኸው ጣልኸውም፥ የቀባኸውንም ጣልኸው።

verses.en: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.
verses.fr: Tu as dédaigné l''alliance avec ton serviteur; Tu as abattu, profané sa couronne.
verses.am: የባሪያህንም ኪዳን አፈረስህ፥ መቅደሱንም በምድር አረከስህ።

verses.en: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.
verses.fr: Tu as détruit toutes ses murailles, Tu as mis en ruines ses forteresses.
verses.am: ቅጥሩን ሁሉ ጣልህ፥ አምባዎቹንም አጠፋህ።

verses.en: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.
verses.fr: Tous les passants le dépouillent; Il est un objet d''opprobre pour ses voisins.
verses.am: መንገድ አላፊም ሁሉ ተናጠቀው፥ ለጎረቤቶቹም ስድብ ሆነ።

verses.en: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
verses.fr: Tu as élevé la droite de ses adversaires, Tu as réjoui tous ses ennemis;
verses.am: የጠላቶቹንም ቀኝ ከፍ ከፍ አደረግህ፥ ጠላቶቹንም ሁሉ ደስ አሰኘህ።

verses.en: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.
verses.fr: Tu as fait reculer le tranchant de son glaive, Et tu ne l''as pas soutenu dans le combat.
verses.am: የሰይፉንም ረድኤት መለስህ፥ በሰልፍም ውስጥ አልደገፍኸውም።

verses.en: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.
verses.fr: Tu as mis un terme à sa splendeur, Et tu as jeté son trône à terre;
verses.am: ከንጽሕናውም ሻርኸው፥ ዙፋኑንም በምድር ጣልህ።

verses.en: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.
verses.fr: Tu as abrégé les jours de sa jeunesse, Tu l''as couvert de honte. Pause.
verses.am: የዙፋኑንም ዘመን አሳነስህ፥ በእፍረትም ሸፈንኸው።

verses.en: How long, Lord? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?
verses.fr: Jusques à quand, Eternel! te cacheras-tu sans cesse, Et ta fureur s''embrasera-t-elle comme le feu?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እስከ መቼ ለዘላለም ፊትህን ትመልሳለህ? እስከ መቼስ ቍጣህ እንደ እሳት ይነድዳል?

verses.en: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?
verses.fr: Rappelle-toi ce qu''est la durée de ma vie, Et pour quel néant tu as créé tous les fils de l''homme.
verses.am: ችሎታዬ ምን እንደ ሆነ አስብ፤ በውኑ የሰውን ልጅ ሁሉ ለከንቱ ፈጠርኸውን?

verses.en: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.
verses.fr: Y a-t-il un homme qui puisse vivre et ne pas voir la mort, Qui puisse sauver son âme du séjour des morts? Pause.
verses.am: ሕያው ሆኖ የሚኖር፥ ሞትንስ የማያይ ማን ነው? ነፍሱንስ ከሲኦል እጅ የሚያድን ማን ነው?

verses.en: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?
verses.fr: Où sont, Seigneur! tes bontés premières, Que tu juras à David dans ta fidélité?
verses.am: ለዳዊት በእውነት የማልህ፥ አቤቱ፥ የቀድሞ ምሕረትህ ወዴት ነው?

verses.en: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;
verses.fr: Souviens-toi, Seigneur! de l''opprobre de tes serviteurs, Souviens-toi que je porte en mon sein tous les peuples nombreux;
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የባሪያዎችህን ስድብ፥ በብብቴ ብዙ አሕዛብን የተቀበልሁትን፥

verses.en: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O Lord; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
verses.fr: Souviens-toi des outrages de tes ennemis, ô Eternel! De leurs outrages contre les pas de ton oint.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጠላቶችህን የሰደቡትን የቀባኸውን ዘመን የሰደቡትን አስብ።

verses.en: Blessed be the Lord for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
verses.fr: Béni soit à jamais l''Eternel! Amen! Amen!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም ይባረክ። ይሁን ይሁን።

verses.en: Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.
verses.fr: Prière de Moïse, homme de Dieu. Seigneur! tu as été pour nous un refuge, De génération en génération.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ለትውልድ ሁሉ መጠጊያ ሆንህልን።

verses.en: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.
verses.fr: Avant que les montagnes fussent nées, Et que tu eusses créé la terre et le monde, D''éternité en éternité tu es Dieu.
verses.am: ተራሮች ሳይወለዱ፥ ምድርም ዓለምም ሳይሠሩ፥ ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ አንተ ነህ።

verses.en: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.
verses.fr: Tu fais rentrer les hommes dans la poussière, Et tu dis: Fils de l''homme, retournez!
verses.am: ሰውን ወደ ኅሳር አትመልስም፤ የሰው ልጆች ሆይ፥ ተመለሱ ትላለህ፤

verses.en: For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.
verses.fr: Car mille ans sont, à tes yeux, Comme le jour d''hier, quand il n''est plus, Et comme une veille de la nuit.
verses.am: ሺህ ዓመት በፊትህ እንዳለፈች እንደ ትናንት ቀን፥ እንደ ሌሊትም ትጋት ነውና።

verses.en: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in the morning they are like grass which groweth up.
verses.fr: Tu les emportes, semblables à un songe, Qui, le matin, passe comme l''herbe:
verses.am: ዘመኖች የተናቁ ይሆናሉ፥ በማለዳም እንደ ሣር ያልፋል።

verses.en: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
verses.fr: Elle fleurit le matin, et elle passe, On la coupe le soir, et elle sèche.
verses.am: ማልዶ ያብባል ያልፋልም፥ በሠርክም ጠውልጎና ደርቆ ይወድቃል።

verses.en: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.
verses.fr: Nous sommes consumés par ta colère, Et ta fureur nous épouvante.
verses.am: እኛ በቍጣህ አልቀናልና፥ በመዓትህም ደንግጠናልና።

verses.en: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.
verses.fr: Tu mets devant toi nos iniquités, Et à la lumière de ta face nos fautes cachées.
verses.am: የተሰወረውን ኃጢአታችንን በፊትህ ብርሃን፥ በደላችንንም በፊትህ አስቀመጥህ።

verses.en: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale that is told.
verses.fr: Tous nos jours disparaissent par ton courroux; Nous voyons nos années s''évanouir comme un son.
verses.am: ዘመናችን ሁሉ አልፎአልና፥ እኛም በመዓትህ አልቀናልና፤ ዘመኖቻችንም እንደ ሸረሪት ድር ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
verses.fr: Les jours de nos années s''élèvent à soixante-dix ans, Et, pour les plus robustes, à quatre-vingts ans; Et l''orgueil qu''ils en tirent n''est que peine et misère, Car il passe vite, et nous nous envolons.
verses.am: የዘመኖቻችንም ዕድሜ ሰባ ዓመት፥ ቢበረታም ሰማንያ ዓመት ነው፤ ቢበዛ ግን ድካምና መከራ ነው፤ ከእኛ ቶሎ ያልፋልና፥ እኛም እንገሠጻለንና።

verses.en: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, so is thy wrath.
verses.fr: Qui prend garde à la force de ta colère, Et à ton courroux, selon la crainte qui t''est due?
verses.am: የቍጣህን ጽናት ማን ያውቃል? ከቍጣህ ግርማ የተነሣ አለቁ።

verses.en: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
