verses.fr: Enseigne-nous à bien compter nos jours, Afin que nous appliquions notre coeur à la sagesse.
verses.am: በልብ ጥበብን እንድንማር፥ ቀኝህን እንዲህ አስታውቀን።

verses.en: Return, O Lord, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.
verses.fr: Reviens, Eternel! Jusques à quand?... Aie pitié de tes serviteurs!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ተመለስ፥ እስከ መቼስ ነው? ስለ ባሪያዎችህም ተምዋገት።

verses.en: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
verses.fr: Rassasie-nous chaque matin de ta bonté, Et nous serons toute notre vie dans la joie et l''allégresse.
verses.am: በማለዳ ምሕረትህን እንጠግባለን፤ በዘመናችን ሁሉ ደስ ይለናል ሐሤትም እናደርጋለን።

verses.en: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, and the years wherein we have seen evil.
verses.fr: Réjouis-nous autant de jours que tu nous as humiliés, Autant d''années que nous avons vu le malheur.
verses.am: መከራ ባሳየኸን ዘመን ፈንታ፥ ክፉም ባየንባቸው ዘመኖች ፋንታ ደስ ይለናል።

verses.en: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.
verses.fr: Que ton oeuvre se manifeste à tes serviteurs, Et ta gloire sur leurs enfants!
verses.am: ባሪያዎችህንና ሥራህን እይ፥ ልጆቻቸውንም ምራ።

verses.en: And let the beauty of the Lord our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
verses.fr: Que la grâce de l''Eternel, notre Dieu, soit sur nous! Affermis l''ouvrage de nos mains, Oui, affermis l''ouvrage de nos mains!
verses.am: የአምላካችን የእግዚአብሔር ብርሃን በላያችን ይሁን። የእጆቻችንንም ሥራ በላያችን አቅና።

verses.en: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.fr: Celui qui demeure sous l''abri du Très-Haut Repose à l''ombre du Tout Puissant.
verses.am: በልዑል መጠጊያ የሚኖር ሁሉን በሚችል አምላክ ጥላ ውስጥ ያድራል።

verses.en: I will say of the Lord, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
verses.fr: Je dis à l''Eternel: Mon refuge et ma forteresse, Mon Dieu en qui je me confie!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን። አንተ መታመኛዬ ነህ እለዋለሁ፤ አምላኬና መሸሸጊያዬ ነው፥ በእርሱም እታመናለሁ።

verses.en: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.
verses.fr: Car c''est lui qui te délivre du filet de l''oiseleur, De la peste et de ses ravages.
verses.am: እርሱ ከአዳኝ ወጥመድ ከሚያስደነግጥም ነገር ያድንሃልና።

verses.en: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
verses.fr: Il te couvrira de ses plumes, Et tu trouveras un refuge sous ses ailes; Sa fidélité est un bouclier et une cuirasse.
verses.am: በላባዎቹ ይጋርድሃል፥ በክንፎቹም በታች ትተማመናለህ፤ እውነት እንደ ጋሻ ይከብብሃል።

verses.en: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;
verses.fr: Tu ne craindras ni les terreurs de la nuit, Ni la flèche qui vole de jour,
verses.am: ከሌሊት ግርማ፥ በቀን ከሚበርር ፍላጻ፥

verses.en: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.
verses.fr: Ni la peste qui marche dans les ténèbres, Ni la contagion qui frappe en plein midi.
verses.am: በጨለማ ከሚሄድ ክፉ ነገር፥ ከአደጋና ከቀትር ጋኔን አትፈራም።

verses.en: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.
verses.fr: Que mille tombent à ton côté, Et dix mille à ta droite, Tu ne seras pas atteint;
verses.am: በአጠገብህ ሺህ በቀኝህም አሥር ሺህ ይወድቃሉ፤ ወደ አንተ ግን አይቀርብም።

verses.en: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.
verses.fr: De tes yeux seulement tu regarderas, Et tu verras la rétribution des méchants.
verses.am: በዓይኖችህ ብቻ ትመለከታለህ፥ የኃጥኣንንም ብድራት ታያለህ።

verses.en: Because thou hast made the Lord, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation;
verses.fr: Car tu es mon refuge, ô Eternel! Tu fais du Très-Haut ta retraite.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ተስፋዬ ነህና፤ ልዑልን መጠጊያህ አደረግህ።

verses.en: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.
verses.fr: Aucun malheur ne t''arrivera, Aucun fléau n''approchera de ta tente.
verses.am: ክፉ ነገር ወደ አንተ አይቀርብም፥ መቅሠፍትም ወደ ቤትህ አይገባም።

verses.en: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
verses.fr: Car il ordonnera à ses anges De te garder dans toutes tes voies;
verses.am: በመንገድህ ሁሉ ይጠብቁህ ዘንድ መላእክቱን ስለ አንተ ያዝዛቸዋልና፤

verses.en: They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.fr: Ils te porteront sur les mains, De peur que ton pied ne heurte contre une pierre.
verses.am: እግርህም በድንጋይ እንዳትሰናከል በእጆቻቸው ያነሡሃል።

verses.en: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.
verses.fr: Tu marcheras sur le lion et sur l''aspic, Tu fouleras le lionceau et le dragon.
verses.am: በተኵላና በእባብ ላይ ትጫማለህ፤ አንበሳውንና ዘንዶውን ትረግጣለህ።

verses.en: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.
verses.fr: Puisqu''il m''aime, je le délivrerai; Je le protégerai, puisqu''il connaît mon nom.
verses.am: በእኔ ተማምኖአልና አስጥለዋለሁ፤ ስሜንም አውቆአልና እጋርደዋለሁ።

verses.en: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.
verses.fr: Il m''invoquera, et je lui répondrai; Je serai avec lui dans la détresse, Je le délivrerai et je le glorifierai.
verses.am: ይጠራኛል እመልስለትማለሁ፥ በመከራውም ጊዜ ከእርሱ ጋራ እሆናለሁ፤ አድነዋለሁ አከብረውማለሁ።

verses.en: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.
verses.fr: Je le rassasierai de longs jours, Et je lui ferai voir mon salut.
verses.am: ረጅምን ዕድሜ አጠግበዋለሁ፥ ማዳኔንም አሳየዋለሁ።

verses.en: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the Lord, and to sing praises unto thy name, O Most High:
verses.fr: Psaume. Cantique pour le jour du sabbat. Il est beau de louer l''Eternel, Et de célébrer ton nom, ô Très-Haut!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ማመስገን መልካም ነው፥ ልዑል ሆይ፥ ለስምህም ዝማሬ ማቅረብ፤

verses.en: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,
verses.fr: D''annoncer le matin ta bonté, Et ta fidélité pendant les nuits,
verses.am: በማለዳ ምሕረትን፥ በሌሊትም እውነትህን ማውራት

verses.en: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.
verses.fr: Sur l''instrument à dix cordes et sur le luth, Aux sons de la harpe.
verses.am: አሥር አውታር ባለው በበገና፥ ከምስጋና ጋርም በመሰንቆ።

verses.en: For thou, Lord, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.
verses.fr: Tu me réjouis par tes oeuvres, ô Eternel! Et je chante avec allégresse l''ouvrage de tes mains.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በሥራህ ደስ አሰኝተኸኛልና፤ በእጅህም ሥራ ደስ ይለኛልና።

verses.en: O Lord, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.
verses.fr: Que tes oeuvres sont grandes, ô Eternel! Que tes pensées sont profondes!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ሥራህ እጅግ ትልቅ ነው፥ አሳብህም እጅግ ጥልቅ ነው።

verses.en: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.
verses.fr: L''homme stupide n''y connaît rien, Et l''insensé n''y prend point garde.
verses.am: ሰነፍ ሰው አያውቅም። ልብ የሌለውም ይህን አያስተውለውም።

verses.en: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:
verses.fr: Si les méchants croissent comme l''herbe, Si tous ceux qui font le mal fleurissent, C''est pour être anéantis à jamais.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኞች እንደ ሣር ሲበቅሉ ዓመፃ የሚያደርጉ ሁሉ ሲለመልሙ፥ ለዘላለም ዓለም እንዲጠፋ ነው።

verses.en: But thou, Lord, art most high for evermore.
verses.fr: Mais toi, tu es le Très-Haut, A perpétuité, ô Eternel!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ግን ለዘላለም ልዑል ነህ፤

verses.en: For, lo, thine enemies, O Lord, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
verses.fr: Car voici, tes ennemis, ô Eternel! Car voici, tes ennemis périssent; Tous ceux qui font le mal sont dispersés.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እነሆ፥ ጠላቶችህ ይጠፋሉና፥ ዓመፃንም የሚሠሩ ሁሉ ይበተናሉና።

verses.en: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.
verses.fr: Et tu me donnes la force du buffle; Je suis arrosé avec une huile fraîche.
verses.am: ቀንዴ አንድ ቀንድ እንዳለው ከፍ ከፍ ይላል፤ ሽምግልናዬም በዘይት ይለመልማል።

verses.en: Mine eye also shall see my desire on mine enemies, and mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.
verses.fr: Mon oeil se plaît à contempler mes ennemis, Et mon oreille à entendre mes méchants adversaires.
verses.am: ዓይኔም በጠላቶቼ ላይ አየች፥ ጆሮዬም በእኔ ላይ በቆሙ በክፉዎች ላይ ሰማች።

verses.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verses.fr: Les justes croissent comme le palmier, Ils s''élèvent comme le cèdre du Liban.
verses.am: ጻድቅ እንደ ዘንባባ ያፈራል፥ እንደ ሊባኖስ ዝግባም ያድጋል።

verses.en: Those that be planted in the house of the Lord shall flourish in the courts of our God.
verses.fr: Plantés dans la maison de l''Eternel, Ils prospèrent dans les parvis de notre Dieu;
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ ተተክለዋል፥ በአምላካችንም አደባባይ ውስጥ ይበቅላሉ።

verses.en: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;
verses.fr: Ils portent encore des fruits dans la vieillesse, Ils sont pleins de sève et verdoyants,
verses.am: ያን ጊዜ በለመለመ ሽምግልና ያፈራሉ ደስተኞችም ሆነው ይኖራሉ።

verses.en: To shew that the Lord is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
verses.fr: Pour faire connaître que l''Eternel est juste. Il est mon rocher, et il n''y a point en lui d''iniquité.
verses.am: አምላኬ እግዚአብሔር እውነተኛ እንደ ሆነ ይነግራሉ፥ በእርሱም ዘንድ ዓመፃ የለም።

verses.en: The Lord reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the Lord is clothed with strength, wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.
verses.fr: L''Eternel règne, il est revêtu de majesté, L''Eternel est revêtu, il est ceint de force. Aussi le monde est ferme, il ne chancelle pas.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ነገሠ፥ ክብርንም ለበሰ፤ እግዚአብሔር ኃይልን ለበሰ፥ ታጠቀም፤ ዓለምን እንዳትናወጥ አጸናት።

verses.en: Thy throne is established of old: thou art from everlasting.
verses.fr: Ton trône est établi dès les temps anciens; Tu existes de toute éternité.
verses.am: ዙፋንህ ከጥንት ጀምሮ የተዘጋጀ ነው፥ አንተም ከዘላለም ነህ።

verses.en: The floods have lifted up, O Lord, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.
verses.fr: Les fleuves élèvent, ô Eternel! Les fleuves élèvent leur voix, Les fleuves élèvent leurs ondes retentissantes.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ወንዞች ከፍ ከፍ አደረጉ፥ ወንዞች ቃሎቻቸውን ከፍ ከፍ አደረጉ።

verses.en: The Lord on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.
verses.fr: Plus que la voix des grandes, des puissantes eaux, Des flots impétueux de la mer, L''Eternel est puissant dans les lieux célestes.
verses.am: ከብዙ ውኆች ድምፅ ከባሕርም ታላቅ ሞገድ ይልቅ እግዚአብሔር በከፍታው ድንቅ ነው።

verses.en: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O Lord, for ever.
verses.fr: Tes témoignages sont entièrement véritables; La sainteté convient à ta maison, O Eternel! pour toute la durée des temps.
verses.am: ምስክርህ እጅግ የታመነ ነው፤ አቤቱ፥ እስከ ረጅም ዘመን ድረስ ለቤትህ ቅድስና ይገባል።

verses.en: O Lord God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.
verses.fr: Dieu des vengeances, Eternel! Dieu des vengeances, parais!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የበቀል አምላክ ነው። የበቀል አምላክ ተገለጠ።

verses.en: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.
verses.fr: Lève-toi, juge de la terre! Rends aux superbes selon leurs oeuvres!
verses.am: የምድር ፈራጅ ሆይ፥ ከፍ ከፍ በል፤ ለትዕቢተኞች ፍዳቸውን ክፈላቸው።

verses.en: Lord, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?
verses.fr: Jusques à quand les méchants, ô Eternel! Jusques à quand les méchants triompheront-ils?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ኃጢአተኞች እስከ መቼ? ኃጢአተኞች እስከ መቼ ይጓደዳሉ?

verses.en: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?
verses.fr: Ils discourent, ils parlent avec arrogance; Tous ceux qui font le mal se glorifient.
verses.am: ይከራከራሉ፥ ዓመፃንም ይናገራሉ፤ ዓመፃንም የሚያደርጉ ሁሉ ይናገራሉ።

verses.en: They break in pieces thy people, O Lord, and afflict thine heritage.
verses.fr: Eternel! ils écrasent ton peuple, Ils oppriment ton héritage;
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ሕዝብን አዋረዱ፥ ርስትህንም አስቸገሩ።

verses.en: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.
verses.fr: Ils égorgent la veuve et l''étranger, Ils assassinent les orphelins.
verses.am: ባልቴቲቱንና ድሀ አደጉን ገደሉ፥ ስደተኛውንም ገደሉ።

verses.en: Yet they say, The Lord shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard it.
verses.fr: Et ils disent: L''Eternel ne regarde pas, Le Dieu de Jacob ne fait pas attention!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አያይም፥ የያዕቆብ አምላክ አያስተውልም አሉ።

verses.en: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?
verses.fr: Prenez-y garde, hommes stupides! Insensés, quand serez-vous sages?
verses.am: የሕዝብ ደንቆሮች ሆይ፥ አስተውሉ፤ ሰነፎችማ መቼ ይጠበባሉ?

verses.en: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?
verses.fr: Celui qui a planté l''oreille n''entendrait-il pas? Celui qui a formé l''oeil ne verrait-il pas?
verses.am: ጆሮን የተከለው አይሰማምን? ዓይንን የሠራው አያይምን?

verses.en: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know?
verses.fr: Celui qui châtie les nations ne punirait-il point, Lui qui donne à l''homme l''intelligence?
verses.am: አሕዛብንስ የሚገሥጸው፥ ለሰውም እውቀት የሚያስተምረው እርሱ አይዘልፍምን?

verses.en: The Lord knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.
verses.fr: L''Eternel connaît les pensées de l''homme, Il sait qu''elles sont vaines.
verses.am: የሰዎች አሳብ ከንቱ እንደ ሆነ እግዚአብሔር ያውቃል።

verses.en: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O Lord, and teachest him out of thy law;
verses.fr: Heureux l''homme que tu châties, ô Eternel! Et que tu instruis par ta loi,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን አይጥልምና፥ ርስቱንም አይተውምና

verses.en: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.
verses.fr: Pour le calmer aux jours du malheur, Jusqu''à ce que la fosse soit creusée pour le méchant!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን አይጥልምና፥ ርስቱንም አይተውምና

verses.en: For the Lord will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel ne délaisse pas son peuple, Il n''abandonne pas son héritage;
verses.am: ፍርድ ወደ ጽድቅ እስኪመልስ ድረስ ልበ ቅኖችም ሁሉ ይከተሉአታል።

verses.en: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.
verses.fr: Car le jugement sera conforme à la justice, Et tous ceux dont le coeur est droit l''approuveront.
verses.am: በክፉዎች ላይ ለእኔ የሚቆም ማን ነው? ዓመፃንስ በሚያደርጉ ላይ ለእኔ የሚከራከር ማን ነው?

verses.en: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
verses.fr: Qui se lèvera pour moi contre les méchants? Qui me soutiendra contre ceux qui font le mal?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የረዳኝ ባይሆን ነፍሴ ለጥቂት ጊዜ በሲኦል ባደረች ነበር።

verses.en: Unless the Lord had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.
verses.fr: Si l''Eternel n''était pas mon secours, Mon âme serait bien vite dans la demeure du silence.
verses.am: እግሮቼ ተሰናከሉ ባልሁ ጊዜ፥ አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህ ረዳኝ።

verses.en: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O Lord, held me up.
verses.fr: Quand je dis: Mon pied chancelle! Ta bonté, ô Eternel! me sert d''appui.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ለልቤ እንደ መከራዋ ብዛት ማጽናናትህ ነፍሴን ደስ አሰኛት።

verses.en: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
verses.fr: Quand les pensées s''agitent en foule au dedans de moi, Tes consolations réjouissent mon âme.
verses.am: በሕግ ላይ ዓመፅን የሚሠራ የዓመፅ ዙፋን ከአንተ ጋር አንድ ይሆናልን?

verses.en: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?
verses.fr: Les méchants te feraient-ils siéger sur leur trône, Eux qui forment des desseins iniques en dépit de la loi?
verses.am: የጻድቅን ነፍስ ያደቡባታል፥ በንጹሕ ደምም ይፈርዳሉ።

verses.en: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
verses.fr: Ils se rassemblent contre la vie du juste, Et ils condamnent le sang innocent.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር መጠጊያ ሆነኝ፥ አምላኬ የተስፋዬም ረዳት ነው።

verses.en: But the Lord is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.
verses.fr: Mais l''Eternel est ma retraite, Mon Dieu est le rocher de mon refuge.
verses.am: እንደ በደላቸውም እንደ ክፋታቸውም ፍዳቸውን ይከፍላቸዋል፥ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔርም ያጠፋቸዋል።

verses.en: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, the Lord our God shall cut them off.
verses.fr: Il fera retomber sur eux leur iniquité, Il les anéantira par leur méchanceté; L''Eternel, notre Dieu, les anéantira.
verses.am: እንደ በደላቸውም እንደ ክፋታቸውም ፍዳቸውን ይከፍላቸዋል፥ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔርም ያጠፋቸዋል።

verses.en: O come, let us sing unto the Lord: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
verses.fr: Venez, chantons avec allégresse à l''Eternel! Poussons des cris de joie vers le rocher de notre salut.
verses.am: ኑ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይበለን፤ ለአምላክ ለመድኃኒታችን እልል እንበል።

verses.en: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
verses.fr: Allons au-devant de lui avec des louanges, Faisons retentir des cantiques en son honneur!
verses.am: በምስጋና ወደ ፊቱ እንድረስ፥ በዝማሬም ለእርሱ እልል እንበል፤

verses.en: For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel est un grand Dieu, Il est un grand roi au-dessus de tous les dieux.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ አምላክ ነውና፥ በአማልክትም ሁሉ ላይ ታላቅ ንጉሥ ነውና።

verses.en: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.
verses.fr: Il tient dans sa main les profondeurs de la terre, Et les sommets des montagnes sont à lui.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን አይጥላቸውም፤ የምድር ዳርቻዎችም በእጁ ውስጥ ናቸው፥ የተራሮች ከፍታዎች የእርሱ ናቸው።

verses.en: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.
verses.fr: La mer est à lui, c''est lui qui l''a faite; La terre aussi, ses mains l''ont formée.
verses.am: ባሕር የእርሱ ናት እርሱም አደረጋት፥ የብስንም እጆቹ ሠሩአት።

verses.en: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the Lord our maker.
verses.fr: Venez, prosternons-nous et humilions-nous, Fléchissons le genou devant l''Eternel, notre créateur!
verses.am: ኑ፥ እንስገድ ለእርሱም እንገዛ፤ በእርሱ ባደረገን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንበርከክ፤

verses.en: For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,
verses.fr: Car il est notre Dieu, Et nous sommes le peuple de son pâturage, Le troupeau que sa main conduit... Oh! si vous pouviez écouter aujourd''hui sa voix!
verses.am: እርሱ አምላካችን ነውና፥ እኛ የማሰማርያው ሕዝብ የእጁም በጎች ነንና።

verses.en: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
verses.fr: N''endurcissez pas votre coeur, comme à Meriba, Comme à la journée de Massa, dans le désert,
verses.am: በምድረ በዳ እንደ ተፈታተኑት እንዳስቈጡት ጊዜ፥ ዛሬ ድምፁን ብትሰሙ ልባችሁን አታጽኑ።

verses.en: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.
verses.fr: Où vos pères me tentèrent, M''éprouvèrent, quoiqu''ils vissent mes oeuvres.
verses.am: የተፈታተኑኝ አባቶቻችሁ ፈተኑኝ ሥራዬንም አዩ።

verses.en: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:
verses.fr: Pendant quarante ans j''eus cette race en dégoût, Et je dis: C''est un peuple dont le coeur est égaré; Ils ne connaissent pas mes voies.
verses.am: ያችን ትውልድ አርባ ዓመት ተቈጥቻት ነበር። ሁልጊዜ ልባቸው ይስታል፥ እነርሱም መንገዴን አላወቁም አልሁ።

verses.en: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.
verses.fr: Aussi je jurai dans ma colère: Ils n''entreront pas dans mon repos!
verses.am: ወደ ዕረፍቴም እንዳይገቡ በቁጣዬ ማልሁ።

verses.en: O sing unto the Lord a new song: sing unto the Lord, all the earth.
verses.fr: Chantez à l''Eternel un cantique nouveau! Chantez à l''Eternel, vous tous, habitants de la terre!
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር አዲስ ምስጋናን አመስግኑ፤ ምድር ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ።

verses.en: Sing unto the Lord, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.
verses.fr: Chantez à l''Eternel, bénissez son nom, Annoncez de jour en jour son salut!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ ስሙንም ባርኩ፥ ዕለት ዕለትም ማዳኑን አውሩ።

verses.en: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.
verses.fr: Racontez parmi les nations sa gloire, Parmi tous les peuples ses merveilles!
verses.am: ክብሩን ለአሕዛብ ተኣምራቱንም ለወገኖች ሁሉ ንገሩ፤

verses.en: For the Lord is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel est grand et très digne de louange, Il est redoutable par-dessus tous les dieux;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ምስጋናውም ብዙ ነውና፥ በአማልክትም ሁሉ ላይ የተፈራ ነውና።

verses.en: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the Lord made the heavens.
verses.fr: Car tous les dieux des peuples sont des idoles, Et l''Eternel a fait les cieux.
verses.am: የአሕዛብ አማልክት ሁሉ አጋንንት ናቸውና፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ሰማያትን ሠራ።

verses.en: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
verses.fr: La splendeur et la magnificence sont devant sa face, La gloire et la majesté sont dans son sanctuaire.
verses.am: ምስጋናና ውበት በፊቱ፥ ቅዱስነትና ግርማ በመቅደሱ ውስጥ ናቸው።

verses.en: Give unto the Lord, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the Lord glory and strength.
verses.fr: Familles des peuples, rendez à l''Eternel, Rendez à l''Eternel gloire et honneur!
verses.am: የአሕዛብ ወገኖች፥ ለእግዚአብሔር አምጡ፥ ክብርና ምስጋናን ለእግዚአብሔር አምጡ፤

verses.en: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.
verses.fr: Rendez à l''Eternel gloire pour son nom! Apportez des offrandes, et entrez dans ses parvis!
verses.am: ለስሙ የሚገባ ክብርን ለእግዚአብሔር አምጡ፤ ቍርባን ያዙ ወደ አደባባዮችም ግቡ።

verses.en: O worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.
verses.fr: Prosternez-vous devant l''Eternel avec des ornements sacrés. Tremblez devant lui, vous tous, habitants de la terre!
verses.am: በቅድስናው ስፍራ ለእግዚአብሔር ስገዱ፤ ምድር ሁሉ በፊቱ ትነዋወጥ።

verses.en: Say among the heathen that the Lord reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.
verses.fr: Dites parmi les nations: L''Eternel règne; Aussi le monde est ferme, il ne chancelle pas; L''Eternel juge les peuples avec droiture.
verses.am: በአሕዛብ መካከል። እግዚአብሔር ነገሠ በሉ። እንዳይናወጥም ዓለሙን እርሱ አጸናው፥ አሕዛብንም በቅንነት ይፈርዳል።

verses.en: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.
verses.fr: Que les cieux se réjouissent, et que la terre soit dans l''allégresse, Que la mer retentisse avec tout ce qu''elle contient,
verses.am: ሰማያት ደስ ይበላቸው፥ ምድርም ሐሤትን ታድርግ፤ ባሕርና ሞላዋ ይናወጡ፤

verses.en: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice
verses.fr: Que la campagne s''égaie avec tout ce qu''elle renferme, Que tous les arbres des forêts poussent des cris de joie,
verses.am: በረሃ በእርስዋም ያሉ ሁሉ ሐሤትን ያድርጉ፤ የዱር ዛፎች ሁሉ በዚያን ጊዜ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ደስ ይላቸዋል፤

verses.en: Before the Lord: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.
verses.fr: Devant l''Eternel! Car il vient, Car il vient pour juger la terre; Il jugera le monde avec justice, Et les peuples selon sa fidélité.
verses.am: ይመጣልና፤ በምድር ላይ ሊፈርድ ይመጣልና፤ እርሱም ዓለምን በጽድቅ አሕዛብንም በቅንነት ይፈርዳል።

verses.en: The Lord reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.
verses.fr: L''Eternel règne: que la terre soit dans l''allégresse, Que les îles nombreuses se réjouissent!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ነገሠ፤ ምድር ሐሤትን ታድርግ፥ ብዙ ደሴቶችም ደስ ይበላቸው።

verses.en: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.
verses.fr: Les nuages et l''obscurité l''environnent, La justice et l''équité sont la base de son trône.
verses.am: ደመና ጭጋግም በዙሪያው ናቸው፤ ጽድቅና ፍርድ የዙፋኑ መሠረት ናቸው።

verses.en: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.
verses.fr: Le feu marche devant lui, Et embrase à l''entour ses adversaires.
verses.am: እሳት በፊቱ ይሄዳል፥ ጠላቶቹንም በዙሪያው ያቃጥላል።

verses.en: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.
verses.fr: Ses éclairs illuminent le monde, La terre le voit et tremble;
verses.am: መብረቆቹ ለዓለም አበሩ፤ ምድር አየችና ተናወጠች።

verses.en: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.fr: Les montagnes se fondent comme la cire devant l''Eternel, Devant le Seigneur de toute la terre.
verses.am: ተራሮችም ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት፥ ከምድር ሁሉ ጌታ ፊት እንደ ሰም ቀለጡ።

verses.en: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.
verses.fr: Les cieux publient sa justice, Et tous les peuples voient sa gloire.
verses.am: ሰማያት የእርሱን ጽድቅ አወሩ፥ አሕዛብም ሁሉ ክብሩን አዩ።

verses.en: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.
verses.fr: Ils sont confus, tous ceux qui servent les images, Qui se font gloire des idoles. Tous les dieux se prosternent devant lui.
verses.am: ለተቀረጸ ምስል የሚሰግዱ ሁሉ፥ በጣዖቶቻቸውም የሚመኩ ይፈሩ፤ መላእክቱ ሁሉ፥ ስገዱለት።

verses.en: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O Lord.
verses.fr: Sion l''entend et se réjouit, Les filles de Juda sont dans l''allégresse, A cause de tes jugements, ô Eternel!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ስለ ፍርድህ ጽዮን ሰምታ ደስ አላት፥ የይሁዳም ሴት ልጆች ደስ አላቸው፤

verses.en: For thou, Lord, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.
verses.fr: Car toi, Eternel! tu es le Très-Haut sur toute la terre, Tu es souverainement élevé au-dessus de tous les dieux.
verses.am: አንተ፥ እግዚአብሔር፥ በምድር ላይ ሁሉ ልዑል ነህና፥ በአማልክትም ሁሉ ላይ እጅግ ከፍ ከፍ ብለሃልና።

verses.en: Ye that love the Lord, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.fr: Vous qui aimez l''Eternel, haïssez le mal! Il garde les âmes de ses fidèles, Il les délivre de la main des méchants.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን የምትወዱ፥ ክፋትን ጥሉ፤ እግዚአብሔር የቅዱሳኑን ነፍሶች ይጠብቃል፥ ከኃጥኣንም እጅ ያድናቸዋል።

verses.en: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.fr: La lumière est semée pour le juste, Et la joie pour ceux dont le coeur est droit.
verses.am: ብርሃን ለጻድቃን፥ ደስታም ለልበ ቅኖች ወጣ።

verses.en: Rejoice in the Lord, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
verses.fr: Justes, réjouissez-vous en l''Eternel, Et célébrez par vos louanges sa sainteté!
verses.am: ጻድቃን፥ በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይበላችሁ፥ ለቅድስናውም መታሰቢያ አመስግኑ።

verses.en: O sing unto the Lord a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.
verses.fr: Psaume. Chantez à l''Eternel un cantique nouveau! Car il a fait des prodiges. Sa droite et son bras saint lui sont venus en aide.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር አዲስ ምስጋናን አመስግኑ፥ እግዚአብሔር ተኣምራትን አድርጎአልና፤ ቀኙ የተቀደሰም ክንዱ ለእርሱ ማዳን አደረገ።

verses.en: The Lord hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.
verses.fr: L''Eternel a manifesté son salut, Il a révélé sa justice aux yeux des nations.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ማዳኑን አስታወቀ፥ በአሕዛብም ፊት ጽድቁን ገለጠ።

verses.en: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.fr: Il s''est souvenu de sa bonté et de sa fidélité envers la maison d''Israël, Toutes les extrémités de la terre ont vu le salut de notre Dieu.
verses.am: ለያዕቆብ ምሕረቱን ለእስራኤልም ቤት እውነቱን አሰበ፤ የምድር ዳርቻዎች ሁሉ የአምላካችንን ማዳን አዩ።

verses.en: Make a joyful noise unto the Lord, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.
verses.fr: Poussez vers l''Eternel des cris de joie, Vous tous, habitants de la terre! Faites éclater votre allégresse, et chantez!
verses.am: ምድር ሁሉ ሆይ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር እልል በሉ፤ አመስግኑ፥ ደስ ይበላችሁ፥ ዘምሩም።

verses.en: Sing unto the Lord with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.
verses.fr: Chantez à l''Eternel avec la harpe; Avec la harpe chantez des cantiques!
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር በመሰንቆ፥ በመሰንቆና በዝማሬ ድምፅ ዘምሩ።

verses.en: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the Lord, the King.
verses.fr: Avec les trompettes et au son du cor, Poussez des cris de joie devant le roi, l''Eternel!
verses.am: በዋሽንትና በመለከት ድምፅ በንጉሥ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እልል በሉ።

verses.en: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.fr: Que la mer retentisse avec tout ce qu''elle contient, Que le monde et ceux qui l''habitent éclatent d''allégresse,
verses.am: ባሕርና ሞላዋ፥ ዓለምም በእርስዋም የሚኖሩ ይናወጡ።

verses.en: Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together
verses.fr: Que les fleuves battent des mains, Que toutes les montagnes poussent des cris de joie,
verses.am: ወንዞችም በአንድነት በእጅ ያጨብጭቡ፤ ተራሮች ደስ ይበላቸው፥ በምድር ሊፈርድ ይመጣልና።

verses.en: Before the Lord; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.
verses.fr: Devant l''Eternel! Car il vient pour juger la terre; Il jugera le monde avec justice, Et les peuples avec équité.
verses.am: ለዓለምም በጽድቅ ለአሕዛብም በቅንነት ይፈርዳል።

verses.en: The Lord reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.
verses.fr: L''Eternel règne: les peuples tremblent; Il est assis sur les chérubins: la terre chancelle.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ነገሠ፥ አሕዛብ ይደንግጡ፤ በኪሩቤል ላይ ተቀመጠ፥ ምድር ትናወጥ።

verses.en: The Lord is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est grand dans Sion, Il est élevé au-dessus de tous les peuples.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በጽዮን ታላቅ ነው፤ እርሱም በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ አለ።

verses.en: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.
verses.fr: Qu''on célèbre ton nom grand et redoutable! Il est saint!
verses.am: ግሩምና ቅዱስ ነውና ሁሉ ታላቅ ስምህን ያመስግኑ።

verses.en: The king's strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.
verses.fr: Qu''on célèbre la force du roi qui aime la justice! Tu affermis la droiture, Tu exerces en Jacob la justice et l''équité.
verses.am: የንጉሥ ክብር ፍርድን ይወድዳል፤ አንተ ቅንነትን አጸናህ፥ ለያዕቆብ ፍርድንና ጽድቅን አንተ አደረግህ።

verses.en: Exalt ye the Lord our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.
verses.fr: Exaltez l''Eternel, notre Dieu, Et prosternez-vous devant son marchepied! Il est saint!
verses.am: አምላካችንን እግዚአብሔርን ከፍ ከፍ አድርጉት፥ ቅዱስ ነውና ወደ እግሩ መረገጫ ስገዱ።

verses.en: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the Lord, and he answered them.
verses.fr: Moïse et Aaron parmi ses sacrificateurs, Et Samuel parmi ceux qui invoquaient son nom, Invoquèrent l''Eternel, et il les exauça.
verses.am: ሙሴና አሮን በካህናቱ ዘንድ፥ ሳሙኤልም ስሙን በሚጠሩት ዘንድ ናቸው። እግዚአብሔርን ጠሩት፥ እርሱም መለሰላቸው።

verses.en: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.
verses.fr: Il leur parla dans la colonne de nuée; Ils observèrent ses commandements Et la loi qu''il leur donna.
verses.am: በደመና ዓምድም ተናገራቸው፤ ምስክሩንና የሰጣቸውን ትእዛዝ ጠበቁ።

verses.en: Thou answeredst them, O Lord our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.
verses.fr: Eternel, notre Dieu, tu les exauças, Tu fus pour eux un Dieu qui pardonne, Mais tu les as punis de leurs fautes.
verses.am: አቤቱ አምላክችን ሆይ፥ አንተ ሰማሃቸው፤ አቤቱ፥ አንተ ማርሃቸው፥ ሥራቸውን ሁሉ ግን ተበቀልሃቸው።

verses.en: Exalt the Lord our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the Lord our God is holy.
verses.fr: Exaltez l''Eternel, notre Dieu, Et prosternez-vous sur sa montagne sainte! Car il est saint, l''Eternel, notre Dieu!
verses.am: አምላካችንን እግዚአብሔርን ከፍ ከፍ አድርጉት፥ በቅዱስ ተራራውም ስገዱ፤ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ቅዱስ ነውና።

verses.en: Make a joyful noise unto the Lord, all ye lands.
verses.fr: Psaume de louange. Poussez vers l''Eternel des cris de joie, Vous tous, habitants de la terre!
verses.am: ምድር ሁሉ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር እልል በሉ፥

verses.en: Serve the Lord with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
verses.fr: Servez l''Eternel, avec joie, Venez avec allégresse en sa présence!
verses.am: በደስታም ለእግዚአብሔር ተገዙ፥ በሐሤትም ወደ ፊቱ ግቡ።

verses.en: Know ye that the Lord he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
verses.fr: Sachez que l''Eternel est Dieu! C''est lui qui nous a faits, et nous lui appartenons; Nous sommes son peuple, et le troupeau de son pâturage.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እርሱ አምላክ እንደ ሆነ እወቁ፤ እርሱ ሠራን እኛም አይደለንም፤ እኛስ ሕዝቡ የማሰማርያውም በጎች ነን።

verses.en: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
verses.fr: Entrez dans ses portes avec des louanges, Dans ses parvis avec des cantiques! Célébrez-le, bénissez son nom!
verses.am: ወደ ደጆቹ በመገዛት፥ ወደ አደባባዮቹም በምስጋና ግቡ፤ አመስግኑት፥ ስሙንም ባርኩ፤

verses.en: For the Lord is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel est bon; sa bonté dure toujours, Et sa fidélité de génération en génération.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ቸር፥ ምሕረቱም ለዘላለም፥ እውነቱም ለልጅ ልጅ ነውና።

verses.en: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O Lord, will I sing.
verses.fr: De David. Psaume. Je chanterai la bonté et la justice; C''est à toi, Eternel! que je chanterai.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትንና ፍርድን እቀኝልሃለሁ።

verses.en: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
verses.fr: Je prendrai garde à la voie droite. Quand viendras-tu à moi? Je marcherai dans l''intégrité de mon coeur, Au milieu de ma maison.
verses.am: እዘምራለሁ፥ ንጹሕ መንገዱንም አስተውላለሁ፤ ወደ እኔ መቼ ትመጣለህ? በቤቴ መካከል በልቤ ቅንነት እሄዳለሁ።

verses.en: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.
verses.fr: Je ne mettrai rien de mauvais devant mes yeux; Je hais la conduite des pécheurs; Elle ne s''attachera point à moi.
verses.am: በዓይኔ ፊት ክፉን ነገር አላኖርሁም፤ ሕግ ተላላፊዎችን ጠላሁ።

verses.en: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.
verses.fr: Le coeur pervers s''éloignera de moi; Je ne veux pas connaître le méchant.
verses.am: ጠማማ ልብም አልተጠጋኝም፤ ክፉ ከእኔ በራቀ ጊዜ አላወቅሁም።

verses.en: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.
verses.fr: Celui qui calomnie en secret son prochain, je l''anéantirai; Celui qui a des regards hautains et un coeur enflé, je ne le supporterai pas.
verses.am: ባልንጀራውን በቀስታ የሚያማን እርሱን አሳደድሁ፤ በዓይኑ ትዕቢተኛ የሆነውና ልቡ የሚሳሳው ከእኔ ጋር አይተባበርም።

verses.en: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.
verses.fr: J''aurai les yeux sur les fidèles du pays, Pour qu''ils demeurent auprès de moi; Celui qui marche dans une voie intègre sera mon serviteur.
verses.am: ከእኔ ጋር ይኖሩ ዘንድ፤ ዓይኖቼ በምድር ምእመናን ላይ ናቸው፤ በቀና መንገድ የሚሄድ እርሱ ያገለግለኛል።

verses.en: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.
verses.fr: Celui qui se livre à la fraude n''habitera pas dans ma maison; Celui qui dit des mensonges ne subsistera pas en ma présence.
verses.am: ትዕቢትን የሚያደርግ በቤቴ መካከል አይኖርም፤ ዓመፅን የሚናገር በዓይኔ ፊት አይቀናም።

verses.en: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the Lord.
verses.fr: Chaque matin j''anéantirai tous les méchants du pays, Afin d''exterminer de la ville de l''Eternel Tous ceux qui commettent l''iniquité.
verses.am: ዓመፃ የሚያደርጉትን ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር ከተማ አጠፋቸው ዘንድ፥ የምድርን ኃጢአተኞች ሁሉ በማለዳ እገድላቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and let my cry come unto thee.
verses.fr: Prière d''un malheureux, lorsqu''il est abattu et qu''il répand sa plainte devant l''Eternel. Eternel, écoute ma prière, Et que mon cri parvienne jusqu''à toi!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴን ስማኝ፥ ጩኸቴም ወደ አንተ ይድረስ።

verses.en: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.
verses.fr: Ne me cache pas ta face au jour de ma détresse! Incline vers moi ton oreille quand je crie! Hâte-toi de m''exaucer!
verses.am: በመከራዬ ቀን ፊትህን ከኔ አትመልስ፤ ጆሮህን ወደ እኔ አዘንብል፤ በጠራሁህ ቀን ፈጥነህ ስማኝ።

verses.en: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.
verses.fr: Car mes jours s''évanouissent en fumée, Et mes os sont enflammés comme un tison.
verses.am: ዘመኔ እንደ ጢስ አልቃለችና፥ አጥንቶቼም እንደ መቃጠያ ተቃጥለዋልና።

verses.en: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.
verses.fr: Mon coeur est frappé et se dessèche comme l''herbe; J''oublie même de manger mon pain.
verses.am: እህል መብላት ተረስቶኛልና ተቀሠፍሁ ልቤም እንደ ሣር ደረቀ።

verses.en: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.
verses.fr: Mes gémissements sont tels Que mes os s''attachent à ma chair.
verses.am: ከጩኸቴ ድምፅ የተነሣ አጥንቶቼ ከሥጋዬ ጋር ተጣበቁ።

verses.en: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
verses.fr: Je ressemble au pélican du désert, Je suis comme le chat-huant des ruines;
verses.am: እንደ ምድረ በዳ እርኩም መሰልሁ፤ በፈረሰ ቤት እንዳለ እንደ ጕጕት ሆንሁ።

verses.en: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.
verses.fr: Je n''ai plus de sommeil, et je suis Comme l''oiseau solitaire sur un toit.
verses.am: ተጋሁ፥ በሰገነትም እንደሚኖር ብቸኛ ድንቢጥ ሆንሁ።

verses.en: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.
verses.fr: Chaque jour mes ennemis m''outragent, Et c''est par moi que jurent mes adversaires en fureur.
verses.am: ጠላቶቼ ሁልጊዜ ይሰድቡኛል፥ የሚያሳድዱኝም ተማማሉብኝ።

verses.en: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping.
verses.fr: Je mange la poussière au lieu de pain, Et je mêle des larmes à ma boisson,
verses.am: አመድን እንደ እህል ቅሜአለሁና፥ መጠጤንም ከእንባዬ ጋር ቀላቅያለሁና፥

verses.en: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.
verses.fr: A cause de ta colère et de ta fureur; Car tu m''as soulevé et jeté au loin.
verses.am: ከቍጣህና ከመዓትህም የተነሣ፤ አንሥተኸኛልና፥ ጥለኸኝማልና።

verses.en: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.
verses.fr: Mes jours sont comme l''ombre à son déclin, Et je me dessèche comme l''herbe.
verses.am: ዘመኖቼ እንደ ጥላ አዘንብለዋል፤ እኔም እንደ ሣር ደርቄአለሁ።

verses.en: But thou, O Lord, shall endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.
verses.fr: Mais toi, Eternel! tu règnes à perpétuité, Et ta mémoire dure de génération en génération.
verses.am: አንተ ግን፥ አቤቱ፥ ለዘላለም ትኖራለህ፥ መታሰቢያህም ለልጅ ልጅ ነው።

verses.en: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.
verses.fr: Tu te lèveras, tu auras pitié de Sion; Car le temps d''avoir pitié d''elle, Le temps fixé est à son terme;
verses.am: አንተ ተነሥ ጽዮንንም ይቅር በላት፥ የምሕረትዋ ጊዜ ነውና፥ ዘመንዋም ደርሶአልና፤

verses.en: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.
verses.fr: Car tes serviteurs en aiment les pierres, Ils en chérissent la poussière.
verses.am: ባሪያዎችህም ድንጋዮችዋን ወድደዋልና፥ ለመሬትዋም አዝነዋልና።

verses.en: So the heathen shall fear the name of the Lord, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.
verses.fr: Alors les nations craindront le nom de l''Eternel, Et tous les rois de la terre ta gloire.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አሕዛብ ስምህን፥ ነገሥታትም ሁሉ ክብርህን ይፈራሉ፤

verses.en: When the Lord shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.
verses.fr: Oui, l''Eternel rebâtira Sion, Il se montrera dans sa gloire.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ጽዮንን ይሠራታልና፥ በክብሩም ይገለጣልና።

verses.en: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.
verses.fr: Il est attentif à la prière du misérable, Il ne dédaigne pas sa prière.
verses.am: ወደ ችግረኞች ጸሎት ተመለከተ፥ ልመናቸውንም አልናቀም።

verses.en: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the Lord.
verses.fr: Que cela soit écrit pour la génération future, Et que le peuple qui sera créé célèbre l''Eternel!
verses.am: ይህ ለሚመጣ ትውልድ ይጻፍ፥ የሚፈጠርም ሕዝብ ለእግዚአብሔር እልል ይላል፤

verses.en: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the Lord behold the earth;
verses.fr: Car il regarde du lieu élevé de sa sainteté; Du haut des cieux l''Eternel regarde sur la terre,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከመቅደሱ ከፍታ ሆኖ ተመልክቶአልና፥ ከሰማይ ሆኖ ምድርን አይቶአልና፤

verses.en: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;
verses.fr: Pour écouter les gémissements des captifs, Pour délivrer ceux qui vont périr,
verses.am: የእስረኞችን ጩኸት ይሰማ ዘንድ፥ ሊገድሉ የተፈረደባቸውን ያድን ዘንድ፤

verses.en: To declare the name of the Lord in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
verses.fr: Afin qu''ils publient dans Sion le nom de l''Eternel, Et ses louanges dans Jérusalem,
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ስም በጽዮን ምስጋናውንም በኢየሩሳሌም ይናገሩ ዘንድ፤

verses.en: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the Lord.
verses.fr: Quand tous les peuples s''assembleront, Et tous les royaumes, pour servir l''Eternel.
verses.am: አሕዛብ በአንድነት በተሰበሰቡ ጊዜ መንግሥታትም ለእግዚአብሔር ይገዙ ዘንድ።

verses.en: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.
verses.fr: Il a brisé ma force dans la route, Il a abrégé mes jours.
verses.am: በኃይሉ ጎዳና መለሰለት። የዘመኔን አነስተኛነት ንገረኝ።

verses.en: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.
verses.fr: Je dis: Mon Dieu, ne m''enlève pas au milieu de mes jours, Toi, dont les années durent éternellement!
verses.am: በዘመኔ እኵሌታ አትውሰደኝ፤ ዓመቶችህ ለልጅ ልጅ ናቸው።

verses.en: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.
verses.fr: Tu as anciennement fondé la terre, Et les cieux sont l''ouvrage de tes mains.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ከጥንት ምድርን መሠረትህ፥ ሰማያትም የእጅህ ሥራ ናቸው።

verses.en: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:
verses.fr: Ils périront, mais tu subsisteras; Ils s''useront tous comme un vêtement; Tu les changeras comme un habit, et ils seront changés.
verses.am: እነርሱ ይጠፋሉ፥ አንተ ግን ትኖራለህ፤ ሁላቸው እንደ ልብስ ያረጃሉ፥ እንደ መጐናጸፊያም ትለውጣቸዋለህ፥ ይለወጡማል፤

verses.en: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.
verses.fr: Mais toi, tu restes le même, Et tes années ne finiront point.
verses.am: አንተ ግን ያው አንተ ነህ፥ ዓመቶችህም ከቶ አያልቁም።

verses.en: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.
verses.fr: Les fils de tes serviteurs habiteront leur pays, Et leur postérité s''affermira devant toi.
verses.am: የባሪያዎችህም ልጆች ይኖራሉ፥ ዘራቸውም ለዘላለም ትጸናለች።

verses.en: Bless the Lord, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.
verses.fr: De David. Mon âme, bénis l''Eternel! Que tout ce qui est en moi bénisse son saint nom!
verses.am: ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኪ፥ አጥንቶቼም ሁሉ፥ የተቀደሰ ስሙን።

verses.en: Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
verses.fr: Mon âme, bénis l''Eternel, Et n''oublie aucun de ses bienfaits!
verses.am: ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኪ፥ ምስጋናውንም ሁሉ አትርሺ፤

verses.en: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;
verses.fr: C''est lui qui pardonne toutes tes iniquités, Qui guérit toutes tes maladies;
verses.am: ኃጢአትሽን ሁሉ ይቅር የሚል፥ ደዌሽንም ሁሉ የሚፈውስ፥

verses.en: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;
verses.fr: C''est lui qui délivre ta vie de la fosse, Qui te couronne de bonté et de miséricorde;
verses.am: ሕይወትሽን ከጥፋት የሚያድናት፥ በምሕረቱና በቸርነቱ የሚከልልሽ፥

verses.en: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle's.
verses.fr: C''est lui qui rassasie de biens ta vieillesse, Qui te fait rajeunir comme l''aigle.
verses.am: ምኞትሽን ከበረከቱ የሚያጠግባት፥ ጕልማስነትሽን እንደ ንስር ያድሳል።

verses.en: The Lord executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.
verses.fr: L''Eternel fait justice, Il fait droit à tous les opprimés.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ይቅርታ አድራጊ ነው፤ ለተበደሉ ሁሉ ይፈርዳል።

verses.en: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Il a manifesté ses voies à Moïse, Ses oeuvres aux enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ለሙሴ መንገዱን አስታወቀ፥ ለእስራኤል ልጆችም አደራረጉን።

verses.en: The Lord is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est miséricordieux et compatissant, Lent à la colère et riche en bonté;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር መሓሪና ይቅር ባይ ነው፥ ከቍጣ የራቀ ምሕረቱም የበዛ።

verses.en: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.
verses.fr: Il ne conteste pas sans cesse, Il ne garde pas sa colère à toujours;
verses.am: ሁልጊዜም አይቀሥፍም፥ ለዘላለምም አይቈጣም።

verses.en: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.
verses.fr: Il ne nous traite pas selon nos péchés, Il ne nous punit pas selon nos iniquités.
verses.am: እንደ ኃጢአታችን አላደረገብንም፥ እንደ በደላችንም አልከፈለንም።

verses.en: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.
verses.fr: Mais autant les cieux sont élevés au-dessus de la terre, Autant sa bonté est grande pour ceux qui le craignent;
verses.am: ሰማይ ከምድር ከፍ እንደሚል፥ እንዲሁ እግዚአብሔር ምሕረቱን በሚፈሩት ላይ አጠነከረ።

verses.en: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
verses.fr: Autant l''orient est éloigné de l''occident, Autant il éloigne de nous nos transgressions.
verses.am: ምሥራቅ ከምዕራብ እንደሚርቅ፥ እንዲሁ ኃጢአታችንን ከእኛ አራቀ።

verses.en: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the Lord pitieth them that fear him.
verses.fr: Comme un père a compassion de ses enfants, L''Eternel a compassion de ceux qui le craignent.
verses.am: አባት ለልጆቹ እንደሚራራ እንዲሁ እግዚአብሔር ለሚፈሩት ይራራል፤

verses.en: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.
verses.fr: Car il sait de quoi nous sommes formés, Il se souvient que nous sommes poussière.
verses.am: ፍጥረታችንን እርሱ ያውቃልና፤ አቤቱ፥ እኛ አፈር እንደ ሆንን አስብ።

verses.en: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
verses.fr: L''homme! ses jours sont comme l''herbe, Il fleurit comme la fleur des champs.
verses.am: ሰውስ ዘመኑ እንደ ሣር ነው፤ እንደ ዱር አበባ እንዲሁ ያብባል፤

verses.en: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''un vent passe sur elle, elle n''est plus, Et le lieu qu''elle occupait ne la reconnaît plus.
verses.am: ነፋስ በነፈሰበት ጊዜ ያልፋልና፥ ስፍራውንም ደግሞ አያውቀውምና።

verses.en: But the mercy of the Lord is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children's children;
verses.fr: Mais la bonté de l''Eternel dure à jamais pour ceux qui le craignent, Et sa miséricorde pour les enfants de leurs enfants,
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ምሕረት ግን ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም በሚፈሩት ላይ፥ ጽድቁም በልጅ ልጆች ላይ ነው፤

verses.en: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.
verses.fr: Pour ceux qui gardent son alliance, Et se souviennent de ses commandements afin de les accomplir.
verses.am: ቃል ኪዳኑን በሚጠብቁ፥ ትእዛዙንም ያደርጉአት ዘንድ በሚያስቡ ላይ ነው።

verses.en: The Lord hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.
verses.fr: L''Eternel a établi son trône dans les cieux, Et son règne domine sur toutes choses.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ዙፋኑን በሰማይ አዘጋጀ፥ መንግሥቱም ሁሉን ትገዛለች።

verses.en: Bless the Lord, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.
verses.fr: Bénissez l''Eternel, vous ses anges, Qui êtes puissants en force, et qui exécutez ses ordres, En obéissant à la voix de sa parole!
verses.am: ቃሉን የምትፈጽሙ፥ ብርቱዎችና ኃያላን፥ የቃሉንም ድምፅ የምትሰሙ መላእክቱ ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩ።

verses.en: Bless ye the Lord, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
verses.fr: Bénissez l''Eternel, vous toutes ses armées, Qui êtes ses serviteurs, et qui faites sa volonté!
verses.am: ሠራዊቱ ሁሉ፥ ፈቃዱን የምታደርጉ አገልጋዮቹ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩ።

verses.en: Bless the Lord, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the Lord, O my soul.
verses.fr: Bénissez l''Eternel, vous toutes ses oeuvres, Dans tous les lieux de sa domination! Mon âme, bénis l''Eternel!
verses.am: ፍጥረቶቹ ሁሉ በግዛቱ ስፍራ ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩ። ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኪ።

verses.en: Bless the Lord, O my soul. O Lord my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.
verses.fr: Mon âme, bénis l''Eternel! Eternel, mon Dieu, tu es infiniment grand! Tu es revêtu d''éclat et de magnificence!
verses.am: ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኪ፤ አቤቱ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ አንተ እጅግ ታላቅ ነህ፤ ክብርንና ግርማን ለበስህ።

verses.en: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:
verses.fr: Il s''enveloppe de lumière comme d''un manteau; Il étend les cieux comme un pavillon.
verses.am: ብርሃንን እንደ ልብስ ለበስህ፤ ሰማይንም እንደ መጋረጃ ዘረጋህ፤

verses.en: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:
verses.fr: Il forme avec les eaux le faîte de sa demeure; Il prend les nuées pour son char, Il s''avance sur les ailes du vent.
verses.am: እልፍኙን በውኃ የሚሠራ፥ ሰረገላውን ደመና የሚያደርግ፥ በነፋስ ክንፍም የሚሄድ፥

verses.en: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:
verses.fr: Il fait des vents ses messagers, Des flammes de feu ses serviteurs.
verses.am: መላእክቱን መንፈስ የሚያደርግ፥ አገልጋዮቹንም የእሳት ነበልባል።

verses.en: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.
verses.fr: Il a établi la terre sur ses fondements, Elle ne sera jamais ébranlée.
verses.am: ለዘላለም እንዳትናወጥ ምድርን በመሠረትዋ ላይ መሠረታት።

verses.en: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.
verses.fr: Tu l''avais couverte de l''abîme comme d''un vêtement, Les eaux s''arrêtaient sur les montagnes;
verses.am: በጥልቅ እንደ ልብስ ከደንሃት፥ በተራሮችም ላይ ውኆች ይቆማሉ።

verses.en: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.
verses.fr: Elles ont fui devant ta menace, Elles se sont précipitées à la voix de ton tonnerre.
verses.am: ከዘለፋህም ይሸሻሉ፥ ከነጐድጓድህም ድምፅ ይደነግጣሉ፤

verses.en: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.
verses.fr: Des montagnes se sont élevées, des vallées se sont abaissées, Au lieu que tu leur avais fixé.
verses.am: ወደ ተራሮች ይወጣሉ፥ ወደ ቈላዎች ወዳዘጋጀህላቸው ስፍራ ይወርዳሉ፤

verses.en: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.
verses.fr: Tu as posé une limite que les eaux ne doivent point franchir, Afin qu''elles ne reviennent plus couvrir la terre.
verses.am: እንዳያልፉትም ድንበር አደረግህላቸው ምድርን ይከድኑ ዘንድ እንዳይመለሱ።

verses.en: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.
verses.fr: Il conduit les sources dans des torrents Qui coulent entre les montagnes.
verses.am: ምንጮችን ወደ ቈላዎች ይልካል፤ በተራሮች መካከል ውኆች ያልፋሉ፤

verses.en: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.
verses.fr: Elles abreuvent tous les animaux des champs; Les ânes sauvages y étanchent leur soif.
verses.am: የዱር አራዊትን ሁሉ ያጠጣሉ፥ የበረሃ አህያዎችም ጥማታቸውን ይረካሉ።

verses.en: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.
verses.fr: Les oiseaux du ciel habitent sur leurs bords, Et font résonner leur voix parmi les rameaux.
verses.am: የሰማይም ወፎች በእነርሱ ዘንድ ያድራሉ፥ በድንጋዩ ስንጥቅ መካከልም ይጮኻሉ።

verses.en: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.
verses.fr: De sa haute demeure, il arrose les montagnes; La terre est rassasiée du fruit de tes oeuvres.
verses.am: ተራሮችን ከላይ የሚያጠጣቸው፤ ከሥራህ ፍሬ ምድር ትጠግባለች።

verses.en: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;
verses.fr: Il fait germer l''herbe pour le bétail, Et les plantes pour les besoins de l''homme, Afin que la terre produise de la nourriture,
verses.am: እንጀራን ከምድር ያወጣ ዘንድ ለምለሙን ለሰው ልጆች ጥቅም፥ ሣርንም ለእንስሳ ያበቅላል።

verses.en: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man's heart.
verses.fr: Le vin qui réjouit le coeur de l''homme, Et fait plus que l''huile resplendir son visage, Et le pain qui soutient le coeur de l''homme.
verses.am: ወይን የሰውን ልብ ደስ ያሰኛል፥ ዘይትም ፊትን ያበራል፥ እህልም የሰውን ጕልበት ያጠነክራል።

verses.en: The trees of the Lord are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
verses.fr: Les arbres de l''Eternel se rassasient, Les cèdres du Liban, qu''il a plantés.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ዛፎች እርሱም የተከላቸው የሊባኖስ ዝግባዎች ይጠግባሉ።

verses.en: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.
verses.fr: C''est là que les oiseaux font leurs nids; La cigogne a sa demeure dans les cyprès,
verses.am: በዚያም ወፎች ይዋለዳሉ፥ የሽመላ ቤትም የእነርሱ ጎረቤት ነው።

verses.en: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.
verses.fr: Les montagnes élevées sont pour les boucs sauvages, Les rochers servent de retraite aux damans.
verses.am: ረጃጅም ተራራዎች ለዋላዎች፥ ድንጋዮችም ለእሽኮኮች መሸሻ ናቸው።

verses.en: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.
verses.fr: Il a fait la lune pour marquer les temps; Le soleil sait quand il doit se coucher.
verses.am: ጨረቃን ለጊዜዎች አደረገ፤ ፀሐይም መግቢያውን ያውቃል።

verses.en: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.
verses.fr: Tu amènes les ténèbres, et il est nuit: Alors tous les animaux des forêts sont en mouvement;
verses.am: ጨለማ ታደርጋለህ ሌሊትም ይሆናል፤ በእርሱም የዱር አራዊት ሁሉ ይወጡበታል።

verses.en: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.
verses.fr: Les lionceaux rugissent après la proie, Et demandent à Dieu leur nourriture.
verses.am: የአንበሳ ግልገሎች ለመንጠቅ ይጮኻሉ፥ ከእግዚአብሔርም ምግባቸውን ይሻሉ።

verses.en: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.
verses.fr: Le soleil se lève: ils se retirent, Et se couchent dans leurs tanières.
verses.am: ፀሐይ ስትወጣ ይሰበሰባሉ በየዋሻቸውም ይተኛሉ።

verses.en: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.
verses.fr: L''homme sort pour se rendre à son ouvrage, Et à son travail, jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: ሰው ወደ ተግባሩ፥ እስኪመሽም ድረስ ወደ ሥራው ይወጣል።

verses.en: O Lord, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.
verses.fr: Que tes oeuvres sont en grand nombre, ô Eternel! Tu les as toutes faites avec sagesse. La terre est remplie de tes biens.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ሥራህ እጅግ ብዙ ነው፤ ሁሉን በጥበብ አደረግህ፥ ምድርም ከፍጥረትህ ተሞላች።

verses.en: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.
verses.fr: Voici la grande et vaste mer: Là se meuvent sans nombre Des animaux petits et grands;
verses.am: ይህች ባሕር ታላቅና ሰፊ ናት፤ በዚያ ስፍራ ቍጥር የሌለው ተንቀሳቃሽ፥ ታላላቆችና ታናናሾች እንስሶች አሉ።

verses.en: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.
verses.fr: Là se promènent les navires, Et ce léviathan que tu as formé pour se jouer dans les flots.
verses.am: በዚያ ጊዜ መርከቦች ይሄዳሉ፥ በዚያም ላይ የፈጠርኸው ዘንዶ ይጫወትበታል።

verses.en: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.
verses.fr: Tous ces animaux espèrent en toi, Pour que tu leur donnes la nourriture en son temps.
verses.am: ምግባቸውን በየጊዜው ትሰጣቸው ዘንድ እነዚህ ሁሉ አንተን ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ።

verses.en: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.
verses.fr: Tu la leur donnes, et ils la recueillent; Tu ouvres ta main, et ils se rassasient de biens.
verses.am: በሰጠሃቸውም ጊዜ ይሰበስባሉ፤ እጅህን ትከፍታለህ፥ ከመልካም ነገርም ይጠግባሉ።

verses.en: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.
verses.fr: Tu caches ta face: ils sont tremblants; Tu leur retires le souffle: ils expirent, Et retournent dans leur poussière.
verses.am: ፊትህን ስትሰውር ይደነግጣሉ፤ ነፍሳቸውን ታወጣለህ ይሞታሉም፥ ወደ አፈራቸውም ይመለሳሉ።

verses.en: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.
verses.fr: Tu envoies ton souffle: ils sont créés, Et tu renouvelles la face de la terre.
verses.am: መንፈስህን ትልካለህ ይፈጠራሉም፥ የምድርንም ፊት ታድሳለህ።

verses.en: The glory of the Lord shall endure for ever: the Lord shall rejoice in his works.
verses.fr: Que la gloire de l''Eternel subsiste à jamais! Que l''Eternel se réjouisse de ses oeuvres!
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ክብር ለዘላለም ይሁን፤ እግዚአብሔር በሥራው ደስ ይለዋል።

verses.en: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.
verses.fr: Il regarde la terre, et elle tremble; Il touche les montagnes, et elles sont fumantes.
verses.am: ምድርን ያያል እንድትንቀጠቀጥም ያደርጋል፤ ተራሮችን ይዳስሳል ይጤሳሉም።

verses.en: I will sing unto the Lord as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
verses.fr: Je chanterai l''Eternel tant que je vivrai, Je célébrerai mon Dieu tant que j''existerai.
verses.am: በሕይወቴ ሳለሁ ለእግዚአብሔር እቀኛለሁ፥ ለአምላኬም በምኖርበት ዘመን ሁሉ እዘምራለሁ።

verses.en: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the Lord.
verses.fr: Que mes paroles lui soient agréables! Je veux me réjouir en l''Eternel.
verses.am: ቃሌ ለእርሱ ይጣፍጠው፥ እኔም በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይለኛል።

verses.en: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the Lord, O my soul. Praise ye the Lord.
verses.fr: Que les pécheurs disparaissent de la terre, Et que les méchants ne soient plus! Mon âme, bénis l''Eternel! Louez l''Eternel!
verses.am: ኅጥኣን ከምድር ይጥፉ፤ ዓመፀኞች እንግዲህ አይገኙ። ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኪ። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.en: O give thanks unto the Lord; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.
verses.fr: Louez l''Eternel, invoquez son nom! Faites connaître parmi les peuples ses hauts faits!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ ስሙንም ጥሩ፥ ለአሕዛብም ሥራውን አውሩ።

verses.en: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.
verses.fr: Chantez, chantez en son honneur! Parlez de toutes ses merveilles!
verses.am: ተቀኙለት፥ ዘምሩለት፥ ተአምራቱንም ሁሉ ተናገሩ።

verses.en: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord.
verses.fr: Glorifiez-vous de son saint nom! Que le coeur de ceux qui cherchent l''Eternel se réjouisse!
verses.am: በቅዱስ ስሙ ተጓደዱ፤ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈልግ ልብ ደስ ይበለው።

verses.en: Seek the Lord, and his strength: seek his face evermore.
verses.fr: Ayez recours à l''Eternel et à son appui, Cherchez continuellement sa face!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ፈልጉት ትጸናላችሁም፤ ሁልጊዜ ፊቱን ፈልጉ።

verses.en: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
verses.fr: Souvenez-vous des prodiges qu''il a faits, De ses miracles et des jugements de sa bouche,
verses.am: ባሪያዎቹ የአብርሃም ዘር፥ ለእርሱም የተመረጣችሁ የያዕቆብ ልጆች ሆይ፥ የሠራትን ድንቅ አስቡ፥ ተአምራቱን የአፉንም ፍርድ።

verses.en: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.
verses.fr: Postérité d''Abraham, son serviteur, Enfants de Jacob, ses élus!
verses.am: ባሪያዎቹ የአብርሃም ዘር፥ ለእርሱም የተመረጣችሁ የያዕቆብ ልጆች ሆይ፥ የሠራትን ድንቅ አስቡ፥ ተአምራቱን የአፉንም ፍርድ።

verses.en: He is the Lord our God: his judgments are in all the earth.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est notre Dieu; Ses jugements s''exercent sur toute la terre.
verses.am: እርሱ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችን ነው፤ ፍርዱ በምድር ሁሉ ነው።

verses.en: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.
verses.fr: Il se rappelle à toujours son alliance, Ses promesses pour mille générations,
verses.am: ቃል ኪዳኑን ለዘላለም፥ እስከ ሺህ ትውልድ ያዘዘውን ቃሉን አሰበ፥

verses.en: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;
verses.fr: L''alliance qu''il a traitée avec Abraham, Et le serment qu''il a fait à Isaac;
verses.am: ለአብርሃም ያደረገውን፥ ለይስሐቅም የማለውን፤

verses.en: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:
verses.fr: Il l''a érigée pour Jacob en loi, Pour Israël en alliance éternelle,
verses.am: ለያዕቆብ ሥርዓት እንዲሆን ለእስራኤልም የዘላለም ኪዳን እንዲሆን አጸና።

verses.en: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:
verses.fr: Disant: Je te donnerai le pays de Canaan Comme héritage qui vous est échu.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። ለአንተ የከነዓንን ምድር የርስታችሁን ገመድ እሰጣለሁ፤

verses.en: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.
verses.fr: Ils étaient alors peu nombreux, Très peu nombreux, et étrangers dans le pays,
verses.am: ይህም የሆነው እነርሱ በቍጥር ጥቂቶች ሰዎች፥ እጅግ ጥቂቶችና ስደተኞች ሲሆኑ ነው።

verses.en: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;
verses.fr: Et ils allaient d''une nation à l''autre Et d''un royaume vers un autre peuple;
verses.am: ከሕዝብ ወደ ሕዝብ፥ ከመንግሥታትም ወደ ሌላ ሕዝብ አለፉ።

verses.en: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;
verses.fr: Mais il ne permit à personne de les opprimer, Et il châtia des rois à cause d''eux:
verses.am: በምድር ላይ ራብን ጠራ፥ የእህልን ኃይል ሁሉ ሰበረ።

verses.en: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
verses.fr: Ne touchez pas à mes oints, Et ne faites pas de mal à mes prophètes!
verses.am: በምድር ላይ ራብን ጠራ፥ የእህልን ኃይል ሁሉ ሰበረ።

verses.en: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.
verses.fr: Il appela sur le pays la famine, Il coupa tout moyen de subsistance.
verses.am: በፊታቸው ሰውን ላከ፤ ዮሴፍ ለባርነት ተሸጠ።

verses.en: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:
verses.fr: Il envoya devant eux un homme: Joseph fut vendu comme esclave.
verses.am: እግሮቹም በእግር ብረት ደከሙ፥ እርሱም በብረት ውስጥ ገባ።

verses.en: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:
verses.fr: On serra ses pieds dans des liens, On le mit aux fers,
verses.am: ቃሉ እስኪመጣለት ድረስ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ፈተነው።

verses.en: Until the time that his word came: the word of the Lord tried him.
verses.fr: Jusqu''au temps où arriva ce qu''il avait annoncé, Et où la parole de l''Eternel l''éprouva.
verses.am: ንጉሥ ላከ ፈታውም፥ የአሕዛብም አለቃ አስፈታው።

verses.en: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.
verses.fr: Le roi fit ôter ses liens, Le dominateur des peuples le délivra.
verses.am: የቤቱ ጌታ፥ የጥሪቱ ሁሉ ገዢ አደረገው፥

verses.en: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:
verses.fr: Il l''établit seigneur sur sa maison, Et gouverneur de tous ses biens,
verses.am: አለቆቹን እንደ ፈቃዱ ይገሥጽ ዘንድ፥ ሽማግሌዎቹንም ጥበበኞች ያደርጋቸው ዘንድ።

verses.en: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.
verses.fr: Afin qu''il pût à son gré enchaîner ses princes, Et qu''il enseignât la sagesse à ses anciens.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ወደ ግብጽ ገባ፥ ያዕቆብም በካም አገር ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
verses.fr: Alors Israël vint en Egypte, Et Jacob séjourna dans le pays de Cham.
verses.am: ሕዝቡንም እጅግ አበዛ፥ ከጠላቶቻቸውም ይልቅ አበረታቸው።

verses.en: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.
verses.fr: Il rendit son peuple très fécond, Et plus puissant que ses adversaires.
verses.am: ሕዝቡን ይጠሉ ዘንድ በባሪያዎቹም ላይ ይተነኰሉ ዘንድ ልባቸውን ለወጠ።

verses.en: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.
verses.fr: Il changea leur coeur, au point qu''ils haïrent son peuple Et qu''ils traitèrent ses serviteurs avec perfidie.
verses.am: ባሪያውን ሙሴን የመረጠውንም አሮንን ላከ።

verses.en: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.
verses.fr: Il envoya Moïse, son serviteur, Et Aaron, qu''il avait choisi.
verses.am: የተኣምራቱን ነገር በላያቸው ድንቁንም በካም አገር አደረገ።

verses.en: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.fr: Ils accomplirent par son pouvoir des prodiges au milieu d''eux, Ils firent des miracles dans le pays de Cham.
verses.am: ጨለማን ላከ ጨለመባቸውም፤ በቃሉም ዐመፁ።

verses.en: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.
verses.fr: Il envoya des ténèbres et amena l''obscurité, Et ils ne furent pas rebelles à sa parole.
verses.am: ውኃቸውን ወደ ደም ለወጠ፥ ዓሦቻቸውንም ገደለ።

verses.en: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.
verses.fr: Il changea leurs eaux en sang, Et fit périr leurs poissons.
verses.am: ምድራቸው የንጉሦቻቸውም ቤቶች በጓጕንቸር ሞሉ።

verses.en: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.
verses.fr: Le pays fourmilla de grenouilles, Jusque dans les chambres de leurs rois.
verses.am: ተናገረ፥ የውሻ ዝንብ ትንኝም በዳርቻቸው መጡ።

verses.en: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.
verses.fr: Il dit, et parurent les mouches venimeuses, Les poux sur tout leur territoire.
verses.am: ዝናባቸውን በረዶ አደረገው፥ እሳትም በምድራቸው ተቃጠለች።

verses.en: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.
verses.fr: Il leur donna pour pluie de la grêle, Des flammes de feu dans leur pays.
verses.am: ወይናቸውንና በለሳቸውን መታ፥ የአገራቸውንም ዛፍ ሁሉ ሰበረ።

verses.en: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.
verses.fr: Il frappa leurs vignes et leurs figuiers, Et brisa les arbres de leur contrée.
verses.am: ተናገረ፥ አንበጣም ስፍር ቍጥር የሌለውም ኩብኩባ መጣ፥

verses.en: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,
verses.fr: Il dit, et parurent les sauterelles, Des sauterelles sans nombre,
verses.am: የአገራቸውንም ለምለም ሁሉ በላ፥ የምድራቸውንም ፍሬ በላ።

verses.en: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.
verses.fr: Qui dévorèrent toute l''herbe du pays, Qui dévorèrent les fruits de leurs champs.
verses.am: የአገራቸውንም በኵር ሁሉ፥ የጕልበታቸውን መጀመሪያ ሁሉ መታ።

verses.en: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.
verses.fr: Il frappa tous les premiers-nés dans leur pays, Toutes les prémices de leur force.
verses.am: ከወርቅና ከብርም ጋር አወጣቸው፥ በወገናቸውም ውስጥ ደዌ አልነበረም።

verses.en: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.
verses.fr: Il fit sortir son peuple avec de l''argent et de l''or, Et nul ne chancela parmi ses tribus.
verses.am: ፈርተዋቸው ነበርና ግብጽ በመውጣታቸው ደስ አላት።

verses.en: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.
verses.fr: Les Egyptiens se réjouirent de leur départ, Car la terreur qu''ils avaient d''eux les saisissait.
verses.am: ደመናን ለመሸፈኛ ዘረጋባቸው፥ እሳትንም በሌሊት ያበራላቸው ዘንድ ዘረጋ።

verses.en: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.
verses.fr: Il étendit la nuée pour les couvrir, Et le feu pour éclairer la nuit.
verses.am: ለመኑ፥ ድርጭትንም አመጣላቸው፥ የሰማይንም እንጀራ አጠገባቸው።

verses.en: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
verses.fr: A leur demande, il fit venir des cailles, Et il les rassasia du pain du ciel.
verses.am: ዓለቱን ሰነጠቀ፥ ውኃውም ፈሰሰ፤ ወንዞች በበረሃ ሄዱ፤

verses.en: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.
verses.fr: Il ouvrit le rocher, et des eaux coulèrent; Elles se répandirent comme un fleuve dans les lieux arides.
verses.am: ለባሪያው ለአብርሃም የነገረውን ቅዱስ ቃሉን አስቦአልና።

verses.en: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.
verses.fr: Car il se souvint de sa parole sainte, Et d''Abraham, son serviteur.
verses.am: ሕዝቡንም በደስታ የተመረጡትንም በእልልታ አወጣ።

verses.en: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:
verses.fr: Il fit sortir son peuple dans l''allégresse, Ses élus au milieu des cris de joie.
verses.am: የአሕዛብንም አገሮች ሰጣቸው፥ የወገኖችንም ድካም ወረሱ፥

verses.en: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;
verses.fr: Il leur donna les terres des nations, Et ils possédèrent le fruit du travail des peuples,
verses.am: ሕጉን ይጠብቁ ዘንድ፥ ሥርዓቱንም ይፈልጉ ዘንድ። ሃሌ ሉያ

verses.en: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the Lord.
verses.fr: Afin qu''ils gardassent ses ordonnances, Et qu''ils observassent ses lois. Louez l''Eternel!
verses.am: ሕጉን ይጠብቁ ዘንድ፥ ሥርዓቱንም ይፈልጉ ዘንድ። ሃሌ ሉያ

verses.en: Praise ye the Lord. O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.fr: Louez l''Eternel! Louez l''Eternel, car il est bon, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: ሃሌ ሉያ፤ ቸር ነውና፥ ምህረቱም ለዘላለም ነውና እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ።

verses.en: Who can utter the mighty acts of the Lord? who can shew forth all his praise?
verses.fr: Qui dira les hauts faits de l''Eternel? Qui publiera toute sa louange?
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ኃይል ሥራ ማን ይናገራል? ምስጋናውንስ ሁሉ ማን ያሰማል?

verses.en: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.
verses.fr: Heureux ceux qui observent la loi, Qui pratiquent la justice en tout temps!
verses.am: ፍርድን የሚጠብቁ፥ ጽድቅንም ሁልጊዜ የሚያደርጉ ምስጉኖች ናቸው።

verses.en: Remember me, O Lord, with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;
verses.fr: Eternel, souviens-toi de moi dans ta bienveillance pour ton peuple! Souviens-toi de moi en lui accordant ton secours,
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በሕዝብህ ሞገስ አስበን፥ በመድኃኒትህም ጐብኘን፤

verses.en: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.
verses.fr: Afin que je voie le bonheur de tes élus, Que je me réjouisse de la joie de ton peuple, Et que je me glorifie avec ton héritage!
verses.am: የመረጥሃቸውን በጎነት እናይ ዘንድ፥ በሕዝብህም ደስታ ደስ ይለን ዘንድ፥ ከርስትህም ጋር እንጓደድ ዘንድ።

verses.en: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
verses.fr: Nous avons péché comme nos pères, Nous avons commis l''iniquité, nous avons fait le mal.
verses.am: ከአባቶቻችን ጋር ኃጢአትን ሠራን፥ ዐመፅንም፥ በደልንም።

verses.en: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.
verses.fr: Nos pères en Egypte ne furent pas attentifs à tes miracles, Ils ne se rappelèrent pas la multitude de tes grâces, Ils furent rebelles près de la mer, près de la mer Rouge.
verses.am: አባቶቻችን በግብጽ ሳሉ ተኣምራትህን አላስተዋሉም፥ የምሕረትህንም ብዛት አላሰቡም፤ በኤርትራ ባሕር ባለፉ ጊዜ ዐመፁብህ።

verses.en: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.
verses.fr: Mais il les sauva à cause de son nom, Pour manifester sa puissance.
verses.am: ኃይሉን ግን ለማስታወቅ። ስለ ስሙ አዳናቸው።

verses.en: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.
verses.fr: Il menaça la mer Rouge, et elle se dessécha; Et il les fit marcher à travers les abîmes comme dans un désert.
verses.am: የኤርትራንም ባሕር ገሠጸ እርሱም ደረቀ፤ እንደ ምድረ በዳ በጥልቅ መራቸው።

verses.en: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
verses.fr: Il les sauva de la main de celui qui les haïssait, Il les délivra de la main de l''ennemi.
verses.am: ከሚጠሉአቸውም እጅ አዳናቸው፥ ከጠላትም እጅ ተቤዣቸው።

verses.en: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.
verses.fr: Les eaux couvrirent leurs adversaires: Il n''en resta pas un seul.
verses.am: ያሳደዱአቸውንም ውኃ ደፈናቸው፥ ከእነርሱም አንድ አልቀረም።

verses.en: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.
verses.fr: Et ils crurent à ses paroles, Ils chantèrent ses louanges.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ በቃሉ አመኑ፥ ምስጋናውንም ዘመሩ።

verses.en: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:
verses.fr: Mais ils oublièrent bientôt ses oeuvres, Ils n''attendirent pas l''exécution de ses desseins.
verses.am: ፈጥነውም ሥራውን ረሱ፥ በምክሩም አልታገሡም።

verses.en: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert.
verses.fr: Ils furent saisis de convoitise dans le désert, Et ils tentèrent Dieu dans la solitude.
verses.am: በምድረ በዳም ምኞትን ተመኙ፥ በበረሃም እግዚአብሔርን ተፈታተኑት።

verses.en: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.
verses.fr: Il leur accorda ce qu''ils demandaient; Puis il envoya le dépérissement dans leur corps.
verses.am: የለመኑትንም ሰጣቸው፤ ለነፍሳቸው ግን ክሳትን ላከ።

verses.en: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the Lord.
verses.fr: Ils se montrèrent, dans le camp, jaloux contre Moïse, Contre Aaron, le saint de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሙሴንም እግዚአብሔር የቀደሰውንም አሮንን በሰፈር ተመቀኙአቸው።

verses.en: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan and covered the company of Abiram.
verses.fr: La terre s''ouvrit et engloutit Dathan, Et elle se referma sur la troupe d''Abiram;
verses.am: ምድርም ተከፈተች ዳታንንም ዋጠችው፥ የአቤሮንንም ወገን ደፈነች፤

verses.en: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.
verses.fr: Le feu embrasa leur troupe, La flamme consuma les méchants.
verses.am: በማኅበራቸውም እሳት ነደደች፥ ነበልባልም ኅጥኣንን አቃጠላቸው።

verses.en: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.
verses.fr: Ils firent un veau en Horeb, Ils se prosternèrent devant une image de fonte,
verses.am: በኮሬብም ጥጃን ሠሩ፥ ቀልጦ ለተሠራ ምስልም ሰገዱ።

verses.en: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.
verses.fr: Ils échangèrent leur gloire Contre la figure d''un boeuf qui mange l''herbe.
verses.am: ሣርም በሚበላ በበሬ ምሳሌ ክብራቸውን ለወጡ።

verses.en: They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;
verses.fr: Ils oublièrent Dieu, leur sauveur, Qui avait fait de grandes choses en Egypte,
verses.am: እንዳያጠፋቸው ቍጣውን ይመልስ ዘንድ የተመረጠው ሙሴ በመቅሠፍት ጊዜ በፊቱ ባይቆም ኖሮ፥ ያጠፋቸው ዘንድ ተናገረ።

verses.en: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.
verses.fr: Des miracles dans le pays de Cham, Des prodiges sur la mer Rouge.
verses.am: እንዳያጠፋቸው ቍጣውን ይመልስ ዘንድ የተመረጠው ሙሴ በመቅሠፍት ጊዜ በፊቱ ባይቆም ኖሮ፥ ያጠፋቸው ዘንድ ተናገረ።

verses.en: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.
verses.fr: Et il parla de les exterminer; Mais Moïse, son élu, se tint à la brèche devant lui, Pour détourner sa fureur et l''empêcher de les détruire.
verses.am: የተወደደችውን ምድር ናቁ፥ በቃሉም አልታመኑም፥

verses.en: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:
verses.fr: Ils méprisèrent le pays des délices; Ils ne crurent pas à la parole de l''Eternel,
verses.am: በድንኳኖቻቸውም ውስጥ አንጐራጐሩ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አልሰሙም።

verses.en: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of the Lord.
verses.fr: Ils murmurèrent dans leurs tentes, Ils n''obéirent point à sa voix.
verses.am: በብዔል ፌጎርም ተባበሩበት፥ የሙታንንም መሥዋዕት በሉ።

verses.en: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:
verses.fr: Et il leva la main pour jurer De les faire tomber dans le désert,
verses.am: በብዔል ፌጎርም ተባበሩበት፥ የሙታንንም መሥዋዕት በሉ።

verses.en: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.
verses.fr: De faire tomber leur postérité parmi les nations, Et de les disperser au milieu des pays.
verses.am: በሥራቸውም አስመረሩት፥ ቸነፈርም በላያቸው በዛ።

verses.en: They joined themselves also unto Baalpeor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
verses.fr: Ils s''attachèrent à Baal-Peor, Et mangèrent des victimes sacrifiées aux morts.
verses.am: ፊንሐስም ተነሥቶ ፈረደባቸው፥ ቸነፈሩም ተወ፤

verses.en: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.
verses.fr: Ils irritèrent l''Eternel par leurs actions, Et une plaie fit irruption parmi eux.
verses.am: ያም እስከ ዘላለም ለልጅ ልጅ ጽድቅ ሆኖ ተቈጠረለት።

verses.en: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.
verses.fr: Phinées se leva pour intervenir, Et la plaie s''arrêta;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዳላቸው አሕዛብን አላጠፉም፤

verses.en: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.
verses.fr: Cela lui fut imputé à justice, De génération en génération pour toujours.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እንዳላቸው አሕዛብን አላጠፉም፤

verses.en: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:
verses.fr: Ils irritèrent l''Eternel près des eaux de Meriba; Et Moïse fut puni à cause d''eux,
verses.am: ከአሕዛብም ጋር ተደባለቁ፥ ሥራቸውንም ተማሩ።

verses.en: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.
verses.fr: Car ils aigrirent son esprit, Et il s''exprima légèrement des lèvres.
verses.am: ለጣዖቶቻቸውም ተገዙ፥ ወጥመድም ሆኑባቸው።

verses.en: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the Lord commanded them:
verses.fr: Ils ne détruisirent point les peuples Que l''Eternel leur avait ordonné de détruire.
verses.am: ወንዶች ልጆቻቸውንና ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውን ለአጋንንት ሠው፤

verses.en: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.
verses.fr: Ils se mêlèrent avec les nations, Et ils apprirent leurs oeuvres.
verses.am: የወንዶች ልጆቻቸውንና የሴቶች ልጆቻቸን ደም፥ ለከነዓን ጣዖቶች የሠውአቸውን ንጹሕ ደም አፈሰሱ፥ ምድርም በደም ረከሰች።

verses.en: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.
verses.fr: Ils servirent leurs idoles, Qui furent pour eux un piège;
verses.am: በሥራቸው ረከሱ፥ በማድረጋቸውም አመነዘሩ።

verses.en: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,
verses.fr: Ils sacrifièrent leurs fils Et leurs filles aux idoles,
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ በሕዝቡ ላይ ነደደ፥ ርስቱንም ተጸየፈ።

verses.en: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.
verses.fr: Ils répandirent le sang innocent, Le sang de leurs fils et de leurs filles, Qu''ils sacrifièrent aux idoles de Canaan, Et le pays fut profané par des meurtres.
verses.am: ወደ አሕዛብም እጅ አሳለፋቸው፥ የሚጠሉአቸውም ገዙአቸው።

verses.en: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.
verses.fr: Ils se souillèrent par leurs oeuvres, Ils se prostituèrent par leurs actions.
verses.am: ጠላቶቻቸውም ግፍ አደረጉባቸው፥ ከእጃቸውም በታች ተዋረዱ።

verses.en: Therefore was the wrath of the Lord kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.
verses.fr: La colère de l''Eternel s''enflamma contre son peuple, Et il prit en horreur son héritage.
verses.am: ብዙ ጊዜ አዳናቸው፤ ነገር ግን በምክራቸው አስመረሩት፥ በኃጢአታቸውም ተዋረዱ።

verses.en: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.
verses.fr: Il les livra entre les mains des nations; Ceux qui les haïssaient dominèrent sur eux;
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ጩኸታቸውን በሰማ ጊዜ ጭንቃቸውን ተመለከተ፤

verses.en: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.
verses.fr: Leurs ennemis les opprimèrent, Et ils furent humiliés sous leur puissance.
verses.am: ለእነርሱም ኪዳኑን አሰበ፥ እንደ ምሕረቱም ብዛት ተጸጸተ።

verses.en: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.
verses.fr: Plusieurs fois il les délivra; Mais ils se montrèrent rebelles dans leurs desseins, Et ils devinrent malheureux par leur iniquité.
verses.am: በማረኩአቸውም ሁሉ ፊት ሞገስን ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:
verses.fr: Il vit leur détresse, Lorsqu''il entendit leurs supplications.
verses.am: አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ አድነን፤ ቅዱስ ስምህን እናመሰግን ዘንድ፥ በምስጋናህም እንመካ ዘንድ፥ ከአሕዛብ መካከል ሰብስበን።

verses.en: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.
verses.fr: Il se souvint en leur faveur de son alliance;
verses.am: ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ይባረክ ሕዝብም ሁሉ አሜን ይበል። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.en: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.
verses.fr: Il eut pitié selon sa grande bonté, Et il excita pour eux la compassion De tous ceux qui les retenaient captifs.
verses.am: በማረኩአቸውም ሁሉ ፊት ሞገስን ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: Save us, O Lord our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.
verses.fr: Sauve-nous, Eternel, notre Dieu! Et rassemble-nous du milieu des nations, Afin que nous célébrions ton saint nom, Et que nous mettions notre gloire à te louer!
verses.am: አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፥ አድነን፤ ቅዱስ ስምህን እናመሰግን ዘንድ፥ በምስጋናህም እንመካ ዘንድ፥ ከአሕዛብ መካከል ሰብስበን።

verses.en: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the Lord.
verses.fr: Béni soit l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, d''éternité en éternité! Et que tout le peuple dise: Amen! Louez l''Eternel!
verses.am: ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ይባረክ ሕዝብም ሁሉ አሜን ይበል። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.en: O give thanks unto the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.fr: Louez l''Eternel, car il est bon, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: ቸር ነውና፥ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፤

verses.en: Let the redeemed of the Lord say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;
verses.fr: Qu''ainsi disent les rachetés de l''Eternel, Ceux qu''il a délivrés de la main de l''ennemi,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ያዳናቸው፥ ከጠላቶች እጅ ያዳናቸው ይናገሩ።

verses.en: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.
verses.fr: Et qu''il a rassemblés de tous les pays, De l''orient et de l''occident, du nord et de la mer!
verses.am: ከምሥራቅና ከምዕራብ፥ ከሰሜንና ከባሕር፥ ከየአገሩ ሰበሰባቸው።

verses.en: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.
