verses.fr: Ils erraient dans le désert, ils marchaient dans la solitude, Sans trouver une ville où ils pussent habiter.
verses.am: ውኃ በሌለበት ምድረ በዳ ተቅበዘበዙ፤ የሚኖሩበትንም ከተማ መንገድ አላገኙም።

verses.en: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
verses.fr: Ils souffraient de la faim et de la soif; Leur âme était languissante.
verses.am: ተራቡ ተጠሙም፥ ነፍሳቸውም በውስጣቸው አለቀች።

verses.en: Then they cried unto the Lord in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
verses.fr: Dans leur détresse, ils crièrent à l''Eternel, Et il les délivra de leurs angoisses;
verses.am: በተጨነቁ ጊዜ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ፥ ከመከራቸውም አዳናቸው፤

verses.en: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.
verses.fr: Il les conduisit par le droit chemin, Pour qu''ils arrivassent dans une ville habitable.
verses.am: ወደሚኖሩበት ከተማ ይሄዱ ዘንድ የቀና መንገድን መራቸው።

verses.en: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.fr: Qu''ils louent l''Eternel pour sa bonté, Et pour ses merveilles en faveur des fils de l''homme!
verses.am: ለሰው ልጆች ስላደረገው ተኣምራት ስለ ምሕረቱም እግዚአብሔርን ያመስግኑ፤

verses.en: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
verses.fr: Car il a satisfait l''âme altérée, Il a comblé de biens l''âme affamée.
verses.am: የተራበችን ነፍስ አጥግቦአልና፥ የተራቈተችንም ነፍስ በበረከት ሞልቶአልና።

verses.en: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;
verses.fr: Ceux qui avaient pour demeure les ténèbres et l''ombre de la mort Vivaient captifs dans la misère et dans les chaînes,
verses.am: በጨለማ በሞትም ጥላ የተቀመጡ፥ በችግር በብረትም የታሰሩ፤

verses.en: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:
verses.fr: Parce qu''ils s''étaient révoltés contre les paroles de Dieu, Parce qu''ils avaient méprisé le conseil du Très-Haut.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስለ ዐመፁ፥ የልዑልንም ምክር ስለ ናቁ፥

verses.en: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.
verses.fr: Il humilia leur coeur par la souffrance; Ils succombèrent, et personne ne les secourut.
verses.am: ልባቸው በድካም ተዋረደ፤ ታመሙ የሚረዳቸውም አጡ።

verses.en: Then they cried unto the Lord in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
verses.fr: Dans leur détresse, ils crièrent à l''Eternel, Et il les délivra de leurs angoisses;
verses.am: በተጨነቁ ጊዜ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ፥ በመከራቸውም አዳናቸው።

verses.en: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.
verses.fr: Il les fit sortir des ténèbres et de l''ombre de la mort, Et il rompit leurs liens.
verses.am: ከጨለማና ከሞት ጥላ አወጣቸው፥ እስራታቸውንም ሰበረ።

verses.en: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.fr: Qu''ils louent l''Eternel pour sa bonté, Et pour ses merveilles en faveur des fils de l''homme!
verses.am: ለሰው ልጆች ስላደረገው ተኣምራት ስለ ምሕረቱም እግዚአብሔርን ያመስግኑ፤

verses.en: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.
verses.fr: Car il a brisé les portes d''airain, Il a rompu les verrous de fer.
verses.am: የናሱን ደዶች ሰብሮአልና፥ የብረቱንም መወርወሪያ ቈርጦአልና።

verses.en: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
verses.fr: Les insensés, par leur conduite coupable Et par leurs iniquités, s''étaient rendus malheureux.
verses.am: ስለ ዓመፃቸው ሰነፉ፥ ስለ ኃጢአታቸውም ተቸገሩ።

verses.en: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.
verses.fr: Leur âme avait en horreur toute nourriture, Et ils touchaient aux portes de la mort.
verses.am: ሰውነታቸው መብልን ሁሉ ተጸየፈች፥ ወደ ሞትም ደጆች ቀረቡ።

verses.en: Then they cry unto the Lord in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.
verses.fr: Dans leur détresse, ils crièrent à l''Eternel, Et il les délivra de leurs angoisses;
verses.am: በተጨነቁ ጊዜም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ፥ ከመከራቸውም አዳናቸው።

verses.en: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.
verses.fr: Il envoya sa parole et les guérit, Il les fit échapper de la fosse.
verses.am: ቃሉን ላከ ፈወሳቸውም፥ ከጥፋታቸውም አዳናቸው።

verses.en: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.fr: Qu''ils louent l''Eternel pour sa bonté, Et pour ses merveilles en faveur des fils de l''homme!
verses.am: ለሰው ልጆች ስላደረገው ተኣምራት ስለ ምሕረቱም እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግኑ፤

verses.en: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.
verses.fr: Qu''ils offrent des sacrifices d''actions de grâces, Et qu''ils publient ses oeuvres avec des cris de joie!
verses.am: የምስጋና መሥዋዕትንም ይሠውለት፥ በእልልታም ሥራውን ይንገሩ።

verses.en: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;
verses.fr: Ceux qui étaient descendus sur la mer dans des navires, Et qui travaillaient sur les grandes eaux,
verses.am: በመርከቦች ወደ ባሕር የሚወርዱ፥ በታላቅ ውኃ ሥራቸውን የሚሠሩ፥

verses.en: These see the works of the Lord, and his wonders in the deep.
verses.fr: Ceux-là virent les oeuvres de l''Eternel Et ses merveilles au milieu de l''abîme.
verses.am: እነርሱ የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ፥ በጥልቅም ያለችውን ድንቁን አዩ።

verses.en: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.
verses.fr: Il dit, et il fit souffler la tempête, Qui souleva les flots de la mer.
verses.am: ተናገረ፥ ዐውሎ ነፋስም ተነሣ፥ ሞገድም ከፍ ከፍ አለ።

verses.en: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.
verses.fr: Ils montaient vers les cieux, ils descendaient dans l''abîme; Leur âme était éperdue en face du danger;
verses.am: ወደ ሰማይ ይወጣሉ ወደ ጥልቅም ይወርዳሉ፤ ነፍሳቸውም በመከራ ቀለጠች።

verses.en: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wit's end.
verses.fr: Saisis de vertige, ils chancelaient comme un homme ivre, Et toute leur habileté était anéantie.
verses.am: ደነገጡ እንደ ስካርም ተንገደገዱ፥ ጥበባቸውም ሁሉ ተዋጠች።

verses.en: Then they cry unto the Lord in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.
verses.fr: Dans leur détresse, ils crièrent à l''Eternel, Et il les délivra de leurs angoisses;
verses.am: በተጨነቁ ጊዜ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኹ፥ ከመከራቸውም አዳናቸው።

verses.en: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
verses.fr: Il arrêta la tempête, ramena le calme, Et les ondes se turent.
verses.am: ዐውሎንም ጸጥ አደረገ፥ ሞገዱም ዝም አለ።

verses.en: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
verses.fr: Ils se réjouirent de ce qu''elles s''étaient apaisées, Et l''Eternel les conduisit au port désiré.
verses.am: ዝም ብሎአልና ደስ አላቸው፤ ወደ ፈለጉትም ወደብ መራቸው።

verses.en: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.fr: Qu''ils louent l''Eternel pour sa bonté, Et pour ses merveilles en faveur des fils de l''homme!
verses.am: ለሰው ልጆች ስላደረገው ተአምራት ስለ ምሕረቱም እግዚአብሔርን ያመስግኑ።

verses.en: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
verses.fr: Qu''ils l''exaltent dans l''assemblée du peuple, Et qu''ils le célèbrent dans la réunion des anciens!
verses.am: በአሕዛብ ጉባኤ ከፍ ከፍ ያድርጉት፥ በሽማግሌዎችም ሸንጎ ያመስግኑት።

verses.en: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;
verses.fr: Il change les fleuves en désert, Et les sources d''eaux en terre desséchée,
verses.am: ወንዞችን ምድረ በዳ፥ የውኃውንም ምንጮች ደረቅ አደረጋቸው፤

verses.en: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
verses.fr: Le pays fertile en pays salé, A cause de la méchanceté de ses habitants.
verses.am: ከተቀመጡባት ክፋት የተነሣ ፍሬያማዋን ምድር ጨው አደረጋት።

verses.en: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.
verses.fr: Il change le désert en étang, Et la terre aride en sources d''eaux,
verses.am: ምድረ በዳን ለውኃ መቆሚያ፥ ደረቁንም ምድር የውኃ ምንጮች አደረገ።

verses.en: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;
verses.fr: Et il y établit ceux qui sont affamés. Ils fondent une ville pour l''habiter;
verses.am: በዚያም ራብተኞችን አስቀመጠ፥ የሚኖርባትንም ከተማ ሠሩ።

verses.en: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.
verses.fr: Ils ensemencent des champs, plantent des vignes, Et ils en recueillent les produits.
verses.am: እርሻዎችንም ዘሩ ወይኖችንም ተከሉ፥ የእህልንም ሰብል አደረጉ።

verses.en: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
verses.fr: Il les bénit, et ils deviennent très nombreux, Et il ne diminue point leur bétail.
verses.am: ባረካቸውም እጅግም በዙ፤ እንስሶቻቸውንም አላሳነሰባቸውም።

verses.en: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.
verses.fr: Sont-ils amoindris et humiliés Par l''oppression, le malheur et la souffrance;
verses.am: እነርሱ በችግር በክፋት በጭንቀት ተዋረዱ እያነሱም ሄዱ፤

verses.en: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.
verses.fr: Verse-t-il le mépris sur les grands, Les fait-il errer dans des déserts sans chemin,
verses.am: በአለቶችም ላይ ኅሣርን፥ አፈሰሰ፥ መንገድም በሌለበት በምድረ በዳ አሳታቸው።

verses.en: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh him families like a flock.
verses.fr: Il relève l''indigent et le délivre de la misère, Il multiplie les familles comme des troupeaux.
verses.am: ችግረኛንም ከችግሩ ረዳው፤ እንደ በጎች መንጋ ወገን አደረገው።

verses.en: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
verses.fr: Les hommes droits le voient et se réjouissent, Mais toute iniquité ferme la bouche.
verses.am: ቅኖች ያያሉ፥ ደስም ይላቸዋል፤ ኃጢአትም ሁሉ አፍዋን ትዘጋለች።

verses.en: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the Lord.
verses.fr: Que celui qui est sage prenne garde à ces choses, Et qu''il soit attentif aux bontés de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ጥበበኛ የሆነና ይህን የሚጠብቅ ማን ነው? እርሱ የእግዚአብሔርን ምሕረት ያስተውላል።

verses.en: O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
verses.fr: Cantique. Psaume de David. Mon coeur est affermi, ô Dieu! Je chanterai, je ferai retentir mes instruments: c''est ma gloire!
verses.am: ልቤ ጽኑ ነው፥ አቤቱ፥ ልቤ ጽኑ ነው፤ እቀኛለሁ በክብሬም እዘምራለሁ።

verses.en: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
verses.fr: Réveillez-vous, mon luth et ma harpe! Je réveillerai l''aurore.
verses.am: በገና ሆይ፥ ተነሥ፥ መሰንቆም፤ እኔም ማልጄ እነሣለሁ።

verses.en: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
verses.fr: Je te louerai parmi les peuples, Eternel! Je te chanterai parmi les nations.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በአሕዛብ መካከል አመሰግንሃለሁ፥ በወገኖችም መካከል እዘምርልሃለሁ፤

verses.en: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.
verses.fr: Car ta bonté s''élève au-dessus des cieux, Et ta fidélité jusqu''aux nues.
verses.am: ምሕረትህ በሰማይ ላይ ታላቅ ናትና፥ እውነትህም እስከ ደመናት ድረስ ነውና።

verses.en: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;
verses.fr: Elève-toi sur les cieux, ô Dieu! Et que ta gloire soit sur toute la terre!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በሰማያት ላይ ከፍ ከፍ በል፥ ክብርህም በምድር ሁሉ ላይ ትሁን።

verses.en: That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.
verses.fr: Afin que tes bien-aimés soient délivrés, Sauve par ta droite, et exauce-nous!
verses.am: ወዳጆችህ ይድኑ ዘንድ፤ በቀኝህ አድን አድምጠኝም።

verses.en: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.fr: Dieu a dit dans sa sainteté: Je triompherai, Je partagerai Sichem, je mesurerai la vallée de Succoth;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በቅድስናው ተናገረ። ደስ ይለኛል፥ ሴኬምንም እካፈላለሁ፥ የሱኮትንም ሸለቆ እሰፍራለሁ።

verses.en: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
verses.fr: A moi Galaad, à moi Manassé; Ephraïm est le rempart de ma tête, Et Juda, mon sceptre;
verses.am: ገለዓድ የእኔ ነው ምናሴም የእኔ ነው፤ ኤፍሬም የራሴ መጠጊያ ነው። ይሁዳ ንጉሤ ነው።

verses.en: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.
verses.fr: Moab est le bassin où je me lave; Je jette mon soulier sur Edom; Je pousse des cris de joie sur le pays des Philistins!
verses.am: ሞዓብ መታጠቢያዬ ነው፥ በኤዶምያስ ላይም ጫማዬን እዘረጋለሁ፤ ፍልስጥኤም ይገዙልኛል።

verses.en: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
verses.fr: Qui me mènera dans la ville forte? Qui me conduit à Edom?
verses.am: ወደ ጽኑ ከተማ ማን ይወስደኛል? ማንስ እስከ ኤዶምያስ ይመራኛል?

verses.en: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?
verses.fr: N''est-ce pas toi, ô Dieu, qui nous as repoussés, Et qui ne sortais plus, ô Dieu, avec nos armées?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የጣልኸኝ አንተ አይደለህምን? አምላክ ሆይ፥ ከሠራዊታችን ጋር አትወጣም።

verses.en: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
verses.fr: Donne-nous du secours contre la détresse! Le secours de l''homme n''est que vanité.
verses.am: በመከራችን ረድኤትን ስጠን፤ የሰውም ማዳን ከንቱ ነው።

verses.en: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
verses.fr: Avec Dieu, nous ferons des exploits; Il écrasera nos ennemis.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ኃይልን እናደርጋለን፤ እርሱም የሚያስጨንቁንን ያዋርዳቸዋል።

verses.en: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. De David. Psaume. Dieu de ma louange, ne te tais point!
verses.am: አምላክ ሆይ፥ ምሥጋናዬን ዝም አትበል፥

verses.en: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
verses.fr: Car ils ouvrent contre moi une bouche méchante et trompeuse, Ils me parlent avec une langue mensongère,
verses.am: የኃጢአተኛ አፍና የተንኰለኛ አፍ በላዬ ተላቅቀውብኛልና፤ በሽንገላ አንደበትም በላዬ ተናገሩ፤

verses.en: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.
verses.fr: Ils m''environnent de discours haineux Et ils me font la guerre sans cause.
verses.am: በጥል ቃል ከበቡኝ፥ በከንቱም ተሰለፉብኝ።

verses.en: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.
verses.fr: Tandis que je les aime, ils sont mes adversaires; Mais moi je recours à la prière.
verses.am: በወደድኋቸው ፋንታ አጣሉኝ፥ እኔ ግን እጸልያለሁ።

verses.en: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
verses.fr: Ils me rendent le mal pour le bien, Et de la haine pour mon amour.
verses.am: በመልካም ፋንታ ክፉን በወደድኋቸውም ፋንታ ጠላትነትን መለሱልኝ።

verses.en: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.
verses.fr: Place-le sous l''autorité d''un méchant, Et qu''un accusateur se tienne à sa droite!
verses.am: በላዩ ኃጢአተኛን ሹም፤ ሰይጣንም በቀኙ ይቁም።

verses.en: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.
verses.fr: Quand on le jugera, qu''il soit déclaré coupable, Et que sa prière passe pour un péché!
verses.am: በተምዋገተም ጊዜ ተረትቶ ይውጣ፤ ጸሎቱም ኃጢአት ትሁንበት።

verses.en: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.
verses.fr: Que ses jours soient peu nombreux, Qu''un autre prenne sa charge!
verses.am: ዘመኖቹም ጥቂት ይሁኑ፤ ሹመቱንም ሌላ ይውሰድ።

verses.en: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
verses.fr: Que ses enfants deviennent orphelins, Et sa femme veuve!
verses.am: ልጆቹም ድሀ አደግ ይሁኑ፥ ሚስቱም መበለት ትሁን።

verses.en: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.
verses.fr: Que ses enfants soient vagabonds et qu''ils mendient, Qu''ils cherchent du pain loin de leur demeure en ruines!
verses.am: ልጆቹም ተናውጠው ይቅበዝበዙ ይለምኑም፥ ከስፍራቸውም ይባረሩ።

verses.en: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.
verses.fr: Que le créancier s''empare de tout ce qui est à lui, Et que les étrangers pillent le fruit de son travail!
verses.am: ባለዕዳም ያለውን ሁሉ ይበርብረው፥ እንግዶችም ድካሙን ሁሉ ይበዝብዙት።

verses.en: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.
verses.fr: Que nul ne conserve pour lui de l''affection, Et que personne n''ait pitié de ses orphelins!
verses.am: የሚያግዘውንም አያግኝ። ለድሀ አደግ ልጆቹም የሚራራ አይኑር።

verses.en: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
verses.fr: Que ses descendants soient exterminés, Et que leur nom s''éteigne dans la génération suivante!
verses.am: ልጆቹ ይጥፉ፤ በአንድ ትውልድ ስሙ ይደምሰስ።

verses.en: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the Lord; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
verses.fr: Que l''iniquité de ses pères reste en souvenir devant l''Eternel, Et que le péché de sa mère ne soit point effacé!
verses.am: የአባቶቹ ኃጢአት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ትታሰብ፤ የእናቱም ኃጢአት አትደምሰስ።

verses.en: Let them be before the Lord continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
verses.fr: Qu''ils soient toujours présents devant l''Eternel, Et qu''il retranche de la terre leur mémoire,
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሁልጊዜ ይኑሩ፤ መታሰቢያቸው ከምድር ይጥፋ።

verses.en: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.
verses.fr: Parce qu''il ne s''est pas souvenu d''exercer la miséricorde, Parce qu''il a persécuté le malheureux et l''indigent, Jusqu''à faire mourir l''homme au coeur brisé!
verses.am: ምሕረትን ያደርግ ዘንድ አላሰበምና ችግረኛንና ምስኪንን ልቡ የተሰበረውንም ሰው ይገድል ዘንድ አሳደደ።

verses.en: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.
verses.fr: Il aimait la malédiction: qu''elle tombe sur lui! Il ne se plaisait pas à la bénédiction: qu''elle s''éloigne de lui!
verses.am: መርገምን ወደደ ወደ እርሱም መጣች፤ በረከትንም አልመረጠም ከእርሱም ራቀች።

verses.en: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.
verses.fr: Qu''il revête la malédiction comme son vêtement, Qu''elle pénètre comme de l''eau dans son intérieur, Comme de l''huile dans ses os!
verses.am: መርገምን እንደ ልብስ ለበሳት፥ እንደ ውኃም ወደ አንጀቱ፥ እንደ ቅባትም ወደ አጥንቱ ገባች።

verses.en: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
verses.fr: Qu''elle lui serve de vêtement pour se couvrir, De ceinture dont il soit toujours ceint!
verses.am: እንደሚለብሰው ልብስ። ሁልጊዜም እንደሚታጠቀው ትጥቅ ይሁነው።

verses.en: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the Lord, and of them that speak evil against my soul.
verses.fr: Tel soit, de la part de l''Eternel, le salaire de mes ennemis, Et de ceux qui parlent méchamment de moi!
verses.am: ይህ ሥራ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ በሚያጣሉኝ በነፍሴም ላይ ክፉን በሚናገሩ ነው።

verses.en: But do thou for me, O God the Lord, for thy name's sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.
verses.fr: Et toi, Eternel, Seigneur! agis en ma faveur à cause de ton nom, Car ta bonté est grande; délivre-moi!
verses.am: አንተ ግን አቤቱ ጌታዬ፥ ስለ ስምህ ምሕረትህን በእኔ ላይ አድርግ፤ ምሕረትህ መልካም ናትና አድነኝ።

verses.en: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
verses.fr: Je suis malheureux et indigent, Et mon coeur est blessé au dedans de moi.
verses.am: እኔ ችግረኛ ምስኪንም ነኝና፥ ልቤም በውስጤ ደነገጠብኝ።

verses.en: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
verses.fr: Je m''en vais comme l''ombre à son déclin, Je suis chassé comme la sauterelle.
verses.am: እንዳለፈ ጥላ አለቅሁ፥ እንደ አንበጣም እረገፍሁ።

verses.en: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.
verses.fr: Mes genoux sont affaiblis par le jeûne, Et mon corps est épuisé de maigreur.
verses.am: ጕልበቶቼ በጾም ደከሙ፤ ሥጋዬም ቅቤ በማጣት ከሳ።

verses.en: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.
verses.fr: Je suis pour eux un objet d''opprobre; Ils me regardent, et secouent la tête.
verses.am: እኔም በእነርሱ ዘንድ ለነውር ሆንሁ፤ ባዩኝ ጊዜ ራሳቸውን ነቀነቁ።

verses.en: Help me, O Lord my God: O save me according to thy mercy:
verses.fr: Secours-moi, Eternel, mon Dieu! Sauve-moi par ta bonté!
verses.am: አቤቱ አምላኬ፥ እርዳኝ፥ እንደ ምሕረትህም አድነኝ።

verses.en: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, Lord, hast done it.
verses.fr: Et qu''ils sachent que c''est ta main, Que c''est toi, Eternel, qui l''as fait!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እጅህ ይህች እንደ ሆነች፥ አንተም ይህችን እንዳደረግህ ይወቁ።

verses.en: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.
verses.fr: S''ils maudissent, toi tu béniras; S''ils se lèvent, ils seront confus, Et ton serviteur se réjouira.
verses.am: እነርሱ ይራገማሉ አንተ ግን ባርክ፤ በእኔ ላይ የሚነሡ ይፈሩ፥ ባሪያህ ግን ደስ ይበለው።

verses.en: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.
verses.fr: Que mes adversaires revêtent l''ignominie, Qu''ils se couvrent de leur honte comme d''un manteau!
verses.am: የሚያጣሉኝ እፍረትን ይልበሱ፤ እፍረታቸውን እንደ መጐናጸፊያ ይልበሱአት።

verses.en: I will greatly praise the Lord with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
verses.fr: Je louerai de ma bouche hautement l''Eternel, Je le célébrerai au milieu de la multitude;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን በአፌ እጅግ አመሰግነዋለሁ። በብዙዎችም መካከል አከብረዋለሁ፤

verses.en: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.
verses.fr: Car il se tient à la droite du pauvre, Pour le délivrer de ceux qui le condamnent.
verses.am: ነፍሱን ከሚያሳድዱአት ያድን ዘንድ በድሀ ቀኝ ቆሞአልና።

verses.en: The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
verses.fr: De David. Psaume. Parole de l''Eternel à mon Seigneur: Assieds-toi à ma droite, Jusqu''à ce que je fasse de tes ennemis ton marchepied.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ጌታዬን። ጠላቶችህን ለእግርህ መቀመጫ እስካደርግልህ ድረስ በቀኜ ተቀመጥ አለው።

verses.en: The Lord shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
verses.fr: L''Eternel étendra de Sion le sceptre de ta puissance: Domine au milieu de tes ennemis!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የኃይልን በትር ከጽዮን ይልክልሃል፤ በጠላቶችህም መካከል ግዛ።

verses.en: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.
verses.fr: Ton peuple est plein d''ardeur, quand tu rassembles ton armée; Avec des ornements sacrés, du sein de l''aurore Ta jeunesse vient à toi comme une rosée.
verses.am: ከአንተ ጋር ቀድሞ በኃይልህ ቀን፥ በቅዱሳን ብርሃን፥ ከአጥቢያ ኮከብ አስቀድሞ ከሆድ ወለድሁህ።

verses.en: The Lord hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
verses.fr: L''Eternel l''a juré, et il ne s''en repentira point: Tu es sacrificateur pour toujours, A la manière de Melchisédek.
verses.am: እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሥርዓት አንተ ለዘላለም ካህን ነህ ብሎ፥ እግዚአብሔር ማለ አይጸጸትም።

verses.en: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
verses.fr: Le Seigneur, à ta droite, Brise des rois au jour de sa colère.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በቀኝህ ነገሥታትን በቍጣው ቀን ይቀጠቅጣቸዋል።

verses.en: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.
verses.fr: Il exerce la justice parmi les nations: tout est plein de cadavres; Il brise des têtes sur toute l''étendue du pays.
verses.am: በአሕዛብ መካከል ይፈርዳል፥ ሬሳዎችንም ያበዛል፤ በሰፊ ምድር ላይ ራሶችን ይቀጠቅጣል።

verses.en: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.
verses.fr: Il boit au torrent pendant la marche: C''est pourquoi il relève la tête.
verses.am: በመንገድ ከፈሳሽ ውኃ ይጠጣል፤ ስለዚህ ራስ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል።

verses.en: Praise ye the Lord. I will praise the Lord with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.
verses.fr: Louez l''Eternel! Je louerai l''Eternel de tout mon coeur, Dans la réunion des hommes droits et dans l''assemblée.
verses.am: ሃሌ ሉያ። አቤቱ፥ በቅኖች ሸንጎ በጉባኤም በፍጹም ልቤ አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.en: The works of the Lord are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
verses.fr: Les oeuvres de l''Eternel sont grandes, Recherchées par tous ceux qui les aiment.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ሥራ ታላቅ ናት፥ ደስ በሚሰኙባት ሁሉ ዘንድ የተፈለገች ናት።

verses.en: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.fr: Son oeuvre n''est que splendeur et magnificence, Et sa justice subsiste à jamais.
verses.am: ሥራው ምስጋናና ግርማ ነው፤ ጽድቁም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

verses.en: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the Lord is gracious and full of compassion.
verses.fr: Il a laissé la mémoire de ses prodiges, L''Eternel miséricordieux et compatissant.
verses.am: ለተአምራቱ መታሰቢያን አደረገ፤ እግዚአብሔር መሓሪና ይቅር ባይ ነው።

verses.en: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.
verses.fr: Il a donné de la nourriture à ceux qui le craignent; Il se souvient toujours de son alliance.
verses.am: ለሚፈሩት ምግብን ሰጣቸው፤ ኪዳኑንም ለዘላለም ያስባል።

verses.en: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.
verses.fr: Il a manifesté à son peuple la puissance de ses oeuvres, En lui livrant l''héritage des nations.
verses.am: የአሕዛብን ርስት ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ ለሕዝቡ የሥራውን ብርታት አሳየ።

verses.en: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.
verses.fr: Les oeuvres de ses mains sont fidélité et justice; Toutes ses ordonnances sont véritables,
verses.am: የእጆቹ ሥራ እውነትና ፍርድ ነው፤ ትእዛዙም ሁሉ የታመነ ነው፥

verses.en: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.
verses.fr: Affermies pour l''éternité, Faites avec fidélité et droiture.
verses.am: ለዘላለምም የጸና ነው፥ በእውነትና በቅንም የተሠራ ነው።

verses.en: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.
verses.fr: Il a envoyé la délivrance à son peuple, Il a établi pour toujours son alliance; Son nom est saint et redoutable.
verses.am: መድኃኒትንም ለሕዝቡ ሰደደ፥ ኪዳኑንም ለዘላለም አዘዘ፤ ስሙ የተቀደሰና የተፈራ ነው።

verses.en: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.
verses.fr: La crainte de l''Eternel est le commencement de la sagesse; Tous ceux qui l''observent ont une raison saine. Sa gloire subsiste à jamais.
verses.am: የጥበብ መጀመሪያ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ነው፥ ለሚያደርጓትም ሁሉ ደኅና ማስተዋል አላቸው፤ ምስጋናውም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

verses.en: Praise ye the Lord. Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.
verses.fr: Louez l''Eternel! Heureux l''homme qui craint l''Eternel, Qui trouve un grand plaisir à ses commandements.
verses.am: ሃሌ ሉያ። እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ፥ ትእዛዙንም እጅግ የሚወድድ ሰው ምስጉን ነው።

verses.en: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
verses.fr: Sa postérité sera puissante sur la terre, La génération des hommes droits sera bénie.
verses.am: ዘሩ በምድር ላይ ኃያል ይሆናል፤ የቅኖች ትውልድ ትባረካለች።

verses.en: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.fr: Il a dans sa maison bien-être et richesse, Et sa justice subsiste à jamais.
verses.am: ክብርና ባለጠግነት በቤቱ ነው፥ ጽድቁም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

verses.en: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
verses.fr: La lumière se lève dans les ténèbres pour les hommes droits, Pour celui qui est miséricordieux, compatissant et juste.
verses.am: ለቅኖች ብርሃን በጨለማ ወጣ፤ መሓሪና ይቅር ባይ ጻድቅም ነው።

verses.en: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.
verses.fr: Heureux l''homme qui exerce la miséricorde et qui prête. Qui règle ses actions d''après la justice.
verses.am: ቸር ሰው ይራራል ያበድራልም፥ በፍርድም ነገሩን ይፈጽማል።

verses.en: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
verses.fr: Car il ne chancelle jamais; La mémoire du juste dure toujours.
verses.am: ለዘላለም አይናወጥም፤ የጻድቅ መታሰቢያ ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

verses.en: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the Lord.
verses.fr: Il ne craint point les mauvaises nouvelles; Son coeur est ferme, confiant en l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከክፉ ነገር አይፈራም፤ በእግዚአብሔር ለመታመን ልቡ የጸና ነው።

verses.en: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.
verses.fr: Son coeur est affermi; il n''a point de crainte, Jusqu''à ce qu''il mette son plaisir à regarder ses adversaires.
verses.am: በጠላቶቹ ላይ እስኪያይ ድረስ ልቡ ጽኑ ነው፥ አይፈራም።

verses.en: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.
verses.fr: Il fait des largesses, il donne aux indigents; Sa justice subsiste à jamais; Sa tête s''élève avec gloire,
verses.am: በተነ ለችግረኞችም ሰጠ፤ ጽድቁ ለዘላለም ዓለም ይኖራል፤ ቀንዱ በክብር ከፍ ከፍ ይላል።

verses.en: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.
verses.fr: Le méchant le voit et s''irrite, Il grince les dents et se consume; Les désirs des méchants périssent.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኛም አይቶ ይቈጣል፥ ጥርሱንም ያፋጫል፥ ይቀልጣልም፤ የኃጢአተኞችም ምኞት ትጠፋለች።

verses.en: Praise ye the Lord. Praise, O ye servants of the Lord, praise the name of the Lord.
verses.fr: Louez l''Eternel! Serviteurs de l''Eternel, louez, Louez le nom de l''Eternel!
verses.am: ሃሌ ሉያ። የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያዎች ሆይ፥ አመስግኑት፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም አመስግኑ።

verses.en: Blessed be the name of the Lord from this time forth and for evermore.
verses.fr: Que le nom de l''Eternel soit béni, Dès maintenant et à jamais!
verses.am: ከዛሬ ጀምሮ እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ የእግዚአብሔር ስም ቡሩክ ይሁን።

verses.en: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the Lord's name is to be praised.
verses.fr: Du lever du soleil jusqu''à son couchant, Que le nom de l''Eternel soit célébré!
verses.am: ከፀሐይ መውጫ ጀምሮ እስከ መግቢያው ድረስ የእግዚአብሔር ስም ይመስገን።

verses.en: The Lord is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est élevé au-dessus de toutes les nations, Sa gloire est au-dessus des cieux.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ላይ ከፍተኛ ነው፥ ክብሩም ከሰማያት በላይ ነው።

verses.en: Who is like unto the Lord our God, who dwelleth on high,
verses.fr: Qui est semblable à l''Eternel, notre Dieu? Il a sa demeure en haut;
verses.am: እንደ አምላካችን እንደ እግዚአብሔር ማን ነው? በላይ የሚኖር፤

verses.en: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!
verses.fr: Il abaisse les regards Sur les cieux et sur la terre.
verses.am: በሰማይና በምድር የተዋረዱትን የሚያይ፤

verses.en: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;
verses.fr: De la poussière il retire le pauvre, Du fumier il relève l''indigent,

verses.en: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
verses.fr: Pour les faire asseoir avec les grands, Avec les grands de son peuple.
verses.am: ከአለቆች ጋር ከሕዝቡም አለቆች ጋር ያኖረው ዘንድ ችግረኛን ከመሬት የሚያነሣ፥ ምስኪኑንም ከፋንድያ ከፍ ከፍ የሚያደርግ፤

verses.en: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the Lord.
verses.fr: Il donne une maison à celle qui était stérile, Il en fait une mère joyeuse au milieu de ses enfants. Louez l''Eternel!
verses.am: መካኒቱን በቤት የሚያኖራት፥ ደስ የተሰኘችም የልጆች እናት የሚያደርጋት። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.en: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;
verses.fr: Quand Israël sortit d''Egypte, Quand la maison de Jacob s''éloigna d''un peuple barbare,
verses.am: እስራኤል ከግብጽ፥ የያዕቆብም ቤት ከእንግዳ ሕዝብ በወጣ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Judah was his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.
verses.fr: Juda devint son sanctuaire, Israël fut son domaine.
verses.am: ይሁዳ መቅደሱ፥ እስራኤልም ግዛቱ ሆነ።

verses.en: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.
verses.fr: La mer le vit et s''enfuit, Le Jourdain retourna en arrière;
verses.am: ባሕር አየች ሸሸችም፥ ዮርዳኖስም ወደ ኋላው ተመለሰ።

verses.en: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.
verses.fr: Les montagnes sautèrent comme des béliers, Les collines comme des agneaux.
verses.am: ተራሮች እንደ ኮርማዎች፥ ኮረብቶችም እንደ ጠቦቶች ዘለሉ።

verses.en: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?
verses.fr: Qu''as-tu, mer, pour t''enfuir, Jourdain, pour retourner en arrière?
verses.am: አንቺ ባሕር የሸሸሽ፥ አንቺም ዮርዳኖስ ወደ ኋላሽ የተመለስሽ፥ምን ሆናችኋል?

verses.en: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; and ye little hills, like lambs?
verses.fr: Qu''avez-vous, montagnes, pour sauter comme des béliers, Et vous, collines, comme des agneaux?
verses.am: እናንተም ተራሮች፥ እንደ ኮርማዎች፥ ኮረብቶችስ፥ እንደ ጠቦቶች ለምን ዘለላችሁ?

verses.en: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;
verses.fr: Tremble devant le Seigneur, ô terre! Devant le Dieu de Jacob,
verses.am: ከያዕቆብ አምላክ ፊት፥ ከጌታ ፊት ምድር ተናወጠች፤

verses.en: Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.
verses.fr: Qui change le rocher en étang, Le roc en source d''eaux.
verses.am: ድንጋዩን ወደ ውኃ መቆሚያ፥ ጭንጫውንም ወደ ውኃ ምንጭ ከለወጠ።

verses.en: Not unto us, O Lord, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth's sake.
verses.fr: Non pas à nous, Eternel, non pas à nous, Mais à ton nom donne gloire, A cause de ta bonté, à cause de ta fidélité!
verses.am: ለእኛ አይደለም፥ አቤቱ፥ ለእኛ አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን ለስምህ ስለ ምሕረትህ ስለ እውነትህም ምስጋናን ስጥ።

verses.en: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?
verses.fr: Pourquoi les nations diraient-elles: Où donc est leur Dieu?
verses.am: አሕዛብ። አምላካቸው ወዴት ነው? አይበሉ።

verses.en: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.
verses.fr: Notre Dieu est au ciel, Il fait tout ce qu''il veut.
verses.am: አምላካችንስ በላይ በሰማይ ነው፤ በሰማይም በምድርም የፈቀደውን ሁሉ አደረገ።

verses.en: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
verses.fr: Leurs idoles sont de l''argent et de l''or, Elles sont l''ouvrage de la main des hommes.
verses.am: የአሕዛብ ጣዖታቶች የወርቅና የብር፥ የሰው እጅ ሥራ ናቸው።

verses.en: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:
verses.fr: Elles ont une bouche et ne parlent point, Elles ont des yeux et ne voient point,
verses.am: አፍ አላቸው አይናገሩምም፤ ዓይን አላቸው አያዩምም፤

verses.en: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:
verses.fr: Elles ont des oreilles et n''entendent point, Elles ont un nez et ne sentent point,
verses.am: ጆሮ አላቸው አይሰሙምም፤ አፍንጫ አላቸው አያሸትቱምም፤

verses.en: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.
verses.fr: Elles ont des mains et ne touchent point, Des pieds et ne marchent point, Elles ne produisent aucun son dans leur gosier.
verses.am: እጅ አላቸው አይዳሰሱምም፤ እግር አላቸው አይሄዱምም፤ በጕሮሮአቸውም አይናገሩም።

verses.en: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.
verses.fr: Ils leur ressemblent, ceux qui les fabriquent, Tous ceux qui se confient en elles.
verses.am: የሚሠሩአቸውም የሚያምኑባቸውም ሁሉ እንደ እነርሱ ይሁኑ።

verses.en: O Israel, trust thou in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.
verses.fr: Israël, confie-toi en l''Eternel! Il est leur secours et leur bouclier.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ታመኑ፤ ረድኤታቸውና መታመኛቸው እርሱ ነው።

verses.en: O house of Aaron, trust in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.
verses.fr: Maison d''Aaron, confie-toi en l''Eternel! Il est leur secours et leur bouclier.
verses.am: የአሮን ቤት ሆይ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ታመኑ ረድኤታቸውና መታመኛቸው እርሱ ነው።

verses.en: Ye that fear the Lord, trust in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.
verses.fr: Vous qui craignez l''Eternel, confiez-vous en l''Eternel! Il est leur secours et leur bouclier.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን የምትፈሩ ሆይ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ታመኑ፤ ረድኤታቸውና መታመኛቸው እርሱ ነው።

verses.en: The Lord hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.fr: L''Eternel se souvient de nous: il bénira, Il bénira la maison d''Israël, Il bénira la maison d''Aaron,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አሰበን ይባርከንማል፤ የእስራኤልን ቤት ይባረካል፥ የአሮንንም ቤት ይባረካል።

verses.en: He will bless them that fear the Lord, both small and great.
verses.fr: Il bénira ceux qui craignent l''Eternel, les petits et les grands;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈሩትን፥ ትንንሾችንና ትልልቆችን ይባርካል።

verses.en: The Lord shall increase you more and more, you and your children.
verses.fr: L''Eternel vous multipliera ses faveurs, A vous et à vos enfants.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በላያችሁ፥ በላያችሁና በልጆቻችሁ ላይ ይጨምር።

verses.en: Ye are blessed of the Lord which made heaven and earth.
verses.fr: Soyez bénis par l''Eternel, Qui a fait les cieux et la terre!
verses.am: እናንተ ሰማይንና ምድርን ለሠራ ለእግዚአብሔር የተባረካችሁ ናችሁ።

verses.en: The heaven, even the heavens, are the Lord's: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.
verses.fr: Les cieux sont les cieux de l''Eternel, Mais il a donné la terre aux fils de l''homme.
verses.am: የሰማያት ሰማይ ለእግዚአብሔር ነው፤ ምድርን ግን ለሰው ልጆች ሰጣት።

verses.en: The dead praise not the Lord, neither any that go down into silence.
verses.fr: Ce ne sont pas les morts qui célèbrent l''Eternel, Ce n''est aucun de ceux qui descendent dans le lieu du silence;
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ሙታን የሚያመሰግኑህ አይደሉም ወደ ሲኦልም የሚወርዱ ሁሉ፤

verses.en: But we will bless the Lord from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the Lord.
verses.fr: Mais nous, nous bénirons l''Eternel, Dès maintenant et à jamais. Louez l''Eternel!
verses.am: እኛ ሕያዋን ግን ከዛሬ ጀምሮ እስከ ዘላለም እግዚአብሔርን እንባርካለን። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.en: I love the Lord, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.
verses.fr: J''aime l''Eternel, car il entend Ma voix, mes supplications;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የልመናዬን ድምፅ ሰምቶአልና ወደድሁት።

verses.en: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.
verses.fr: Car il a penché son oreille vers moi; Et je l''invoquerai toute ma vie.
verses.am: ጆሮውን ወደ እኔ አዘንብሎአልና በዘመኔ ሁሉ እጠራዋለሁ።

verses.en: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
verses.fr: Les liens de la mort m''avaient environné, Et les angoisses du sépulcre m''avaient saisi; J''étais en proie à la détresse et à la douleur.
verses.am: የሞት ጣር ያዘኝ፥ የሲኦልም ሕማም አገኘኝ፤ ጭንቀትንና መከራን አገኘሁ።

verses.en: Then called I upon the name of the Lord; O Lord, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.
verses.fr: Mais j''invoquai le nom de l''Eternel: O Eternel, sauve mon âme!
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም ጠራሁ። አቤቱ፥ ነፍሴን አድናት።

verses.en: Gracious is the Lord, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est miséricordieux et juste, Notre Dieu est plein de compassion;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር መሓሪና ጻድቅ ነው፥ አምላካችንም ይቅር ባይ ነው።

verses.en: The Lord preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.
verses.fr: L''Eternel garde les simples; J''étais malheureux, et il m''a sauvé.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሕፃናትን ይጠብቃል፤ ተቸገርሁ እርሱም አዳነኝ።

verses.en: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the Lord hath dealt bountifully with thee.
verses.fr: Mon âme, retourne à ton repos, Car l''Eternel t''a fait du bien.
verses.am: ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ ወደ ዕረፍትሽ ተመለሺ፥ እግዚአብሔር መልካም አድርጎልሻልና፤

verses.en: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
verses.fr: Oui, tu as délivré mon âme de la mort, Mes yeux des larmes, Mes pieds de la chute.
verses.am: ነፍሴን ከሞት፥ ዓይኔንም ከእንባ፥ እግሬንም ከመሰናከል አድኖአልና።

verses.en: I will walk before the Lord in the land of the living.
verses.fr: Je marcherai devant l''Eternel, Sur la terre des vivants.
verses.am: በሕያዋን አገር በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እሄዳለሁ።

verses.en: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:
verses.fr: J''avais confiance, lorsque je disais: Je suis bien malheureux!
verses.am: አመንሁ ስለዚህም ተናገርሁ፤ እኔም እጅግ ተቸገርሁ።

verses.en: I said in my haste, All men are liars.
verses.fr: Je disais dans mon angoisse: Tout homme est trompeur.
verses.am: እኔም ከድንጋጤዬ የተነሣ። ሰው ሁሉ ሐሰተኛ ነው አልሁ።

verses.en: What shall I render unto the Lord for all his benefits toward me?
verses.fr: Comment rendrai-je à l''Eternel Tous ses bienfaits envers moi?
verses.am: ስላደረገልኝ ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ምንን እመልሳለሁ?

verses.en: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the Lord.
verses.fr: J''élèverai la coupe des délivrances, Et j''invoquerai le nom de l''Eternel;
verses.am: የመድኃኒትን ጽዋ እቀበላለሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም እጠራለሁ።

verses.en: I will pay my vows unto the Lord now in the presence of all his people.
verses.fr: J''accomplirai mes voeux envers l''Eternel, En présence de tout son peuple.
verses.am: በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ፊት ስእለቴን ለእግዚአብሔር እፈጽማለሁ።

verses.en: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his saints.
verses.fr: Elle a du prix aux yeux de l''Eternel, La mort de ceux qui l''aiment.
verses.am: የቅዱሳኑ ሞት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የከበረ ነው።

verses.en: O Lord, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.
verses.fr: Ecoute-moi, ô Eternel! car je suis ton serviteur, Ton serviteur, fils de ta servante. Tu as détaché mes liens.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እኔ ባሪያህ ነኝ፥ ባሪያህ ነኝ፥ የሴት ባሪያህም ልጅ ነኝ፤ ሰንሰለቴን ሰበርህ።

verses.en: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the Lord.
verses.fr: Je t''offrirai un sacrifice d''actions de grâces, Et j''invoquerai le nom de l''Eternel;
verses.am: ለአንተ የምስጋና መሥዋዕትን እሠዋለሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ስም እጠራለሁ።

verses.en: I will pay my vows unto the Lord now in the presence of all his people.
verses.fr: J''accomplirai mes voeux envers l''Eternel, En présence de tout son peuple,
verses.am: በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ፊት ስእለቴን ለእግዚአብሔር እፈጽማለሁ፥

verses.en: In the courts of the Lord's house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the Lord.
verses.fr: Dans les parvis de la maison de l''Eternel, Au milieu de toi, Jérusalem! Louez l''Eternel!
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባይ፥ ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ በመካከልሽም። ሃሌሉያ

verses.en: O praise the Lord, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.
verses.fr: Louez l''Eternel, vous toutes les nations, Célébrez-le, vous tous les peuples!
verses.am: አሕዛብ ሁላችሁ፥ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑት፥ ወገኖችም ሁሉ ያመስግኑት፤

verses.en: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the Lord endureth for ever. Praise ye the Lord.
verses.fr: Car sa bonté pour nous est grande, Et sa fidélité dure à toujours. Louez l''Eternel!
verses.am: ምሕረቱ በእኛ ላይ ጸንታለችና፤ የእግዚአብሔርም እውነት ለዘላለም ትኖራለች። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.en: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.fr: Louez l''Eternel, car il est bon, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፥ ቸር ነውና፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ናትና።

verses.en: Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.fr: Qu''Israël dise: Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: ቸር እንደ ሆነ፥ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም እንደ ሆነች የእስራኤል ቤት አሁን ይንገሩ።

verses.en: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.fr: Que la maison d''Aaron dise: Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: ቸር እንደ ሆነ፥ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም እንደ ሆነች የአሮን ቤት አሁን ይንገሩ።

verses.en: Let them now that fear the Lord say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.fr: Que ceux qui craignent l''Eternel disent: Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: ቸር እንደ ሆነ፥ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም እንደ ሆነች እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈሩ ሁሉ አሁን ይንገሩ።

verses.en: I called upon the Lord in distress: the Lord answered me, and set me in a large place.
verses.fr: Du sein de la détresse j''ai invoqué l''Eternel: L''Eternel m''a exaucé, m''a mis au large.
verses.am: በተጨነቅሁ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን ጠራሁት፤ ሰማኝ አሰፋልኝም።

verses.en: The Lord is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
verses.fr: L''Eternel est pour moi, je ne crains rien: Que peuvent me faire des hommes?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ረዳቴ ነው፥ አልፈራም ሰው ምን ያደርገኛል?

verses.en: The Lord taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est mon secours, Et je me réjouis à la vue de mes ennemis.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ረዳቴ ነው፥ እኔም በጠላቶቼ ላይ አያለሁ።

verses.en: It is better to trust in the Lord than to put confidence in man.
verses.fr: Mieux vaut chercher un refuge en l''Eternel Que de se confier à l''homme;
verses.am: በሰው ከመታመን ይልቅ በእግዚአብሔር መታመን ይሻላል።

verses.en: It is better to trust in the Lord than to put confidence in princes.
verses.fr: Mieux vaut chercher un refuge en l''Eternel Que de se confier aux grands.
verses.am: በገዦች ተስፋ ከማድረግ ይልቅ በእግዚአብሔር ተስፋ ማድረግ ይሻላል።

verses.en: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the Lord will I destroy them.
verses.fr: Toutes les nations m''environnaient: Au nom de l''Eternel, je les taille en pièces.
verses.am: አሕዛብ ሁሉ ከበቡኝ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ስም አሸነፍኋቸው፤

verses.en: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.
verses.fr: Elles m''environnaient, m''enveloppaient: Au nom de l''Eternel, je les taille en pièces.
verses.am: መክበቡንስ ከበቡኝ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ስም አሸነፍኋቸው፤

verses.en: They compassed me about like bees: they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.
verses.fr: Elles m''environnaient comme des abeilles; Elles s''éteignent comme un feu d''épines; Au nom de l''Eternel, je les taille en pièces.
verses.am: ንብ ማርን እንዲከብብ ከበቡኝ፥ እሳትም በእሾህ ውስጥ እንዲነድድ ነደዱ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ስም አሸነፍኋቸው።

verses.en: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the Lord helped me.
verses.fr: Tu me poussais pour me faire tomber; Mais l''Eternel m''a secouru.
verses.am: ገፋኸኝ፥ ለመውደቅም ተንገዳገድሁ፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን አገዘኝ።

verses.en: The Lord is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est ma force et le sujet de mes louanges; C''est lui qui m''a sauvé.
verses.am: ኃይሌም ዝማሬዬም እግዚአብሔር ነው፥ እርሱም መድኃኒት ሆነልኝ።

verses.en: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the Lord doeth valiantly.
verses.fr: Des cris de triomphe et de salut s''élèvent dans les tentes des justes: La droite de l''Eternel manifeste sa puissance!
verses.am: የእልልታና የመድኃኒት ድምፅ በጻድቃን ድንኳን ነው፤ የእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ኃይልን አደረገች።

verses.en: The right hand of the Lord is exalted: the right hand of the Lord doeth valiantly.
verses.fr: La droite de l''Eternel est élevée! La droite de l''Eternel manifeste sa puissance!
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ከፍ ከፍ አደረገችኝ፤ የእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ኃይልን አደረገች።

verses.en: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the Lord.
verses.fr: Je ne mourrai pas, je vivrai, Et je raconterai les oeuvres de l''Eternel.
verses.am: አልሞትም በሕይወት እኖራለሁ እንጂ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ሥራ እናገራለሁ።

verses.en: The Lord hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.
verses.fr: L''Eternel m''a châtié, Mais il ne m''a pas livré à la mort.
verses.am: መገሠጽስ እግዚአብሔር ገሠጸኝ፤ ለሞት ግን አልሰጠኝም።

verses.en: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the Lord:
verses.fr: Ouvrez-moi les portes de la justice: J''entrerai, je louerai l''Eternel.
verses.am: የጽድቅን ደጆች ክፈቱልኝ፤ ወደ እነርሱ ገብቼ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰግናለሁ።

verses.en: This gate of the Lord, into which the righteous shall enter.
verses.fr: Voici la porte de l''Eternel: C''est par elle qu''entrent les justes.
verses.am: ይህች የእግዚአብሔር ደጅ ናት፤ ወደ እርስዋ ጻድቃን ይገባሉ።

verses.en: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.
verses.fr: Je te loue, parce que tu m''as exaucé, Parce que tu m''as sauvé.
verses.am: ሰምተኸኛልና፥ መድኃኒትም ሆነኸኛልና አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.en: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.
verses.fr: La pierre qu''ont rejetée ceux qui bâtissaient Est devenue la principale de l''angle.
verses.am: ግንበኞች የናቁት ድንጋይ፥ እርሱ የማዕዘን ራስ ሆነ፥

verses.en: This is the Lord's doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.
verses.fr: C''est de l''Eternel que cela est venu: C''est un prodige à nos yeux.
verses.am: ይህች ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ሆነች፥ ለዓይናችንም ድንቅ ናት።

verses.en: This is the day which the Lord hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.fr: C''est ici la journée que l''Eternel a faite: Qu''elle soit pour nous un sujet d''allégresse et de joie!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የሠራት ቀን ይህች ናት፤ ሐሤትን እናድርግ፥ በእርስዋም ደስ ይበለን።

verses.en: Save now, I beseech thee, O Lord: O Lord, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.
verses.fr: O Eternel, accorde le salut! O Eternel, donne la prospérité!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እባክህ፥ አሁን አድን፤ አቤቱ፥ እባክህ፥ አሁን አቅና።

verses.en: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the Lord: we have blessed you out of the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Béni soit celui qui vient au nom de l''Eternel! Nous vous bénissons de la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ስም የሚመጣ ቡሩክ ነው፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ቤት መረቅናችሁ።

verses.en: God is the Lord, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est Dieu, et il nous éclaire. Attachez la victime avec des liens, Amenez-la jusqu''aux cornes de l''autel!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላክ ነው፥ ለእኛም በራልን፤ እስከ መሠዊያው ቀንዶች ድረስ የበዓሉን መሥዋዕት በገመድ እሰሩት።

verses.en: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.
verses.fr: Tu es mon Dieu, et je te louerai; Mon Dieu! je t''exalterai.
verses.am: አንተ አምላኬ ነህ አመሰግንህማለሁ። አንተ አምላኬ ነህ፥ ከፍ ከፍ አደርግሃለሁ፤ ሰምተኸኛልና፥ መድኃኒትም ሆነኸኛልና አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.en: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.fr: Louez l''Eternel, car il est bon, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፥ ቸር ነውና፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ናትና።

verses.en: Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the Lord.
verses.fr: Heureux ceux qui sont intègres dans leur voie, Qui marchent selon la loi de l''Eternel!
verses.am: በመንገዳቸው ንጹሐን የሆኑ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ሕግ የሚሄዱ ምስጉኖች ናቸው።

verses.en: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.
verses.fr: Heureux ceux qui gardent ses préceptes, Qui le cherchent de tout leur coeur,
verses.am: ምስክሩን የሚፈልጉ፥ በፍጹም ልብ የሚሹት ምስጉኖች ናቸው፤

verses.en: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.
verses.fr: Qui ne commettent point d''iniquité, Et qui marchent dans ses voies!
verses.am: ዓመፅንም አያደርጉም፥ በመንገዶቹም ይሄዳሉ።

verses.en: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.
verses.fr: Tu as prescrit tes ordonnances, Pour qu''on les observe avec soin.
verses.am: ትእዛዛትህን እጅግ እንጠብቅ ዘንድ አንተ አዘዝህ።

verses.en: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!
verses.fr: Puissent mes actions être bien réglées, Afin que je garde tes statuts!
verses.am: ሥርዓትህን ለመጠበቅ፤ መንገዶቼ ይቀኑ ዘንድ እወድድ ነበር።

verses.en: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.
verses.fr: Alors je ne rougirai point, A la vue de tous tes commandements.
verses.am: ትእዛዝህን ሁሉ ስመለከት በዚያን ጊዜ አላፍርም።

verses.en: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.
verses.fr: Je te louerai dans la droiture de mon coeur, En apprenant les lois de ta justice.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የጽድቅህን ፍርድ ስማር በቅን ልብ አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.en: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.
verses.fr: Je veux garder tes statuts: Ne m''abandonne pas entièrement!
verses.am: ሥርዓትህን እጠብቃለሁ፤ በፍጹም አትጣለኝ።  ቤት

verses.en: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.
verses.fr: Comment le jeune homme rendra-t-il pur son sentier? En se dirigeant d''après ta parole.
verses.am: ጕልማሳ መንገዱን በምን ያነጻል? ቃልህን በመጠበቅ ነው።

verses.en: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.
verses.fr: Je te cherche de tout mon coeur: Ne me laisse pas égarer loin de tes commandements!
verses.am: በፍጹም ልቤ ፈለግሁህ፥ ከትእዛዝህ አታርቀኝ።

verses.en: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
verses.fr: Je serre ta parole dans mon coeur, Afin de ne pas pécher contre toi.
verses.am: አንተ እንዳልበድል፥ ቃልህን በልቤ ሰወርሁ።

verses.en: Blessed art thou, O Lord: teach me thy statutes.
verses.fr: Béni sois-tu, ô Eternel! Enseigne-moi tes statuts!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ቡሩክ ነህ፤ ሥርዓትህን አስተምረኝ።

verses.en: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.
verses.fr: De mes lèvres j''énumère Toutes les sentences de ta bouche.
verses.am: የአፍህን ፍርድ ሁሉ በከንፈሬ ነገርሁ።

verses.en: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.
verses.fr: Je me réjouis en suivant tes préceptes, Comme si je possédais tous les trésors.
verses.am: እንደ ብልጥግና ሁሉ በምስክርህ መንገድ ደስ አለኝ።

verses.en: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.
verses.fr: Je médite tes ordonnances, J''ai tes sentiers sous les yeux.
verses.am: ትእዛዝህን አሰላስላለሁ፥ መንገድህንም እፈልጋለሁ።

verses.en: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.
verses.fr: Je fais mes délices de tes statuts, Je n''oublie point ta parole.
verses.am: በትእዛዝህ ደስ ይለኛል፤ ቃልህንም አልረሳም።  ጋሜል

verses.en: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.
verses.fr: Fais du bien à ton serviteur, pour que je vive Et que j''observe ta parole!
verses.am: ለባሪያህ መልካም አድርግ ሕያው እንድሆን፥ ቃልህንም እንድጠብቅ።

verses.en: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.
verses.fr: Ouvre mes yeux, pour que je contemple Les merveilles de ta loi!
verses.am: ዓይኖቼን ክፈት፥ ከሕግህም ተኣምራትህን አያለሁ።

verses.en: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.
verses.fr: Je suis un étranger sur la terre: Ne me cache pas tes commandements!
verses.am: እኔ በምድር እንግዳ ነኝ፤ ትእዛዛትህን ከእኔ አትሰውር።

verses.en: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.
verses.fr: Mon âme est brisée par le désir Qui toujours la porte vers tes lois.
verses.am: ነፍሴ ሁልጊዜ ፍርድህን እጅግ ናፈቀች።

verses.en: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.
verses.fr: Tu menaces les orgueilleux, ces maudits, Qui s''égarent loin de tes commandements.
verses.am: ከትእዛዛትህ የሳቱትን ትዕቢተኞችንና ርጉማንን ዘለፍህ።

verses.en: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.
verses.fr: Décharge-moi de l''opprobre et du mépris! Car j''observe tes préceptes.
verses.am: ምስክርህን ፈልጌአለሁና። ስድብንና ነውርን ከእኔ አርቅ።

verses.en: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.
verses.fr: Des princes ont beau s''asseoir et parler contre moi, Ton serviteur médite tes statuts.
verses.am: አለቆች ደግሞ ተቀምጠው እኔን አሙኝ፤ ባሪያህ ግን ሕግህን ያሰላስል ነበር።

verses.en: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counselors.
verses.fr: Tes préceptes font mes délices, Ce sont mes conseillers.
verses.am: ምስክርህም ተድላዬ ነው፥ ሥርዓትህም መካሪዬ ነው።  ዳሌጥ

verses.en: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.
verses.fr: Mon âme est attachée à la poussière: Rends-moi la vie selon ta parole!
verses.am: ነፍሴ ወደ ምድር ተጠጋች፤ እንደ ቃልህ ሕያው አድርገኝ።

verses.en: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.
verses.fr: Je raconte mes voies, et tu m''exauces: Enseigne-moi tes statuts!
verses.am: መንገድህን ነገርሁ ሰማኸኝም፤ ሥርዓትህን አስተምረኝ።

verses.en: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.
verses.fr: Fais-moi comprendre la voie de tes ordonnances, Et je méditerai sur tes merveilles!
verses.am: የሥርዓትህን መንገድ እንዳስተውል አድርገኝ፥ ተኣምራትህንም አሰላስላለሁ።

verses.en: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
verses.fr: Mon âme pleure de chagrin: Relève-moi selon ta parole!
verses.am: ከኀዘን የተነሣ ነፍሴ አንቀላፋች፤ በቃልህ አጠንክረኝ።

verses.en: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.
verses.fr: Eloigne de moi la voie du mensonge, Et accorde-moi la grâce de suivre ta loi!
verses.am: የዓመፅን መንገድ ከእኔ አርቅ፥ በሕግህም ማረኝ፤

verses.en: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.
verses.fr: Je choisis la voie de la vérité, Je place tes lois sous mes yeux.
verses.am: የእውነትህን መንገድ መረጥሁ፥ ፍርድህንም አልረሳሁም።

verses.en: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O Lord, put me not to shame.
verses.fr: Je m''attache à tes préceptes: Eternel, ne me rends point confus!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ምስክርህን ተጠጋሁ፤ አታሳፍረኝ።

verses.en: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.
verses.fr: Je cours dans la voie de tes commandements, Car tu élargis mon coeur.
verses.am: ልቤን ባሰፋኸው ጊዜ፥ በትእዛዝህ መንገድ ሮጥሁ።  ሄ

verses.en: Teach me, O Lord, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.
verses.fr: Enseigne-moi, Eternel, la voie de tes statuts, pour que je la retienne jusqu''à la fin!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የሥርዓትህን መንገድ አስተምረኝ፥ ሁልጊዜም እፈልገዋለሁ።

verses.en: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
verses.fr: Donne-moi l''intelligence, pour que je garde ta loi Et que je l''observe de tout mon coeur!
verses.am: እንዳስተውል አድርገኝ፥ ሕግህንም እፈልጋለሁ፤ በፍጹም ልቤም እጠብቀዋለሁ።

verses.en: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
verses.fr: Conduis-moi dans le sentier de tes commandements! Car je l''aime.
verses.am: እርስዋን ወድጃለሁና የትእዛዝህን መንገድ ምራኝ።

verses.en: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.
verses.fr: Incline mon coeur vers tes préceptes, Et non vers le gain!
verses.am: ልቤን ወደ ምስክርህ አዘንብል፥ ወደ ስስትም አይሁን።

verses.en: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.
verses.fr: Détourne mes yeux de la vue des choses vaines, Fais-moi vivre dans ta voie!
verses.am: ከንቱ ነገርን እንዳያዩ ዓይኖቼን መልስ፤ በመንገድህ ሕያው አድርገኝ።

verses.en: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.
verses.fr: Accomplis envers ton serviteur ta promesse, Qui est pour ceux qui te craignent!
verses.am: እንዲፈራህ ባሪያህን በቃልህ አጽና።

verses.en: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.
verses.fr: Eloigne de moi l''opprobre que je redoute! Car tes jugements sont pleins de bonté.
verses.am: ፍርድህ መልካም ናትና የተጠራጠርሁትን ስድብ ከእኔ አርቅ።

verses.en: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.
verses.fr: Voici, je désire pratiquer tes ordonnances: Fais-moi vivre dans ta justice!
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ትእዛዝህን ናፈቅሁ፤ በጽድቅህ ሕያው አድርገኝ  ዋው

verses.en: Let thy mercies come also unto me, O Lord, even thy salvation, according to thy word.
verses.fr: Eternel, que ta miséricorde vienne sur moi, Ton salut selon ta promesse!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እንደ ቃልህ፥ ምሕረትህና መድኃኒትህ ይምጡልኝ።

verses.en: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.
verses.fr: Et je pourrai répondre à celui qui m''outrage, Car je me confie en ta parole.
verses.am: በቃልህ ታምኛለሁና ለሚሰድቡኝ በነገር እመልስላቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.
verses.fr: N''ôte pas entièrement de ma bouche la parole de la vérité! Car j''espère en tes jugements.
verses.am: በፍርድህም ታምኛለሁና የእውነትን ቃል ከአፌ ፈጽመህ አታርቅ።

verses.en: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.
verses.fr: Je garderai ta loi constamment, A toujours et à perpétuité.
verses.am: ለዘላለም ዓለም ሁልጊዜ ሕግህን እጠብቃለሁ።

verses.en: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.
verses.fr: Je marcherai au large, Car je recherche tes ordonnances.
verses.am: ትእዛዛትህንም ፈልጌአለሁና አስፍቼ እሄዳለሁ።

verses.en: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.
verses.fr: Je parlerai de tes préceptes devant les rois, Et je ne rougirai point.
verses.am: በነገሥታት ፊት ምስክርህን እናገራለሁ፥ አላፍርምም፤

verses.en: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.
verses.fr: Je fais mes délices de tes commandements. Je les aime.
verses.am: እጅግም በወደድኋቸው በትእዛዛትህ ደስ ይለኛል።

verses.en: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.
verses.fr: Je lève mes mains vers tes commandements que j''aime, Et je veux méditer tes statuts.
verses.am: እጆቼንም ወደ ወደድኋቸው ወደ ትእዛዛትህ አነሣለሁ፤ ሥርዓትህንም አሰላስላሁ።  ዛይ

verses.en: Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.
verses.fr: Souviens-toi de ta promesse à ton serviteur, Puisque tu m''as donné l''espérance!
verses.am: ለባሪያህ ተስፋ ያስደረግኸውን ቃልህን አስብ።

verses.en: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.
verses.fr: C''est ma consolation dans ma misère, Car ta promesse me rend la vie.
verses.am: ቃልህ ሕያው አድርጎኛልና ይህች በመከራዬ ደስ አሰኘችኝ።

verses.en: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.
verses.fr: Des orgueilleux me chargent de railleries; Je ne m''écarte point de ta loi.
verses.am: ትዕቢተኞች እጅግ ዐመፁ፤ እኔ ግን ከሕግህ አልራቅሁም።

verses.en: I remembered thy judgments of old, O Lord; and have comforted myself.
verses.fr: Je pense à tes jugements d''autrefois, ô Eternel! Et je me console.
verses.am: ከጥንት የነበረውን ፍርድህን አሰብሁ፥ አቤቱ፥ ተጽናናሁም።

verses.en: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.
verses.fr: Une colère ardente me saisit à la vue des méchants Qui abandonnent ta loi.
verses.am: ሕግህን ከተዉ ከኃጢአተኞች የተነሣ ኅዘን ያዘኝ።

verses.en: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.
verses.fr: Tes statuts sont le sujet de mes cantiques, Dans la maison où je suis étranger.
verses.am: በእንግድነቴ አገር ሥርዓትህ መዝሙር ሆነችኝ።

verses.en: I have remembered thy name, O Lord, in the night, and have kept thy law.
verses.fr: La nuit je me rappelle ton nom, ô Eternel! Et je garde ta loi.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በሌሊት ስምህን አሰብሁ፥ ሕግህንም ጠበቅሁ።

verses.en: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.
verses.fr: C''est là ce qui m''est propre, Car j''observe tes ordonnances.
verses.am: ትእዛዛትህንም ፈልጌአለሁና፤ ይህች ሆነችልኝ።  ሔት

verses.en: Thou art my portion, O Lord: I have said that I would keep thy words.
verses.fr: Ma part, ô Eternel! je le dis, C''est de garder tes paroles.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ክፍሌ ነው፤ ሕግህን እጠብቃለሁ አልሁ።

verses.en: I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.
verses.fr: Je t''implore de tout mon coeur: Aie pitié de moi, selon ta promesse!
verses.am: በፍጹም ልቤ ወደ ፊትህ ተማለልሁ፤ እንደ ቃልህ ማረኝ።

verses.en: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
verses.fr: Je réfléchis à mes voies, Et je dirige mes pieds vers tes préceptes.
verses.am: ስለ መንገዶችህ አሰብሁ፥ እግሬንም ወደ ምስክሮችህ መለስሁ።

verses.en: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.
verses.fr: Je me hâte, je ne diffère point D''observer tes commandements.
verses.am: ትእዛዝህን ለመጠበቅ ጨከንሁ አልዘገየሁምም።

verses.en: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.
verses.fr: Les pièges des méchants m''environnent; Je n''oublie point ta loi.
verses.am: የኃጥኣን ገመዶች ተተበተቡብኝ፤ ሕግህን ግን አልረሳሁም።

verses.en: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.
verses.fr: Au milieu de la nuit je me lève pour te louer, A cause des jugements de ta justice.
verses.am: ስለ ጽድቅህ ፍርድ፥ በእኩለ ሌሊት አመሰግንህ ዘንድ እነሣለሁ።

verses.en: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.
verses.fr: Je suis l''ami de tous ceux qui te craignent, Et de ceux qui gardent tes ordonnances.
verses.am: እኔ ለሚፈሩህ ሁሉ፥ ትእዛዝህንም ለሚጠብቁ ባልንጀራ ነኝ።

verses.en: The earth, O Lord, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.
verses.fr: La terre, ô Eternel! est pleine de ta bonté; Enseigne-moi tes statuts!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህ በምድር ሁሉ ሞላች፤ ሥርዓትህን አስተምረኝ።  ጤት

verses.en: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O Lord, according unto thy word.
verses.fr: Tu fais du bien à ton serviteur, O Eternel! selon ta promesse.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እንደ ቃልህ ለባሪያህ መልካም አደረግህ።

verses.en: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.
verses.fr: Enseigne-moi le bon sens et l''intelligence! Car je crois à tes commandements.
verses.am: በትእዛዛትህ ታምኛለሁና መልካም ምክርና እውቀትን አስተምረኝ።

verses.en: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.
verses.fr: Avant d''avoir été humilié, je m''égarais; Maintenant j''observe ta parole.
verses.am: እኔ ሳልጨነቅ ሳትሁ፤ አሁን ግን ቃልህን ጠበቅሁ።

verses.en: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.
verses.fr: Tu es bon et bienfaisant; Enseigne-moi tes statuts!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ቸር ነህ፥ በቸርነትህም ሥርዓትህን አስተምረኝ።

verses.en: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.
verses.fr: Des orgueilleux imaginent contre moi des faussetés; Moi, je garde de tout mon coeur tes ordonnances.
verses.am: የትዕቢተኞች ዓመፅ በላዬ በዛ፤ እኔ ግን በፍጹም ልቤ ትእዛዛትህን እፈልጋለሁ።

verses.en: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.
verses.fr: Leur coeur est insensible comme la graisse; Moi, je fais mes délices de ta loi.
verses.am: ልባቸው እንደ ወተት ረጋ፤ እኔ ግን በሕግህ ደስ ይለኛል።

verses.en: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.
verses.fr: Il m''est bon d''être humilié, Afin que j''apprenne tes statuts.
verses.am: ሥርዓትህን እማር ዘንድ ያስጨነቅኸኝ መልካም ሆነልኝ።

verses.en: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.
verses.fr: Mieux vaut pour moi la loi de ta bouche Que mille objets d''or et d''argent.
verses.am: ከአእላፋት ወርቅና ብር ይልቅ የአፍህ ሕግ ይሻለኛል።  ዮድ

verses.en: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
verses.fr: Tes mains m''ont créé, elles m''ont formé; Donne-moi l''intelligence, pour que j''apprenne tes commandements!
verses.am: እጆችህ ሠሩኝ አበጃጁኝም፤ እንዳስተውል አድርገኝ፥ ትእዛዛትህንም እማራለሁ።

verses.en: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.
verses.fr: Ceux qui te craignent me voient et se réjouissent, Car j''espère en tes promesses.
verses.am: በቃልህ ታምኛለሁና የሚፈሩህ እኔን አይተው ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: I know, O Lord, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.
verses.fr: Je sais, ô Eternel! que tes jugements sont justes; C''est par fidélité que tu m''as humilié.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ፍርድህ ጽድቅ እንደ ሆነች፥ በእውነትህም እንዳስቸገርኸኝ አወቅሁ።

verses.en: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.
verses.fr: Que ta bonté soit ma consolation, Comme tu l''as promis à ton serviteur!
verses.am: ምሕረትህ ለመጽናናቴ ትሁነኝ፥ እንደ ቃልህም ለባሪያህ ይሁነው።

verses.en: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.
verses.fr: Que tes compassions viennent sur moi, pour que je vive! Car ta loi fait mes délices.
verses.am: ሕግህ ተድላዬ ናትና ቸርነትህ ትምጣልኝ፥ በሕይወትም ልኑር።

verses.en: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.
verses.fr: Qu''ils soient confondus, les orgueilleux qui m''oppriment sans cause! Moi, je médite sur tes ordonnances.
verses.am: ትዕቢተኞች በዓመፅ ጠምመውብኛልና ይፈሩ፤ እኔ ግን በትእዛዝህ እጫወታለሁ።

verses.en: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.
verses.fr: Qu''ils reviennent à moi, ceux qui te craignent, Et ceux qui connaissent tes préceptes!
verses.am: የሚፈሩህና ምስክሮችህን የሚያውቁ ወደ እኔ ይመለሱ።

verses.en: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.
verses.fr: Que mon coeur soit sincère dans tes statuts, Afin que je ne sois pas couvert de honte!
verses.am: እንዳላፍር ልቤ በሥርዓትህ የቀና ይሁን።  ካፍ

verses.en: My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.
verses.fr: Mon âme languit après ton salut; J''espère en ta promesse.
verses.am: ነፍሴ መድኃኒትህን ናፈቀች፤ በቃልህም ታመንሁ።

verses.en: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?
verses.fr: Mes yeux languissent après ta promesse; Je dis: Quand me consoleras-tu?
verses.am: መቼ ታጽናናኛለህ እያልሁ ዓይኖቼ ስለ ቃልህ ፈዘዙ።

verses.en: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.
verses.fr: Car je suis comme une outre dans la fumée; Je n''oublie point tes statuts.
verses.am: በጢስ እንዳለ አቁማዳ ሆኛለሁና፤ ሥርዓትህን ግን አልረሳሁም።

verses.en: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
verses.fr: Quel est le nombre des jours de ton serviteur? Quand feras-tu justice de ceux qui me persécutent?
verses.am: የባሪያህ ዘመኖች ስንት ናቸው? በሚያሳድዱኝስ ላይ መቼ ትፈርድልኛለህ?

verses.en: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.
verses.fr: Des orgueilleux creusent des fosses devant moi; Ils n''agissent point selon ta loi.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኞች ጨዋታን ነገሩኝ፥ አቤቱ፥ እንደ ሕግህ ግን አይደለም።

verses.en: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.
verses.fr: Tous tes commandements ne sont que fidélité; Ils me persécutent sans cause: secours-moi!
verses.am: ትእዛዛትህ ሁሉ እውነት ናቸው፤ በዓመፅ አሳድደውኛል፤ እርዳኝ።

verses.en: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.
verses.fr: Ils ont failli me terrasser et m''anéantir; Et moi, je n''abandonne point tes ordonnances.
verses.am: ከምድር ሊያጠፉኝ ጥቂት ቀርቶአቸው ነበር፤ እኔ ግን ትእዛዛትህን አልተውሁም።

verses.en: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.
verses.fr: Rends-moi la vie selon ta bonté, Afin que j''observe les préceptes de ta bouche!
verses.am: እንደ ምሕረትህ ሕያው አድርገኝ፤ የአፍህንም ምስክር እጠብቃለሁ።  ላሜድ

verses.en: For ever, O Lord, thy word is settled in heaven.
verses.fr: A toujours, ô Eternel! Ta parole subsiste dans les cieux.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ቃልህ በሰማይ ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

verses.en: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
verses.fr: De génération en génération ta fidélité subsiste; Tu as fondé la terre, et elle demeure ferme.
verses.am: እውነትህ ለልጅ ልጅ ናት፤ ምድርን መሠረትሃት እርስዋም ትኖራለች።

verses.en: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.
verses.fr: C''est d''après tes lois que tout subsiste aujourd''hui, Car toutes choses te sont assujetties.
verses.am: ሁሉም ባሪያዎችህ ናቸውና ቀኑ በትእዛዝህ ይኖራል።

verses.en: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
verses.fr: Si ta loi n''eût fait mes délices, J''eusse alors péri dans ma misère.
verses.am: ሕግህ ተድላዬ ባይሆን፥ ቀድሞ በጐስቍልናዬ በጠፋሁ ነበር።

verses.en: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.
verses.fr: Je n''oublierai jamais tes ordonnances, Car c''est par elles que tu me rends la vie.
verses.am: በእርሱ ሕያው አድርገኸኛልና ፍርድህን ለዘላለም አልረሳም።

verses.en: I am thine, save me: for I have sought thy precepts.
verses.fr: Je suis à toi: sauve-moi! Car je recherche tes ordonnances.
verses.am: እኔ የአንተ ነኝ፤ ፍርድህን ፈልጌአልሁና አድነኝ።

verses.en: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.
verses.fr: Des méchants m''attendent pour me faire périr; Je suis attentif à tes préceptes.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኞች ያጠፉኝ ዘንድ ጠበቁኝ፤ ምስክርህን ግን መረመርሁ።

verses.en: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.
verses.fr: Je vois des bornes à tout ce qui est parfait: Tes commandements n''ont point de limite.
verses.am: የሥራህን ሁሉ ፍጻሜ አየሁ፤ ትእዛዝህ ግን እጅግ ሰፊ ነው።  ሜም

verses.en: O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
verses.fr: Combien j''aime ta loi! Elle est tout le jour l''objet de ma méditation.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ሕግህን እንደ ምን እጅግ ወደድሁ! ቀኑን ሁሉ እርሱ ትዝታዬ ነው።

verses.en: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.
verses.fr: Tes commandements me rendent plus sage que mes ennemis, Car je les ai toujours avec moi.
verses.am: ለዘላለም ለእኔ ነውና ትእዛዝህ ከጠላቶቼ ይልቅ አስተዋይ አደረገኝ።

verses.en: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.
verses.fr: Je suis plus instruit que tous mes maîtres, Car tes préceptes sont l''objet de ma méditation.
verses.am: ምስክርህ ትዝታዬ ነውና ካስተማሩኝ ሁሉ ይልቅ አስተዋልሁ።

verses.en: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.
verses.fr: J''ai plus d''intelligence que les vieillards, Car j''observe tes ordonnances.
verses.am: ትእዛዝህን ፈልጌአለሁና ከሽማግሌዎች ይልቅ አስተዋልሁ።

verses.en: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.
verses.fr: Je retiens mon pied loin de tout mauvais chemin, Afin de garder ta parole.
verses.am: ቃልህን እጠብቅ ዘንድ ከክፉ መንገድ ሁሉ እግሬን ከለከልሁ።

verses.en: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.
verses.fr: Je ne m''écarte pas de tes lois, Car c''est toi qui m''enseignes.
verses.am: አስተምረኸኛልና ከፍርድህ አልራቅሁም።

verses.en: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
verses.fr: Que tes paroles sont douces à mon palais, Plus que le miel à ma bouche!
verses.am: ቃልህ ለጕሮሮዬ ጣፋጭ ነው፤ ከማርና ከወለላ ይልቅ ለአፌ ጣፈጠኝ።

verses.en: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.
verses.fr: Par tes ordonnances je deviens intelligent, Aussi je hais toute voie de mensonge.
verses.am: ከትእዛዝህ የተነሣ አስተዋልሁ፤ ስለዚህ የሐሰትን መንገድ ጠላሁ።  ኖን

verses.en: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
verses.fr: Ta parole est une lampe à mes pieds, Et une lumière sur mon sentier.
verses.am: ሕግህ ለእግሬ መብራት፥ ለመንገዴ ብርሃን ነው።

verses.en: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.
verses.fr: Je jure, et je le tiendrai, D''observer les lois de ta justice.
verses.am: የጽድቅህን ፍርድ እጠብቅ ዘንድ ማልሁ፥ አጸናሁም።

verses.en: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O Lord, according unto thy word.
verses.fr: Je suis bien humilié: Eternel, rends-moi la vie selon ta parole!
verses.am: እጅግ ተቸገርሁ፤ አቤቱ፥ እንደ ቃልህ ሕያው አድርገኝ።

verses.en: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O Lord, and teach me thy judgments.
verses.fr: Agrée, ô Eternel! les sentiments que ma bouche exprime, Et enseigne-moi tes lois!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ከአፌ የሚወጣውን ቃል ውደድ፥ ፍርድህንም አስተምረኝ።

verses.en: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.
verses.fr: Ma vie est continuellement exposée, Et je n''oublie point ta loi.
verses.am: ነፍሴ ሁልጊዜ በእጅህ ውስጥ ናት፤ ሕግህን ግን አልረሳሁም።

verses.en: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.
verses.fr: Des méchants me tendent des pièges, Et je ne m''égare pas loin de tes ordonnances.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኞች ወጥመድን ዘረጉብኝ፤ ከትእዛዝህ ግን አልሳትሁም።

verses.en: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
verses.fr: Tes préceptes sont pour toujours mon héritage, Car ils sont la joie de mon coeur.
verses.am: የልቤ ደስታ ነውና ምስክርህን ለዘላለም ወረስሁ።

verses.en: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.
verses.fr: J''incline mon coeur à pratiquer tes statuts, Toujours, jusqu''à la fin.
verses.am: ለዘላለም ለፍጻሜውም ትእዛዝህን አደርግ ዘንድ ልቤን አዘነበልሁ።  ሳምኬት

verses.en: I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.
verses.fr: Je hais les hommes indécis, Et j''aime ta loi.
verses.am: ዓመፀኞችን ጠላሁ፥ ሕግህን ግን ወደድሁ።

verses.en: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
verses.fr: Tu es mon asile et mon bouclier; J''espère en ta promesse.
verses.am: አንተ ረዳቴና መጠጊያዬ ነህ፥ በቃልህም ተማመንሁ።

verses.en: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.
verses.fr: Eloignez-vous de moi, méchants, Afin que j''observe les commandements de mon Dieu!
verses.am: እናንተ ኃጢአተኞች፥ ከእኔ ራቁ፥ የአምላኬንም ትእዛዝ ልፈልግ።

verses.en: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.
verses.fr: Soutiens-moi selon ta promesse, afin que je vive, Et ne me rends point confus dans mon espérance!
verses.am: እንደ ቃልህ ደግፈኝ፥ ሕያውም እሆናለሁ። ከተስፋዬም አልፈር።

verses.en: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.
verses.fr: Sois mon appui, pour que je sois sauvé, Et que je m''occupe sans cesse de tes statuts!
verses.am: እርዳኝ እድናለሁም፥ ሁልጊዜም ሥርዓትህን እመረምራለሁ።

verses.en: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.
verses.fr: Tu méprises tous ceux qui s''écartent de tes statuts, Car leur tromperie est sans effet.
verses.am: ምኞታቸው ዓመፃ ነውና ከሥርዓትህ የሚርቁትን ሁሉ አጐሳቈልሃቸው።

verses.en: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.
verses.fr: Tu enlèves comme de l''écume tous les méchants de la terre; C''est pourquoi j''aime tes préceptes.
verses.am: የምድርን ኃጢአተኞች ሁሉ እንደ ርኵሰት አጠፋሃቸው፤ ስለዚህ ምስክርህን ወደድሁ።

verses.en: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.
verses.fr: Ma chair frissonne de l''effroi que tu m''inspires, Et je crains tes jugements.
verses.am: ሥጋዬ አንተን ከመፍራት የተነሣ ደንገጠ፤ ከፍርድህ የተነሣ ፈርቻለሁ።  ዔ

verses.en: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.
verses.fr: J''observe la loi et la justice: Ne m''abandonne pas à mes oppresseurs!
verses.am: ፍርድንና ጽድቅን ሠራሁ፤ ለሚያስጨንቁኝ አሳልፈህ አትስጠኝ።

verses.en: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.
verses.fr: Prends sous ta garantie le bien de ton serviteur, Ne me laisse pas opprimer par des orgueilleux!
verses.am: ባሪያህን በመልካም ጠብቀው፤ ትዕቢተኞችም አይጋፉኝ።

verses.en: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.
verses.fr: Mes yeux languissent après ton salut, Et après la promesse de ta justice.
verses.am: ዓይኖቼ ለማዳንህ፥ ለጽድቅህም ቃል ፈዘዙ።

verses.en: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.
verses.fr: Agis envers ton serviteur selon ta bonté, Et enseigne-moi tes statuts!
verses.am: ለባሪያህ እንደ ምሕረትህ አድርግ፥ ሥርዓትህንም አስተምረኝ።

verses.en: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.
verses.fr: Je suis ton serviteur: donne-moi l''intelligence, Pour que je connaisse tes préceptes!
verses.am: እኔ ባሪያህ ነኝ፤ እንዳስተውል አድርገኝ፥ ምስክርህንም አውቃለሁ።

verses.en: It is time for thee, Lord, to work: for they have made void thy law.
verses.fr: Il est temps que l''Eternel agisse: Ils transgressent ta loi.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር የሥራ ጊዜ ነው፥ ሕግህንም ሻሩት።

verses.en: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi j''aime tes commandements, Plus que l''or et que l''or fin;
verses.am: ስለዚህ ከወርቅና ከዕንቍ ይልቅ ትእዛዝህን ወደድሁ።

verses.en: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je trouve justes toutes tes ordonnances, Je hais toute voie de mensonge.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ወደ ትእዛዝህ ሁሉ አቀናሁ፥ የዓመፅንም መንገድ ሁሉ ጠላሁ።  ፌ

verses.en: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.
verses.fr: Tes préceptes sont admirables: Aussi mon âme les observe.
verses.am: ምስክሮችህ ድንቆች ናቸው፤ ስለዚህ ነፍሴ ፈለገቻቸው።

verses.en: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
verses.fr: La révélation de tes paroles éclaire, Elle donne de l''intelligence aux simples.
verses.am: የቃልህ ፍቺ ያበራል፥ ሕፃናትንም አስተዋዮች ያደርጋል።

verses.en: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.
verses.fr: J''ouvre la bouche et je soupire, Car je suis avide de tes commandements.
verses.am: አፌን ከፈትሁ፥ አለከለክሁም፤ ወደ ትእዛዝህ ናፍቄአለሁና።

verses.en: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.
verses.fr: Tourne vers moi ta face, et aie pitié de moi, Selon ta coutume à l''égard de ceux qui aiment ton nom!
verses.am: ስምህን ለሚወድዱ እንድምታደርገው ፍርድ፥ ወደ እኔ ተመልከተ ማረኝም።

verses.en: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.fr: Affermis mes pas dans ta parole, Et ne laisse aucune iniquité dominer sur moi!
verses.am: አካሄድን እንደ ቃልህ አቅና፤ ኃጢአትም ሁሉ አይግዛኝ።

verses.en: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.
verses.fr: Délivre-moi de l''oppression des hommes, Afin que je garde tes ordonnances!
verses.am: ከሰው ግፍ አድነኝ፤ ትእዛዝህንም እጠብቃለሁ።

verses.en: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.
verses.fr: Fais luire ta face sur ton serviteur, Et enseigne-moi tes statuts!
verses.am: በባሪያህ ላይ ፊትህን አብራ፥ ሥርዓትህንም አሰተምረኝ።

verses.en: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.
verses.fr: Mes yeux répandent des torrents d''eaux, Parce qu''on n''observe point ta loi.
verses.am: ሕግህን አልጠበቅሁምና የውኃ ፈሳሽ ከዓይኖቼ ፈሰሰ።  ጻዴ

verses.en: Righteous art thou, O Lord, and upright are thy judgments.
verses.fr: Tu es juste, ô Eternel! Et tes jugements sont équitables;
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ጻድቅ ነህ፥ ፍርድህም ቅን ነው።

verses.en: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.
verses.fr: Tu fondes tes préceptes sur la justice Et sur la plus grande fidélité.
verses.am: ምስክርህን በጽድቅ አዘዝህ፥ እጅግም ቅን ነው።

verses.en: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.
verses.fr: Mon zèle me consume, Parce que mes adversaires oublient tes paroles.
verses.am: ጠላቶቼ ቃልህን ረስተዋልና የቤትህ ቅንዓት አቀለጠኝ።

verses.en: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.
verses.fr: Ta parole est entièrement éprouvée, Et ton serviteur l''aime.
verses.am: ቃልህ እጅግ የነጠረ ነው፥ ባሪያህም ወደደው።

verses.en: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.
verses.fr: Je suis petit et méprisé; Je n''oublie point tes ordonnances.
verses.am: እኔ ታናሽና የተናቅሁ ነኝ፤ ትእዛዛትህን ግን አልረሳሁም።

verses.en: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.
verses.fr: Ta justice est une justice éternelle, Et ta loi est la vérité.
verses.am: ጽድቅህ የዘላለም ጽድቅ ነው፥ ቃልህም እውነት ነው።

verses.en: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.
verses.fr: La détresse et l''angoisse m''atteignent: Tes commandements font mes délices.
verses.am: መከራና ችግር አገኙኝ፤ ትእዛዛትህ ግን ተድላዬ ናቸው።

verses.en: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.
verses.fr: Tes préceptes sont éternellement justes: Donne-moi l''intelligence, pour que je vive!
