verses.am: ምስክርህ ለዘላለም ጽድቅ ነው፤ እንዳስተውል አድርገኝ፥ በሕይወትም አኑረኝ።  ቆፍ

verses.en: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O Lord: I will keep thy statutes.
verses.fr: Je t''invoque de tout mon coeur: exauce-moi, Eternel, Afin que je garde tes statuts!
verses.am: በፍጹም ልቤ ጮኽሁ፥ አቤቱ፥ ስማኝ፤ ሥርዓትህን እፈልጋለሁ።

verses.en: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.
verses.fr: Je t''invoque: sauve-moi, Afin que j''observe tes préceptes!
verses.am: ወደ አንተ ጮኽሁ፤ አድነኝ፥ ምስክርህንም እጠብቃለሁ።

verses.en: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.
verses.fr: Je devance l''aurore et je crie; J''espère en tes promesses.
verses.am: ማለዳ ጮኽሁ፤ ቃልህንም ተስፋ አድርጌአለሁ።

verses.en: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
verses.fr: Je devance les veilles et j''ouvre les yeux, Pour méditer ta parole.
verses.am: ቃልህን አስብ ዘንድ ዓይኖቼ ለመማለድ ቀደሙ።

verses.en: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O Lord, quicken me according to thy judgment.
verses.fr: Ecoute ma voix selon ta bonté! Rends-moi la vie selon ton jugement!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እንደ ቸርነትህ ድምፄን ስማ፤ እንደ ፍርድህ ሕያው አድርገኝ።

verses.en: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.
verses.fr: Ils s''approchent, ceux qui poursuivent le crime, Ils s''éloignent de la loi.
verses.am: በዓመፃ የሚያሳድዱኝ ቀረቡ፥ ከሕግህም ራቁ።

verses.en: Thou art near, O Lord; and all thy commandments are truth.
verses.fr: Tu es proche, ô Eternel! Et tous tes commandements sont la vérité.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ቅርብ ነህ፥ መንገዶችህም ሁሉ ቅኖች ናቸው።

verses.en: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.
verses.fr: Dès longtemps je sais par tes préceptes Que tu les as établis pour toujours.
verses.am: ከዘላለም እንደ መሠረትኸው ከቀድሞ ጀምሮ ከምስክርህ የተነሣ አወቅሁ።  ሬስ

verses.en: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.
verses.fr: Vois ma misère, et délivre-moi! Car je n''oublie point ta loi.
verses.am: ሕግህን አልረሳሁምና ችግሬን ተመልከት አድነኝም።

verses.en: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.
verses.fr: Défends ma cause, et rachète-moi; Rends-moi la vie selon ta promesse!
verses.am: ፍርዴን ፍረድ አድነኝም፤ ስለ ቃልህ ሕያው አድርገኝ።

verses.en: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.
verses.fr: Le salut est loin des méchants, Car ils ne recherchent pas tes statuts.
verses.am: መድኃኒት ከኅጥኣን ሩቅ ነው፥ ሥርዓትህን አልፈለጉምና።

verses.en: Great are thy tender mercies, O Lord: quicken me according to thy judgments.
verses.fr: Tes compassions sont grandes, ô Eternel! Rends-moi la vie selon tes jugements!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ቸርነትህ እጅግ ብዙ ነው፤ እንደ ፍርድህ ሕያው አድርገኝ።

verses.en: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.
verses.fr: Mes persécuteurs et mes adversaires sont nombreux; Je ne m''écarte point de tes préceptes,
verses.am: ያሳደዱኝና ያስጨነቁኝ ብዙዎች ናቸው፤ ከምስክር ግን ፈቀቅ አላልሁም።

verses.en: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.
verses.fr: Je vois avec dégoût des traîtres Qui n''observent pas ta parole.
verses.am: ቃልህን አልጠበቁምና ሰነፎችን አይቼ አዘንሁ።

verses.en: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O Lord, according to thy lovingkindness.
verses.fr: Considère que j''aime tes ordonnances: Eternel, rends-moi la vie selon ta bonté!
verses.am: ትእዛዝህን እንደ ወደድሁ ተመልከት፤ አቤቱ፥ በምሕረትህ ሕያው አድርገኝ።

verses.en: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.
verses.fr: Le fondement de ta parole est la vérité, Et toutes les lois de ta justice sont éternelles.
verses.am: የቃልህ መጀመሪያ እውነት ነው፥ የጽድቅህንም ፍርድ ሁሉ ለዘላለም ነው።  ሳን

verses.en: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
verses.fr: Des princes me persécutent sans cause; Mais mon coeur ne tremble qu''à tes paroles.
verses.am: ገዢዎች በከንቱ አሳደዱኝ፤ ከቃልህ የተነሣ ግን ልቤ ደነገጠብኝ።

verses.en: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.
verses.fr: Je me réjouis de ta parole, Comme celui qui trouve un grand butin.
verses.am: ብዙ ምርኮ እንዳገኘ በቃልህ ደስ አለኝ።

verses.en: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.
verses.fr: Je hais, je déteste le mensonge; J''aime ta loi.
verses.am: ዓመፃን ጠላሁ ተጸየፍሁም፤ ሕግን ግን ወደድሁ።

verses.en: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.
verses.fr: Sept fois le jour je te célèbre, A cause des lois de ta justice.
verses.am: ስለ ጽድቅህ ፍርድ ሰባት ጊዜ በቀን አመሰግንሃለሁ።

verses.en: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.
verses.fr: Il y a beaucoup de paix pour ceux qui aiment ta loi, Et il ne leur arrive aucun malheur.
verses.am: ሕግህን ለሚወድዱ ብዙ ሰላም ነው፥ ዕንቅፋትም የለባቸውም።

verses.en: Lord, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.
verses.fr: J''espère en ton salut, ô Eternel! Et je pratique tes commandements.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ማዳንህን ተስፋ አደርግሁ፥ ትእዛዛትህንም ጠበቅሁ።

verses.en: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.
verses.fr: Mon âme observe tes préceptes, Et je les aime beaucoup.
verses.am: ነፍሴ ምስክርህን ጠበቀች እጅግም ወደደችው።

verses.en: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.
verses.fr: Je garde tes ordonnances et tes préceptes, Car toutes mes voies sont devant toi.
verses.am: መንገዶቼ ሁሉ በፊትህ ናቸውና ትእዛዝህንና ምስክርህን ጠበቅሁ።  ታው

verses.en: Let my cry come near before thee, O Lord: give me understanding according to thy word.
verses.fr: Que mon cri parvienne jusqu''à toi, ô Eternel! Donne-moi l''intelligence, selon ta promesse!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴ ወደ ፊትህ ትቅረብ፤ እንደ ቃልህም አስተዋይ አድርገኝ።

verses.en: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.
verses.fr: Que ma supplication arrive jusqu''à toi! Délivre-moi, selon ta promesse!
verses.am: ልመናዬ ወደ ፊትህ ትድረስ፤ እንደ ቃልህ አድነኝ።

verses.en: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.
verses.fr: Que mes lèvres publient ta louange! Car tu m''enseignes tes statuts.
verses.am: ሥርዓትህን አስተምረኸኛልና ከንፈሮቼ ምስጋናን አወጡ።

verses.en: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.
verses.fr: Que ma langue chante ta parole! Car tous tes commandements sont justes.
verses.am: ትእዛዛትህ ሁሉ ጽድቅ ናቸውና አንደበቴ ቃልህን ተናገረ።

verses.en: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.
verses.fr: Que ta main me soit en aide! Car j''ai choisi tes ordonnances.
verses.am: ትእዛዛትህን መርጫለሁና እጅህ የሚያድነኝ ይሁን።

verses.en: I have longed for thy salvation, O Lord; and thy law is my delight.
verses.fr: Je soupire après ton salut, ô Eternel! Et ta loi fait mes délices.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ማዳንህን ናፈቅሁ፤ ሕግህም ተድላዬ ነው።

verses.en: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.
verses.fr: Que mon âme vive et qu''elle te loue! Et que tes jugements me soutiennent!
verses.am: ነፍሴ ትኑርልኝ ታመሰግንህማለች፥ ፍርድህም ይርዳኝ።

verses.en: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.
verses.fr: Je suis errant comme une brebis perdue; cherche ton serviteur, Car je n''oublie point tes commandements.
verses.am: እንደ ጠፉ በግ ተቅበዘበዝሁ፤ ትእዛዛትህን አልረሳሁምና ባሪያህን ፈልገው።

verses.en: In my distress I cried unto the Lord, and he heard me.
verses.fr: Cantique des degrés. Dans ma détresse, c''est à l''Eternel Que je crie, et il m''exauce.
verses.am: በተጨነቅሁ ጊዜ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኽሁ፥ ሰማኝም።

verses.en: Deliver my soul, O Lord, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.
verses.fr: Eternel, délivre mon âme de la lèvre mensongère, De la langue trompeuse!
verses.am: ከዓመፀኛ ከንፈር ከሸንጋይም አንደበት፥ አቤቱ፥ ነፍሴን አድናት።

verses.en: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?
verses.fr: Que te donne, que te rapporte Une langue trompeuse?
verses.am: ስለ ሽንገላ አንደበት ምንም ይሰጡሃል? ምንስ ይጨምሩልሃል?

verses.en: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
verses.fr: Les traits aigus du guerrier, Avec les charbons ardents du genêt.
verses.am: እንደ በረሃ እንጨት ፍም የኃያላን ፍላጾች የተሳሉ ናቸው።

verses.en: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
verses.fr: Malheureux que je suis de séjourner à Méschec, D''habiter parmi les tentes de Kédar!
verses.am: መኖሪያዬ የራቀ እኔ ወዮልኝ፤ በቄዳር ድንኳኖች አደርሁ።

verses.en: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.
verses.fr: Assez longtemps mon âme a demeuré Auprès de ceux qui haïssent la paix.
verses.am: ሰላምን ከሚጠሉ ጋር ነፍሴ ብዙ ጊዜ ኖረች።

verses.en: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.
verses.fr: Je suis pour la paix; mais dès que je parle, Ils sont pour la guerre.
verses.am: እኔ ሰላማዊ ነኝ፤ በተናገኋቸው ጊዜ ግን በከንቱ ተሰለፉብኝ።

verses.en: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
verses.fr: Cantique des degrés. Je lève mes yeux vers les montagnes... D''où me viendra le secours?
verses.am: ዓይኖቼ ወደ ተራሮች አነሣሁ፤ ረዳቴ ከወዴት ይምጣ?

verses.en: My help cometh from the Lord, which made heaven and earth.
verses.fr: Le secours me vient de l''Eternel, Qui a fait les cieux et la terre.
verses.am: ረዳቴ ሰማይና ምድርን ከሠራ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
verses.fr: Il ne permettra point que ton pied chancelle; Celui qui te garde ne sommeillera point.
verses.am: እግርህን ለመናወጥ አይሰጠውም፤ የሚጠብቅህም አይተኛም።

verses.en: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.fr: Voici, il ne sommeille ni ne dort, Celui qui garde Israël.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እስራኤልን የሚጠብቅ አይተኛም አያንቀላፋምም።

verses.en: The Lord is thy keeper: the Lord is thy shade upon thy right hand.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est celui qui te garde, L''Eternel est ton ombre à ta main droite.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ይጠብቅሃል፥ እግዚአብሔርም በቀኝ እጅህ በኩል ይጋርድሃል።

verses.en: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.
verses.fr: Pendant le jour le soleil ne te frappera point, Ni la lune pendant la nuit.
verses.am: ፀሐይ በቀን አያቃጥልህም ጨረቃም በሌሊት።

verses.en: The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.
verses.fr: L''Eternel te gardera de tout mal, Il gardera ton âme;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከክፉ ሁሉ ይጠብቅሃል፥ ነፍስህንም ይጠብቃታል።

verses.en: The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
verses.fr: L''Eternel gardera ton départ et ton arrivée, Dès maintenant et à jamais.
verses.am: ከዛሬ ጀምሮ እስከ ዘላለም እግዚአብሔር መውጣትህና መግባትህን ይጠብቃል።

verses.en: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Cantique des degrés. De David. Je suis dans la joie quand on me dit: Allons à la maison de l''Eternel!
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እንሄድ ባሉኝ ጊዜ ደስ አለኝ።

verses.en: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Nos pieds s''arrêtent Dans tes portes, Jérusalem!
verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ እግሮቻችን በአደባባይሽ ቆሙ።

verses.en: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:
verses.fr: Jérusalem, tu es bâtie Comme une ville dont les parties sont liées ensemble.
verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌምስ እርስ በርስዋ እንደ ተገጠገጠች ከተማ ተሠርታለች።

verses.en: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the Lord, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the Lord.
verses.fr: C''est là que montent les tribus, les tribus de l''Eternel, Selon la loi d''Israël, Pour louer le nom de l''Eternel.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ስም ያመስግኑ ዘንድ፥ ለእስራኤል ምስክር ሊሆኑ የእግዚአብሔር ነገዶች ወደዚያ ይወጣሉ።

verses.en: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
verses.fr: Car là sont les trônes pour la justice, Les trônes de la maison de David.
verses.am: ዙፋኖች በዚያ ለፍርድ ተቀምጠዋልና፥ የዳዊት ቤት ዙፋኖች።

verses.en: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.
verses.fr: Demandez la paix de Jérusalem. Que ceux qui t''aiment jouissent du repos!
verses.am: ለኢየሩሳሌም ሰላምን ለምኑ፤ አንተንም ለሚወድዱ ልማት ይሁን።

verses.en: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.
verses.fr: Que la paix soit dans tes murs, Et la tranquillité dans tes palais!
verses.am: በኃይልህ ሰላም፥ በጌጠኛ ቤትህም ልማት ይሁን።

verses.en: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.
verses.fr: A cause de mes frères et de mes amis, Je désire la paix dans ton sein;
verses.am: ስለ ወንድሞቼ ስለ ባልንጀሮቼም፥ በውስጥሽ ሰላም ይሁን አልሁ።

verses.en: Because of the house of the Lord our God I will seek thy good.
verses.fr: A cause de la maison de l''Eternel, notre Dieu, Je fais des voeux pour ton bonheur.
verses.am: ስለ አምላካችን ስለ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ላንቺ መልካምነትሽን ፈለግሁ።

verses.en: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.
verses.fr: Cantique des degrés, Je lève mes yeux vers toi, Qui sièges dans les cieux.
verses.am: 1 በሰማይ የምትኖር ሆይ፥ ዓይኖቼን ወደ አንተ አነሣሁ።

verses.en: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the Lord our God, until that he have mercy upon us.
verses.fr: Voici, comme les yeux des serviteurs sont fixés sur la main de leurs maîtres, Et les yeux de la servante sur la main de sa maîtresse, Ainsi nos yeux se tournent vers l''Eternel, notre Dieu, Jusqu''à ce qu''il ait pitié de nous.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ የባሪያዎች ዓይኖች ወደ ጌታቸው እጅ እንደ ሆኑ፥ የባሪያይቱም ዓይን ወደ እመቤትዋ እጅ እንደ ሆነ፥ እንዲሁ እስኪምረን ድረስ ዓይናችን ወደ አምላካችን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: Have mercy upon us, O Lord, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
verses.fr: Aie pitié de nous, Eternel, aie pitié de nous! Car nous sommes assez rassasiés de mépris;
verses.am: ማረን፥ አቤቱ፥ ማረን፤ ንቀትን እጅግ ጠግበናልና፤

verses.en: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.
verses.fr: Notre âme est assez rassasiée Des moqueries des orgueilleux, du mépris des hautains.
verses.am: የባለጠጎች ስድብና የትዕቢተኞችን ንቀት ነፍሳችን እጅግ ጠገበች።

verses.en: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, now may Israel say;
verses.fr: Cantique des degrés. De David. Sans l''Eternel qui nous protégea, Qu''Israël le dise!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከእኛ ጋር ባይሆን እስራኤል እንዲህ ይበል።

verses.en: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, when men rose up against us:
verses.fr: Sans l''Eternel qui nous protégea, Quand les hommes s''élevèrent contre nous,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከእኛ ጋር ባይሆን ሰዎች በእኛ ላይ በተነሡ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:
verses.fr: Ils nous auraient engloutis tout vivants, Quand leur colère s''enflamma contre nous;
verses.am: ቍጣቸውን በላያችን በነደደ ጊዜ፥ በዚያን ጊዜ ሕያዋን ሳለን በዋጡን ነበር፤

verses.en: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:
verses.fr: Alors les eaux nous auraient submergés, Les torrents auraient passé sur notre âme;
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ውኃ ባሰጠመን ነበር፥ በነፍሳችንም ላይ ፈሳሽ ባለፈ ነበር፤

verses.en: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
verses.fr: Alors auraient passé sur notre âme Les flots impétueux.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ የጐርፍ ውኃ በነፍሳችን ላይ ባለፈ ነበር።

verses.en: Blessed be the Lord, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.
verses.fr: Béni soit l''Eternel, Qui ne nous a pas livrés en proie à leurs dents!
verses.am: ለጥርሳቸው ንክሻ ያላደረገን እግዚአብሔር ይባረክ።

verses.en: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.
verses.fr: Notre âme s''est échappée comme l''oiseau du filet des oiseleurs; Le filet s''est rompu, et nous nous sommes échappés.
verses.am: ነፍሳችን እንደ ወፍ ከአዳኞች ወጥመድ አመለጠች። ወጥመድ ተሰበረ እኛም አመለጥን።

verses.en: Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
verses.fr: Notre secours est dans le nom de l''Eternel, Qui a fait les cieux et la terre.
verses.am: ረድኤታችን ሰማይንና ምድርን በሠራ በእግዚአብሔር ስም ነው።

verses.en: They that trust in the Lord shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.
verses.fr: Cantique des degrés. Ceux qui se confient en l''Eternel Sont comme la montagne de Sion: elle ne chancelle point, Elle est affermie pour toujours.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር የታመኑ እንደማይታወክ ለዘላለም እንደሚኖር እንደ ጽዮን ተራራ ናቸው።

verses.en: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the Lord is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.
verses.fr: Des montagnes entourent Jérusalem; Ainsi l''Eternel entoure son peuple, Dès maintenant et à jamais.
verses.am: ተራሮች በኢየሩሳሌም ዙሪያ እንደ ሆኑ፥ ከዛሬ ጀምሮ ለዘላለም፤ እግዚአብሔር በሕዝቡ ዙሪያ ነው።

verses.en: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.
verses.fr: Car le sceptre de la méchanceté ne restera pas sur le lot des justes, Afin que les justes ne tendent pas les mains vers l''iniquité.
verses.am: ጻድቃን እጃቸውን ወደ ክፋት እንዳይዘረጉ የኃጥኣን በትር በጻድቃን ዕጣ ላይ አይኖርም።

verses.en: Do good, O Lord, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.
verses.fr: Eternel, répands tes bienfaits sur les bons Et sur ceux dont le coeur est droit!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ለቸሮች ልባቸውም ለቀና መልካምን አድርግ።

verses.en: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the Lord shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.
verses.fr: Mais ceux qui s''engagent dans des voies détournées, Que l''Eternel les détruise avec ceux qui font le mal! Que la paix soit sur Israël!
verses.am: ወደ ጠማማነት የሚመለሱትን ግን ዓመፃን ከሚሠሩት ጋር እግዚአብሔር ይወስዳቸዋል። ሰላም በእስራኤል ላይ ይሁን።

verses.en: When the Lord turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
verses.fr: Cantique des degrés. Quand l''Eternel ramena les captifs de Sion, Nous étions comme ceux qui font un rêve.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የጽዮንን ምርኮ በመለሰ ጊዜ፥ እጅግ ደስተኞች ሆንን።

verses.en: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The Lord hath done great things for them.
verses.fr: Alors notre bouche était remplie de cris de joie, Et notre langue de chants d''allégresse; Alors on disait parmi les nations: L''Eternel a fait pour eux de grandes choses!
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ አፋችን ደስታን፥ አንደበታችንም ሐሴትን ሞላ፤ በዚያን ጊዜ በአሕዛብ ዘንድ። እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ነገርን አደረገላቸው ተባለ።

verses.en: The Lord hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
verses.fr: L''Eternel a fait pour nous de grandes choses; Nous sommes dans la joie.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ነገርን አደረገልን፥ ደስም አለን።

verses.en: Turn again our captivity, O Lord, as the streams in the south.
verses.fr: Eternel, ramène nos captifs, Comme des ruisseaux dans le midi!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በደቡብ እንዳሉ ፈሳሾች ምርኮአችንን መልስ።

verses.en: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
verses.fr: Ceux qui sèment avec larmes Moissonneront avec chants d''allégresse.
verses.am: በልቅሶ የሚዘሩ በደስታ ይለቅማሉ።

verses.en: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
verses.fr: Celui qui marche en pleurant, quand il porte la semence, Revient avec allégresse, quand il porte ses gerbes.
verses.am: በሄዱ ጊዜ፥ ዘራቸውን ተሸክመው እያለቀሱ ተሰማሩ፤ በተመለሱ ጊዜ ግን ነዶአቸውን ተሸክመው ደስ እያላቸው ይመጣሉ።

verses.en: Except the Lord build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the Lord keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.
verses.fr: Cantique des degrés. De Salomon. Si l''Eternel ne bâtit la maison, Ceux qui la bâtissent travaillent en vain; Si l''Eternel ne garde la ville, Celui qui la garde veille en vain.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ቤትን ካልሠራ፥ ሠራተኞች በከንቱ ይደክማሉ፤ እግዚአብሔር ከተማን ካልጠበቀ፥ ጠባቂ በከንቱ ይተጋል።

verses.en: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.
verses.fr: En vain vous levez-vous matin, vous couchez-vous tard, Et mangez-vous le pain de douleur; Il en donne autant à ses bien-aimés pendant leur sommeil.
verses.am: በማለዳ መገሥገሣችሁም ከንቱ ነው። ለወዳጆቹ እንቅልፍን በሰጠ ጊዜ፥ እናንተ የመከራን እንጀራ የምትበሉ፥ ከተቀመጣችሁበት ተነሡ።

verses.en: Lo, children are an heritage of the Lord: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
verses.fr: Voici, des fils sont un héritage de l''Eternel, Le fruit des entrailles est une récompense.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ልጆች የእግዚአብሔር ስጦታ ናቸው፥ የሆድም ፍሬ የእርሱ ዋጋ ነው።

verses.en: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.
verses.fr: Comme les flèches dans la main d''un guerrier, Ainsi sont les fils de la jeunesse.
verses.am: በኃያል እጅ እንዳሉ ፍላጾች፥ የጐልማስነት ልጆች እንዲሁ ናቸው።

verses.en: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.
verses.fr: Heureux l''homme qui en a rempli son carquois! Ils ne seront pas confus, Quand ils parleront avec des ennemis à la porte.
verses.am: ከእነርሱ ዘንድ ምኞቱን የሚፈጽም ብፁዕ ሰው ነው፤ ጠላቶቻቸውን በአደባባይ በተናገሩ ጊዜ እርሱ አያፍርም።

verses.en: Blessed is every one that feareth the Lord; that walketh in his ways.
verses.fr: Cantique des degrés. Heureux tout homme qui craint l''Eternel, Qui marche dans ses voies!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈሩት ሁሉ፥ በመንገዶቹም የሚሄዱ ምስጉኖች ናቸው።

verses.en: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
verses.fr: Tu jouis alors du travail de tes mains, Tu es heureux, tu prospères.
verses.am: የድካምህንም ፍሬ ትመገባለህ፤ ምስጉን ነህ መልካምም ይሆንልሃል።

verses.en: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.
verses.fr: Ta femme est comme une vigne féconde Dans l''intérieur de ta maison; Tes fils sont comme des plants d''olivier, Autour de ta table.
verses.am: ሚስትህ በቤትህ እልፍኝ ውስጥ እንደሚያፈራ ወይን ናት፤ ልጆችህ በማዕድህ ዙሪያ እንደ ወይራ ቡቃያ ናቸው።

verses.en: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the Lord.
verses.fr: C''est ainsi qu''est béni L''homme qui craint l''Eternel.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ ሰው እንዲህ ይባረካል።

verses.en: The Lord shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
verses.fr: L''Eternel te bénira de Sion, Et tu verras le bonheur de Jérusalem Tous les jours de ta vie;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከጽዮን ይባርክህ፤ በሕይወትህ ዘመን ሁሉ፥ የኢየሩሳሌምን መልካምነትዋን ታያለህ።

verses.en: Yea, thou shalt see thy children's children, and peace upon Israel.
verses.fr: Tu verras les fils de tes fils. Que la paix soit sur Israël!
verses.am: የልጆችህንም ልጆች ታያለህ። በእስራኤል ላይ ሰላም ይሁን።

verses.en: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:
verses.fr: Cantique des degrés. Ils m''ont assez opprimé dès ma jeunesse, Qu''Israël le dise!
verses.am: እስራኤል። ከትንሽነቴ ጀምሮ ብዙ ጊዜ ተሰለፉብኝ ይበል፤

verses.en: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.
verses.fr: Ils m''ont assez opprimé dès ma jeunesse, Mais ils ne m''ont pas vaincu.
verses.am: ከትንሽነቴ ጀምሮ ብዙ ጊዜ ተሰለፉብኝ፤ ነገር ግን አላሸነፉኝም።

verses.en: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.
verses.fr: Des laboureurs ont labouré mon dos, Ils y ont tracé de longs sillons.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኞች በጀርባዬ ላይ መቱኝ፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም አስረዘሙአት።

verses.en: The Lord is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est juste: Il a coupé les cordes des méchants.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ጻድቅ ነው፤ የኃጢአተኞችን አንገታቸውን ቈረጠ።

verses.en: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.
verses.fr: Qu''ils soient confondus et qu''ils reculent, Tous ceux qui haïssent Sion!
verses.am: ጽዮንን የሚጠሉ ሁሉ ይፈሩ፥ ወደ ኋላቸውም ይመለሱ።

verses.en: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:
verses.fr: Qu''ils soient comme l''herbe des toits, Qui sèche avant qu''on l''arrache!
verses.am: በሰገነት ላይ እንደ በቀለ ሣር፥ ሳይነቀል እንደሚደርቅ፥

verses.en: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.
verses.fr: Le moissonneur n''en remplit point sa main, Celui qui lie les gerbes n''en charge point son bras,
verses.am: ለሚያጭደው እጁን፥ ነዶዎቹን ለሚሰበስብ እቅፉን እንደማይሞላ ይሁኑ።

verses.en: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the Lord be upon you: we bless you in the name of the Lord.
verses.fr: Et les passants ne disent point: Que la bénédiction de l''Eternel soit sur vous! Nous vous bénissons au nom de l''Eternel!
verses.am: በመንገዱም የሚያልፉ። የእግዚአብሔር በረከት በእናንተ ላይ ይሁን፤ በእግዚአብሔር ስም እንመርቃችኋለን አይሉም።

verses.en: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O Lord.
verses.fr: Cantique des degrés. Du fond de l''abîme je t''invoque, ô Eternel!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተን ከጥልቅ ጠራሁህ።

verses.en: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
verses.fr: Seigneur, écoute ma voix! Que tes oreilles soient attentives A la voix de mes supplications!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ድምፄን ስማ፤ ጆሮህ የልመናዬን ቃል የሚያደምጥ ይሁን።

verses.en: If thou, Lord, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?
verses.fr: Si tu gardais le souvenir des iniquités, Eternel, Seigneur, qui pourrait subsister?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ኃጢአትንስ ብትጠባበቅ፥ አቤቱ፥ ማን ይቆማል?

verses.en: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
verses.fr: Mais le pardon se trouve auprès de toi, Afin qu''on te craigne.
verses.am: ይቅርታ ከአንተ ዘንድ ነውና።

verses.en: I wait for the Lord, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
verses.fr: J''espère en l''Eternel, mon âme espère, Et j''attends sa promesse.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ስለ ስምህ ተስፋ አደረግሁህ፤ ነፍሴ በሕግህ ታገሠች።

verses.en: My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.
verses.fr: Mon âme compte sur le Seigneur, Plus que les gardes ne comptent sur le matin, Que les gardes ne comptent sur le matin.
verses.am: ከማለዳው ሰዓት ጀምሮ እስከ ሌሊት ነፍሴ በእግዚአብሔር ታመነች።

verses.en: Let Israel hope in the Lord: for with the Lord there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.
verses.fr: Israël, mets ton espoir en l''Eternel! Car la miséricorde est auprès de l''Eternel, Et la rédemption est auprès de lui en abondance.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ምሕረት፥ በእርሱም ዘንድ ብዙ ማዳን ነውና እስራኤል በእግዚአብሔር ይታመን።

verses.en: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
verses.fr: C''est lui qui rachètera Israël De toutes ses iniquités.
verses.am: እርሱም እስራኤልን ከኃጢአቱ ሁሉ ያድነዋል።

verses.en: Lord, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.
verses.fr: Cantique des degrés. De David. Eternel! je n''ai ni un coeur qui s''enfle, ni des regards hautains; Je ne m''occupe pas de choses trop grandes et trop relevées pour moi.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ልቤ አይታበይብኝ፥ ዓይኖቼም ከፍ ከፍ አይበሉብኝ፤ ከትልልቆች ጋር፥ ከእኔም ይበልጥ ከሚከበሩ ጋር አልሄድሁም።

verses.en: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.
verses.fr: Loin de là, j''ai l''âme calme et tranquille, Comme un enfant sevré qui est auprès de sa mère; J''ai l''âme comme un enfant sevré.
verses.am: ነፍሴን አሳረፍኋት፥ የእናቱንም ጡት እንዳስተውት ዝም አሰኘኋት፤ ነፍሴ የእናቱን ጡት እንዳስተውት በእኔ ውስጥ ናት።

verses.en: Let Israel hope in the Lord from henceforth and for ever.
verses.fr: Israël, mets ton espoir en l''Eternel, Dès maintenant et à jamais!
verses.am: ከዛሬ ጀምሮ እስከ ዘላለም እስራኤል በእግዚአብሔር ይታመን።

verses.en: Lord, remember David, and all his afflictions:
verses.fr: Cantique des degrés. Eternel, souviens-toi de David, De toutes ses peines!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ዳዊትን ገርነቱንም ሁሉ አስብ፤

verses.en: How he sware unto the Lord, and vowed unto the mighty God of Jacob;
verses.fr: Il jura à l''Eternel, Il fit ce voeu au puissant de Jacob:
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር እንደ ማለ፥ ለያዕቆብም አምላክ እንደ ተሳለ።

verses.en: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;
verses.fr: Je n''entrerai pas dans la tente où j''habite, Je ne monterai pas sur le lit où je repose,
verses.am: በእውነት ወደ ቤቴ ድንኳን አልገባም፥ ወደ ምንጣፌም አልጋ አልወጣም፥

verses.en: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,
verses.fr: Je ne donnerai ni sommeil à mes yeux, Ni assoupissement à mes paupières.
verses.am: ለዓይኖቼም መኝታ ለሽፋሽፍቶቼም እንቅልፍ፥ ለጕንጮቼም ዕረፍትን አልሰጥም፥

verses.en: Until I find out a place for the Lord, an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.
verses.fr: Jusqu''à ce que j''aie trouvé un lieu pour l''Eternel, Une demeure pour le puissant de Jacob.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር ስፍራ፥ ለያዕቆብ አምላክ ማደሪያ እስካገኝ ድረስ ብሎ።

verses.en: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.
verses.fr: Voici, nous en entendîmes parler à Ephrata, Nous la trouvâmes dans les champs de Jaar...
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በኤፍራታ ሰማነው፥ በዱር ውስጥም አገኘነው።

verses.en: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.
verses.fr: Allons à sa demeure, Prosternons-nous devant son marchepied!...
verses.am: ወደ ማደሪያዎቹ እንገባለን፤ እግሮቹ በሚቆሙበት ስፍራ እንሰግዳለን።

verses.en: Arise, O Lord, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.
verses.fr: Lève-toi, Eternel, viens à ton lieu de repos, Toi et l''arche de ta majesté!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ወደ ዕረፍትህ ተነሥ፥ አንተና የመቅደስህ ታቦት።

verses.en: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.
verses.fr: Que tes sacrificateurs soient revêtus de justice, Et que tes fidèles poussent des cris de joie!
verses.am: ካህናቶችህ ጽድቅን ይልበሱ፥ ቅዱሳንህም ደስ ይበላቸው።

verses.en: For thy servant David's sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.
verses.fr: A cause de David, ton serviteur, Ne repousse pas ton oint!
verses.am: ስለ ዳዊት ስለ ባሪያህ የቀባኸውን ሰው ፊት አትመልስ።

verses.en: The Lord hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
verses.fr: L''Eternel a juré la vérité à David, Il n''en reviendra pas; Je mettrai sur ton trône un fruit de tes entrailles.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለዳዊት በእውነት ማለ አይጸጸትምም፥ እንዲህ ብሎ። ከሆድህ ፍሬ በዙፋንህ ላይ አስቀምጣለሁ።

verses.en: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.
verses.fr: Si tes fils observent mon alliance Et mes préceptes que je leur enseigne, Leurs fils aussi pour toujours Seront assis sur ton trône.
verses.am: ልጆችህ ኪዳኔን፥ ይህንም የማስተምራቸውን ምስክሬን ቢጠብቁ፥ ልጆቻቸው ደግሞ በዙፋንህ ላይ ለዘላለም ይቀመጣሉ።

verses.en: For the Lord hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.
verses.fr: Oui, l''Eternel a choisi Sion, Il l''a désirée pour sa demeure:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ጽዮንን መርጦአታልና፥ ማደሪያውም ትሆነው ዘንድ ወድዶአታልና፥ እንዲህ ብሎ።

verses.en: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
verses.fr: C''est mon lieu de repos à toujours; J''y habiterai, car je l''ai désirée.
verses.am: ይህች ለዘላለም ማረፊያዬ ናት፤ መርጫታለሁና በዚህች አድራለሁ።

verses.en: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
verses.fr: Je bénirai sa nourriture, Je rassasierai de pain ses indigents;
verses.am: አሮጊቶችዋን እጅግ እባርካለሁ፥ ድሆችዋንም እንጀራ አጠግባለሁ።

verses.en: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
verses.fr: Je revêtirai de salut ses sacrificateurs, Et ses fidèles pousseront des cris de joie.
verses.am: ካህናቶችዋንም ደኅንነትን አለብሳቸዋለሁ፥ ቅዱሳኖችዋም እጅግ ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.
verses.fr: Là j''élèverai la puissance de David, Je préparerai une lampe à mon oint,
verses.am: በዚያ ለዳዊት ቀንድን አበቅላለሁ፥ ለቀባሁትም ሰው መብራትን አዘጋጃለሁ።

verses.en: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.
verses.fr: Je revêtirai de honte ses ennemis, Et sur lui brillera sa couronne.
verses.am: ጠላቶችንም እፍረትን አለብሳቸዋለሁ፤ በእርሱ ግን ቅድስናዬ ያብባል።

verses.en: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
verses.fr: Cantique des degrés. De David. Voici, oh! qu''il est agréable, qu''il est doux Pour des frères de demeurer ensemble!
verses.am: ወንድሞች በኅብረት ቢቀመጡ፥ እነሆ፥ መልካም ነው፥ እነሆም፥ ያማረ ነው።

verses.en: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
verses.fr: C''est comme l''huile précieuse qui, répandue sur la tête, Descend sur la barbe, sur la barbe d''Aaron, Qui descend sur le bord de ses vêtements.
verses.am: ከራስ እስከ ጢም እንደሚፈስስ፥ እስከ አሮን ጢም፥ በልብሱ መደረቢያ እንደሚወርድ ሽቱ ነው።

verses.en: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the Lord commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.
verses.fr: C''est comme la rosée de l''Hermon, Qui descend sur les montagnes de Sion; Car c''est là que l''Eternel envoie la bénédiction, La vie, pour l''éternité.
verses.am: በጽዮን ተራሮች እንደሚወርድ እንደ አርሞንዔም ጠል ነው፤ በዚያ እግዚአብሔር በረከቱን ሕይወትንም እስከ ዘላለም አዝዞአልና።

verses.en: Behold, bless ye the Lord, all ye servants of the Lord, which by night stand in the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Cantique des degrés. Voici, bénissez l''Eternel, vous tous, serviteurs de l''Eternel, Qui vous tenez dans la maison de l''Eternel pendant les nuits!
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩ፥ በአምላካችን ቤት አደባባዬች የምትቆሙ እናንተ የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያዎች ሁላችሁ።

verses.en: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the Lord.
verses.fr: Elevez vos mains vers le sanctuaire, Et bénissez l''Eternel!
verses.am: በሌሊት በቤተ መቅደስ ውስጥ እጆቻችሁን አንሡ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ባርኩ።

verses.en: The Lord that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.
verses.fr: Que l''Eternel te bénisse de Sion, Lui qui a fait les cieux et la terre!
verses.am: ሰማይንና ምድርን የሠራ እግዚአብሔር ከጽዮን ይባርክህ።

verses.en: Praise ye the Lord. Praise ye the name of the Lord; praise him, O ye servants of the Lord.
verses.fr: Louez l''Eternel! Louez le nom de l''Eternel, Louez-le, serviteurs de l''Eternel,
verses.am: ሃሌ ሉያ። የእግዚአብሔርን ስም አመስግኑ፤ እናንተ የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያዎች ሆይ፥ አመስግኑት፥

verses.en: Ye that stand in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God.
verses.fr: Qui vous tenez dans la maison de l''Eternel, Dans les parvis de la maison de notre Dieu!
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ፥ በአምላካችን ቤት አደባባይ የምትቆሙ።

verses.en: Praise the Lord; for the Lord is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.
verses.fr: Louez l''Eternel! car l''Eternel est bon. Chantez à son nom! car il est favorable.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ቸር ነውና እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፤ ለስሙ ዘምሩ፥ መልካም ነውና፤

verses.en: For the Lord hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel s''est choisi Jacob, Israël, pour qu''il lui appartînt.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ያዕቆብን ለራሱ፥ እስራኤልንም ለመዝገቡ መርጦታልና፤

verses.en: For I know that the Lord is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.
verses.fr: Je sais que l''Eternel est grand, Et que notre Seigneur est au-dessus de tous les dieux.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ እንደ ሆነ፥ ጌታችንም ከአማልክት ሁሉ እንዲበልጥ አውቄአለሁና።

verses.en: Whatsoever the Lord pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.
verses.fr: Tout ce que l''Eternel veut, il le fait, Dans les cieux et sur la terre, Dans les mers et dans tous les abîmes.
verses.am: በሰማይና በምድር በባሕርና በጥልቆች ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔር የወደደውን ሁሉ አደረገ።

verses.en: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.
verses.fr: Il fait monter les nuages des extrémités de la terre, Il produit les éclairs et la pluie, Il tire le vent de ses trésors.
verses.am: ከምድር ዳር ደመናትን ያወጣል፤ በዝናብ ጊዜ መብረቅን አደረገ፤ ነፋሳትንም ከመዛግብቱ ያወጣል።

verses.en: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.
verses.fr: Il frappa les premiers-nés de l''Egypte, Depuis les hommes jusqu''aux animaux.
verses.am: የግብጽን በኵር ልጆች ከሰው ጀምሮ እስከ እንስሳ ድረስ መታ።

verses.en: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.
verses.fr: Il envoya des signes et des miracles au milieu de toi, Egypte! Contre Pharaon et contre tous ses serviteurs.
verses.am: ግብጽ ሆይ፥ በመካከልሽ በፈርዖንና በባሪያዎቹ ሁሉ ላይ ተኣምራትንና ድንቅን ሰደደ።

verses.en: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;
verses.fr: Il frappa des nations nombreuses, Et tua des rois puissants,
verses.am: ብዙ አሕዛብን መታ፥ ብርቱዎችንም ነገሥታት ገደለ።

verses.en: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:
verses.fr: Sihon, roi des Amoréens, Og, roi de Basan, Et tous les rois de Canaan;
verses.am: የአሞራውያንን ንጉሥ ሴዎንን፥ የባሳንንም ንጉሥ ዐግን፥ የከነዓንን መንግሥታት ሁሉ ገደለ፤

verses.en: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.
verses.fr: Et il donna leur pays en héritage, En héritage à Israël, son peuple.
verses.am: ምድራቸውንም ርስት አድርጎ ለእስራኤል ለሕዝቡ ርስት ሰጠ።

verses.en: Thy name, O Lord, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O Lord, throughout all generations.
verses.fr: Eternel! ton nom subsiste à toujours, Eternel! ta mémoire dure de génération en génération.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ስምህ ለዘላለም ነው፥ ዝክርህም ለልጅ ልጅ ነው፤

verses.en: For the Lord will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel jugera son peuple, Et il aura pitié de ses serviteurs.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቡ ይፈርዳልና፥ ባሪያዎቹንም ይረዳልና።

verses.en: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
verses.fr: Les idoles des nations sont de l''argent et de l''or, Elles sont l''ouvrage de la main des hommes.
verses.am: የአሕዛብ ጣዖታት የብርና የወርቅ፥ የሰው እጅ ሥራ ናቸው።

verses.en: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;
verses.fr: Elles ont une bouche et ne parlent point, Elles ont des yeux et ne voient point,
verses.am: አፍ አላቸው፥ አይናገሩምም፤ ዓይን አላቸው፥ አያዩምም፤

verses.en: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.
verses.fr: Elles ont des oreilles et n''entendent point, Elles n''ont point de souffle dans leur bouche.
verses.am: ጆሮ አላቸው፥ አይሰሙምም፤ እስትንፋስም በአፋቸው የለም።

verses.en: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusteth in them.
verses.fr: Ils leur ressemblent, ceux qui les fabriquent, Tous ceux qui se confient en elles.
verses.am: የሚሠሩአቸው ሁሉ የሚታመኑባቸውም ሁሉ እንደ እነርሱ ይሁን።

verses.en: Bless the Lord, O house of Israel: bless the Lord, O house of Aaron:
verses.fr: Maison d''Israël, bénissez l''Eternel! Maison d''Aaron, bénissez l''Eternel!
verses.am: የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩት። የአሮን ቤት ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩት፤

verses.en: Bless the Lord, O house of Levi: ye that fear the Lord, bless the Lord.
verses.fr: Maison de Lévi, bénissez l''Eternel! Vous qui craignez l''Eternel, bénissez l''Eternel!
verses.am: የሌዊ ቤት ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩት እግዚአብሔርን የምትፈሩት ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ባርኩት።

verses.en: Blessed be the Lord out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the Lord.
verses.fr: Que de Sion l''on bénisse l''Eternel, Qui habite à Jérusalem! Louez l''Eternel!
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌም የሚያድር እግዚአብሔር ከጽዮን የተባረከ ነው። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.en: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.fr: Louez l''Eternel, car il est bon, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፤ ቸር ነውና፥ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና።

verses.en: O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.fr: Louez le Dieu des dieux, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: የአማልክትን አምላክ አመስግኑ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና።

verses.en: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.fr: Louez le Seigneur des seigneurs, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: የጌቶችን ጌታ አመስግኑ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.fr: Celui qui seul fait de grands prodiges, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: እርሱ ብቻውን ታላቅ ተኣምራትን ያደረገ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.fr: Celui qui a fait les cieux avec intelligence, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: ሰማያትን በብልሃት የሠራ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.fr: Celui qui a étendu la terre sur les eaux, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: ምድርን በውኃ ላይ ያጸና፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: To him that made great lights: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.fr: Celui qui a fait les grands luminaires, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: ብቻውን ታላላቅ ብርሃናትን የሠራ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.fr: Le soleil pour présider au jour, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: ለፀሐይ ቀንን ያስገዛው፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.fr: La lune et les étoiles pour présider à la nuit, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: ለጨረቃና ለከዋክብትም ሌሊትን ያስገዛቸው፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.fr: Celui qui frappa les Egyptiens dans leurs premiers-nés, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: ከበኵራቸው ጋር ግብጽን የመታ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: And brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.fr: Et fit sortir Israël du milieu d''eux, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: እስራኤልንም ከመካከላቸው ያወጣ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.fr: A main forte et à bras étendu, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: በጸናች እጅ በተዘረጋችም ክንድ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.fr: Celui qui coupa en deux la mer Rouge, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: የኤርትራን ባሕር በየክፍሉ የከፈለ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.fr: Qui fit passer Israël au milieu d''elle, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: እስራኤልን በመካከሉ ያሳለፈ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.fr: Et précipita Pharaon et son armée dans la mer Rouge, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: ፈርዖንንና ሠራዊቱን በኤርትራ ባሕር የጣለ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.fr: Celui qui conduisit son peuple dans le désert, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: ሕዝቡን በምድረ በዳ የመራ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.fr: Celui qui frappa de grands rois, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: ታላላቅ ነገሥታትን የመታ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.fr: Qui tua des rois puissants, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: ብርቱዎችንም ነገሥታት የገደለ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.fr: Sihon, roi des Amoréens, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: የአሞራውያንን ንጉሥ ሴዎንን፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.fr: Et Og, roi de Basan, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: የባሳንን ንጉሥ ዐግን፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.fr: Et donna leur pays en héritage, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: ምድራቸውን ርስት አድርጎ የሰጠ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.fr: En héritage à Israël, son serviteur, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: ለባሪያው ለእስራኤል ርስት፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና።

verses.en: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.fr: Celui qui se souvint de nous quand nous étions humiliés, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: እኛን በመዋረዳችን አስቦናልና፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.fr: Et nous délivra de nos oppresseurs, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: ከጠላቶቻችንም እጅ አድኖናልና፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና፤

verses.en: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.fr: Celui qui donne la nourriture à toute chair, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: ለሥጋ ሁሉ ምግብን የሚሰጥ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና።

verses.en: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.fr: Louez le Dieu des cieux, Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: የሰማይን አምላክ አመስግኑ፤ ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና።

verses.en: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
verses.fr: Sur les bords des fleuves de Babylone, Nous étions assis et nous pleurions, en nous souvenant de Sion.
verses.am: በባቢሎን ወንዞች አጠገብ በዚያ ተቀመጥን፤ ጽዮንንም ባሰብናት ጊዜ አለቀስን።

verses.en: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.
verses.fr: Aux saules de la contrée Nous avions suspendu nos harpes.
verses.am: በአኻያ ዛፎችዋ ላይ መሰንቆቻችንን ሰቀልን።

verses.en: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.
verses.fr: Là, nos vainqueurs nous demandaient des chants, Et nos oppresseurs de la joie: Chantez-nous quelques-uns des cantiques de Sion!
verses.am: የማረኩን በዚያ የዝማሬን ቃል ፈለጉብን፥ የወሰዱንም። የጽዮንን ዝማሬ ዘምሩልን አሉን።

verses.en: How shall we sing the Lord's song in a strange land?
verses.fr: Comment chanterions-nous les cantiques de l''Eternel Sur une terre étrangère?
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ዝማሬ በባዕድ ምድር እንዴት እንዘምራለን?

verses.en: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.
verses.fr: Si je t''oublie, Jérusalem, Que ma droite m''oublie!
verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ብረሳሽ፥ ቀኜ ትርሳኝ።

verses.en: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.
verses.fr: Que ma langue s''attache à mon palais, Si je ne me souviens de toi, Si je ne fais de Jérusalem Le principal sujet de ma joie!
verses.am: ባላስብሽ፥ ምላሴ በጕሮሮዬ ይጣበቅ፤ ከደስታዬ ሁሉ በላይ ኢየሩሳሌምን ባልወድድ።

verses.en: Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.
verses.fr: Eternel, souviens-toi des enfants d''Edom, Qui, dans la journée de Jérusalem, Disaient: Rasez, rasez Jusqu''à ses fondements!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በኢየሩሳሌም ቀን የኤዶምን ልጆች አስብ። እስከ መሠረትዋ ድረስ አፍርሱ አፍርሱ ያሉአትን።

verses.en: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.
verses.fr: Fille de Babylone, la dévastée, Heureux qui te rend la pareille, Le mal que tu nous as fait!
verses.am: አንቺ ወራዳ የባቢሎን ልጅ ሆይ፥ ስለ ተበቀልሽን የሚበቀልሽ የተመሰገነ ነው።

verses.en: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.
verses.fr: Heureux qui saisit tes enfants, Et les écrase sur le roc!
verses.am: ሕፃናቶችሽን ይዞ በዓለት ላይ የሚፈጠፍጣቸው የተመሰገነ ነው።

verses.en: I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.
verses.fr: De David. Je te célèbre de tout mon coeur, Je chante tes louanges en la présence de Dieu.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ በፍጹም ልቤ አመሰግንሃለሁ፥ የአፌን ነገር ሰምተኸኛልና፤ በመላእክት ፊት እዘምርልሃለሁ።

verses.en: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.
verses.fr: Je me prosterne dans ton saint temple, Et je célèbre ton nom, à cause de ta bonté et de ta fidélité, Car ta renommée s''est accrue par l''accomplissemen de tes promesses.
verses.am: ወደ ቅዱስ መቅደስህ እሰግዳለሁ፤ ስለ ምሕረትህና ስለ እውነትህ ስምህንም አመሰግናለሁ፥ በሁሉ ላይ ቅዱስ ስምህን ከፍ ከፍ አድርገሃልና።

verses.en: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.
verses.fr: Le jour où je t''ai invoqué, tu m''as exaucé, Tu m''as rassuré, tu as fortifié mon âme.
verses.am: በጠራሁህ ቀን በፍጥነት አድምጠኝ፤ ነፍሴን በኃይልህ በብዙ አጸናሃት።

verses.en: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O Lord, when they hear the words of thy mouth.
verses.fr: Tous les rois de la terre te loueront, ô Eternel! En entendant les paroles de ta bouche;
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የምድር ነገሥታት ሁሉ ያመሰግኑሃል፤ የአፍህን ቃል ሁሉ ሰምተዋልና።

verses.en: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the Lord: for great is the glory of the Lord.
verses.fr: Ils célébreront les voies de l''Eternel, Car la gloire de l''Eternel est grande.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም መንገድ ይዘምራሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔር ክብር ታላቅ ነውና።

verses.en: Though the Lord be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est élevé: il voit les humbles, Et il reconnaît de loin les orgueilleux.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከፍ ያለ ነውና፥ ወደ ችግረኞችም ይመለከታልና፤ ትዕቢተኞችንም ከሩቅ ያውቃል።

verses.en: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.
verses.fr: Quand je marche au milieu de la détresse, tu me rends la vie, Tu étends ta main sur la colère de mes ennemis, Et ta droite me sauve.
verses.am: በመከራ መካከል እንኳ ብሄድ፥ አንተ ሕያው ታደርገኛለህ፤ በጠላቶቼ ቍጣ ላይ እጆቼን ትዘረጋለህ፥ ቀኝህም ታድነኛለች።

verses.en: The Lord will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O Lord, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
verses.fr: L''Eternel agira en ma faveur. Eternel, ta bonté dure toujours, N''abandonne pas les oeuvres de tes mains!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ብድራትን ይመልስልኛል፤ አቤቱ፥ ምሕረትህ ለዘላለም ነው፤ አቤቱ፥ የእጅህን ሥራ ቸል አትበል።

verses.en: O lord, thou hast searched me, and known me.
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. De David. Psaume. Eternel! tu me sondes et tu me connais,
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ መረመርኸኝ፥ አወቅኸኝም።

verses.en: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.
verses.fr: Tu sais quand je m''assieds et quand je me lève, Tu pénètres de loin ma pensée;
verses.am: አንተ መቀመጤንና መነሣቴን አወቅህ፤ አሳቤን ሁሉ ከሩቅ አስተዋልህ።

verses.en: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways.
verses.fr: Tu sais quand je marche et quand je me couche, Et tu pénètres toutes mes voies.
verses.am: ፍለጋዬንና ዕረፍቴን አንተ መረመርህ፤ መንገዶቼን ሁሉ ቀድመህ አወቅህ፥

verses.en: For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O Lord, thou knowest it altogether.
verses.fr: Car la parole n''est pas sur ma langue, Que déjà, ô Eternel! tu la connais entièrement.
verses.am: የዓመፃ ቃል በአንደበቴ እንደሌለ።

verses.en: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.
verses.fr: Tu m''entoures par derrière et par devant, Et tu mets ta main sur moi.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ እነሆ የቀድሞውንና የኋላውን አወቅህ፤ አንተ ፈጠርኸኝ፥ እጅህንም በላዬ አደረግህ።

verses.en: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.
verses.fr: Une science aussi merveilleuse est au-dessus de ma portée, Elle est trop élevée pour que je puisse la saisir.
verses.am: እውቀትህ ከእኔ ይልቅ ተደነቀች፤ በረታች፥ ወደ እርስዋም ለመድረስ አልችልም።

verses.en: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?
verses.fr: Où irais-je loin de ton esprit, Et où fuirais-je loin de ta face?
verses.am: ከመንፈስህ ወዴት እሄዳለሁ? ከፊትህስ ወዴት እሸሻለሁ?

verses.en: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.
verses.fr: Si je monte aux cieux, tu y es; Si je me couche au séjour des morts, t''y voilà.
verses.am: ወደ ሰማይ ብወጣ፥ አንተ በዚያ አለህ። ወደ ሲኦልም ብወርድ፥ በዚያ አለህ።

verses.en: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
verses.fr: Si je prends les ailes de l''aurore, Et que j''aille habiter à l''extrémité de la mer,
verses.am: እንደ ንስር የንጋትን ክንፍ ብወስድ፥ እስከ ባሕር መጨረሻም ብበርር፥

verses.en: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.
verses.fr: Là aussi ta main me conduira, Et ta droite me saisira.
verses.am: በዚያ እጅህ ትመራኛለች፥ ቀኝህም ትይዘኛለች።

verses.en: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.
verses.fr: Si je dis: Au moins les ténèbres me couvriront, La nuit devient lumière autour de moi;
verses.am: በውኑ ጨለማ ትሸፍነኛለች ብል፥ ሌሊት በዙሪያዬ ብርሃን ትሆናለች፤

verses.en: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.
verses.fr: Même les ténèbres ne sont pas obscures pour toi, La nuit brille comme le jour, Et les ténèbres comme la lumière.
verses.am: ጨለማ በአንተ ዘንድ አይጨልምምና፥ ሌሊትም እንደ ቀን ታበራለችና፤ እንደ ጨለማዋ እንዲሁ ብርሃንዋ ነው።

verses.en: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother's womb.
verses.fr: C''est toi qui as formé mes reins, Qui m''as tissé dans le sein de ma mère.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ኵላሊቴን ፈጥረሃልና፥ በእናቴም ሆድ ሰውረኸኛል።

verses.en: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
verses.fr: Je te loue de ce que je suis une créature si merveilleuse. Tes oeuvres sont admirables, Et mon âme le reconnaît bien.
verses.am: ግሩምና ድንቅ ሆኜ ተፈጥሬአለሁና አመሰግንሃለሁ፤ ሥራህ ድንቅ ነው፥ ነፍሴም እጅግ ታውቀዋለች።

verses.en: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
verses.fr: Mon corps n''était point caché devant toi, Lorsque j''ai été fait dans un lieu secret, Tissé dans les profondeurs de la terre.
verses.am: እኔ በስውር በተሠራሁ ጊዜ፥ አካሌም በምድር ታች በተሠራ ጊዜ አጥንቶቼ ከአንተ አልተሰወሩም።

verses.en: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.
verses.fr: Quand je n''étais qu''une masse informe, tes yeux me voyaient; Et sur ton livre étaient tous inscrits Les jours qui m''étaient destinés, Avant qu''aucun d''eux existât.
verses.am: ያልተሠራ አካሌን ዓይኖችህ አዩኝ፤ የተፈጠሩ ቀኖቼ ሁሉ አንድ ስንኳ ሳይኖር በመጽሐፍህ ተጻፉ።

verses.en: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!
verses.fr: Que tes pensées, ô Dieu, me semblent impénétrables! Que le nombre en est grand!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አሳቦችህ በእኔ ዘንድ እንደ ምን እጅግ የተከበሩ ናቸው! ቍጥራቸውም እንደ ምን በዛ!

verses.en: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.
verses.fr: Si je les compte, elles sont plus nombreuses que les grains de sable. Je m''éveille, et je suis encore avec toi.
verses.am: ብቈጥራቸው ከአሸዋ ይልቅ ይበዛሉ፤ ተነሣሁም፥ እኔም ገና ከአንተ ጋር ነኝ።

verses.en: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.
verses.fr: O Dieu, puisses-tu faire mourir le méchant! Hommes de sang, éloignez-vous de moi!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አንተ ኃጢአተኞችን የምትገድል ከሆንህስ፥ የደም ሰዎች ሆይ፥ ከእኔ ፈቀቅ በሉ።

verses.en: For they speak against thee wickedly, and thine enemies take thy name in vain.
verses.fr: Ils parlent de toi d''une manière criminelle, Ils prennent ton nom pour mentir, eux, tes ennemis!
verses.am: በክፋት ይናገሩብሃልና፤ ጠላቶችህም በከንቱ ያምፁብሃል።

verses.en: Do not I hate them, O Lord, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?
verses.fr: Eternel, n''aurais-je pas de la haine pour ceux qui te haïssent, Du dégoût pour ceux qui s''élèvent contre toi?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ የሚጠሉህን እኔ የጠላሁ አይደለሁምን? ስለ ጠላቶችህም አልተሰቀቅሁምን?

verses.en: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.
verses.fr: Je les hais d''une parfaite haine; Ils sont pour moi des ennemis.
verses.am: ፍጹም ጥል ጠላኋቸው፥ ጠላቶችም ሆኑኝ።

verses.en: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
verses.fr: Sonde-moi, ô Dieu, et connais mon coeur! Eprouve-moi, et connais mes pensées!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ መርምረኝ ልቤንም እወቅ፤ ፍተነኝ መንገዴንም እወቅ፤

verses.en: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
verses.fr: Regarde si je suis sur une mauvaise voie, Et conduis-moi sur la voie de l''éternité!
verses.am: በደልንም በእኔ ውስጥ ብታገኝ እይ፤ የዘላለምንም መንገድ ምራኝ።

verses.en: Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;
verses.fr: Au chef des chantres. Psaume de David. Eternel, délivre-moi des hommes méchants! Préserve-moi des hommes violents.
verses.am: ለመዘምራን አለቃ የዳዊት መዝሙር።

verses.en: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.
verses.fr: Qui méditent de mauvais desseins dans leur coeur, Et sont toujours prêts à faire la guerre!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ከክፉ ሰው አድነኝ፥ በልባቸውም ክፉ ካሰቡ ከዓመፀኞች ሰዎች ጠብቀኝ፤ ቀኑን ሁሉ ለሰልፍ ይከማቻሉ።

verses.en: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison is under their lips. Selah.
verses.fr: Ils aiguisent leur langue comme un serpent, Ils ont sous leurs lèvres un venin d''aspic. Pause.
verses.am: ምላሳቸውን እንደ እባብ ሳሉ፤ ከከንፈራቸው በታች የእፉኝት መርዝ ነው።

verses.en: Keep me, O Lord, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.
verses.fr: Eternel, garantis-moi des mains du méchant! Préserve-moi des hommes violents, Qui méditent de me faire tomber!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ከኃጢአተኞች እጅ ጠብቀኝ፥ እርምጃዬንም ሊያሰናክሉ ከመከሩ ከዓመፀኞች አድነኝ።

verses.en: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.
verses.fr: Des orgueilleux me tendent un piège et des filets, Ils placent des rets le long du chemin, Ils me dressent des embûches. Pause.
verses.am: ትዕቢተኞች ወጥመድን ሰወሩብኝ፥ ለእግሮቼም የወጥመድ ገመድን ዘረጉ፤ በመንገድ ዕንቅፋትን አኖሩ።

verses.en: I said unto the Lord, Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O Lord.
verses.fr: Je dis à l''Eternel: Tu es mon Dieu! Eternel, prête l''oreille à la voix de mes supplications!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርንም። አንተ አምላኬ ነህ፤ የልመናዬን ቃል፥ አቤቱ፥ አድምጥ አልሁት።

verses.en: O God the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
verses.fr: Eternel, Seigneur, force de mon salut! Tu couvres ma tête au jour du combat.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጌታዬ፥ የመድኃኒቴ ጕልበት፥ በሰልፍ ቀን ራሴን ሸፈንህ።

verses.en: Grant not, O Lord, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.
verses.fr: Eternel, n''accomplis pas les désirs du méchant, Ne laisse pas réussir ses projets, de peur qu''il ne s''en glorifie! Pause.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ከምኞቴ የተነሣ ለኃጢአተኞች አትስጠኝ፤ በላዬ ተማከሩ፤ እንዳይጓደዱ አትተወኝ።

verses.en: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
verses.fr: Que sur la tête de ceux qui m''environnent Retombe l''iniquité de leurs lèvres!
verses.am: የሚከብቡኝን ራስ የከንፈራቸው ክፋት ይክደናቸው።

verses.en: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.
verses.fr: Que des charbons ardents soient jetés sur eux! Qu''il les précipite dans le feu, Dans des abîmes, d''où ils ne se relèvent plus!
verses.am: የእሳት ፍም በላያቸው ይውደቅ፤ እንዳይነሡም ወደ እሳትና ወደ ማዕበል ይጣሉ።

verses.en: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
verses.fr: L''homme dont la langue est fausse ne s''affermit pas sur la terre; Et l''homme violent, le malheur l''entraîne à sa perte.
verses.am: ተናጋሪ ሰው በምድር ውስጥ አይጸናም፤ ዓመፀኛን ሰው ክፋት ለጥፋት ይፈልገዋል።

verses.en: I know that the Lord will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.
verses.fr: Je sais que l''Eternel fait droit au misérable, Justice aux indigents.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለድሀ ዳኝነትን ለችግረኛም ፍርድን እንዲያደርግ አወቅሁ።

verses.en: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.
verses.fr: Oui, les justes célébreront ton nom, Les hommes droits habiteront devant ta face.
verses.am: ጻድቃንም በእውነት ስምህን ያመሰግናሉ፤ ቀኖችም በፊትህ ይኖራሉ።

verses.en: Lord, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.
verses.fr: Psaume de David. Eternel, je t''invoque: viens en hâte auprès de moi! Prête l''oreille à ma voix, quand je t''invoque!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ ጮኽሁ፤ ስማኝ፤ ወደ አንተ ስጮኽም የልመናዬን ቃል አድምጥ።

verses.en: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
verses.fr: Que ma prière soit devant ta face comme l''encens, Et l''élévation de mes mains comme l''offrande du soir!
verses.am: ጸሎቴን በፊትህ እንደ ዕጣን ተቀበልልኝ፥ እጅ መንሣቴም እንደ ሠርክ መሥዋዕት ትሁን።

verses.en: Set a watch, O Lord, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.
verses.fr: Eternel, mets une garde à ma bouche, Veille sur la porte de mes lèvres!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ለአፌ ጠባቂ አኑር፥ የከንፈሮቼንም መዝጊያ ጠብቅ።

verses.en: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.
verses.fr: N''entraîne pas mon coeur à des choses mauvaises, A des actions coupables avec les hommes qui font le mal, Et que je ne prenne aucune part à leurs festins!
verses.am: ልቤን ወደ ክፉ ነገር አትመልሰው፥ ዓመፃን ከሚያደርጉ ሰዎች ጋር ለኃጢአት ምክንያት እንዳልሰጥ፤ ከምርጦቻቸውም ጋር አልተባበር።

verses.en: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.
verses.fr: Que le juste me frappe, c''est une faveur; Qu''il me châtie, c''est de l''huile sur ma tête: Ma tête ne se détournera pas; Mais de nouveau ma prière s''élèvera contre leur méchanceté.
verses.am: ጻድቅ በምሕረት ይገሥጸኝ፥ ይዝለፈኝም፥ የኃጢአተኛ ዘይት ግን ራሴን አይቅባ፤ ጸሎቴ ገና በክፋታቸው ላይ ነውና።

verses.en: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
verses.fr: Que leurs juges soient précipités le long des rochers, Et l''on écoutera mes paroles, car elles sont agréables.
verses.am: ኃያላኖቻቸው በዓለት አጠገብ ተጣሉ፤ ጣፋጭ ናትና ቃሌን ይሰማሉ።

verses.en: Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.
verses.fr: Comme quand on laboure et qu''on fend la terre, Ainsi nos os sont dispersés à l''entrée du séjour des morts.
verses.am: በምድር ላይ እንደ ተሰነጠቀ እንደ መሬት ጓል፥ እንዲሁ አጥንቶቻችን በሲኦል ተበተኑ።

verses.en: But mine eyes are unto thee, O God the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.
verses.fr: C''est vers toi, Eternel, Seigneur! que se tournent mes yeux, C''est auprès de toi que je cherche un refuge: N''abandonne pas mon âme!
verses.am: አቤቱ ጌታ፥ ዓይኖቼ ወደ አንተ ናቸውና፤ በአንተ ታመንሁ፥ ነፍሴን አታውጣት።

verses.en: Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.
verses.fr: Garantis-moi du piège qu''ils me tendent, Et des embûches de ceux qui font le mal!
verses.am: ከሰወሩብኝ ወጥመድ፥ ዓመፅንም ከሚያደርጉ ሰዎች ዕንቅፋት ጠብቀኝ።

verses.en: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.
verses.fr: Que les méchants tombent dans leurs filets, Et que j''échappe en même temps!
verses.am: እኔ ብቻዬን እስካልፍ ድረስ ኃጢአተኞች በወጥመዳቸው ይውደቁ።

verses.en: I cried unto the Lord with my voice; with my voice unto the Lord did I make my supplication.
verses.fr: Cantique de David. Lorsqu''il était dans la caverne. Prière. De ma voix je crie à l''Eternel, De ma voix j''implore l''Eternel.
verses.am: በቃሌ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኽሁ፤ በቃሌ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ለመንሁ።

verses.en: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.
verses.fr: Je répands ma plainte devant lui, Je lui raconte ma détresse.
verses.am: ልመናዬን በፊቱ አፈስሳለሁ፤ መከራዬንም በፊቴ እናገራለሁ።

verses.en: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.
verses.fr: Quand mon esprit est abattu au dedans de moi, Toi, tu connais mon sentier. Sur la route où je marche Ils m''ont tendu un piège.
verses.am: ነፍሴ በውስጤ ባለቀች ጊዜ መንገዴን አወቅሁ፤ በምሄድባት በዚያች መንገድ ወጥመድን ሰወሩብኝ።

verses.en: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.
verses.fr: Jette les yeux à droite, et regarde! Personne ne me reconnaît, Tout refuge est perdu pour moi, Nul ne prend souci de mon âme.
verses.am: ወደ ቀኝ ተመለከትሁ አየሁም፥ የሚያውቀኝም አጣሁ፤ መሸሸጊያም የለኝም፥ ስለ ነፍሴም የሚመራመር የለም።

verses.en: I cried unto thee, O Lord: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.
verses.fr: Eternel! c''est à toi que je crie. Je dis: Tu es mon refuge, Mon partage sur la terre des vivants.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ ጮኽሁ። አንተ ተስፋዬ ነህ፥ በሕያዋንም ምድር አንተ እድል ፈንታዬ ነህ አልሁ።

verses.en: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.
verses.fr: Sois attentif à mes cris! Car je suis bien malheureux. Délivre-moi de ceux qui me poursuivent! Car ils sont plus forts que moi.
verses.am: እጅግ ተቸግሬአለሁና ወደ ልመናዬ አድምጥ፤ በርትተውብኛልና ከሚያሳድዱኝ አድነኝ።

verses.en: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.
verses.fr: Tire mon âme de sa prison, Afin que je célèbre ton nom! Les justes viendront m''entourer, Quand tu m''auras fait du bien.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ስምህን አመሰግን ዘንድ፤ ነፍሴን ከወህኒ አውጣት፤ ዋጋዬን እስክትሰጠኝ ድረስ ጻድቃን እኔን ይጠብቃሉ።

verses.en: Hear my prayer, O Lord, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.
verses.fr: Psaume de David. Eternel, écoute ma prière, prête l''oreille à mes supplications! Exauce-moi dans ta fidélité, dans ta justice!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ጸሎቴን ስማ፤ በእውነትህ ልመናዬን አድምጥ፥ በጽድቅህም መልስልኝ።

verses.en: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.
verses.fr: N''entre pas en jugement avec ton serviteur! Car aucun vivant n''est juste devant toi.
verses.am: ሕያው ሁሉ በፊትህ ጻድቅ አይደለምና ከባሪያህ ጋር ወደ ፍርድ አትግባ።

verses.en: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.
verses.fr: L''ennemi poursuit mon âme, Il foule à terre ma vie; Il me fait habiter dans les ténèbres, Comme ceux qui sont morts depuis longtemps.
verses.am: ጠላትህ ነፍሴን አሳድዶአታል፥ ሕይወቴንም በምድር ውስጥ አጐስቍሎአታል፤ ቀድሞ እንደ ሞተ ሰው በጨለማ አኑሮኛል።

verses.en: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.
verses.fr: Mon esprit est abattu au dedans de moi, Mon coeur est troublé dans mon sein.
verses.am: ነፍሴ በውስጤ አለቀችብኝ፥ ልቤም በውስጤ ደነገጠብኝ።

verses.en: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.
verses.fr: Je me souviens des jours d''autrefois, Je médite sur toutes tes oeuvres, Je réfléchis sur l''ouvrage de tes mains.
verses.am: የቀድሞውን ዘመን አሰብሁ፥ ሥራህንም ሁሉ አሰላሰልሁ፤ የእጅህንም ሥራ ተመለከትሁ።

verses.en: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.
verses.fr: J''étends mes mains vers toi; Mon âme soupire après toi, comme une terre desséchée. Pause.
verses.am: እጆቼን ወደ አንተ ዘረጋሁ፤ ነፍሴም እንደ ምድረ በዳ አንተን ተጠማች።

verses.en: Hear me speedily, O Lord: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.
verses.fr: Hâte-toi de m''exaucer, ô Eternel! Mon esprit se consume. Ne me cache pas ta face! Je serais semblable à ceux qui descendent dans la fosse.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ፈጥነህ ስማኝ፤ ነፍሴ አልቃለች፤ ፊትህን ከኔ አትመልስ፥ ወደ ጕድጓድም እንደሚወርዱ አልሁን።

verses.en: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.
verses.fr: Fais-moi dès le matin entendre ta bonté! Car je me confie en toi. Fais-moi connaître le chemin où je dois marcher! Car j''élève à toi mon âme.
verses.am: አንተን ታምኛለሁና በማለዳ ምሕረትህን አሰማኝ፤ አቤቱ፥ ነፍሴን ወደ አንተ አንሥቻለሁና የምሄድበትን መንገድ አስታውቀኝ።

verses.en: Deliver me, O Lord, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.
verses.fr: Délivre-moi de mes ennemis, ô Eternel! Auprès de toi je cherche un refuge.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ ተማፅኛለሁና ከጠላቶቼ አድነኝ።

verses.en: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
verses.fr: Enseigne-moi à faire ta volonté! Car tu es mon Dieu. Que ton bon esprit me conduise sur la voie droite!
verses.am: አንተ አምላኬ ነህና ፈቃድህን ለማድረግ አስተምረኝ፤ ቅዱስ መንፈስህም በጽድቅ ምድር ይምራኝ።

verses.en: Quicken me, O Lord, for thy name's sake: for thy righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.
verses.fr: A cause de ton nom, Eternel, rends-moi la vie! Dans ta justice, retire mon âme de la détresse!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ስለ ስምህ ሕያው አድርገኝ፤ በጽድቅህም ነፍሴን ከመከራዋ አውጣት።

verses.en: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.
verses.fr: Dans ta bonté, anéantis mes ennemis, Et fais périr tous les oppresseurs de mon âme! Car je suis ton serviteur.
verses.am: በምሕረትህ ጠላቶቼን ደምስሳቸው፥ እኔ ባሪያህ ነኝና ነፍሴን የሚያስጨንቁአትን ሁሉ አጥፋቸው።

verses.en: Blessed be the Lord my strength which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:
verses.fr: De David. Béni soit l''Eternel, mon rocher, Qui exerce mes mains au combat, Mes doigts à la bataille,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር አምላኬ ይባረክ፥ ለእጆቼ ሰልፍን፥ ለጣቶቼም ዘመቻን የሚያስተምር፤

verses.en: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.
verses.fr: Mon bienfaiteur et ma forteresse, Ma haute retraite et mon libérateur, Mon bouclier, celui qui est mon refuge, Qui m''assujettit mon peuple!
verses.am: መሓሪዬና መሸሸጊያዬ፥ መጠጊያዬና መድኃኒቴ፤ ረዳቴና መታመኛዬም፤ ሕዝቤንም ከእኔ በታች የሚያስገዛልኝ።

verses.en: Lord, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!
verses.fr: Eternel, qu''est-ce que l''homme, pour que tu le connaisses? Le fils de l''homme, pour que tu prennes garde à lui?
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እርሱን ታውቀው ዘንድ ሰው ምንድር ነው? ታስብለት ዘንድ የሰው ልጅ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away.
verses.fr: L''homme est semblable à un souffle, Ses jours sont comme l''ombre qui passe.
verses.am: ሰው ከንቱን ነገር ይመስላል፤ ዘመኑ እንደ ጥላ ያልፋል።

verses.en: Bow thy heavens, O Lord, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
verses.fr: Eternel, abaisse tes cieux, et descends! Touche les montagnes, et qu''elles soient fumantes!
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ሰማዮችህን ዝቅ ዝቅ አድርጋቸው ውረድም፤ ተራሮችን ዳስሳቸው ይጢሱም።

verses.en: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.
verses.fr: Fais briller les éclairs, et disperse mes ennemis! Lance tes flèches, et mets-les en déroute!
verses.am: መብረቆችህን ብልጭ አድርጋቸው በትናቸውም፤ ፍላጾችህን ላካቸው አስደንግጣቸውም።

verses.en: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;
verses.fr: Etends tes mains d''en haut; Délivre-moi et sauve-moi des grandes eaux, De la main des fils de l''étranger,

verses.en: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
verses.fr: Dont la bouche profère la fausseté, Et dont la droite est une droite mensongère.
verses.am: እጅህን ከአርያም ላክ አድነኝም ከብዙ ውኆች፥ አፋቸውም ምናምንን ከሚናገር፥ ቀኛቸው የሐሰት ቀኝ ከሆነ፥ ከባዕድ ልጆች እጅ አስጥለኝ።

verses.en: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.
verses.fr: O Dieu! je te chanterai un cantique nouveau, Je te célébrerai sur le luth à dix cordes.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ አዲስ ቅኔ እቀኛልሃለሁ፤ አሥር አውታር ባለው በገና እዘምርልሃለሁ።

verses.en: It is he that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.
verses.fr: Toi, qui donnes le salut aux rois, Qui sauvas du glaive meurtrier David, ton serviteur,
verses.am: ለነገሥታት መድኃኒትን የሚሰጥ፥ ባሪያውን ዳዊትን ከክፉ ሰይፍ የሚያድነው እርሱ ነው።

verses.en: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:
verses.fr: Délivre-moi et sauve-moi de la main des fils de l''étranger, Dont la bouche profère la fausseté, Et dont la droite est une droite mensongère!...
verses.am: አድነኝ፥ አፋቸውም ምናምንን ከሚናገር፥ ቀኛቸውም የሐሰት ቀኝ ከሆነ፥ ከባዕድ ልጆች እጅ አስጥለኝ።

verses.en: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:
verses.fr: Nos fils sont comme des plantes Qui croissent dans leur jeunesse; Nos filles comme les colonnes sculptées Qui font l''ornement des palais.
verses.am: ልጆቻቸው በጕልማስነታቸው እንደ አዲስ አትክልት የሆኑ፥ ሴቶች ልጆቻቸውም እንደ እልፍኝ ያማሩና ያጌጡ፤

verses.en: That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:
verses.fr: Nos greniers sont pleins, Regorgeant de toute espèce de provisions; Nos troupeaux se multiplient par milliers, par dix milliers, Dans nos campagnes;
verses.am: ዕቃ ቤቶቻቸውም የተሞሉ በየዓይነቱ ዕቃ የሚሰጡ፥ በጎቻቸውም ብዙ የሚወልዱ፥ በማሰማርያቸውም የሚበዙ፥

verses.en: That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.
verses.fr: Nos génisses sont fécondes; Point de désastre, point de captivité, Point de cris dans nos rues!
verses.am: ላሞቻቸውም የሚሰቡ፤ ቅጥራቸውም መፍረሻና መውጫ የሌለው፥ በአደባባዮቻቸውም ዋይታ የሌለ፤

verses.en: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose God is the Lord.
verses.fr: Heureux le peuple pour qui il en est ainsi! Heureux le peuple dont l''Eternel est le Dieu!
verses.am: እንደዚህ የሚሆን ሕዝብ የተመሰገነ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር አምላኩ የሆነ ሕዝብ ምስጉን ነው።

verses.en: I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
verses.fr: Louange. De David. Je t''exalterai, ô mon Dieu, mon roi! Et je bénirai ton nom à toujours et à perpétuité.
verses.am: አምላኬ ንጉሤ ሆይ፥ ከፍ ከፍ አደርግሃለሁ፥ ስምህንም ለዘላለም ዓለምም እባርካለሁ።

verses.en: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.
verses.fr: Chaque jour je te bénirai, Et je célébrerai ton nom à toujours et à perpétuité.
verses.am: በየቀኑ ሁሉ እባርክሃለሁ፥ ስምህንም ለዘላለም ዓለምም አመሰግናለሁ።

verses.en: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est grand et très digne de louange, Et sa grandeur est insondable.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ነው እጅግም የተመሰገነ ነው፤ ለታላቅነቱም ፍጻሜ የለውም።

verses.en: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.
verses.fr: Que chaque génération célèbre tes oeuvres, Et publie tes hauts faits!
verses.am: ትውልደ ትውልድ ሥራህን ያመሰግናሉ፥ ኃይልህንም ያወራሉ።

verses.en: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.
verses.fr: Je dirai la splendeur glorieuse de ta majesté; Je chanterai tes merveilles.
verses.am: የቅድስናህን ግርማ ክብር ይናገራሉ፥ ተኣምራትህንም ይነጋገራሉ።

verses.en: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.
verses.fr: On parlera de ta puissance redoutable, Et je raconterai ta grandeur.
verses.am: የግርማህንም ኃይል ይናገራሉ፥ ታላቅነትህንም ይነጋገራሉ፥ ብርታትህንም ይነጋገራሉ።

verses.en: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.
verses.fr: Qu''on proclame le souvenir de ton immense bonté, Et qu''on célèbre ta justice!
verses.am: የቸርነትህን ብዛት መታሰብ ያወጣሉ፥ በጽድቅህም ሐሤትን ያደርጋሉ።

verses.en: The Lord is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est miséricordieux et compatissant, Lent à la colère et plein de bonté.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ርኅሩኅና መሓሪ ነው፥ ከቍጣ የራቀ፥ ምሕረቱም ብዙ ነው፤

verses.en: The Lord is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est bon envers tous, Et ses compassions s''étendent sur toutes ses oeuvres.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለሚታገሡት ቸር ነው። ምሕረቱም በሥራው ሁሉ ላይ ነው።

verses.en: All thy works shall praise thee, O Lord; and thy saints shall bless thee.
verses.fr: Toutes tes oeuvres te loueront, ô Eternel! Et tes fidèles te béniront.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ሥራህ ሁሉ ያመሰግኑሃል፥ ቅዱሳንህም ይባርኩሃል።

verses.en: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy power;
verses.fr: Ils diront la gloire de ton règne, Et ils proclameront ta puissance,
verses.am: የመንግሥትህን ክብር ይናገራሉ፥ ኃይልህንም ይነጋገራሉ፥

verses.en: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.
verses.fr: Pour faire connaître aux fils de l''homme ta puissance Et la splendeur glorieuse de ton règne.
verses.am: ለሰው ልጆች ኃይልህን የመንግሥትህንም ግርማ ክብር ያስታውቁ ዘንድ

verses.en: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.
verses.fr: Ton règne est un règne de tous les siècles, Et ta domination subsiste dans tous les âges.
verses.am: መንግሥትህ የዘላለም መንግሥት ናት፥ ግዛትህም ለልጅ ልጅ ነው።

verses.en: The Lord upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.
verses.fr: L''Eternel soutient tous ceux qui tombent, Et il redresse tous ceux qui sont courbés.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በቃሎቹ የታመነ ነው፥ በሥራውም ሁሉ ጻድቅ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር የተፍገመገሙትን ሁሉ ይደግፋቸዋል፥ የወደቁትንም ያነሣቸዋል።

verses.en: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season.
verses.fr: Les yeux de tous espèrent en toi, Et tu leur donnes la nourriture en son temps.
verses.am: የሁሉ ዓይን አንተን ተስፋ ያደርጋል፤ አንተም ምግባቸውን በየጊዜው ትሰጣቸዋለህ።

verses.en: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
verses.fr: Tu ouvres ta main, Et tu rassasies à souhait tout ce qui a vie.
verses.am: አንተ እጅህን ትከፍታለህ፥ ሕይወት ላለውም ሁሉ መልካምን ታጠግባለህ።

verses.en: The Lord is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est juste dans toutes ses voies, Et miséricordieux dans toutes ses oeuvres.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በመንገዱ ሁሉ ጻድቅ ነው በሥራውም ሁሉ ቸር ነው።

verses.en: The Lord is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est près de tous ceux qui l''invoquent, De tous ceux qui l''invoquent avec sincérité;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለሚጠሩት ሁሉ፥ በእውነት ለሚጠሩት ሁሉ ቅርብ ነው።

verses.en: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.
verses.fr: Il accomplit les désirs de ceux qui le craignent, Il entend leur cri et il les sauve.
verses.am: ለሚፈሩት ምኞታቸውን ያደርጋል፥ ልመናቸውንም ይሰማል ያድናቸዋልም።

verses.en: The Lord preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.
verses.fr: L''Eternel garde tous ceux qui l''aiment, Et il détruit tous les méchants.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የሚወድዱትን ሁሉ ይጠብቃል፤ ኃጢአተኞችንም ሁሉ ያጠፋል።

verses.en: My mouth shall speak the praise of the Lord: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
verses.fr: Que ma bouche publie la louange de l''Eternel, Et que toute chair bénisse son saint nom, A toujours et à perpétuité!
verses.am: አፌ የእግዚአብሔርን ምስጋና ይናገራል፤ ሥጋም ሁሉ ለዘላለም ዓለም የተቀደሰውን ስሙን ይባርክ።

verses.en: Praise ye the Lord. Praise the Lord, O my soul.
verses.fr: Louez l''Eternel! Mon âme, loue l''Eternel!
verses.am: ሃሌ ሉያ። ነፍሴ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኚ።

verses.en: While I live will I praise the Lord: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.
verses.fr: Je louerai l''Eternel tant que je vivrai, Je célébrerai mon Dieu tant que j''existerai.
verses.am: በሕይወቴ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰግናለሁ፤ በምኖርበት ዘመን ሁሉ ለአምላኬ እዘምራለሁ።

verses.en: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.
verses.fr: Ne vous confiez pas aux grands, Aux fils de l''homme, qui ne peuvent sauver.
verses.am: ማዳን በማይችሉ በሰው ልጆችና በአለቆች አትታመኑ።

verses.en: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.
verses.fr: Leur souffle s''en va, ils rentrent dans la terre, Et ce même jour leurs desseins périssent.
verses.am: ነፍሱ ትወጣለች ወደ መሬቱም ይመለሳል፤ ያን ጊዜ ምክሩ ሁሉ ይጠፋል።

verses.en: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the Lord his God:
verses.fr: Heureux celui qui a pour secours le Dieu de Jacob, Qui met son espoir en l''Eternel, son Dieu!
verses.am: የያዕቆብ አምላክ ረዳቱ የሆነ ተስፋውም በአምላኩ በእግዚአብሔር የሆነ ሰው ምስጉን ነው፤

verses.en: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein is: which keepeth truth for ever:
verses.fr: Il a fait les cieux et la terre, La mer et tout ce qui s''y trouve. Il garde la fidélité à toujours.
verses.am: እርሱም ሰማይንና ምድርን ባሕርንም፥ በእነርሱ ያለውንም ሁሉ የፈጠረ፤ እውነትን ለዘላለም የሚጠብቅ፤

verses.en: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. The Lord looseth the prisoners:
verses.fr: Il fait droit aux opprimés; Il donne du pain aux affamés; L''Eternel délivre les captifs;
verses.am: ለተበደሉት የሚፈርድ፥ ለተራቡ ምግብን የሚሰጥ ነው። እግዚአብሔር የታሰሩትን ይፈታል፤

verses.en: The Lord openeth the eyes of the blind: the Lord raiseth them that are bowed down: the Lord loveth the righteous:
verses.fr: L''Eternel ouvre les yeux des aveugles; L''Eternel redresse ceux qui sont courbés; L''Eternel aime les justes.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የወደቁትን ያነሣል፤ እግዚአብሔር ዕውሮችን ጥበበኞች ያደርጋቸዋል፤ እግዚአብሔር ጻድቃንን ይወድዳል፤

verses.en: The Lord preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.
verses.fr: L''Eternel protège les étrangers, Il soutient l''orphelin et la veuve, Mais il renverse la voie des méchants.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ስደተኞችን ይጠብቃል፤ ድሀ አደጎችንና ባልቴቶችን ይቀበላል፤ የኃጢአተኞችንም መንገድ ያጠፋል።

verses.en: The Lord shall reign for ever, even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the Lord.
verses.fr: L''Eternel règne éternellement; Ton Dieu, ô Sion! subsiste d''âge en âge! Louez l''Eternel!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለዘላለም ይነግሣል፤ ጽዮን ሆይ፥ አምላክሽ ለልጅ ልጅ ነው። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.en: Praise ye the Lord: for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.
verses.fr: Louez l''Eternel! Car il est beau de célébrer notre Dieu, Car il est doux, il est bienséant de le louer.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ፥ መዝሙር መልካም ነውና። ለአምላካችን ምስጋና ያማረ ነው።

verses.en: The Lord doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.
verses.fr: L''Eternel rebâtit Jérusalem, Il rassemble les exilés d''Israël;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ኢየሩሳሌምን ይሠራል፥ ከእስራኤልም የተበተኑትን ይሰበስባል።

verses.en: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
verses.fr: Il guérit ceux qui ont le coeur brisé, Et il panse leurs blessures.
verses.am: ልባቸውን የቈሰሉትን ይፈውሳል፥ ሕማማቸውንም ይጠግናል።
