verses.en: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.
verses.fr: Il compte le nombre des étoiles, Il leur donne à toutes des noms.
verses.am: የከዋክብትንም ብዛት ይቈጥራል፥ ሁሉንም በየስማቸው ይጠራቸዋል።

verses.en: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.
verses.fr: Notre Seigneur est grand, puissant par sa force, Son intelligence n''a point de limite.
verses.am: ጌታችን ታላቅ ነው፥ ኃይሉም ታላቅ ነው፥ ለጥበቡም ቍጥር የለውም።

verses.en: The Lord lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.
verses.fr: L''Eternel soutient les malheureux, Il abaisse les méchants jusqu''à terre.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የዋሃንን ያነሣል፥ ኃጢአተኞችን ግን እስከ ምድር ድረስ ያዋርዳል።

verses.en: Sing unto the Lord with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:
verses.fr: Chantez à l''Eternel avec actions de grâces, Célébrez notre Dieu avec la harpe!
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር በምስጋና ዘምሩ፥ ለአምላካችንም በመሰንቆ ዘምሩ፤

verses.en: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.
verses.fr: Il couvre les cieux de nuages, Il prépare la pluie pour la terre; Il fait germer l''herbe sur les montagnes.
verses.am: ሰማዩን በደመናት ይሸፍናል ለምድርም ዝናብን ያዘጋጃል፤ ሣርን በተራሮች ላይ ያበቅላል፤ ለምለሙንም ለሰው ልጆች ጥቅም።

verses.en: He giveth to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.
verses.fr: Il donne la nourriture au bétail, Aux petits du corbeau quand ils crient,
verses.am: ለሚጠሩት ለቍራዎች ጫጩቶች ለእንስሶችም ምግባቸውን ይሰጣል።

verses.en: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.
verses.fr: Ce n''est pas dans la vigueur du cheval qu''il se complaît, Ce n''est pas dans les jambes de l''homme qu''il met son plaisir;
verses.am: የፈረስን ኃይል አይወድድም፥ በሰውም ጭን አይደሰትም።

verses.en: The Lord taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.
verses.fr: L''Eternel aime ceux qui le craignent, Ceux qui espèrent en sa bonté.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በሚፈሩት፥ በምሕረቱም በሚታመኑት ይደሰታል።

verses.en: Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.
verses.fr: Jérusalem, célèbre l''Eternel! Sion, loue ton Dieu!
verses.am: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኚ፥

verses.en: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee.
verses.fr: Car il affermit les barres de tes portes, Il bénit tes fils au milieu de toi;
verses.am: ጽዮንም ሆይ፥ ለአምላክሽ እልል በዪ፤ የደጆችሽን መወርወሪያ አጽንቶአልና፥ ልጆችንም በውስጥሽ ባርኮአልና።

verses.en: He maketh peace in thy borders, and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.
verses.fr: Il rend la paix à ton territoire, Il te rassasie du meilleur froment.
verses.am: በወሰንሽም ሰላምን አደረገ፥ የስንዴንም ስብ አጠገበሽ።

verses.en: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.
verses.fr: Il envoie ses ordres sur la terre: Sa parole court avec vitesse
verses.am: ነገሩን ወደ ምድር ይሰድዳል፥ ቃሉም እጅግ ፈጥኖ ይሮጣል።

verses.en: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.
verses.fr: Il donne la neige comme de la laine, Il répand la gelée blanche comme de la cendre;
verses.am: አመዳዩን እንደ ባዘቶ ይሰጣል፤ ጉሙን እንደ አመድ ይበትነዋል፤

verses.en: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?
verses.fr: Il lance sa glace par morceaux; Qui peut résister devant son froid?
verses.am: በረዶውን እንደ ፍርፋሪ ያወርዳል፤ በበረዶውስ ፊት ማን ይቆማል?

verses.en: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
verses.fr: Il envoie sa parole, et il les fond; Il fait souffler son vent, et les eaux coulent.
verses.am: ቃሉን ልኮ ያቀልጠዋል፤ ነፋሱን ያነፍሳል፥ ውኆችንም ያፈስሳል።

verses.en: He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.
verses.fr: Il révèle sa parole à Jacob, Ses lois et ses ordonnances à Israël;
verses.am: ቃሉን ለያዕቆብ፥ ሥርዓቱንና ፍርዱን ለእስራኤል ይናገራል።

verses.en: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the Lord.
verses.fr: Il n''a pas agi de même pour toutes les nations, Et elles ne connaissent point ses ordonnances. Louez l''Eternel!
verses.am: ለሌሎች አሕዛብ ሁሉ እንዲህ አላደረገም፥ ፍርዱንም አልገለጠላቸውም። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.en: Praise ye the Lord. Praise ye the Lord from the heavens: praise him in the heights.
verses.fr: Louez l''Eternel! Louez l''Eternel du haut des cieux! Louez-le dans les lieux élevés!
verses.am: ሃሌ ሉያ። እግዚአብሔርን ከሰማያት አመስግኑት፤ በአርያም አመስግኑት።

verses.en: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.
verses.fr: Louez-le, vous tous ses anges! Louez-le, vous toutes ses armées!
verses.am: መላእክቱ ሁሉ፥ አመስግኑት፤ ሠራዊቱ ሁሉ፥ አመስግኑት።

verses.en: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.
verses.fr: Louez-le, soleil et lune! Louez-le, vous toutes, étoiles lumineuses!
verses.am: ፀሐይና ጨረቃ፥ አመስግኑት፤ ከዋክብትና ብርሃን ሁሉ፥ አመስግኑት።

verses.en: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that be above the heavens.
verses.fr: Louez-le, cieux des cieux, Et vous, eaux qui êtes au-dessus des cieux!
verses.am: ሰማየ ሰማያት፥ አመስግኑት የሰማያት በላይም ውኃ።

verses.en: Let them praise the name of the Lord: for he commanded, and they were created.
verses.fr: Qu''ils louent le nom de l''Eternel! Car il a commandé, et ils ont été créés.
verses.am: እርሱ ብሎአልና፥ ሆኑም፤ እርሱም አዝዞአልና፥ ተፈጠሩም፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ስም ያመስግኑት።

verses.en: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.
verses.fr: Il les a affermis pour toujours et à perpétuité; Il a donné des lois, et il ne les violera point.
verses.am: ለዘላለም ዓለም አቆማቸው፤ ትእዛዝን ሰጠ፥ አያልፉምም።

verses.en: Praise the Lord from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:
verses.fr: Louez l''Eternel du bas de la terre, Monstres marins, et vous tous, abîmes,
verses.am: እባቦች ጥልቆችም ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ከምድር አመስግኑት፤

verses.en: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapours; stormy wind fulfilling his word:
verses.fr: Feu et grêle, neige et brouillards, Vents impétueux, qui exécutez ses ordres,
verses.am: እሳትና በረዶ አመዳይና ውርጭ፥ ቃሉን የሚያደርግ ዐውሎ ነፋስም፤

verses.en: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:
verses.fr: Montagnes et toutes les collines, Arbres fruitiers et tous les cèdres,
verses.am: ተራሮች ኰረብቶችም ሁሉ፥ የሚያፈራም ዛፍ ዝግባም ሁሉ፤

verses.en: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:
verses.fr: Animaux et tout le bétail, Reptiles et oiseaux ailés,
verses.am: አራዊትም እንስሳትም ሁሉ፥ ተንቀሳቃሾችም የሚበርሩ ወፎችም፤

verses.en: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:
verses.fr: Rois de la terre et tous les peuples, Princes et tous les juges de la terre,
verses.am: የምድር ነገሥታት አሕዛብም ሁሉ፥ አለቆች የምድርም ፈራጆች ሁሉ፥

verses.en: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:
verses.fr: Jeunes hommes et jeunes filles, Vieillards et enfants!
verses.am: ጕልማሶችና ቈነጃጅቶች፥ ሽማግሌዎችና ልጆች፤

verses.en: Let them praise the name of the Lord: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.
verses.fr: Qu''ils louent le nom de l''Eternel! Car son nom seul est élevé; Sa majesté est au-dessus de la terre et des cieux.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ስም ያመስግኑ፤ ስሙ ብቻውን ከፍ ከፍ ብሎአልና፥ ምስጋናውም በሰማይና በምድር ላይ ነው።

verses.en: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the Lord.
verses.fr: Il a relevé la force de son peuple: Sujet de louange pour tous ses fidèles, Pour les enfants d''Israël, du peuple qui est près de lui. Louez l''Eternel!
verses.am: የሕዝቡንም ቀንድ ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋል፤ የቅዱሳኑንም ሁሉ ምስጋና ወደ እርሱ ለቀረበ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ሕዝብ ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋል። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.en: Praise ye the Lord. Sing unto the Lord a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.
verses.fr: Louez l''Eternel! Chantez à l''Eternel un cantique nouveau! Chantez ses louanges dans l''assemblée des fidèles!
verses.am: ሃሌ ሉያ። ለእግዚአብሔር አዲሱን ቅኔ ተቀኙለት፤ ምስጋናው በቅዱሳኑ ጉባኤ ነው።

verses.en: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
verses.fr: Qu''Israël se réjouisse en celui qui l''a créé! Que les fils de Sion soient dans l''allégresse à cause de leur roi!
verses.am: እስራኤል በፈጣሪው ደስ ይበለው፥ የጽዮንም ልጆች በንጉሣቸው ሐሤትን ያድርጉ።

verses.en: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.
verses.fr: Qu''ils louent son nom avec des danses, Qu''ils le célèbrent avec le tambourin et la harpe!
verses.am: ስሙን በዘፈን ያመስግኑ፥ በከበሮና በመሰንቆም ይዘምሩለት።

verses.en: For the Lord taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel prend plaisir à son peuple, Il glorifie les malheureux en les sauvant.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በሕዝቡ ተደስቶአልና፥ የዋሃንንም በማዳኑ ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋልና።

verses.en: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.
verses.fr: Que les fidèles triomphent dans la gloire, Qu''ils poussent des cris de joie sur leur couche!
verses.am: ቅዱሳን በክብር ይመካሉ፤ በምንጣፋቸውም ላይ ሐሤትን ያደርጋሉ።

verses.en: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a two-edged sword in their hand;
verses.fr: Que les louanges de Dieu soient dans leur bouche, Et le glaive à deux tranchants dans leur main,
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ምስጋና በጕሮሮአቸው ነው፤ ሁለት አፍ ያለውም ሰይፍ በእጃቸው ነው፥

verses.en: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;
verses.fr: Pour exercer la vengeance sur les nations, Pour châtier les peuples,
verses.am: በአሕዛብ ላይ በቀልን በሰዎችም መካከል ቅጣትን ያደርጉ ዘንድ፤

verses.en: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
verses.fr: Pour lier leurs rois avec des chaînes Et leurs grands avec des ceps de fer,
verses.am: ንጉሦቻቸውን በሰንሰለት፥ አለቆቻቸውንም በእግር ብረት ያስሩ ዘንድ፤

verses.en: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the Lord.
verses.fr: Pour exécuter contre eux le jugement qui est écrit! C''est une gloire pour tous ses fidèles. Louez l''Eternel!
verses.am: የተጻፈውን ፍርድ ያደርጉባቸው ዘንድ። ለቅዱሳን ሁሉ ይህች ክብር ናት። ሃሌ ሉያ።

verses.en: Praise ye the Lord. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.
verses.fr: Louez l''Eternel! Louez Dieu dans son sanctuaire! Louez-le dans l''étendue, où éclate sa puissance!
verses.am: ሃሌ ሉያ። እግዚአብሔርን በመቅደሱ አመስግኑት፤ በኃይሉ ጠፈር አመስግኑት።

verses.en: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.
verses.fr: Louez-le pour ses hauts faits! Louez-le selon l''immensité de sa grandeur!
verses.am: በችሎቱ አመስግኑት፤ በታላቅነቱ ብዛት አመስግኑት።

verses.en: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.
verses.fr: Louez-le au son de la trompette! Louez-le avec le luth et la harpe!
verses.am: በመለከት ድምፅ አመስግኑት፤ በበገናና በመሰንቆ አመስግኑት።

verses.en: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.
verses.fr: Louez-le avec le tambourin et avec des danses! Louez-le avec les instruments à cordes et le chalumeau!
verses.am: በከበሮና በዘፈን አመስግኑት፤ በአውታርና በእምቢልታ አመስግኑት።

verses.en: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.
verses.fr: Louez-le avec les cymbales sonores! Louez-le avec les cymbales retentissantes!
verses.am: ድምፁ መልካም በሆነ ጸናጽል አመስግኑት፤ እልልታ ባለው ጸናጽል አመስግኑት።

verses.en: Let every thing that hath breath praise the Lord. Praise ye the Lord.
verses.fr: Que tout ce qui respire loue l''Eternel! Louez l''Eternel!
verses.am: እስትንፋስ ያለው ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን ያመስግን። ሃሌ ሉያ።
